rows.name: Ants: Leaf-al Warfare
rows.short_description: Ants: Leaf-Al Warfare is a 2D turn based strategy game where you must command your army of Ants, headed by a Queen, against up to three other foes, being wary of the various environmental hazards. Putting your tactical prowess to good use is the key to victory. War has never been so Leaf-al.
rows.description_html: Ants: Leaf-Al Warfare is a 2D turn based strategy game where you fight other players with their own Ant armies in a turf war. You command your army of Ants and move yourself into tactical positions and select various weapons to take down your opponents. Heading your army is a Queen Ant, who has a special ability unique to each army that can be used to turn the tides in battle. Clever use of your Queen’s abilities is the key to win this game. Losing your Queen will cause your surviving Ants to lose extra health, and you will no longer be able to use your Queen’s ability. You’re not just fighting the enemy teams however, as you’ve also got the environmental hazards lying in wait for you! Whether it be a Venus Flytrap or an unsecured Barbecue, the environment will be just as much a player as you are! The unpredictable combat and toon styled visuals will give you a thrill when you send another Ant launching across the battlefield and into the Pond or even throwing a grenade into a Plant Pot and watching the unlucky adversaries within. With combat like this, war has never been so Leaf-al!

rows.name: DECON Protocol
rows.short_description: Dive into sci-fi alien worlds where you wipe out Alien scourge by deconstructing them into parts to upgrade your base and your DECON unit, allowing you to produce higher outputs, more damage, more gains, and JUST MORE. DECON PROTOCOL is an incremental game with idle and clicker mechanics.
rows.description_html: Welcome to DECON Protocol! GAME DESCRIPTION Dive into sci-fi alien worlds where you deconstruct aliens into parts to upgrade your base.  Attempt to wipe out the Aliens plaguing each planet and build your base and DECON Unit to produce higher outputs, more damage, more gains, and JUST MORE. DECON Protocol offers a challenge to see what heights you can reach. KEY FEATURES Several Overlapping Systems. Deconstruct aliens to gather their pieces and parts in order to upgrade a multitude of systems including: Employee Training, DECON upgrades, DECON Overclocking, Gene Splicing, Studies that grant buffs, Missions, Geode Mines, Toxic Waste trading, and much more. Most systems reset on Wormhole (Prestige), but many also have a SPECIALIZATION BAR which grants permanent upgrades for each system that carry through prestige. There are also daily login bonuses, weekly login bonuses, extra idle gains while playing that store in a chest, and offline progression and gains. Manage your own base today and wipe out the alien scourge overwhelming the planets in your sector!

rows.name: The Day in a Life of a Dayfly
rows.short_description: A melancholic journey through the cemetery... and far beyond its gates.
rows.description_html: Sefirot lives through eight lifetimes, carrying the full weight of her memories from one to the next. Dayflies, born to live only a single day, leave their memories written on leaves, hoping the next will read and remember. At the grave of her beloved, now gone after his eighth and final life, Sefirot meets a dayfly. She agrees to help her find the scattered leaves that hold the forgotten stories of her kind. The Day in a Life of a Dayfly —  a visual novel that came from nowhere but was made with love. Features: 🦋 Unique artwork — a blend of illustrations and photography. 🍃 Original music (menu theme). How to Play:   🍃 Check each character’s “Status” tab in the menu and examine the memory leaves in your inventory to better understand their inner world. 🦋 Unlock two endings based on your choices.

rows.name: Ignis Dei
rows.short_description: Heralded by a comet, seen as a harbinger of doom, the Black Death arrived in Florence in 1348. Wander through the woods to escape the plague, face various riddles and encounter mysterious creatures.
rows.description_html: Foretold by a comet, which many regarded as a harbinger of doom, the Black Death reached Florence in 1348. The epidemic spread rapidly, killing a large portion of the population and leaving a profound impact on European society, economy, and culture. Ignis Dei is a puzzle-horror game inspired by the aforementioned events. The player will find themselves wandering through a forest to escape the plague, solving various puzzles, interacting with mysterious creatures, exploring, observing, and becoming lost in dark and haunting environments. What fate awaits them? EXPLORATION Every step will lead you into the unknown. PUZZLES Interact with the Messanges. MYSTERY Discover what lies behind the arrivial of the comet. Of the great mortality and famine that befell Florence and its surroundings, and of a comet that appeared. In the year 1348, at the end of March, a comet appeared in the sky toward the east, at the end of the sign of Virgo and the beginning of Libra—both human signs, signifying great affliction and death upon human bodies, as we shall say hereafter. The comet itself lasted only a few days, but many evils followed its ominous signs, especially upon our city of Florence. Soon after, a great mortality began, such that those who fell ill scarcely survived. More than a sixth of the citizens died, and many were the best and most beloved—both men and women. No family was spared, with two, three, or more members perishing. The plague lasted until the coming winter. ( Giovanni Villani, Nuova Cronica. Florence, 1348 ) DISCLAIMER Ignis Dei was originally made for the Spaghetti Horror 2025 Game Jam, as such it is a short game aimed to entertain you for about 30 minutes. Some improvements have been made for the Steam release but you might encounters bugs and some parts of the game might appear unfinished due to the short development time. We hope you will enjoy the experience nonetheless.

rows.name: Powwow Bound: A Menominee Homecoming
rows.short_description: Experience the story of a Menominee family reconnecting with their tribal culture and language through the lens of the Menominee Annual Contest Powwow.
rows.description_html: Powwow Bound: A Menominee Homecoming is a 3D narrative-driven adventure game. Experience the story of a Menominee family returning to the reservation for the annual contest powwow. Play as Deborah Jo (DJ) as she works to uncover her mom’s history with the powwow dance circle through narrative set pieces and Powwow-inspired minigames. Learn about traditional dance styles through a rhythm game and take photos of recreated locations set on the Menominee Reservation in Wisconsin.

rows.name: Batta? Batta!
rows.short_description: 'Join the adventure with Battery Knight Beta!'
rows.description_html: Batta Batta Game Introduction Welcome to the distant world of discarded objects, where the old and worn-out envy the new. One day, the discarded items kidnapped the beloved Princess Smartphone, known for her charm! You become an ordinary yet special battery, setting off on an adventure to rescue the princess! ◆ Ride Electronic Devices for Action Hop on electronic devices to unleash unique abilities. Use the distinct powers of each device to fight your enemies! ◆ 2D and 3D Perspective-Switching Puzzles Seamlessly switch between 2D and 3D views during your adventure. Change your perspective to carve out new paths and overcome obstacles! ◆ Adorable and Charming Characters Meet cute and lovable characters in the world of objects! This project was created with the intent of building a portfolio. Development became progressively challenging due to various circumstances, such as team members' job seeking and preparations, leading us to conclude the narrative much earlier than initially envisioned. Should you have the opportunity to play and provide a review, it would significantly contribute to the planning of future projects and my ongoing studies.

rows.name: First Steps in Learning about Pregnancy
rows.short_description: Play as a pregnant woman experiencing daily life from early pregnancy to childbirth prep. Learn about local medical and support systems through interactive choices. Features 1-hour playtime and save/load. Great for those interested in healthcare, education, or social welfare
rows.description_html: Welcome to “First Pregnancy: Matsumoto–Daihoku Area Edition”! This serious game (an educational game designed to address social issues) lets players learn about daily life during pregnancy and the local support systems available. You play as the main character who has just learned she’s pregnant and experience her journey while interacting with her partner, medical professionals, and family. Based on information from the Matsumoto–Daihoku region in Nagano Prefecture, the game naturally introduces local medical systems and support programs. Enjoy the story while deepening your understanding of pregnancy and childbirth. ⸻ Game Features • Experience Pregnancy Through an Interactive Story Play as a woman in early pregnancy and go through daily events such as managing physical changes, attending prenatal checkups, joining parenting classes, and preparing for childbirth. Medical and administrative knowledge is woven naturally into the story. • Branching Choices That Influence the Story The narrative changes depending on your choices in conversations and actions. Each option is accompanied by explanations so that players can learn the appropriate responses through gameplay. • Realistic Settings Based on Local Information Local resources from Matsumoto, Omachi, and Azumino cities are featured, including maternal and child health handbooks, medical expense subsidies, hometown deliveries, and postpartum care. ⸻ Highlights • Approx. 1-hour playtime with save/load functions • Suitable not only for pregnant individuals but also for healthcare students, educators, high school students, and those considering pregnancy • Learn about the social systems that support pregnancy and childbirth in an engaging way ⸻ Development Background This game was developed with support from the Nagano Prefectural “Regional Vitality Promotion Fund.” It was planned and supervised by a pediatrician from the Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University School of Medicine, with contributions from medical students and childcare support volunteers. It is widely used as an educational tool to help people understand the real-life flow of medical and welfare services. ⸻ Recommended For • Pregnant individuals • Students and young people interested in pregnancy and childbirth • Educators and professionals in childcare and welfare • Those with pregnant partners or family members • Anyone interested in learning about local support systems ⸻ Development Team • Developer: M-Terrace • Supervision: Matsumoto–Daihoku Regional Birth and Childcare Safety Network Council • Planning: Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University School of Medicine (Dr. Yukihide Miyosawa) ⸻ Medical Disclaimer This game is intended for educational and awareness purposes only. It does not substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you are experiencing health concerns or unusual symptoms, please consult a physician or midwife. ⸻ Begin your journey through pregnancy in the beautiful natural surroundings and warm support of Shinshu. Deepen your understanding of pregnancy and childbirth with “First Pregnancy: Matsumoto–Ōhoku Area Edition.”

rows.name: Enrobssyba
rows.short_description: Enrobssyba is a dark fantasy roguelite that thrusts you into a shadowed, ever-changing dungeon, teeming with enemies, upgrades, and untold power.
rows.description_html: Abyssborne is a dark fantasy roguelite Abyssborne thrusts you into a shadowed, ever-changing dungeon, teeming with enemies, upgrades, and untold power. Master Dynamic Combat Engage in fast-paced, reactive combat where every strike matters. Face a wide variety of unique enemies and grow stronger with each battle. Grow Stronger with Every Step Progress through the ever-changing dungeon, unlock new abilities, and evolve your playstyle. Each run brings you closer to mastering the darkness. Uncover the Secrets of the Abyss Progress deeper into the dungeon to piece together the cryptic story. Discover hidden letters and uncover the dark mysteries buried within the Abyss.

rows.name: Bartholomew.exe
rows.short_description: In this short FPS horror experience you are thrown into a maze where the game's state shifts between Nightmare and Dream, you are hunted by the monster Bartholomew in the nightmare and you get to hunt him in the dream. Upgrade your revolver, stock up on traps and kill Bartholomew.
rows.description_html: Can you survive the nightmare and take control of the dream? You wake up in the maze of the monster - Bartholomew. In this maze, reality shifts between nightmare and dream , a constant cat and mouse chase where you take contrasting roles in each state. During the Dream State you will need to chase Bartholomew and try your best to put him down with your trusty revolver however you need to be quick before the nightmare state begins anew. In the Nightmare State, You are disarmed and hunted, the only viable options are your traps that can help slow down the monstrosity chasing you. Collect the coins scattered along the maze so you can buy upgrades for your revolver and additional traps to kill the beast faster. Don't stop running, don't stop hunting. HE. IS. Bartholomew...

rows.name: Hop n' Hook
rows.short_description: Hop n' Hook is a platforming-fishing game set across three distinct zones, built around movement, exploration, and collection. Swing with your rod, explore open-ended zones, and catch over 100 unique fish—some of which fight back in reactive boss encounters.
rows.description_html: Hop n' Hook is a platforming-fishing game set across three distinct zones, built around movement, exploration, and collection.  You play as Hoppe Jr., using a fishing rod that doubles as a grappling hook. Swing across gaps, scale cliffs, and cast into remote ponds to reel in over 50 unique fish. Some are simple. Others fight back—pulling you into short, reactive boss encounters that break the calm with bursts of tension. The world is open and layered with secrets. Optional quests and side paths reward players who take their time, while platforming challenges and precision grappling keep movement fast and satisfying. There’s no combat. No timers. Just a steady rhythm of hopping, casting, and exploring a world that quietly unfolds as you go.

rows.name: Astral Lodge
rows.short_description: A short 2D point-and-click room escape game in the spirit of flash games of the early internet. Explore a surreal, dreamlike room, using objects and clues to interact with the environment and escape.
rows.description_html: Astral Lodge is a short but sweet 2D point-and-click room escape game in the spirit of early 2000s Flash games. Explore a surreal, dreamlike environment rendered entirely with hand-drawn assets and painted backgrounds. Set across seven fixed camera views of a single strange room, Astral Lodge invites players to solve 3–4 environmental puzzles using object interactions and visual clues. Your skeletal cursor glows green over interactive elements, and a visible inventory at the bottom of the screen allows you to use items you collect directly in the scene.  There are no save states, menus, or customization options—just a linear, ambient, and slightly eerie point-and-click experience. Perfect for fans of obscure web-based games from the early internet, Astral Lodge delivers a singular mood in under 30 minutes. The game runs in a fixed 1280x960 resolution and can be exited at any time by closing the window. Story, art, music/sfx and game design by James Ryan Wallker.

rows.name: NEODITRONIX
rows.short_description: THE DREAMCORE RHYTHM EXPERIENCE
rows.description_html: NEODITRONIX is the dreamcore rhythm experience, available as a web-based, standalone freeware title. HEAR various sounds with frenetic rhythm gameplay, utilizing unique lane lasers. RECOLLECT memories with a full narrative exploring lost dreams. KINETIC RHYTHMIC ACTION Challenge yourself with traditional rhythm arcade 4k action, flipped upside down with a unique lane-shifting mechanic. Use your mouse to move the lanes along the line while handling the 4 lanes simultaneously! The game offers 3 ( ? ) different difficulties: Lite, Neon, and Enigma, for those looking to set the adversity to their liking. A HAUNTING, DREAMY ADVENTURE Enter the dreamworld. Awake in a spaceship with no memories and a strange, mysterious companion in tow, hear Shiro 's past in 2D side-scrolling vignettes in the Adventure mode. Uncover the secrets of Shiro's past and the universe surrounding him. FEATURES A love letter to rhythm games, narrative games, and the SKY HOUR WORKS doujin circle, published as a part of our  6th anniversary! Including playable tracks from takehirotei, Tatsuoto, Kyotsugyon, DeBisco, Frums, and more! Future updates will include new story content, accessibility features, playable tracks, and secrets. creature

rows.name: Ice Dodo
rows.short_description: INSANE PARKOUR GAME IN OUTER SPACE. Using left and right arrow buttons, bring the character to the finish line. But watch out -- if you hit the cones or fall off the platform, then you must restart! All 711 maps totally unlocked!
rows.description_html: Ice Dodo is a 3D parkour game in outer space. This game is a decade old and it is finally available on Steam. With simple controls, avoid falling off the slippery ice or hitting the cones. In this game, you can press left and right to steer the player (called a dodo). Hitting up arrow will make the player jump, and hitting down arrow will make the player drift on certain parts of the map. This game has an in-game level editor. However, it is not available on Steam right now. Anyways, Ice Dodo has around 800 levels and they are all totally unlocked except at the very start of the game. The OG cup and Dodo cup contain maps made by Seojoon Yeon, the developer, with the rest having been designed by the community. If you are a fan of Roblox or Minecraft parkour, this game is absolutely for you. But what makes Ice Dodo unique is that you can not stop the forward movement of the player. Reaction time is crucial. Fun history of Ice Dodo: Seojoon Yeon created this game as a Chrome Extension back when he was 13 years old as a fun way for his classmates to play games during school lectures. Now it is available to play on the website and on Steam!

Fun history of Ice Dodo: Seojoon Yeon created this game as a Chrome Extension back when he was 13 years old as a fun way for his classmates to play games during school lectures. Now it is available to play on the website and on Steam!
rows.reviews_html: “And for all you gamers out there, Ice Dodo is a fast-paced 3D platforming game that requires balance, speed and finesse.” 10 – Google

rows.name: Voden's Job
rows.short_description: Play cards that draw cards, that draw more cards, that earn you DNA to evolve your specimen.
rows.description_html: Voden's Job is a small roguelike deckbuilding game where you have 7 rounds of experiments to collect enough DNA to evolve your specimen. Between each experiment, you can upgrade your deck with new cards, combos, and strange tools. The catch? Upgrading costs DNA, so you'll need to carefully balance how much you're willing to spend each round. The rules are simple : each experiment round is about playing Mutation cards until you run out of options. Mutation cards have a cost, paid with Eye cards, and each one has a different effect, like drawing more cards or gaining DNA. A Mutation is too weak ? Just throw in some Enzyme cards to unleash powerful combos . Features 37 unique cards, including Mutation, Eye, and Enzyme types 5 powerful tools to amplify card effects and tilt the odds in your favor Fast-paced, streamlined gameplay Endless replayability: each round is different Atmospheric soundtrack mixed with splatter-style sound design Rich pixel art visuals with plenty of juicy effects

rows.name: Calm the Storm
rows.short_description: A free narrative experiment in accessible gaming.
rows.description_html: Theo and Kallie are on their way out for a fun night at the club. Little do they know that monsters lurk in the shadows...  waiting for a patsy, a snack, or maybe a saviour. The night will tell. Calm the Storm is a branching game that combines the experience of a narrative podcast with the interactive decision-making of a choose-your-own-path story or visual novel, letting the listener choose their preferred outcome for the story. Will Theo unlock hidden powers? Will Kallie take arms and fight a vampire? Only you can decide. Ludic Lemur is excited to release this narrative experiment to audiences for free. And it is an experiment. We're pretty sure this hands-free, voice-controllable adventure is the first game of its kind, intended to be accessible for people who are visually impaired, with closed captioning for people who are Deaf and/or hard of hearing and a voice-command interface for people with manual and/or visual impairments.  Since launching, we have collected feedback from Playability, AccessAbility, and a core group of players. We've updated the prototype with accessibility adjustments, including the ability to pause, skip forward, and some graphic updates. We are hard at work on a new, full-length game that will pick up where Calm the Storm left off. Follow this game in order to get updates about that companion game. *Please note, Calm the Storm contains mild profanity and low-gore violence.

rows.name: Delfini
rows.short_description: Delfini is a gentle and delicate two-player cooperative ocean exploration game, it is about a moving journey where two dolphins bravely save the polluted coral reef island.
rows.description_html: Delfini is a gentle and delicate two-player cooperative ocean exploration game, it is about a moving journey where two dolphins bravely save the polluted coral reef island. In this clear ocean world, players will accompany two dolphins as they rescue their fellow sea creature friends, who are trapped by harmful substances, to encounter a story of friendship, hope, and healing. You and your friend will guide these two dolphins to clean up the polluted coral reefs, which is not only about preserving the marine environment but also about building friendships and maintaining protection. During your exploration, the rescued sea creature friends will join your team to support and help you protect the coral world under the sea. The soothing music, combined with the relaxing gameplay, will bring a calming and healing feeling to players, making Delfini a game where you can unwind with friends and soothe your soul from busy life routines. Here in Delfini, every action is meaningful, and every coral reef cleanup represents a new hope for the sea. Whether you are playing the game to protect the environment, for appreciation, or to feel touched by Delfini's poetic story, you will always find your own rhythm under the sea.

rows.name: MOLD
rows.short_description: Mold is a beautifully haunting exploration game. Scurry around the decaying sewers as a bug in a dying colony. Collect corpses of your kin to bring to your infected queen, as it is your only purpose.
rows.description_html: The world is decaying. MOLD consumes everything Explore this rotten world from the perspective of an insignificant worker bug doing what it can to keep its queen alive. Climb through sewer pipes and over the soft mold-covered husks of others like you. Mold is a beautifully haunting exploration game. Scurry around the decaying sewers as a bug in a dying colony. This game was created by Finley Southwick for Ringling College of Art and Design's Game Art department. MOLD is a very short narrative and atmospheric collection and exploration game. You can crawl on any surface-- along walls, and ceilings to collect the corpses of your kin to bring to your infected queen, as it is your only purpose as you dodge deadly fungal spores that will result in your grotesque end!

rows.name: Dark Neighbors
rows.short_description: Overview: a mischievously fun action game where you're one of the kids from the 'Darkien Crew' on a mission to turn a picture-perfect suburban neighborhood into your personal splash zone. Armed with beautiful red water balloons and other cool items.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Dark Neighbors , a mischievously fun action game where you're one of the kids from the 'Darkien Crew' on a mission to turn a picture-perfect suburban neighborhood into your personal splash zone. Armed with beautiful red water balloons and other cool items, you and your crew sneak through white-picket-fence-lined streets, dodging nosy neighbors, police, and meddling children as you soak every grumpy adult in sight. Your main targets? The Angry Neighbors – the ones who yell if your bike touches their grass or if your music is “too loud.” Take aim, time your throws, and unleash watery chaos without getting caught. Each house has a nosey neighbor ready to hurt you for disturbing the peace. Play solo or host an online game with friends in online co-op, unlock your special powerful move and become the legend of the cul-de-sac. Beautifully rendered in cartoonish suburban bliss, this game is a chaotic blend of stealth, strategy, and summer fun. Suburbia will never be the same again. Ready, aim… SPLASH!

rows.name: Fading Lights
rows.short_description: A first person detective game inspired by return of obra dinn where you have to interact with various items inside a house and unlock old memories to rebuild your Family Tree.
rows.description_html: Step into the fading memories of Max, an elderly man living with dementia. This narrative-driven first-person detective game invites you to explore Max’s home, uncover forgotten fragments of his past, and slowly piece together his family tree while experiencing the world through his perspective. You play as Max, wandering through his house filled with everyday objects that spark vivid but fragile memories. Each object leads to an interactive scene from Max’s daily life but also some defining moments, while also revealing the symptoms of dementia. Between memories, you’ll piece together the family tree, connecting names and relationships using the clues you’ve gathered. A unique feature of the game is its dual art style, designed to emphasize the contrast between reality and memory. Max’s present-day home is depicted in a realistic and darker style, grounding the player in the weight of his current life. In contrast, his memories unfold in a cutesy, surreal aesthetic, filled with bright colors and softened shapes. This shift highlights that these scenes are not reality, but fragile, idealized fragments of the past, beautiful, yet fleeting. The game features an emotional soundtrack designed to complement the fragile, dreamlike atmosphere of Max’s memories, with subtle audio cues that guide the player and intensify the emotional impact of key moments. Gameplay Features • Exploration & Discovery: Search Max’s home for objects that unlock memory sequences. • Memory Diving: Enter Max’s fading recollections, where you gather clues and experience his life events from his perspective. • Symptom-Based Challenges: Each memory reflects a different symptom of dementia, from disorientation to false memories, creating unique gameplay twists. • Family Tree Reconstruction: Use the clues you uncover to rebuild Max’s family tree. After each memory, connect names and relationships in the UI to gradually restore his history. • Dialog Review System: Revisit conversations and hints in the UI to ensure you never miss a crucial detail. Unlike traditional puzzle or detective games, this experience blends storytelling with psychological authenticity. By tying each gameplay sequence to a symptom of dementia, players don’t just uncover Max’s story, they feel what it’s like to live with his condition. The result is a deeply empathetic, emotional journey about memory, identity, and family.

rows.name: Goodbye
rows.short_description: A story-driven interactive game about a sweet old lady and a mysterious figure. Follow her daily routine by completing a simple task list, until it’s time to make an unusual deal with the One Who’s Waiting. And please, do not say “goodbye.”
rows.description_html: You have just discovered a piece of my heart. Welcome to the world of a sweet old lady, who is trying to reconnect with her granddaughter. Enjoy your cozy routine, like baking buns, feeding the birdies, and keeping your soul intact. Eventually, take care of an unexpected guest . Features: A heartfelt and emotional story about an old lady and the One Who’s Waiting. 15–20 minutes of first-person gameplay. Charming, soothing music. Immersive voice acting. Beautiful, cozy environment. A hidden secret waiting to be discovered on the map. Controls: W, A, S, D – Walk F – Interact R – Open reminder E – Light a candle RB – Pick up fire lamp We'll meet again.

rows.name: Narrow One
rows.short_description: Join fast-paced archery battles where you and your teammates fight to capture the enemy flag medieval style. Master your bow, and outplay the enemy in tactical 5v5 matches
rows.description_html: This game is all about capturing flags. Fight your way into enemy territory and steal their flag. Use hidden paths and clever routes to sneak past enemy defenses. Once you’ve got the flag, you’ll be target number one. Team up with friends, cover each other, and battle your way to victory. Fast-paced 5v5 action built for skillful play. Jump into quick, intense matches with friends or solo. Choose from 6 distinct classes, each with its own team role, like the speedy Runner for flag captures or the Support class for covering teammates from afar. Find your playstyle, own your role, and lead your team to victory. Easy to learn, tough to master — that’s where the real challenge and fun begins. There’s tons of gear to unlock. Earn coins by playing rounds and explore the shop for outfits, weapons, bow skins, arrows, tattoos, and more. Mix and match to create your own unique look, and now it’s time to flex on the battlefield. There are 17+ unique maps to explore, each with its own vibe and secrets. From Samurai castles and desert oases to Viking forts and Greek sky temples, every map has their own theme. Alternate map versions will force you to adapt your routes. Plus, changing weather every round means you’ll need to stay sharp. Features: 5v5 online multiplayer flag capture 6 different bows with customisable skins 50+ different melee weapons Customizable characters and gear Squad up with friends Controller, touchscreen & gamepad support Seasonal content 17+ unique maps Regular new content Weekly gamemodes

rows.name: Laser Harp VR
rows.short_description: You too can be a stealth major You will be the organizer and make the live show a success!　Please note that the instrument to be handled is the “Laser Harp”.
rows.description_html: Become the Stealth Major. Take center stage and play the laser harp in a VR rhythm game that transforms performance into pure expression. This is not just about hitting notes—this is about becoming the music. Featuring a collection of original tracks across various genres, this immersive VR experience invites players to step into a dynamic concert space where light and sound respond to your every move. Key Features Immersive Live-Style VR Stage ： Experience music-reactive lighting and visual effects that shift with every beat. Laser Harp Interaction ： Use your hands to perform with a virtual laser harp—intuitive, engaging, and expressive. Easy to Learn, Expressive to Master ： Designed with accessibility in mind, focusing on musical expression over technical difficulty. Original Music Across Genres  ：Tracks range from 1 to 5 minutes, offering a wide variety of moods and styles to explore. Score if you like—but the true reward is expressing the music in your own unique way. *The Early Access version is currently experiencing compatibility issues with the HTC Vive headset and may not work properly. A fix is planned for the production version.

Fish out ancient treasures, upgrade your fishing abilities, and face your biggest regrets in this narrative fishing game! Will you manage to fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life?
rows.description_html: Fishing! Dialogue! Upgrades! The unbearable weight of a lifetime's worth of regrets! Enjoy a bite-sized narrative fishing experience! Fish out a variety of ancient treasures, make small talk with your local low-level demon companion, and attempt to come to terms with the fact your will never get back all the time you wasted, or reconcile all the bad choices you made in life. That is, of course, unless you can fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life. Many have tried for thousands of years, but you will be the one to finally do it, right? Featuring: Fun dialogue with your assigned demon   A variety of fishing upgrades Tons of ancient treasures to fish out Enjoy your afterlife! Trust me, it gets better after the first few centuries. rows.name: taking my Dark Knight Girlfriend to the corner store
rows.short_description: A beautiful Dark Knightess from another world enlisted me in her quest to slay a rogue wizard, and now we're dating! But what if she finds out I have no idea who the Gray Wizard is?!
rows.description_html: Dana is a mostly normal girl living a mostly normal life until one day, Brunhilde- a fearsome Dark Knight from another realm- tears through a portal in the sky and asks Dana to guide her to find and slay the mysterious Gray Wizard. Instantly, Dana enlists herself as Brunhilde's companion and guide, promising to help her find her prize in this unfamiliar world - all while praying Brunhilde never catches onto the fact that Dana has no idea who she's looking for. In 'Taking My Dark Knight Girlfriend to the Corner Store,' accompany Dana as she takes her girlfriend out on a grocery trip and live a day in the life of a woman living with a Dark Knight. Experience the thrill of picking out snacks for a servant of Evil, argue that winning a claw machine is essential to her quest, and don't let her kill anyone! About 10k words and 1 hour of gameplay One true ending (and one silly ending) with fun choices along the way Cute, hand-drawn artwork with full CGs Lesbian t4t romance Tuss

rows.name: Bad Golf
rows.short_description: Don't let the name fool you! A former Xbox Live Indie Games hidden gem, Bad Golf is a casual yet competitive multiplayer 2D golf game. Play a relaxing round by yourself or a frantic golf race with local or online friends.
rows.description_html: Bad Golf is a casual but competitive multiplayer 2D golf game. Play local multiplayer or online with friends for lowest score or fastest time. Originally published for the Xbox Live Indie Games platform, it became an indie darling receiving international acclaim. Actual internet comments: 'The game is the most fun with more than one player ... as players do not take 'turns', everyone just fires away until they make it at the same time.' 'Bad Golf on XBLIG is great and the cause of plenty of shouting at the TV at my place.' 'Bad Golf is actually pretty good.'

rows.name: Paper Pusher
rows.short_description: A short atmospheric psychological horror game. Locked in a corporate contract, you must decide who lives and who dies based only on details that can be written down about them. How will you justify your choices?
rows.description_html: (This game is about 1 hour long and must be completed in one sitting) Become a family member of Extricate Inc. We are the most ethical non-consensual euthanasia service available in the US government. As a Paper Pusher, you will be the one who decides who gets extinguished and who gets extricated. These choices will be made based on metrics like age, gender, job, income, physical abnormalities, drug use, and much more! This job also comes with a complimentary apartment for the time of your contract and an Extricate Home Entertainment System for you to enjoy during your downtime! Main Workload As an Extricate Inc. Paper Pusher, you will be filling papers. Each paper will be associated with a person, including details about their name, age, gender, job, and other relevant information. You then will make a decision of if that person is Extricated (Saved) or Extinguished (Killed). Each day will have 5 papers. Only two people can be Extricated per day. (This game learns who you are and what you care about in a person as you play.)

rows.name: Ice Cream Typer
rows.short_description: A fast-paced typing arcade game where each round gives you less time to type bizarre phrases. Test your speed, accuracy, and endurance in an endless challenge that gets harder every step
rows.description_html: Ice Cream Typer  is a high-speed typing challenge where the only way forward is faster fingers. Inspired by the infamous fitness test and arcade classics, this mode throws you into an endless typing gauntlet. Complete ridiculous words and phrases under pressure—each round gives you less time, and one slip-up could be the end. It’s goofy, intense, and surprisingly addictive. How It Works: A phrase appears on screen. You type it. Quickly and correctly. The next round starts… with even less time. Repeat until you break—or beat your high score. Key Features: Pacer Test Mode with Increasing Difficulty: The timer gets shorter every round. Stay sharp or get dropped. Speed & Accuracy-Based Scoring: Points and combos scale with how fast (and clean) you type. Goofy Word Prompts:  The cat did what? Cheerful, Upbeat Vibes: Lighthearted music and satisfying sound effects keep the energy high. Simple & Focused: Just your keyboard, a timer, and a screen full of sweetness.

rows.name: Bound Between Desks
rows.short_description: A mystical visual novel where ordinary school life intertwines with mysterious phenomena. Every decision you make could lead to uncovering secrets... or plunge you into even greater uncertainty.
rows.description_html: Welcome to a school where nothing is quite what it seems. Bound Between Desks is a story-driven visual novel set in an ordinary school that's hiding something. Beneath the surface of regular classes and casual conversations, there's a darker mystery waiting to be uncovered. The choices you make will determine not only how the story unfolds, but what truths you'll discover along the way. Key Features Complex Characters Build relationships, earn trust, or watch it crumble as you dig deeper into their secrets. How you interact with each character directly affects where the story goes. An Unsettling Setting The school looks normal enough at first glance. But as you explore its classrooms, hallways, and forgotten corners, the boundary between reality and something stranger starts to blur. How far are you willing to go for answers? Meaningful Choices Your decisions matter. With over four different endings and multiple variations, no two playthroughs are the same. Each choice you make reveals a different piece of the puzzle. Striking Anime-Style Visuals The game features expressive character art and carefully composed scenes that pull you into the school's tense, mysterious atmosphere. Immersive Soundtrack Experience deeper immersion through a soundtrack that highlights every moment of tension, mystery, and revelation. The music amplifies each emotion and enhances the atmosphere of every scene. What Awaits You Cross-Platform Gaming : Play on Windows, macOS, Linux Rich Storyline : 5+ chapters of gripping narrative with updates. Multiple Endings : Discover all secrets through various story paths Full Localization : Complete support for Russian and English languages(will add other after release) Genre and Atmosphere This is a mystery visual novel with psychological elements and touches of horror. The school starts off feeling safe and familiar, but that sense of normalcy won't last. You'll question what's real, who you can trust, and what's lurking just out of sight. If you like visual novels with strong writing, impactful choices, and tension that sticks with you after you've closed the game, this one's for you. Discover the truth. Make your choices. Decide who—and what—matters most.

rows.name: SCP: Yet Another Day
rows.short_description: SCP: Yet Another Day is a mess of genres RPG where a dysfunctional friend group must get it together to escape a monster filled facility and survive a psychopathic terrorist, expect madness
rows.description_html: ACT 1 RELEASED! future acts   soon The SCP foundation was once a prestigious organization dedicated to maintaining order in the world and containing supernatural anomalies however today, the SCP facility has fallen into madness with it's management dominated by brain rotted morons and it's power worsening day by day.... not only allowing the dangers contained within to break out but also a certain bloodthirsty intruder to infiltrate in, only a matter of time before all hell breaks loose in the fever dream chaos of the story. The brain rotted morons that reside down in the facility each have a quirk uniquely wrong with them (from the schizophrenic addict lars, a d class inmate of the facility to our protagonist cat girl sinner, the reincarnation of the demon the scarlet king) as they all play a role within the group dynamic whilst also having their own concealed arcs and ambitions under the surface... not all of these arcs will be completed however as no one is safe from the narratives brutality so not all will survive... SCP: Yet Another Day's combat uses a hybrid gameplay system between a dynamic RPG and a turn based card game, blend card combinations together to create absurd decks that exploit the games mechanics to clear your enemies, culminating in deadly bosses that put your skills to the challenge and demand calculated adapting to win. AN EXPANSIVE LORE - The history of the foundation stretches across time and beyond with several secrets behind the scenes to be put together presenting a layered mystery. UNIQUE PLAYTHROUGHS - Depending on what traits are chosen by the player the dialogue they experience will be specialized to them allowing them to discover information others do not. THE CHAOS INSURGENCY HAS HIJACKED THIS DESCRIPTION - Do not be fooled by the foundation, they are corrupt and not what they seem... this must be stopped, that is why we at the chaos insurgency, the greatest faction in the verse are calling YOU to join the rebellion and FIGHT BACK! PLAY ACT 1 NOW!!!

rows.name: Panzer Kliker
rows.short_description: Idle tank-building clicker game with retro pixel-art style. Assemble parts, recruit crew, and upgrade your war machine to climb the ranks - even while you're away!
rows.description_html: 🔧 Build the tank of your dreams — one click at a time! In Panzer Klicker Mk I , you take on the role of engineer, commander, and clicker-in-chief. Your mission: construct the ultimate armored beast by collecting parts, assembling a crew. 🪖 Gameplay: Earn points by clicking tank. Spend your resources on tank parts (tracks, guns, armor) and recruit your elite crew – from commander to loader and two gunners. Every upgrade boosts your clicking efficiency! 🌄 Retro style, modern destruction Classic pixel-art visuals Simple interface – parts on the left, crew on the right, YOUR TANK in the center Score and rank system – climb to the general! Unlock hidden upgrades and experimental tech! Will your machine dominate the battlefield or end up a pile of scrap? One click can make the difference... 🛠 Panzer Klicker Mk I – Click & build!

rows.name: 원 샷(One Shot)
rows.short_description: One Shot is a top-down shooting game set in the Wild West. A former sheriff, burning with vengeance after his son is kidnapped, heads into an outlaw hideout to wipe them out. Arm yourself well and prepare for one-shot kills.
rows.description_html: One Shot is a top-down shooter set in the Wild West. A former sheriff, enraged after his son is kidnapped, heads into the outlaw’s den for revenge. Gear up with a variety of weapons and prepare for one-shot kills. A single mistake means death. One-Shot, One-Kill Gunfights Every enemy dies in a single shot — but so do you. Equip revolvers, bullets, focused shots, and trinkets to craft your unique loadout. There’s no need to unlock gear. Experiment with all kinds of builds. No Cover, No Tricks All enemies are ready to shoot at you. At least they’re only using guns. There are no walls to hide behind — but luckily, your bullets won’t get stuck either.

rows.name: The Asterion
rows.short_description: Asterion is a stylized rogue-like adventure inspired by Greek mythology. Explore the Labyrinth, face the Minotaur, and uncover a haunting story of gods, betrayal, and survival.
rows.description_html: 🧵 Enter the Labyrinth Asterion is a rogue-like action-adventure set in the mythological Labyrinth of Knossos. Play as Theseus , guided by Ariadne , and explore a shifting maze full of traps, spirits, and forgotten secrets. ⚔️ Features 🧠 Environmental puzzles inspired by Daedalus’ inventions 🧵 Procedurally generated labyrinth floors 👻 Enemies from Greek myth: shades, animated statues... 🧪 Mythical artifacts: Ares' Rage, Eolus' Claw, Icarus' Wings... 🗣️ Atmospheric storytelling through voice lines and cutscenes 🎨 A unique visual style inspired by ancient frescoes and modern indie games 🎯 A Game of Choice and Consequence You’re not just fighting the Minotaur — you’re fighting your fate. Each run uncovers new fragments of the myth, as you piece together your destiny.

rows.name: DepthLess
rows.short_description: A surreal first-person platformer horror game where you descend into nightmarish architecture, solve spatial puzzles, and survive grotesque creatures.
rows.description_html: DepthLess does not follow a traditional story. Instead, it delivers a deeply atmospheric experience — a descent through surreal, decaying environments filled with disturbingly unnatural creatures and oppressive silence. There are no dialogues, cutscenes, or exposition. Every step forward leads you deeper into environments that become increasingly abstract, corrupted, and hostile. The real narrative is your journey downward — facing the unknown, solving subtle spatial puzzles, and surviving a world that clearly wasn't made for humans. There is no traditional story in DepthLess. Instead, the experience itself is the story — a wordless descent through isolated architecture, shifting environments, and your own perception. With every fall, the world becomes more distorted. There is no narrator, no cutscene. Only space, sound, and your decisions. **rapidly press R and Spacebar** to move forward. It might feel tricky at first, but once you get used to it, it becomes much easier!

rows.name: Lloyd the Monkey: Remastered
rows.short_description: A mysterious girl falls from the sky and sets simian swordsman Lloyd Zaru on an adventure that will change his world forever!
rows.description_html: The first installment of the Lloyd the Monkey trilogy has arrived on Steam in a remastered form, rebuilt from the ground up to create the ideal version of the classic platformer! Centuries have passed since the new millennium, and not only has humanity taken to the stars, but our closest relatives have evolved to match us and have created a society all their own in the Amazon jungle, a paradise where nature and technology blend in harmony. But destiny dictates that life never stays the same for very long, as a mysterious, bushy-tailed girl has fallen from the sky and, with nowhere else to go, has taken up residence with the Zaru brothers Lloyd and Arnie. Unbeknownst to all, this girl’s presence has attracted the attention of a seedy group of gorillas who have claimed land still poisoned by the sins of the past as their base. For there is a secret hidden from all parties that will soon change the lives of everyone who gets tangled up in it. The Lloyd the Monkey saga is about to begin! Features: All twelve stages from the HMTL5 version, combined into six maps. Classical music complementing the original score. Retro aesthetics invoking the 16-bit classics. Polygonal 3D Special Stages.

rows.name: Justice Became Prey
rows.short_description: Ali, who lives an ordinary life, loses all the happiness and peace he once had in a single day. And with a glimmer of hope, he begins searching for the peace he can no longer find in this world — for himself and his little sister.
rows.description_html: You wake up and everything is in its place — your family, your home, your hopes, and your peace. Then, someone who has lost their humanity — and with it, all their values — comes and rips away your happiness. You have two choices: Give up and accept your helplessness? Or fight for your life and your hopes? Key Features: 🎯 Story-Driven FPS Gameplay : A blend of action and narrative. 🎭 Emotional Narrative : Themes of justice, regret, inner journey, and personal reckoning. 🧠 Stealth or Action : Dive headfirst into the action or take the silent path through stealth gameplay. 🎧 Sound & Music : Music that enhances and supports the storytelling experience. Explosives, knives, guns, bullets, endless sand, pain, destruction, and corrupted souls... But this game focuses more on emotions than weapons, on silence more than explosions, and on inner reckoning rather than rage. If you're looking for a meaningful first-person shooter experience with a powerful story, this journey is made for you.

rows.name: Peach Tangle
rows.short_description: A boy and a girl, and a story about defeating loneliness in a mysterious forest. A short and heartwarming romance visual novel where you get to know the cute tomboy Mira! Animated sexual scenes, great music and award-winning art!
rows.description_html: A boy and a girl,  and a story about defeating loneliness in a mysterious forest. Peach Tangle is a visual novel with fully animated scenes, including all the sex scenes! Get to know a cute girl with a unique personality and explore a beautifully rendered forest full of secrets, in this short, gripping story! A story full of drama, comedy and mystery. Characters Wendel A loner, half by choice, half by necessity.  Fundamentally a good guy, he's very pleasant if you take the effort to get to know him. The problem is he rarely makes that effort himself, and other people don't really have a reason to either. So all his life he's had very few close friends and even fewer girls. Mira A strong-willed girl. She doesn't see it herself, but people often call her a tomboy. She's always looking out for other people, even if it means a bunch of extra work for herself. Despite hardships, she does her best to stay cheerful. Features: 2-4 Hours of reading time. HD 1080P - Enjoy the game with HD graphics and illustrations. Animated sex scenes. 14+ fantastic music tracks. Everything crafted lovingly by human hands, no AI. 3D characters & BGs mixed with 2D hand painted artworks. If you like the game hit me up on Patreon to help me make more games! (AhaNubis @ Patreon)

The problem is he rarely makes that effort himself, and other people don't really have a reason to either. So all his life he's had very few close friends and even fewer girls. Mira A strong-willed girl. She doesn't see it herself, but people often call her a tomboy. She's always looking out for other people, even if it means a bunch of extra work for herself. Despite hardships, she does her best to stay cheerful. Features: 2-4 Hours of reading time. HD 1080P - Enjoy the game with HD graphics and illustrations. Animated sex scenes. 14+ fantastic music tracks. rows.name: Catanks
rows.short_description: Catanks is a 3D game created by students from UPGRADE, reimagining nostalgic tank combat with decisive third-person cat-piloted gameplay.
rows.description_html: Blast your way through feline fun with Catanks! Follow an immersive level-styled campaign with unique rodent enemies and homely yet hazardous environments, or battle nonstop against explosive combatants in riveting classic missions. Catanks is a 3D game created by students from UPGRADE, reimagining nostalgic tank combat with decisive third-person cat-piloted gameplay. Features: Campaign: Defend your home from the invading rats in exciting 3rd person tank gameplay in Catanks's campaign! Each level introduces new mechanics and challenges, such as navigating around sharp obstacles or fending off heavy artillery. Classic Mode: Test your skills against 50 consecutive top-down arcade-style levels with the objective to kill all enemies in each level. Each level becomes more difficult than the last and raises the stakes. Special Abilities: Use two special Catank abilities to help blast your way through levels. Rocket Cat is for those who want more firepower while Bubble Cat allows you to slip by enemies without taking damage. Achievements: Unlock Steam achievements by completing feats of skill such as beating the game in an unconventional way!

rows.name: INFLAMED
rows.short_description: NO INFLATION WITHOUT REPRESENTATION! UNITE and fight for the rights of wacky Inflatables everywhere by causing destructive mayhem through a campaign of protests staged across the nation. Flop and Flail together in a memorable righteous rampage.
rows.description_html: UNITE and fight for the rights of wacky Inflatables everywhere by causing destructive mayhem through a campaign of protests staged across the nation. Flop and Flail together in a memorable righteous rampage. INFLAMED is the winner of the Georgia Game Developer Association's 2024 'Best in Georgia' competition. Initially developed during the 48-hour Global Game Jam, Inflamed underwent an additional month of development to produce the BiG Submission downloadable demo, which is now on Steam for the world to play! CONTROLLER RECOMMENDED! Left Stick to Move Right Stick to Flail Around Either Trigger to Pick Up and Release Left and Right Bumpers to Cycle Character Select Right Special Button to Connect Controllers and Select Character Left Special Button to Pause Inflamed features a campaign where its Inflatable protagonists advance through a series of protests. Each protest takes place at a unique location relevant to the plight of the unpaid Inflatables. In order to make a change and rally support, players will need to earn a series of symbolic victories, hurting bottom lines and garnering positive sentiment for the Inflatable revolution. These symbolic victories take the form of objectives for players to complete at each protest - often requiring them to cause wacky and destructive mayhem. Players will need to work together to effectively complete their objectives and claim victory!

rows.name: Zeppelin Rush
rows.short_description: A Tower Offense game in which you deploy goblin manned zeppelins in an effort to earn money and destroy the dwarven fortress.
rows.description_html: Zeppelin Rush is a reverse tower defense game where you lead a crew of furious goblins in an explosive assault aerial assault against a heavily fortified dwarf stronghold. The dwarves stole your gold, now it’s payback time. Build and pilot a fleet of goblin-engineered war zeppelins, smashing through enemy towers while collecting loot to upgrade your fleet and multiply your forces. Choose your path across lanes of combat, with varying tower layouts and rewards. Adapt your strategy mid-flight by upgrading engines, armor, and weapons as you make your way further into enemy territory! Each run is a fast-paced mix of strategy, destruction, and resource management, challenging you to balance risk and reward on the fly. With chaotic goblin tech, real-time destruction, explosive visuals, and strategic lane selection, Zeppelin Rush delivers an action-packed twist on the tower defense formula from the sky, with vengeance. Take flight. Break towers. Reclaim your gold. The goblins are coming - and nothing is safe... Fast paced gameplay requiring rapid decision making Intense layout of enemy towers that foster intense combat Economy based deployment and upgrade system

rows.name: Pieceful Gallery
rows.short_description: A classic jigsaw game—each puzzle is a stunning work of art, replicating the operation and difficulty of traditional jigsaws. Come experience Cyber Puzzle now~!
rows.description_html: In real life, there are many jigsaw enthusiasts who, for various reasons, can’t complete a puzzle. Pieceful Gallery is a game that fully simulates the classic jigsaw experience: use your mouse to organize and rotate puzzle pieces, then assemble the entire image in the traditional way. There’s no space limitation, progress is saved automatically, and levels range from easy to difficult. Come try it for free! Game Features: · Faithfully replicates the operation and challenge of a classic jigsaw—easy to learn and use · Each level features a high-definition work of art, allowing you to appreciate masterpieces as you play · Puzzle sizes increase from 100 to 1,000 pieces, suitable for beginners or seasoned players of any age · Relaxing background music to soothe your mind while you play (All art used in the game is in the public domain.)

rows.name: Don't Get Your Hopes Up
rows.short_description: You're looking for a new apartment in Amsterdam. Your once-confident search is morphing into panic. Nothing is available. Anything will do. ANYTHING.
rows.description_html: Don't Get Your Hopes Up is a short interactive comic about housing shortage and horror in architecture.  Based on desperate apartment searches undertaken in 2022 and 2024, and drawing from a half decade of conversations about Amsterdam's housing crisis, the game moves between fiction, documentary, and social commentary. With disquiet and creeping unease, it dismantles the consoling fictions of abundance, and laments a feeling of home that's always just beyond reach. Short, emotional, and relatable (unless you're a landlord)  Playtime: 40-60 minutes. Dive into a week of apartment hunting through the eyes of Krish and Yan, a couple looking to find an apartment in Amsterdam. Classic visual novel gameplay meets sparse, parallax comic book illustrations, with a few narrative and mechanical twists.  View odd apartments and make tough decisions on renting and overbidding. Experience a moving story about precarity, solidarity, alienation, and the systems that keep us apart. A haunting post-punk soundscape  Immerse yourself in a haunting, propulsive soundscape featuring music by Simon Frank and a special track by Rotterdam band Neighbours Burning Neighbours.  A uniquely Amsterdam story that is resonant everywhere 'EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE, FOR ANYTHING TO STAY THE SAME.' Learn a wayward history of contemporary Amsterdam that is resonant globally. Play through a carefully constructed bricolage of references, ideas, speculations, and social commentary about the housing crisis that attempts to distill fleeting perceptions of an ambient present into coherent yet unsettling images. 'State-of-the-art maleficence”, with inspirations from Leila Taylor’s Sick Houses , Joshua Comaroff and Ker-Shing Ong’s Horror in Architecture , and Ayşegül Savaş’ The Anthropologists .

rows.reviews_html: “Don't Get Your Hopes Up is a good game because not only is it good commentary on the (many, worldwide) housing crisis (especially how those intersect with racism and the climate crisis), it also understands that yes, I probably would rent a flat that contained an exact replica of itself in dollhouse form, complete with a little doll me, and inside that replica another replica of another flat, another future, spiralling in on itself forever. Housing market's in shambles isn't it.” regicidal-defenestration, Tumblr “A deeply engaging, vital, eye-opening piece of work, chock-full of empathy and critical thinking.” 4/5 – So Many Games “I had a hard time finding a single sentence in this thing I didn't want to screenshot...do dig in.” Rock Paper Shotgun

rows.name: The Night Is Long
rows.short_description: The Night Is Long is a short first-person horror game where a grieving man follows a ghostly vision into an abandoned mansion. Uncover dark secrets, survive atmospheric horrors, and face your past through exploration, puzzles, and subtle scares.
rows.description_html: The Night Is Long is a short first-person Lovecraftian inspired horror game that explores grief, guilt, and the chilling unknown. In the midst of emotional turmoil, a grieving man sets out on a nighttime drive, desperate to escape the pain of his past. But when his deceased wife suddenly appears in the middle of the road, he swerves into the unknown — and follows her into a long-abandoned mansion. Inside, reality begins to unravel. The deeper he explores, the clearer it becomes: the night is long, and he is not alone. Use your wits and determination to survive the horrors within and uncover the truth buried in the shadows of the mansion. Features An emotional, story-rich experience Exploration-focused gameplay with storytelling delivered through scattered notes and hand-drawn illustrations A chilling atmosphere that builds psychological tension Random paranormal events to keep you constantly on edge A sanity system that dynamically affects ambient and sounds Classic key-hunting and inventory puzzles Mindful, well-placed jump scares that enhance atmosphere and tension

rows.name: Ani Idle
rows.short_description: Ani Idle is an Idle-like RPG in which you will have to fight a variety of enemies. Kill them, collect their loot, take a rest, do some quests and craft your gear to become more and more powerful.
rows.description_html: Ani Idle is a Fantasy RPG with an Idle-like playstyle. Jump into a short adventure and try to kill all the enemies and clear all the dungeons. While not fighting, you might feel like taking a rest, do some quests or craft your gear to make it more powerful. Your Character: You will have different stats like attributes (used for quests), regeneration, crit chance, chance for DoTs or just raw damage. Damage types include physical, fire, ice and lightning - the same goes for your resistances. Find the best combinations to fight your enemies, because they have the same kind of stats. Classes: Depending on your weapon you will have one of five classes and each class has their own skill you can use in combat. Fight: Start with some low-level slimes, like every good adventurer does. Soon you will kill more dangerous enemies and loot their gear to make it yours. Kill enough of them to also level up and become stronger and stronger. Dungeons: When you are ready, start exploring dungeons, that will contain several enemies in a row. This is the only place, where you cannot flee, so be prepared! Quests: Good adventurers will have to do some quests from time to time. Explore weird places, help some people (or not) and gather some loot here as well. Each quest will let you choose between three options and sometimes they just have random outcomes and could also depend on your attributes. Rest: You deserve it! Inventory: Sort and check your precious loot. Equip your gear or see what kind of delicious consumables you might find. Crafting: If you have already found some crafting crystals, this is your place to be! Use them to reroll your gear, try to make it the best you currently need. Achievements: Of course there are Achievements to collect and hunt! Some might be easy, but others might need some more research. Check the menu for some advice on how to get them. Ani Idle is the very first game I developed. It started as a hobby and grew into something special. I am proud to have made it this far and hope you will like my little Idle-like RPG adventure game as much as I do.

rows.name: Purrates
rows.short_description: Purrates is a point & click adventure about cat pirates resolving a great mystery. Embrace the pirate's duties with captain Clawdius Whiskers & reassemble your ship's crew! Every cat for themselves! Craft items to solve various puzzles & win back the favor of your fellow purrates! Yarrr!
rows.description_html: Have you ever yearned for an adventure 'cross the far seas........ with yer cats? Purrates is an adventurous point & click mystery focused on the tale of a pirate cat crew. Experience the epic tale of the Purrates crew on their valiant quest to discover the mystery of the Red Dot! Talk to the local residents - the harbor workers may know a few things about the island and where to find supplies. Explore the harbor, town square & tavern while chatting with fellow purrates to learn more about this great mystery...... Take your time to soak in the atmosphere and get immersed in the pirate setting! Immerse yerself in the cat-pirate world of Purrates! Comic book panel art by Jordan Deemi

rows.name: Lil' Snot: Moon Escape
rows.short_description: Lil' Snot: Moon Escape is a difficult, minimalist, precision-platformer. Sling yourself with mouse controls through 5 levels with unique mechanics each to test your capabilities. Try to beat my fastest finish time of 2:39!
rows.description_html: Lil' Snot: Moon Escape is a difficult, minimalist, precision-platformer . Sling yourself through 5 levels with unique mechanics each to test your capabilities. Try to beat my fastest finish time of 2:39! The lil' snot has always wanted to see what's outside of his moon prison, it's up to you to help the lil' snot escape! Enjoy an atmospheric moon-ish soundtrack and the silence of the character in space. By holding down Mouse Button Left and dragging down and aiming like a bow , let go and the lil' snot will be shot like an arrow ! Use  A and D to move and get the placement you want. Each stage has varying platforming mechanics : Sticky walls, repulsion walls, invisible platforms, teleporting platforms, portals, and more! Playtime: 30 Minutes - 3 Hours (varies based on skill and experience)

rows.description_html: The show must go on, even if it kills you. Curtainfall is a fast-paced action roguelike set in a twisted theatrical underworld. Step into the spotlight as a masked performer fighting through cursed circus zones while uncovering fragments of your lost identity. Chain together melee attacks, special abilities, and combat buffs to create devastating builds on the fly. Each run plays out like a new act, with bizarre enemies pulled straight from a nightmare masquerade. And when the final curtain rises, give the performance of your afterlife.

Step into the spotlight, express your unique style, and share the beat with friends. Your journey to stardom starts here—join the party now! 💖 To thank all players for your support, we’ve prepared a special gift for every new idol! 🎁 More exciting rewards are waiting for you both in-game and on our Discord server —don't miss out! rows.name: S.R.A
rows.short_description: S.R.A Project is a challenging roguelike bullet hell wave survival game. Face cosmic creatures, improve through skill and perseverance, and master a world that rewards learning and adaptation.
rows.description_html: SRA Project Embark on a thrilling journey with a game designed to challenge, entertain, and keep you on your toes. If you’re looking for a difficult yet rewarding experience, one that requires learning and constant improvement, then this game is for you. It’s perfect for those who want to take the path of self-betterment and mastery. S.R.A Project is a roguelike, bullet hell, wave survival game where you face relentless attacks from cosmic creatures. Adapt and evolve alongside these challenges. Prove your worth by defeating the leader and earn the right to progress. Share your screenshots of the main menu to join our leaderboard, or play solo to master the game on your own terms. We appreciate any reports of bugs you may stumble with or any suggestions for developing abilities and improvements. Controls: WASD - Move Arrow Keys - Shoot Esc - Pause Shift - Dash Hold R - Restart Space - Active

rows.name: Tawa : Lost in Time
rows.short_description: Tawa: Lost in Time is a narrative survival-adventure game where players step into the fragile paws of Tawa, a small mouse lost in a vast and unforgiving prehistoric world. After being separated from her family by a powerful earthquake..
rows.description_html: About the Game – Tawa: Lost in Time Tawa: Lost in Time is a narrative survival-adventure game where players step into the fragile paws of Tawa, a small mouse lost in a vast and unforgiving prehistoric world. After being separated from her family by a powerful earthquake, Tawa finds herself alone in an ancient land dominated by dinosaurs and primeval landscapes. To survive, she must navigate a hostile ecosystem where she is not a predator — but prey. Designed as an immersive single-player experience, the game blends emotional storytelling, stealth-based gameplay, and environmental puzzles into a cinematic journey. With no dialogue or traditional HUD, the story is told entirely through animation, music, and environmental cues. Key Features Immersive prehistoric world Explore five unique biomes — coastal beaches, dense forests, volcanic cliffs, mysterious ruins, and an isolated central island. Each zone features unique visual identity, dynamic soundscapes, and carefully designed danger zones populated by ancient creatures. Stealth and survival mechanics Avoid predators, stay hidden in tall grass, burrow under roots, or freeze to avoid detection. Timing and observation are crucial. Tawa cannot fight, but she can outsmart, escape, and endure. Narrative-driven exploration Experience a silent story of resilience, fear, and hope. Tawa’s journey is a visual and auditory tale shaped by her surroundings and her reactions to them. Naturalistic gameplay systems Tawa’s stamina, health, and perception are influenced by environmental conditions. Rain, heat, hunger, and exhaustion all affect how she moves and reacts. Players must read the world like an animal would. Dynamic audio and visual cues No minimaps or UI distractions. Distant rumbles, predator calls, rustling bushes, and changing light conditions serve as navigational and survival signals. An emotional journey with thematic depth At its core, Tawa: Lost in Time is about vulnerability, family, and finding one's way in a world that is indifferent to your existence. It's a poetic and existential experience rooted in naturalism and quiet intensity. Who Is This Game For? Tawa: Lost in Time appeals to fans of atmospheric, story-rich indie games and nature-based adventures. Players who enjoy titles such as Ori and the Blind Forest , Stray , INSIDE , Shelter , or Spirit of the North will find familiar themes of survival, environmental storytelling, and emotional resonance. The game is particularly suitable for: Players looking for non-violent, thoughtful gameplay Nature lovers and fans of prehistoric themes Fans of cinematic platformers and immersive audio-visual design Gamers interested in indie storytelling and symbolic worldbuilding Technical Details Platform: PC (with console versions planned) Engine: Unity Genre: Adventure, Survival, Narrative Mode: Single-player Language: Universally understandable through visuals and sound (no spoken dialogue) Development status: Early access demo available soon

rows.name: Nelli The Seer
rows.short_description: Nelli The Seer is a third-person platformer and memory game. Jump, glide and see the future to collect the treasures present in the Templo Mayor. Collect the fragments of the obsidian mirror to show the future to your people.
rows.description_html: A STUDENT VIDEO GAME PROJECT Nelli The Seer is a game developed by first-year students at a video game school. The team had 14 weeks to deliver a third-person action-adventure game set in a historical temple. Game Design and Level Design students started pre-production first, followed three weeks later by the Environment Artists, Animators, and Character Riggers. The programmers joined the project seven weeks after the Game Designers. Game Design and Level Design students had seven weeks of pre-production, while the Environment Artists, Character Rigger and Animator teams had four. Then, all teams worked together during the final seven weeks of production to complete the game. The result is a platformer blended with a memory-based puzzle game , offering about 30 minutes of gameplay . NELLI, A FORMER AZTEC WARRIOR TURNED PRIEST At the beginning of the 16th century , you play as Nelli , a young man from Tenochtitlan. Once a proud Aztec warrior, Nelli is granted the gift of foresight by Tezcatlipoca , the god of night and destiny. Upon discovering his new ability to see the future, he chooses to become a priest. A DARK PROPHECY In his final vision, Nelli sees a grim fate awaiting his people : soldiers will invade the great city of Tenochtitlan , capital of the Aztec Empire. Determined to warn his people, he seeks an audience with Emperor Moctezuma II . However, the emperor does not believe him, Nelli’s prophecy contradicts those of the high priests. NELLI'S QUEST To prove his vision, Nelli ventures deep into the Templo Mayor . His goal : to reassemble the Obsidian Mirror , a sacred relic of the Aztecs and the divine attribute of Tezcatlipoca . Its fragments are scattered throughout the temple’s hidden chambers. Once the mirror is restored, Nelli hopes to convince the emperor of the truth. CORE GAME MECHANICS • Use Nelli’s athletic abilities : jump , climb , and crouch to reach areas inaccessible to ordinary people. • Activate mystical mechanisms  : open ancient stone doors, move platforms, and create new paths through the temple. • Collect the Feather Gem to gain the ability to glide. This power lets you reach normally unreachable zones and interact with objects while falling. • Harness Nelli’s gift of foresight : lie down on vision altars to extend your view into the future. Reveal hidden spikes, avoid sudden traps, and spot disappearing platforms. Remember trap patterns and safe paths to complete your quest and fulfill your destiny.

rows.name: Urban Undergrounds
rows.short_description: A first-person horror game where you explore an abandoned bunker, avoid deadly threats, and search for your missing friend in a chilling story.
rows.description_html: Urban Undergrounds Face the darkness. Find your friend. Escape the unknown. You are an experienced urban explorer, known for venturing into abandoned places where no one else dares to go. One day, your best friend Marcus invites you to investigate an old, decaying urban bunker hidden deep in a forest far from civilization. When you arrive, an overwhelming sense of dread overtakes you. A bone-chilling shriek sends both of you running for your lives. But Marcus can’t let it go. Days later, he returns to the bunker alone—and now he’s missing. With no other option, you gather your courage and return to the bunker yourself. The forest falls silent as you step into the cold, concrete depths… and descend into something far worse than you imagined. Gameplay Overview Urban Undergrounds is a first-person indie horror game that combines atmospheric exploration with survival elements. Players must navigate a labyrinth of abandoned hallways, hidden rooms, and locked-off areas, while uncovering the horrifying truth behind the bunker. Key Features Explore the Unknown: Traverse eerie corridors, pitch-black rooms, and decaying underground facilities filled with environmental storytelling. Survive the Dangers: Face off against terrifying threats—some seen, some unseen. Use stealth and caution to survive. There are no weapons ; your only option is to escape or hide. Solve Puzzles and Unlock New Areas: Progression requires collecting keys, finding clues, and solving environmental puzzles to unlock new sections of the complex. Discover the Story: Piece together the mystery of the bunker through notes, visual details, and the disturbing discoveries you encounter. Immersive Horror Experience: Expect sudden jump scares, intense audio design, and psychological horror elements that will keep you on edge. Single-Player Experience: This game is a solo survival experience designed for players who love atmospheric, narrative-driven horror. Content Warning ⚠️ Urban Undergrounds contains rapid flashing lights, sudden jump scares, and intense horror elements. Recommended Age: 16+ Technical Info Gameplay Style: First-person exploration, stealth, survival horror Platform: PC (keyboard & mouse, controller support optional) Estimated Playtime: 1–2 hours (varies by play style) Saving: Auto-save system with checkpoints

Watch as skewered fruits are coated in dazzling sugar, transforming into fantastic, glittering desserts. Make and admire your very own tanghulu and grow your shop into the top snack spot in Korea! Game Features: Create Your Own Tanghulu: Start with a humble wooden stick and watch your snack evolve into luxurious, unlimited-refill tanghulu. Research and unlock new skins to become a master tanghulu artisan who captivates customers' palates. Competition and Challenges: Compete against other tanghulu shops to earn the title of the best tanghulu spot. Challenge the Steam rankings to earn generous rewards (a sense of accomplishment, satisfaction, love, and peace). Experience the sweet and thrilling world of a tanghulu hotspot in  Big Giant Tanghulu: Tanghulu Legend!  It's time to get your tanghulu shop always open and create the legend of unlimited refills! By the way, there's no such thing as International Tanghulu Day. ...Just in case you were wondering.

rows.short_description: A relaxing puzzle game where you reveal beautiful anime artwork by clearing away colored tiles. No timers, no pressure, just aim, click, and enjoy the view.
rows.description_html: 🧩 Puzzle Temptation: Anime Reveal Take a break. Clear your mind. Reveal the beauty beneath. Puzzle Temptation: Anime Reveal is a calm and satisfying puzzle experience designed for short play sessions and long chill vibes. Instead of placing pieces, you’ll reveal hidden anime art by tapping rotating circles to shoot and clear colored puzzle tiles. Every hit uncovers more of the artwork underneath, a new outfit, a new pose, a new moment of temptation. There’s no timer, no pressure, and no stress. Just a relaxing atmosphere, soft music, and stunning anime illustrations waiting to be revealed at your pace. 🎯 Features: Relaxing Gameplay – Click to fire and watch tiles fade away as images are slowly uncovered. Beautiful Anime Art – Unlock dozens of unique illustrations with various outfits and themes. No Pressure – No time limits, no score, just pure visual satisfaction. Gallery Mode – Revisit any unlocked artwork at any time. One-Hand Friendly – Simple, click-based gameplay ideal for winding down. Whether you’re between study sessions, taking a break from work, or just want to chill with something visually rewarding, Puzzle Temptation: Anime Reveal offers a satisfying escape.
