rows.name: Kasama: The Awakening
rows.short_description: Dive into this magical journey and join Orion The Orange in the adventure of a lifetime through dreams and nightmares. Uncover the secrets, face your fears, and restore the balance in the land of Kasamas! Will you dare to dream and face the night with them?
rows.description_html: Every human has a Kasama, a dream-avatar that reflects their soul. In Kasama: The Awakening , you’ll step into the dreamworld as Orion, a spirit warrior on a quiet quest through the fading realm of Kastania. Uncover hidden truths, face your fears, and help restore balance to a world teetering between light and shadow. This is a short, heartfelt journey, perfect for players who love story-rich games like Journey , Inside , or Oxenfree . Will you dare to dream... and face the night with them? Long ago, a sacred chestnut tree gave life to three mythical beings, protectors of the dreamworld and guides of the human soul: • Ipno – the firstborn, guardian of restful sleep for all living things. • Morpheo – the middle child, who grants the power to dream and glimpse other realities. • Phao – the youngest, who wakes beings from dreams and helps them carry meaning into the real world. But when the chestnuts that sustain this balance begin to vanish, the Kasamas grow weaker... and darkness creeps in. Walk through floating forests, forgotten ruins, and shimmering dreamscapes as you piece together Kastania’s lost history. Every place you visit reflects a feeling, a memory, or a fear, both personal and ancient. Not all dreams are peaceful. Some hold sorrow. Some conceal truths. Some fight back. But only by facing them can you restore what was lost. Kasama: The Awakening is the first chapter in a cinematic, episodic saga, built for one-night play sessions that leave a lasting impression.

rows.name: Space Hitchhiker Stop
rows.short_description: Your store has been kidnapped by the mafia, work for them and upgrade your ship until you're able to hyperjump out of space!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Space Hitchhiker Stop, you are a dude working in a Hitchhiker Stop, in Space. You're being hunted down by the mafia and have to work for them in order to upgrade your ship and escape Space. In this game you'll have to manage your resources by creating crates so that the mafia customers come into your store and you get the moneyz from them. Remember that if you don't buy boxes and create supplies, you'll run out of them! Causing your mafia clients to not come into your store because you have nothing to sell. And so you'll go bankrupt, and they'll kill you. If you have enough coin, you're also able to purchase upgrades, these three upgrades come with many tiers, you're able to make the customer have a bigger temper, they pay you more money and to make your energy last longer! You are also able to upgrade the generators, which will make their crafting time even faster! The goal of the game is to fully upgrade your ship and to escape the mafia by hyperdriving away from Space. Be wary of your energy and your bills, if you go bankrupt, the mafia will kill you (as we already said before). If you run out of energy you'll simply die, as is the rules of space and time fluctuation and many more rules there are. -- The mafia

rows.name: Realms Road
rows.short_description: REALMS ROAD includes turn-based RPG, rogue-like and adventure elements. Players will find themselves in crazy fights in various lands by choosing the right champion and party members. With deep character customization and a semi-automatic battle system, REALMS ROAD awaits all adventurers.
rows.description_html: Choose the champion that suits you from 20 legends and build your team! Travel from realm to realm and hunt down corrupted enemies one by one. Show off your strategic genius on the battlefield with the turn-based combat system. Develop your team members in your own unique way. Customize the equipment and features suitable for each member with gold, skill books and monster essences that you will obtain from the maps. Try to survive to avoid going back to the beginning! Focus on optional quests and puzzles in realms and watch out for traps in some areas. Destroy corrupted special, elite and boss type enemies! Realms Road awaits you with its fluid story with its unique champions, loyal companions, equipment that you can choose according to your playing style, different realm quests and various enemies.

rows.name: Night of the Extinct
rows.short_description: Become the eyes of a mid-2010s paranormal content creator, who has challenged himself to stay overnight at an allegedly haunted museum. Will he make it out alive?
rows.description_html: This is a 'pilot' game of sorts to see if you guys like what we're doing and if you want more! Please leave a review with your highlights and your criticisms, it's a tremendous help. The Silvercity Sharks and ArtOfGerald are collaborating to bring you a new horror experience... Go back in time and see the creatures of yesterday, but you might be doing more than just seeing. These creatures come to life at night, and it's your job to survive your time here. Become the eyes of a mid-2010s paranormal content creator named Elliot, who has challenged himself to stay overnight at an allegedly haunted museum. Meet new friends that'll talk your ear off and enemies that will stalk you down to your death. Explore the museum and see what sights are offered, with real descriptions of the items!  Traverse your way through the establishment by completing security checks with PHYSICS! Find the secrets of the National Museum of Paleontology through different routes... WITH VOICE ACTING, ACHIEVEMENTS, and TRANSLATED INTO 13 LANGUAGES! Will YOU make it out alive?

rows.name: Exploding Judo Federation
rows.short_description: It's judo on a minefield! Tech the grab or die, in this fast-paced 3D fighting game where every! single! throw! is lethal!
rows.description_html: Tech the grab or die trying! From the creator of Schwarzerblitz and Motionsickness, here comes a new, fast paced, explosive, 1v1 fighting game, where every grab is lethal . Roll around, wait for an opening and smash your opponent on the tarmac (explosions might ensue)! It's judo until it isn't Grabs are the way, but this doesn't mean one cannot fight dirty! Each character has a super move at their disposal, be it an invincible grab, a counter attack or a full screen pew pew laser, that immediately seals the match. Strive for victory Use strikes to create grab opportunities, roll around the stage to position yourself, grab at the right moment to seal the deal. No block, no rest, only movement, fundamentals and a generous amount of dirt. Do you have what it takes to become the master of Exploding Judo? All of this with the help of... full 3D movement with the help of a Roll button. This is a five buttons game (punch, kick, grab, dash, roll) with emphasis on dodging and grabbing 11 standard characters plus 3 unlockable boss characters and an annoying gun-headed goon that cannot beat the champ even if he tries his best (well, unless he gets really, REALLY lucky with a random grab) arcade mode, survival mode and time attack mode nine stages plus the classic grid (duh) and an extra green screen stage for photobashing shenanigans local versus (online modes unfortunately not planned) tutorial and training mode a psychopathic dabbing killer robot reinstalled into a bunny droid body (which is actually canon) a giant kaiju robot with plasma chainsaws and a full screen laser (which is ALSO canon, if you care about this sort of stuff) the one and only Callowman from Duels of Fortune as a special playable guest character!

rows.name: Epoch Spire
rows.short_description: Epoch Spire is a first-person shooter roguelike, where players improve by discovering and understanding the secrets of a spire on an alien planet.
rows.description_html: You explore the floors of a mysterious spire on an alien planet without a nearby star. When dying in the spire, the only thing you keep is your knowledge. Try again in a new, randomized floor of the tower! Use your laser gun to fight monsters and interact with the environment! Many things are unknown to the player at the beginning. Uncover secrets and solve puzzles to get rewards which will make you stronger for your current try! Once you know how to solve a puzzle, you will be able to solve it again in future tries.

Collect gems, giant coins, and even other people’s credit cards in your pursuit! As you play, some collectibles will take you to other parts of the arcade. Collect the credit cards of other people, and hack into their accounts to steal all of their coins and gold bars. Or find gallery tokens, and get ready to collect a boatload of coins and gold in a frantic clicking minigame. Features: Stealing money from people Realistic slot zombie experience Powerups and collectibles No microtransactions or AI Casual, grind-free, and beatable in an evening

rows.name: Ruby and The Lost Crystals
rows.short_description: Ruby and the Lost Crystals is a calm third-person puzzle adventure where you swap between two characters to solve puzzles. Use physical interactions, magical projectiles, and object-swapping to unlock paths, reflect lasers, activate platforms, break obstacles, and explore ancient ruins.
rows.description_html: Ruby and the Lost Crystals is a calm third-person puzzle adventure where you swap between two characters with unique abilities to solve magical puzzles, activate mechanisms, and explore the ruins of a forgotten civilisation. 🎮 A solo adventure with dual-character gameplay You control: Ruby , a young girl who can physically interact with the environment: push blocks, turn capstan, activate pressure plate and jump. Sapphire, a magical stone fairy who shoots projectiles to illuminate crystals, activate platforms, and swap the positions of objects. Switch between the two to solve puzzles combining logic, spatial reasoning, timing, and magical interactions . 🧠 Evolving and varied puzzle mechanics Each area introduces new mechanics , combined in creative ways as the game progresses: Illuminate lost crystals Redirect and  combine coloured lasers . Teleport objects to create paths and platforms Move blocks and platforms to reach new areas Interact with pressure plates, rotatable structures, or long-range triggers The puzzles are handcrafted to challenge your thinking without ever overwhelming , encouraging experimentation and observation. This peaceful third-person puzzle adventure invites players to explore two handcrafted zones filled with ancient ruins, magical devices, and hidden secrets. Through a blend of light dialogue, stylised visuals, and an evolving original soundtrack, the game offers a calm and focused solo experience built around thoughtful interactions and the cooperation between two unique characters.

With randomized station layouts, loot and weapon upgrade system each run becomes unique! Customize your arsenal, manage your resources, and prepare for the final battle at the Federation Main Station (F.M.S.) . Features: Randomized space stations with unique themes and threat Weapon upgrade and modification system Dynamic encounters: aliens, zombies, rogue AI, and more Roguelike progression system Each sector contains a unique boss associated with its general theme

rows.name: Skaldsong
rows.short_description: A singleplayer/multiplayer RPG reminiscent of TTRPGs mixed with MUD games but with content generated by an AI Game Master.
rows.description_html: About This Game Gather your friends (or just yourself) and step into a world without a script. Skaldsong is a multiplayer RPG platform that combines the deep mechanics of classic CRPGs with the narrative freedom of tabletop role-playing. Here, the story is not pre-written. It's generated live, guided either by a human Game Master using our toolset, or by an advanced generative AI that acts as your Game Master. There is daily free AI Usage for everyone! Stuck as a forever DM? Lacking friends but want to play a TTRPG? Have friends but nobody wants to be the one to run the game? Just want to see what AI can do? Then this game is for you. A True RPG Engine Skaldsong is not another hastily thrown together AI chatbot. It is a complete game engine with robust, underlying systems that feel like a modern evolution of classic MUDs (Multi-User Dungeons). The AI's role is not to solely run the game, but to create content for it. You are not limited to pure adventure games, using custom Game Rules, you can play all sorts of games- Slice of Life school romance? The management of a mercenary company? Fight in the gladiator pits? Interstellar Empire management? With the right ruleset, the AI can smoothly run about any game you can define. When the AI responds to your actions, its narrative is embedded with special [Tags] . Our custom parser reads these tags and translates them into mechanical changes within the game state. If the AI describes you finding a sword, a [Create_Item] tag mechanically adds that sword to your inventory. This system ensures that the story and the game mechanics are always perfectly in sync. While the interaction is text-based, the world is fully visualized. You are not just reading text; you are interacting with graphical character sheets, inventory windows, a world map, quest logs, and more. I'm tired of hastily put together AI games that look like, frankly, dogwater. Skaldsong is a demonstration of how you can truly use AI not to replace the game, but enhance it. Free-to-Play and Paid Content Skaldsong is free to download and play. The core software, including the multiplayer framework and all non-AI GM tools, is available to everyone at no cost, meaning if you join a friend or public lobby, you will have to pay nothing to play with them.  Additionally, every player gets 40 free actions/generations using our subscription model for free per day. If you want unlimited usage of the subscription model, there is a $15 subscription for 30 days of unlimited usage available for purchase in-game or a higher tier $25 subscription which includes image generation. But to use the premium models and image generation, these all use credits which can be purchased through Steam. Credits are spent as used. The cost of AI features (outside Unlimited usage) depends on factors such as the size of your game world, how many characters are in your game, and various other settings you can tweak to meet your cost threshold. Tips on managing cost and other helpful information can be found on the Skaldsong Discord. The AI as a Creative Partner When you play with the AI GM, you just tell it what genre, setting, and type of game you'd like to play. Guided by those, the AI's responsibilities include: Reactive Storytelling: Generating narrative outcomes, NPC dialogue, and environmental descriptions based on your party's specific actions. On-Demand Content: Creating new characters, items, quests, and locations as the story demands them. AI-Powered Art: Generating images based on your characters and locations. Generally, if a character is wearing something, the image will show it. If you see an object in a scene? You can interact with it. Create character portraits, item icons, and stunning location art on the fly. These assets are then automatically shared with all connected players, bringing your shared world to life visually. You can select from a list of pre-written art styles or create your own. Built-In Text-to-Speech with Custom Voices:  If your computer can handle it, you can use our built-in TTS system to generate voice overs for your game using custom voices. You can use one of the preset ones or add your own! Seamless Multiplayer & Asset Sharing Built on Steamworks, Skaldsong is designed for a hassle-free multiplayer experience. The host controls the world, and clients connect to share in the adventure. Our system automatically synchronizes all necessary game assets, including any AI-generated images or custom music tracks the host chooses to use. When using the AI, only the lobby host needs to have credits. If you're playing as a player, there is absolutely no cost associated with AI usage. A UI That Does Not Make You Puke Designed to work with all your information being in windows you can scale, resize, and reposition. Use one of the pre-built color themes or make your own. Use a custom background or let the game set the background based on the location your party is in. Change to a favored font even. You can even drag 'stickers' of your characters and items onto the screen to place them directly in the location as you play. But the most important thing, is that the UI won't make you want to puke! A Powerful Tool for Human Game Masters The AI is completely optional. Skaldsong can be used as a powerful platform for running your own TTRPG campaigns with friends. As a human GM, you can ignore the AI entirely and use the game's systems to: Track character stats, health, and inventories for all players. Manage a world map with custom locations. Create and assign quests through the built-in quest log. Distribute loot and currency mechanically. Keep a persistent, savable record of your campaign world. Play included or custom music or other .mp3s to all of your players at once Future tools (Battlemap) in the roadmap
rows.about_html: About This Game Gather your friends (or just yourself) and step into a world without a script. Skaldsong is a multiplayer RPG platform that combines the deep mechanics of classic CRPGs with the narrative freedom of tabletop role-playing. Here, the story is not pre-written. It's generated live, guided either by a human Game Master using our toolset, or by an advanced generative AI that acts as your Game Master. There is daily free AI Usage for everyone! Stuck as a forever DM? Lacking friends but want to play a TTRPG? Have friends but nobody wants to be the one to run the game? Just want to see what AI can do? Then this game is for you. A True RPG Engine Skaldsong is not another hastily thrown together AI chatbot. It is a complete game engine with robust, underlying systems that feel like a modern evolution of classic MUDs (Multi-User Dungeons). The AI's role is not to solely run the game, but to create content for it. You are not limited to pure adventure games, using custom Game Rules, you can play all sorts of games- Slice of Life school romance? The management of a mercenary company? Fight in the gladiator pits? Interstellar Empire management? With the right ruleset, the AI can smoothly run about any game you can define. When the AI responds to your actions, its narrative is embedded with special [Tags] . Our custom parser reads these tags and translates them into mechanical changes within the game state. If the AI describes you finding a sword, a [Create_Item] tag mechanically adds that sword to your inventory. This system ensures that the story and the game mechanics are always perfectly in sync. While the interaction is text-based, the world is fully visualized. You are not just reading text; you are interacting with graphical character sheets, inventory windows, a world map, quest logs, and more. I'm tired of hastily put together AI games that look like, frankly, dogwater. Skaldsong is a demonstration of how you can truly use AI not to replace the game, but enhance it. Free-to-Play and Paid Content Skaldsong is free to download and play. The core software, including the multiplayer framework and all non-AI GM tools, is available to everyone at no cost, meaning if you join a friend or public lobby, you will have to pay nothing to play with them.  Additionally, every player gets 40 free actions/generations using our subscription model for free per day. If you want unlimited usage of the subscription model, there is a $15 subscription for 30 days of unlimited usage available for purchase in-game or a higher tier $25 subscription which includes image generation. But to use the premium models and image generation, these all use credits which can be purchased through Steam. Credits are spent as used. The cost of AI features (outside Unlimited usage) depends on factors such as the size of your game world, how many characters are in your game, and various other settings you can tweak to meet your cost threshold. Tips on managing cost and other helpful information can be found on the Skaldsong Discord. The AI as a Creative Partner When you play with the AI GM, you just tell it what genre, setting, and type of game you'd like to play. Guided by those, the AI's responsibilities include: Reactive Storytelling: Generating narrative outcomes, NPC dialogue, and environmental descriptions based on your party's specific actions. On-Demand Content: Creating new characters, items, quests, and locations as the story demands them. AI-Powered Art: Generating images based on your characters and locations. Generally, if a character is wearing something, the image will show it. If you see an object in a scene? You can interact with it. Create character portraits, item icons, and stunning location art on the fly. These assets are then automatically shared with all connected players, bringing your shared world to life visually. You can select from a list of pre-written art styles or create your own. Built-In Text-to-Speech with Custom Voices:  If your computer can handle it, you can use our built-in TTS system to generate voice overs for your game using custom voices. You can use one of the preset ones or add your own! Seamless Multiplayer & Asset Sharing Built on Steamworks, Skaldsong is designed for a hassle-free multiplayer experience. The host controls the world, and clients connect to share in the adventure. Our system automatically synchronizes all necessary game assets, including any AI-generated images or custom music tracks the host chooses to use. When using the AI, only the lobby host needs to have credits. If you're playing as a player, there is absolutely no cost associated with AI usage. A UI That Does Not Make You Puke Designed to work with all your information being in windows you can scale, resize, and reposition. Use one of the pre-built color themes or make your own. Use a custom background or let the game set the background based on the location your party is in. Change to a favored font even. You can even drag 'stickers' of your characters and items onto the screen to place them directly in the location as you play. But the most important thing, is that the UI won't make you want to puke! rows.name: Don't Break
rows.short_description: Break out of a dungeon as a fragile soul in a potion bottle. Roll, bounce, and avoid fall damage while fighting awkward physics to survive the impossible. Can you escape without breaking?
rows.description_html: Awkward physics Master the slippery, bouncy movement of a potion bottle. Every jump demands perfect timing, angling, and speed control. Death...everywhere There are no safe zones. Title screen? Game lobby? Even checkpoints? All of them are potential death traps. One bad landing, and you shatter. Pick your poison Use optional checkpoints to save progress, but at a cost. Choose wisely. Not every risk is worth it. Short but brutal Fewer levels, higher skill ceiling. It’s a concentrated, punishing experience that’s incredibly rewarding to overcome. Lore-accurate difficulty Beat the game on normal? Try “lore-accurate” mode. It’s the way it was meant to be played… and you probably won’t survive.

rows.name: ALASKA - An Endless Night
rows.short_description: Winner of the 2023 Pégases Awards: Alaska is a third-person investigation and exploration game. Play as Clarence, a former bounty hunter chasing Enyeto, accused of your brother’s death. Explore snowy Alaskan landscapes, uncover clues, and decide your target’s fate.
rows.description_html: Alaska is a third person investigation and exploration game, where you play as Clarence a former bounty hunter seeking revenge. You will have to follow the trail of Enyeto, on the run after being accused of your brother's death, by reconstructing his adventures on various investigation scenes. Explore the vast snowy landscapes of Alaska and track down your target, where only you can decide his fate. rows.name: Habbo Hotel: Origins
rows.short_description: A pixel-art social simulation MMO where you customize your avatar, build and decorate rooms, trade rare items, and join live community events in a nostalgic yet ever-evolving virtual world.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Habbo Hotel : Origins Step back into a vibrant pixel universe where familiar faces and fresh surprises await. Remember that first rush of logging on, choosing your avatar’s hairstyle, then racing through crowded lobbies? You’ll feel it all over again—only bigger and with brand-new twists. Your Pixel Self, Your Rules Ever wondered how far your creativity can stretch? Slip into hundreds of new outfits, mix ’n’ match classic looks, then head to our revamped fashion studio. It’s casual, it’s bold, and it’s entirely you. Build, Share, Repeat • Design cozy lounges or epic party halls with fresh furniture packs • Show off your space in community showcases • Trade rare items in friendly marketplaces Here’s the thing: whether you’re crafting a chill corner for friends or an over-the-top dance floor, the tools are out there. Think retro vibes paired with modern flair—so you never feel boxed in. Live Events That Keep You Guessing You know what’s fun? Spontaneous quests, surprise DJ sets, and pixel treasure hunts. Our calendar is always packed. Join a midnight rave one day, then team up for a build-off the next. It’s social gaming without the fuss. Why Habbo Hotel : Origins? Honestly, it’s more than nostalgia. It’s a living, breathing community that evolves every season. Whether you’re reconnecting with old pals or making new ones, there’s always a reason to log back in. Ready to Jump In? Install now and claim your free Steam starter pack (Nameplate & Steam Crank!), once you've reached level 15 in either the fishing or gardening skill! Your pixel playground is open 24/7 and waiting for you. See you in the lobby!

rows.name: Cube Ninja
rows.short_description: Cube Ninja is a fast pace platformer. By the power of shuriken, he could weaving through the air and piercing enemies like flash. Confront the spraying blood and blade in front, can the Cube Ninja overcomes this wild hunt?
rows.description_html: Ninja Destiny When the full moon rises, the unrested ghosts who died on the battlefield appear again to seize the bodies of normal people for revenge or simply to kill. To protect the peace of everyone, each generation of Cube Ninja has to use “Pure Jade Shuriken” to sever the grudge and send souls back to the underworld forever. But with each severing, the original owner of the body will die too. Will our new Cube Ninja, who just took shuriken from his dying master, end everything? Or he’s just another soul that also lost in slaughter, like those ghosts? The ninja needs to resolve this battle as quickly as possible; he must find the origin of all this and then eliminate it. Ninja Moving Fast The ninja's fast movement skills come from the power of shuriken. The ninja first needs to throw the shuriken. After the shuriken is thrown, the ninja can immediately rush to the shuriken. The enemy hit by the shuriken will fall into a flaw, and the ninja's sprint can instantly kill the enemy who falls into the flaw. In addition, the ninja also masters karate. It will automatically kill or block any danger that is close enough. But once the shot is made, the ninja will fall into a flaw. After killing the enemy again, you can attack again. In the level, the goal of the ninja is to kill enough enemies and reach the end. In the level, the ninja does not need to kill all the enemies, but only needs to find the fastest route in the vast sea of enemies. Game highlights: 1. Move at super high speed, passing through the scene like flowing water. 2. Plan the route with enemies as nodes. 3. Use terrain to fight. 4. Interesting mini-game levels. Ninja Eat

rows.name: ScreeIN
rows.short_description: ScreeIn is a psychological horror experience about isolation, memory, and self-deception — a fragmented journey into a mind on the edge.
rows.description_html: Screeln’s game begins with the end: your death. The rest is a descent into fragmented memories and constructed realities. Using a broken television set as a gateway, you switch channels — each one a surreal stage, echoing a piece of your past. ScreeIn blends exploration, environmental puzzles, and narrative horror into an episodic structure. Each “channel” is a level designed around a specific trauma, a specific rule, a specific lie. Some are quiet. Some are violent. All are watching you. As you navigate haunted offices, infinite parking lots, looping corridors, and abandoned domestic spaces, your role shifts. Sometimes you’re a solver. Sometimes you’re the observed. Sometimes you're no longer sure. In every space, you must enter the screen to proceed. Throughout, strange rules govern each space — rituals you must obey, or break, or decipher. These rules aren’t always written, and breaking them may not mean what you think. To move forward, you must solve puzzles rooted in these shifting logics. Scattered across these scenes are physical traces of progress — things to be remembered or reclaimed. You collect channel buttons as keys to advance, each one anchoring you to a deeper truth. The game uses a reverse narrative structure: the further you go, the closer you come to your beginning. In time, you may exit the screen, discover what truly led to your end — or get lost in the noise trying.

rows.name: Jojon Wik
rows.short_description: He just wanted his cat back now everyone's getting punched. Play as Jojon Wik, a legendary brawler on a rampage after a corrupt official’s spoiled son steals his beloved cat. In this hilarious fighting game, battle through enemies, flashy combos, and over-the-top action. Justice is coming.
rows.description_html: Jojon Wik Step into the furious fists and flying kicks of Jojon Wik , a wild, over-the-top fighting game where corruption gets KO’d — one spoiled brat at a time. When the pampered son of a corrupt official steals Jojon’s beloved cat , he unleashes a storm of righteous vengeance the city will never forget. You are Jojon Wik , underground legend, and the last person you’d want to anger. What started as a simple catnapping turns into a full-blown beatdown tour through the twisted world of privilege and power. Jojon Wik its not the official game of John Wick Movie. FEATURES: Arcade-style 3D Fighting – Tight controls, and flashy combos. Story Mode – Satirical campaign filled with difficult boss, shady office. Unique Enemies – Bunch of bodyguards. Unlockable Moves & Costumes – Fight in style and absurd special attacks. Voice-acted Dialogues – With serious delivery.

rows.name: Transit King Tycoon
rows.short_description: Build a thriving trucking empire as the manager of a growing logistics company in this exciting tycoon game. Manage a diverse fleet of trucks, semi-trucks, buses, and even ships as you transport goods and expand your empire!
rows.description_html: Step into the ultimate truck simulator with Transit King! Build a thriving trucking empire as the manager of a growing logistics company in this exciting tycoon game. From small deliveries to large-scale operations, create a logistics network that connects cities, ports, and production hubs. Manage a diverse fleet of trucks, semi-trucks, buses, and even ships as you transport goods and expand your truck simulator empire! MANAGE YOUR TRUCKING EMPIRE Start with a small fleet and expand your garage with a variety of trucks and cargo vehicles. Grow your routes, meet rising demand, and unlock strategic opportunities to become a successful tycoon. Are you ready to lead the ultimate truck simulator and grow your business? TRUCK SIMULATOR & TYCOON FEATURES Deliver Goods Across Cities: Move cargo to cities, businesses, and factories to keep supplies moving. Upgrade Your Fleet: Unlock, buy, and upgrade an extensive selection of trucks to boost capacity and efficiency. Build Facilities & Increase Demand: Create warehouses and production sites to generate new orders and revenue. rows.name: Atollo
rows.short_description: Set sail across a shifting sea in this colorful pixel-art adventure. Battle enemy ships, meet goofy islanders, collect magical eggs and awaken the kraken. A compact, handcrafted, free-to-play game.
rows.description_html: Set sail into the unknown in Atollo , a vibrant, pixel-art sea adventure where every journey is unique. Explore a shifting archipelago, meet goofy island dwellers, and battle rival ships to collect five magical eggs - your only key to awakening the kraken at the heart of the map. FEATURES 🗺️ Ever-changing map Explore a procedurally generated archipelago - no two voyages are the same. 🚢 Fast-paced naval combat Face off against enemy ships in tight, tactical battles on the open sea. 🌴 Bizarre island encounters Visit 5 random islands per run and meet one of 24 whimsical characters - from moons with sunglasses to haunted coffee pots. 🥚 The egg hunt begins Earn magical eggs from the islanders. Collect all five to summon your final challenge. 🐙 Face the kraken Unlock the center of the map and confront a colossal sea beast in a thrilling endgame battle. 📸 Progress artwork After each run, view a unique scene featuring the characters you’ve met - and silhouettes for those yet to be found. A GAME MADE WITH PICO-8 Atollo is a standalone desktop release built entirely in Pico-8 , a fantasy console for tiny retro games. Development on Pico-8 is a celebration of creative constraints, compact code, and playful design - and it’s free to play . ABOUT THE DEVELOPER Hello ! I'm Alberto and I'm a solo developer with a passion for expressive games :)) Atollo was created from start to finish by me, from the design and code to the art and audio, as a personal challenge and a way to grow as a game maker . I’m releasing Atollo for free with the goal of sharing something fun, goofy and replayable, while building a portfolio that can help me take the next step into the game development industry . If you enjoyed the game or have any feedback, I’d love to hear from you! :))

rows.name: Radial Overdrive
rows.short_description: Strap in, hotshot! Welcome to Radial Overdrive! Weave through the city of opportunity and style in your state-of-the-art high-speed hovercraft. Upgrade your vehicle to keep those turns smooth and nerves loose. Push the limits of what's possible in this endless racing rogue-lite!
rows.description_html: Radial Overdrive is a retro-futuristic, endless racing rogue-lite where speed isn’t just a thrill, it’s survival. Set in a massive city controlled by large corporations, this hovercraft racing game takes you through the different parts of the city and shows you what life might be like in a couple hundred years. With wealth disparity increased dramatically, it is clear there is a stark contrast between the rich and poor. The lower levels are gritty, claustrophobic and dark, while the top levels are luxurious, beautiful and colorful! The Radial Overdrive race is organized by the rich for their entertainment, so you better make an interesting show as your life is literally in the hands of the 1%. Radial Overdrive is a thrilling blend of high-speed racing and rogue-lite challenges, where every run is unique, and every decision matters. Will you master the art of speed and rise to the top, or will you join the graveyard of fallen racers? Strap in and find out. Steam Deck compatible

rows.name: Gamer Stop Simulator : Prologue
rows.short_description: Gamer Stop Simulator is a simulation game where you manage a video game store. Buy games and consoles from customers, repair broken devices, test games, and add rare items to your collection. Negotiate prices, expand your store, and grow your business in this exciting retail experience!
rows.description_html: Gamer Stop Simulator Prologue– Passion, Pixels, and Profit! Gamer Stop Simulator: Prologue is the first step in your journey, starting with just a few old games and limited cash. In this preview version, you’ll begin restoring a forgotten shop, stocking shelves, and making your first sales. Advanced features will be available in the full version. GROW FROM LOCAL NOBODY TO LEGENDARY SHOP Host garage sales, take part in collector events, and decide your store’s future: will it be a massive marketplace, or a boutique museum of gaming history? INTERACT WITH UNIQUE CUSTOMERS Deal with collectors, bargain hunters, and nostalgic gamers. Some just want a cheap game, others bring in boxes of hidden gems for you to inspect. Negotiate hard or miss out on rare finds. REPAIR & DIAGNOSE SYSTEMS Use your diagnostic tools to find and fix hardware issues. As your skills grow, you’ll identify deeper problems, lower repair costs, and boost resale value. Everything from cosmetic damage to deep internal failures awaits your expertise. MANAGE YOUR SHOP LIKE A PRO Open and close your store manually. Clean, organize, and decorate your space to attract more customers. Expand your business, unlock new areas like repair zones or testing stations, and customize your store layout. ACTIVE OR IDLE — YOUR CHOICE Whether you prefer hands-on retail gameplay or earning passive income through online sales and rentals, Gamer Stop Simulator supports your style. Just don’t neglect your store—dusty shelves and unhappy customers mean bad reviews and lost revenue. rows.name: Accordion Solitaire
rows.short_description: A different kind of solitaire. More difficult, more strategic.
rows.description_html: A different kind of solitaire. Accordion Solitaire is a more difficult, more strategic variation of solitaire. Starting with a shuffled deck, you will draw cards and make decisions about how to stack them based on matching ranks and suits. But there are strict rules about when cards can be stacked: When a stack is adjacent to a matching rank or suit. When a stack is separated from a matching rank or suit by exactly two other stacks. The goal of the game is to begin with one deck of cards, and end up with one stack of cards. It will be trickier than you might think! Features Multiple Rulesets Accordion Solitaire features 3 rulesets that change the way the game is played: Strict Draw one card at a time, and all possible moves must be made before drawing again. Relaxed Draw one card at a time, but you can continue to draw without making all possible moves if you choose. Free Draw the entire deck at once and play with full knowledge. Accessibility Accordion Solitaire comes with some accessibility features that make it possible for all to play. Possible move hints When holding a stack, possible moves will be highlighted to make it easier to understand your options.  Defaults to On. Auto draw Automatically draw cards until there is a possible move (only applicable when using Strict or Relaxed rules) so you don't have to click the deck manually as often.  Defaults to On. Reduced motion By default stacks shake when they have possible moves to make it easier to understand your options. If the shaking is distracting or overwhelming, you can force all stacks to stay still. Defaults to Off. High contrast Places a color filter over each suit to make it easier to understand when stacks have matching suits. Defaults to Off. Music & Sound Fully adjustable Music and Sound sliders allow you to modify volume in-game. Music and Sound can also be enabled or disabled. Defaults to enable Music and Sound, with volume set to 50%. Tutorial If the above rule explanation is difficult to wrap your head around, don't worry! There's a full tutorial in-game that will explain the concepts of Accordion Solitaire very clearly. The tutorial uses the following features: Strict ruleset Show possible move hints Auto draw The tutorial takes possible move hints even further by dimming stacks which would be impossible to move your held stack onto. The tutorial will equip you with everything you need to know in order to be successful at Accordion Solitaire!

rows.name: This Winter of Ours
rows.short_description: Alone as two, together as one - A fantasy/yuri visual novel telling the story of two girls traversing a snow covered forest and growing closer.
rows.description_html: Alone as two, together as one. This Winter of Ours  is a fantasy/yuri visual novel that tells the story of two girls surviving in a hostile winter forest, and living their new life together day by day.  As day turns to night and the last of the grass is suffocated by snow, apprentice merchant Delia finds herself completely lost and alone. With no hope for survival, she finally lays to rest her dreams of learning magic and discovering the secrets of her world, allowing herself to be taken by the elements. Yet she awakens, and finds an unfamiliar figure lying next to her. A girl who is similarly yet uniquely alone. While she isn't forthcoming on any details of herself, the girl agrees to escort the merchant to safety, thus beginning their presumably short-lived adventure. Little do the two know, they both have what the other needs. Will they be able to find that hidden treasure within each other, or will doubts and secrets consume them both? An apprentice merchant traveling in her father's shadow. Cordial yet anxious, she struggles to fit in with the life of a trader, secretly yearning for her dead dream of studying magic and becoming a mage. If only she had a little push. A short-spoken survivalist who calls the snowy forest her home. Initially a nameless stranger, she is given the name 'Lux' when she encounters an estranged merchant in training. Despite her distrustful nature, something within her compels her to help the apprentice trader escape the forest. Gameplay: ~3-4 hours of gameplay 30k words Assets: Custom sprites, cgs, and bgs Original Soundtrack (and sound effects!) Technical: Self-Voicing (enable with the 'v' key) Snow. Lots and lots of snow Keyboard and Controller support Crimfinity - Project Director, Coder, Co-writer 92FM - Lead Writer, QA adricheri - Art Director, Sprites, CGs, QA Flasium - Music, SFX DaxThinksNot - Background Artist  River - Splashscreen  QA Team - Nimiria, Rose, fitmarshmellow

rows.name: Vibe Clicker
rows.short_description: An idle clicker where you evolve from college graduate to Vibe Lord. Click, automate with AI tools, manage resources, and discover multiple endings in this satirical take on modern work life.
rows.description_html: From College Graduate to Vibe Lord Start as a college graduate looking for work, spending late nights and long days fueled only by a cup of coffee, as your clicks drive you forward. After hundreds of resumes and your first encounter with AI, you finally receive a job offer from an AI startup, In Beta Forever, Inc. During your boring and routine career obligations, you discover the shortcut has been in front of you the entire time. You start handing off your work to AI, and you feel you can run a business with how easy things have become. Watch as your career evolves and the world of AI unfolds before your very eyes on your journey to becoming The Vibe Lord. Features Six Career Phases - Progress through 6 fun and satirical career phases, from college graduate to legend, while ultimately trying to achieve Vibe Lord status. The only way to fully embrace change is to embrace risks. Resource Management - Balance your money, public reputation, and processing power as you click your way into fully automated clicking and purchasing systems. Satirical Story - A humorous, yet thoughtful exploration of AI’s role in modern work and society. Multiple Endings - Your choices ultimately determine whether humanity and AI find harmony, or something else entirely. Unique, hand-drawn art - All in-game art is hand-drawn and includes over 50 unique game icons and clicker art made by TheAverageGoob ​! The Vibe Shop is full of items to change your clicker once you become a Vibe Lord. Click responsibly. The AI is watching.

rows.name: Silent Residence
rows.short_description: Experience Harry's story of battling multiple personalities and his severe case of schizophrenia. In this First-person horror game, you battle the hallucinations and illusions your mind creates. You misjudge reality and quickly lose control over yourself.
rows.description_html: A Schizophrenic's Story Play as Harry, a man tormented by schizophrenia and multiple personalities. Delusions and hallucinations twist his world and perspective, turning friends and neighbors into threats. Harry’s mind can’t decide whether it wants help or total control.  Silent Residence is a psychological horror game about mental tension , identity , fear , and losing touch with reality . You must push on and fight your isolation with what's real. You can't give up. A Psychological Horror Experience A place taken in your apartment complex. The little details and your surrounding environment will feel the same, but they always have a frightening aspect to them.  NPC Interaction Interact with your neighbors and friends to narrate the story further. The people you live with can't be trusted. They always feel like a stranger to you, no matter how long you've known them. Hallucinations & Delusions The surrounding environments twist and change to simulate the horrors of schizophrenia. You never feel comfortable in one space. Keep moving and fight your delusions. You are nobody's isolation.

rows.name: Guns&Sodas
rows.short_description: GUNS&SODAS is a fast-paced rogue-action arcade where legendary sodas, wild guns, and explosive combos collide. Recover the Primal Sodas and unleash chaos with the power of Vending Machines!
rows.description_html: INFO GUNS&SODAS is a fast-paced arcade rogue-action game where explosive sodas and relentless gunfire mix into a high-octane experience! In a world where the Five Primal Sodas , the base ingredients of every drink ever made, have been stolen, only you, the Chosen Can Hero, can bring them back. Get ready to face waves of armed enemies, dynamic environments, and unleash the full power of the legendary Vending Machines ! THE 5 PRIMORDIAL DRINKS Collect the Primordial Drinks to unlock permanent effects for future runs. KEY FEATURES • Stylish, high-speed arcade action: Dash, shoot, and chain combos in a fast and fluid combat system. • Rogue-lite mechanics: Start each run from scratch, but as your skills improve, you’ll earn higher scores to unlock better gear and alternate paths . • Super Dash: Dodge enemy fire with high-speed acrobatic moves using the side mouse buttons (or by quickly pressing the left and right mouse buttons in sequence), or by pressing L3 on the gamepad. • Vending Machines as allies: Activate and upgrade VMs to gain rear cover. Some drop powerful gadgets that trigger your Super Shot . • Tons of guns: Discover a wild arsenal of pistols, each with its own unique mechanics and playstyle. • Combo system: Chain kills to boost efficiency and increase your final score.

rows.name: Summoners War: RUSH
rows.short_description: Summoners War: Rush is an idle tower defense RPG where you collect and strengthen your Monsters to build a team and defeat waves of enemies! Fight increasingly powerful foes across Stage Mode and Tower Defense Mode. Build your ultimate team and dominate every challenge!
rows.description_html: KEY GAME FEATURES Summoners War: Rush is an idle tower defense RPG where you build a team of Monsters to battle. Feast your eyes on fascinating Monster artwork and stunning skill effects, and take on stages and Defense mode bosses with your ever-evolving Monster lineup! Log in now and claim 14 essential top-tier Monsters and all the materials you need to start growing them—for free! Stages Climb through stages and face off against increasingly strong bosses. The higher the difficulty, the better the rewards. Exploit each boss's weakness to clear stages faster and reach new heights! Sky Island Defense (Tower Defense Mode) Enter Sky Island Defense, a unique tower defense mode. Strategically place your Monsters and unleash skill cards to wipe out waves of incoming enemies. Coordinate support skills to take down powerful bosses. Don't miss limited-time campaign events tied to new Monster releases—packed with valuable rewards. Magic Orb Use Magic Orbs to instantly acquire equipment. If a newly obtained piece is stronger than what's equipped, it will auto-replace to boost your power. Equipment is collected even during battle, making your progression both dynamic and satisfying. Challenge Put your skill card usage and Monster placement to the test in Challenge Mode! Face 25 intense waves on massive tower defense maps—twice the size of Sky Island Defense. Make real-time card choices, compete on the leaderboard, and aim for top ranks in new weekly seasons! Land of Conquest Hop aboard your airship and conquer zones across the Land of Conquest. Defeat bosses and capture regions to earn loot—including powerful boss Critters. Guild Dungeon Join forces with your Guild to defeat powerful dungeon bosses. Form a 50-Monster army—25 from your team and 25 from your Guildmates. rows.name: Imperfect Garden
rows.short_description: Imperfect Garden is an action-packed boss rush with two levels, each culminating in a unique boss that tests your reflexes. You control a one-armed youth in a desolate world, fighting powerful Perpetuos—proving that determination can triumph over adversity.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in a world that was once full of life and color, but now holds only remnants of what it used to be. Gardens that once boasted vibrant flowers and singing fountains now lie dry and covered in dust. Temples that were once majestic stand broken and half-entombed by withered vines. The wind sighs through the ruins, carrying a strange silence, as if time itself has stopped. Across this landscape walks a nameless youth. As a child, he lost his right arm in an accident he can no longer recall clearly. Despite the pain of his prosthetic, he carries his sword with unwavering resolve. The sky above him is forever painted in shades of orange and gray, like an endless sunset. Here dwell the Perpetuos, ancient beings wielding a dark power that relentlessly expands the desert. It is said that whenever one of them awakens, the land around them withers a little more. The youth knows that if they are left unchecked, soon nothing living will remain in this place. Your character’s skills are essential for surviving in this hostile world: Attack (Red): Deliver a frontal slash with your sword, engaging enemies head-on. Dash (Blue): Execute a swift forward movement, letting you dodge enemy strikes and reposition strategically. Parry (Yellow): Block and counterattack at the precise moment, using your sword to deflect blows and create openings. Crossbow (Green): Draw a crossbow to strike from afar, temporarily swapping your sword for a ranged weapon. To defeat each boss, you’ll need to blend your skills with cunning and perfect timing. Watch their tells closely: a slight recoil before a sweeping strike, a flicker of light before an energy blast, or a subtle trembling in their limbs—all signal the perfect moment to strike. Good luck, warrior, and may your determination shine beyond the darkness!

rows.name: God's Continent
rows.short_description: 'God's Continent' is a strategy card game. You will enter a magical world full of fantasy and adventure. Along the way, you can form a powerful team of your own among the three races of humans, beasts and demons, and embark on the road to fight against darkness.
rows.description_html: Travel benefits Gift Pack Redemption Code: godvip666 godvip777 godvip888 How to Redeem: Copy the redemption code - Click the avatar in-game - Redeem the gift pack Join our QQ group, Discord, and community discussion group to receive special gift packs (Japanese) About the Game The meteorite from outer space, like a ray of death light, cut through the vast starry sky and fell heavily to the Kalia continent. The huge impact force generated by its explosion, like a raging tsunami, almost swept the entire continent. This disaster not only brought material destruction, but also awakened the seven ancient demon kings sleeping in the forgotten land. Their awakening broke the balance of the world, and the Kalia continent instantly fell into the abyss of darkness, and a world-destroying catastrophe was about to come. At this moment of life and death, the legendary son of God came to this world with a mission. He will reunite the power of light, courage, and hope, fight a desperate battle with the dark forces, and fight to restore peace to the world. ​ The hero professions in the game are rich and diverse, with 6 major professions: Berserker, Mage, Shooter, Assassin, Shield Warrior, and Sacrifice, each with its own unique characteristics. Berserker, with powerful melee output ability, is like a meat grinder on the battlefield; Mage, who controls the power of elements, can cause high spell damage to the enemy at a long distance; Shooter, with superb archery skills, fast attack speed and high hit rate; Assassin, with quick shots, good at stealth and burst, can give the enemy a fatal blow in an instant; Shield Warrior, is a solid barrier for the team, with strong defense ability and health value to effectively protect teammates; Sacrifice, is the life guarantee of the team, with super strong healing and gain capabilities. ​ Before the battle begins, players can clearly see the enemy's information and position, so as to adjust the position and lineup in a targeted manner. The victory conditions and requirements in different battle scenes are different. Players need to pay attention to the battle prompts, the order of killing the opponent's monsters, and other requirements to achieve a perfect clearance. ​ Hero skill matching is also a highlight. Unlike conventional card mobile games, the hero skills here can be released manually by the player, and heroes with different attributes can stack different skill buffs, which can produce completely different effects. If you get stuck in a battle, you may find the key to a breakthrough by studying the effects of hero skills and releasing them in a reasonable combination. ​​ The hero development system is rich and in-depth. Players can use experience potions to increase hero experience, help heroes improve their ability levels, comprehend new skills and passive characteristics of skills, and use breakthrough gems to unlock new skills when they reach a certain level. In addition, the resources required for each level and rank upgrade and the effects after the upgrade are clearly informed to the players, so that players can accurately estimate the overall improvement and allocate development resources in a targeted manner. ​ Each hero has an independent equipment system and rune system. Different heroes with different runes can change the basic combat attributes of the hero, adding variability to the linear hero development mode. The game uses advanced graphics technology and high-end physics engines to create a colorful magical world. The characters and scenes are beautifully designed, whether it is an ancient European castle, a grassland in the wilderness, a mysterious cave, or a snow-covered mountain, they are all lifelike. The full-process sound effects output and the soft and sweet voice-overs of the beautiful girls bring players an immersive gaming experience. During the battle, the natural and smooth fighting movements and the gorgeous and cool skill effects make people excited.

rows.name: The Traded Groom
rows.short_description: A short adult otome about an arranged marriage and the many forms your new relationship can take.
rows.description_html: Today's your wedding day, and you've never met your husband. You're the chief of several semi-nomadic clans; he's an imperial prince of the Han people, with whom you have a complicated political relationship. You meet for the first time on the same day you marry, and you quickly find that he isn't the arrogant, prideful prince you'd expected. Get to know him over the night and find out whether he's a spy for your enemies or a victim of political schemes; and most of all, whether this marriage can work. Features: 35k words (1-2 hours of reading) One husband, who may turn into a love interest, friend, or remain a stranger 8 CGs (4 NSFW) 5 endings to the wedding night 4 epilogues and 3 extras after the wedding night, showing how your choices have shaped your relationship

rows.name: R.A.T.: Human Error – Episode One
rows.short_description: The world ended. Now the real nightmare begins. Deep underground, a child wakes in a infected facility. Minds are breaking. Bodies are changing. Crawl through vents, follow echoes, and escape before it’s too late. Your mother is waiting.
rows.description_html: Please note that there is a f12 bug that restarts the whole game, this will be fixed as soon as possible The war ended in a blinding flash. Now, the earth is hollow, a fractured shell hiding the remnants of humanity. A new era of evolution is about to begin. Survivors fled underground, but salvation was a lie. A sickness spread, warping minds, twisting bodies. No one is being spared. You are a child, taken to a hidden facility deep below the surface. You don’t know why. Only that you’re sick. That everyone is. And something is wrong.You have to escape. Crawl through the vents. Follow the echoes to get to the surface. Your mother is waiting for you. Explore a surreal, underground facility  by clicking through rooms, searching for clues, interacting with objects, and uncovering hidden paths. Converse with strange and varied characters , your choices affect what you learn and who you can trust. Crawl through dark vents to move between areas. The  Rat Maze is  a skill-based mini-game with multiple paths! Choices matter : your decisions shape the narrative, unlock secrets, and determine which of the multiple endings you reach.

rows.description_html: Mar is a first person low quality small horror game where your only task is to escape monster by searching for specific items to escape each location. The game features several maps ranging from underground dungeons and dreamy like place. Your objective is to collect 5 specific items in each place to unlock your way to escape. The monster's task is to hunt you down and prevent you from escaping so make sure that you aren't in its way. Game is designed to give a old-school gameplay style with low quality environment and some camera effects.

rows.name: CanKendama
rows.short_description: This system enables you to play Kendama in the real world by practicing Kendama in the VR world.
rows.description_html: By playing with this VR application, you can learn the techniques of Kendama, a traditional Japanese toy. There are two types of techniques that can be learned: “Moshikame” and “Tsubame-gaeshi”. If you practice these techniques in the app, you will be able to do them in the real world. In the VR world, you practice in an environment where the ball moves slowly and then gradually becomes faster. The system supports smooth progress with fewer stumbles. Please practice Kendama while following the model moves that appear in front of you, and then try actual Kendama in the real world. 【Warning】 This app is only compatible with Quest. Please note that other devices may cause hand orientation or malfunction.

rows.name: Curyeux
rows.short_description: Dive into the mind of Lucienne, a tormented painter. Leap through emotional memories, solve puzzles where shapes deceive and emotion leads the way. A dreamlike platformer where each painting brings you one step closer to yourself.
rows.description_html: Curyeux is a dreamlike puzzle-platformer where Lucienne Grégoire , the protagonist, embarks on a personal quest for meaning. Journey through fragmented memories drawn from her artistic world, as she dives deep into a period of intense introspection. Each level is a piece of memory, where logic gives way to perception. You’ll need to run, jump, solve, circumvent, and understand in order to move forward… and uncover yourself along the way. The adventure leads you through ever-changing painterly environments  : sketches, watercolors, bursts of color and brushstrokes, where appearances are often deceiving . Lucienne must learn to see through her own illusions, accept who she is, and break free from the gaze of others. Key Features 🎨 A variety of painterly landscapes , where every shape reflects an emotional state. 🧠 Puzzles that challenge your reasoning and perception : observe, understand, and experiment. 🌌 A symbolic and touching narrative , told through the environment, movement, sound, and gameplay. An introspective journey about identity , self-acceptance, and the transformative power of doubt .

rows.name: Iron Dusk Path of Honor
rows.short_description: A 2D/3D hybrid medieval action-adventure game where you fight, block, and outwit enemies in real-time combat while navigating arenas, pirate towns, and cult strongholds on a quest to reclaim your honor.
rows.description_html: Iron Dusk: Path of Honor is a gripping 2D/3D hybrid medieval action-adventure where honor is forged through fire, steel, and sacrifice. Step into the boots of a fallen knight as you embark on a cinematic journey across a war-torn kingdom, haunted by betrayal and bound by destiny. Once a celebrated hero, you now fight to reclaim your name in a land overrun by cultist tyrants, ruthless pirates, and shadowy forces. Cast into the depths, forced into arenas, lost at sea, and hunted by ancient evils, your path to redemption winds through arena combat, treacherous towns, and storm-wracked shores. ⚔️ Features Epic Story-Driven Campaign – Follow a fully narrated, chapter-based storyline with dramatic voiceover and cinematic presentation. From dungeons to duels, each act builds toward a climactic final confrontation. Hybrid Visual Style – Traverse a stylized world where 2D art blends seamlessly with 3D combat arenas and environments. Skill-Based Combat – Slash, block, and strike with precision in reactive real-time battles. Right-click for light attacks, left-click for heavy blows, and time your parries to survive deadly encounters. Morality and Choices – Lie, gamble, or fight your way forward. Outwit pirates in games of Liar’s Dice or take your chances with your sword. A World of Danger and Wonder – From outlaw ports to Viking cult villages, the world of Iron Dusk is rich with atmosphere, mystery, and danger. Dynamic Encounters – Face brutal arena fights, bar brawls, sea storms, and siege warfare as you climb from disgrace to glory. 🛡️ Will You Rise? Fight for your kingdom. Reclaim your honor. Face the cult. Confront the king. The dusk is falling—but from the ashes, heroes rise.

rows.name: My Sexy Neighbour 2 | Prologue
rows.short_description: Before the fame came the thrill. In this provocative prologue to My Sexy Neighbor 2, you take your first steps into a world of voyeurism, dares, and dirty cash. Sneak, stream, seduce — and discover how one wild night can change everything.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the prologue of My Sexy Neighbor 2 — the forbidden origin story where everything begins. Before the fans, before the fame, and before the full-on madness, there was just you — a bored nobody with a camera, a dirty mind, and a thirst for something more. What started as a joke — a few dares, a few sneaky clips — is about to spiral into something wild. 👀 Peep into lives behind closed doors. 🚪 Test your limits with petty break-ins and first risky stunts. 🎥 Discover the thrill of being watched — and paid for it. 💬 Meet the first voices of your future fanbase: hungry, twisted, and very generous. 💦 And yes — expect things to get hot. Very hot. 🎮 What’s in the prologue: 🌃 First missions — low stakes, high tension. 🛠️ Basic tools and dirty tricks. 🔞 Softcore mischief meets hardcore curiosity. 💻 A peek into the dark web future. 🌐 Open world with real-time flow — do what you want, when you want. 🧠 NPCs live their own lives — watch, follow, interfere... or seduce. ⚠️ What happens next? That’s up to you. But this is where it all starts — with one bad decision that feels way too good. Your story’s about to go viral. Ready to hit “record”?

rows.name: Lost in the Woods
rows.short_description: 'One last try' Violet is determined to save her broken marriage - at any cost!Wandering through a dark forest in search of lost mementos, she finds the world around her shifting with every step.
rows.description_html: Violet’s marriage is falling apart. One night, in a desperate attempt to make things right, she ventures into a mysterious forest, determined to gather the cherished belongings that once brought joy to her husband. But the woods are filled with secrets: a strange will-o’-the-wisp appears again and again, its intent unclear - friend or foe? As Nordic folklore comes to life around her, the line between reality and memory begins to blur. A Journey into Darkness On her search for the lost fragments of her relationship, Violet encounters strange objects and enigmatic creatures. Some seem familiar, others frighten with their strangeness. As she ventures deeper into this surreal forest, the line between reality and delusion begins to blur. Things appear that shouldn’t exist, memories twist, and every decision can lead her fate further into an unexpected direction. Explore. Uncover. Remember. Wander through the eerie woods and uncover their hidden secrets. Collect scattered clues like fragments of Violet’s past and interact with mysterious objects that sometimes promise answers… and sometimes only raise new questions. Listen to Violet’s voice as her thoughts, doubts, and longings come to life. Every step and every spoken word brings you closer to the truth… or drives you further into madness. Everything Changes What once felt familiar may vanish in the blink of an eye. New paths open, and known places shift their appearance. The forest lives and transforms with every step you take. Nothing remains the same, and each discovery pulls you further into a labyrinth of secrets that will never let you go. Choices That Matter Your choices shape not only her path, but also the reality around her. Are you ready to lose yourself and uncover every hidden truth? Features A short story told through 2D exploration in a surreal setting Visual novel passages with two possible endings A deep psychological story about love, loss, and madness Unique visual scenes and illustrations Dark atmosphere and subtle horror A journey between reality, memory, and delusion

Listen to Violet’s voice as her thoughts, doubts, and longings come to life. Every step and every spoken word brings you closer to the truth… or drives you further into madness. Everything Changes What once felt familiar may vanish in the blink of an eye. New paths open, and known places shift their appearance. The forest lives and transforms with every step you take. Nothing remains the same, and each discovery pulls you further into a labyrinth of secrets that will never let you go. Choices That Matter Your choices shape not only her path, but also the reality around her. Are you ready to lose yourself and uncover every hidden truth? Features A short story told through 2D exploration in a surreal setting Visual novel passages with two possible endings A deep psychological story about love, loss, and madness Unique visual scenes and illustrations Dark atmosphere and subtle horror A journey between reality, memory, and delusion

rows.name: Vigil
rows.short_description: Vigil is a short Narrative Horror Game that takes place in an unsettling underground facility. Your job is to dispose of boxes, however, you’re not alone. A terrifying automaton roams the facility, moving only when you look away or when you blink in real life.
rows.description_html: This game is best experienced with a webcam Gameplay: Vigil is a short Narrative Horror Game set deep underground in the decaying halls of Vigil Incorporated. To create a truly unique horror experience, the game detects when you blink by using your webcam. You play as an employee and your job here is simple. You must dispose of boxes. It may not be as easy as you think since you aren't alone in this facility... A terrifying and dangerous automaton roams Vigil Inc.'s derelict halls. If you encounter it, DON'T BLINK AND DON'T LOOK AWAY . This automaton can only move when you aren't looking. Vigil Inc. holds many secrets and you might uncover a few during your shift. Remember to stay Vigil. Features: Real-life blinking detection via webcam Alternative keyboard-based blinking mechanic for non-webcam players A terrifying, Weeping Angel-inspired enemy that responds to your actual blinks A short but intense narrative-driven horror experience Basketball!

rows.name: W|RE
rows.short_description: A veteran hitman, bored with routine assignments, alters their perception with a mind-bending drug, shifting to a stripped-down reality, where they perceive only sounds as light as they eliminate their targets as fast as possible to earn more money.
rows.description_html: Summary W|RE is a short fast-paced, first-person shooter where you play as a veteran hitman—tired of routine contracts—who takes a mind-altering drug that radically changes how he perceives the world. In this altered state, sound becomes light: every gunshot, footstep, or musical beat sends out colorful waves that briefly illuminate the environment in glowing outlines. Your mission is simple: reach the target location and eliminate your enemies as fast and precisely as possible. The faster you are, the more money you earn. If you're not satisfied with your performance, try again—perfect your rhythm, and climb the highscore ladder. Goal The goal is to clear all rooms in a level as quickly and efficiently as possible while maximizing your score. Your final score is affected by several factors, including clear time, headshot count, hits and accuracy. The better you perform, the more your employer is willing to pay - and the higher you climb on the leaderboard. Setting The world of W|RE is inspired by the cyberpunk aesthetic: dark, industrial environments lit by vibrant color and driven by pulsing music. A short comic-style cutscene introduces each run, explaining your mission and setting the tone. Speakers placed throughout the world reinforce the rhythm, making every level feel like a playable beat-driven hallucination where your perception is as much a weapon as your gun.

rows.name: CAPTAIN FIRAT
rows.short_description: The world is a vast, beautiful and dangerous place, especially if you're stranded on an island full of cursed skeletons. Find ways to escape from this island together with the villagers on the island.
rows.description_html: The world is a vast, beautiful and dangerous place, especially if you're stranded on an island full of cursed skeletons. Find ways to escape from this island together with the villagers on the island.    Uncover the mysteries while playing through the story! Who did this to you? How do you go home? These are all answers you will uncover as you play through the story.    It’s time to go big, or never go home!    Craft weapons and kill cursed skeletons.    Gather materials and build on the island. Spears, Axes, Bows, Spearguns, and so much more can all be crafted through an interactive crafting menu or by the quick-craft selection wheel. Items in your inventory and on the ground around you can all be crafted into something useful.    If you are hungry, the easiest way is to fish. Hunt, Fish, Trap, and Skin animals for food or kill to insert your dominance over the pacific islands.    neglecting animals on the farm. Build and manage your farm with water management and plant growth cycles. Create your own custom island and add it to your survival world!

rows.name: Space Alien Hangar
rows.short_description: Play as a space alien in a light-hearted third-person 3D sci-fi adventure. Explore a space station hangar, power up the hover jack, transport an aggressive alien pet onto the shuttle, fix the broken shuttle engine, etc. All with the help from your floating AI companion. Gamepad suggested.
rows.description_html: It's up to you, our hero space alien to complete this light-hearted short third-person pov sci-fi adventure. Explore the shuttle hangar bay on the space station, interact with gruff NPCs, power up the hover jack, transport an aggressive alien pet, fix a smoking shuttle engine with your space wrench that you left up in the break room, launch the shuttle from the control room, etc. A short, quirky sci-fi adventure with no combat and lots of charm.

rows.name: Pumpkin Simulator
rows.short_description: Pumpkin Simulator is a game in which you can become a pumpkin.

rows.name: LIGHT-BRINGER
rows.short_description: LIGHT-BRINGER is a first-person exploration horror game with psychedelic visuals and a harsh noise soundtrack. Explore 3D platforming environments with puzzles and mazes reflecting facets of American Christianity, collect hidden Sacred Hearts, and confront Lucifer's temptation.
rows.description_html: Witness a psychedelic vision of American Christianity. LIGHT-BRINGER is a first-person exploration horror game with psychedelic visuals and a harsh noise soundtrack. Explore multiple levels featuring puzzle platforming elements and hidden items, while chaotic FMVs play in sync with the music, creating an inescapable audiovisual nightmare that continuously changes as you explore it. Engage with the temptation of Lucifer and gaze upon his works. The game explores Lucifer as a metaphor for humanity's capacity for malice. Platforming sections are interspersed with cutscenes during which Lucifer will show you what he has done, and ask you to join him. Watch as Christ's message is contorted and abused by the powers that be. Environments and in-game videos depict the resurgence of Christofascism in the United States of America, and how its proponents publicly and privately act in ways that are directly contradictory to the teachings of Jesus of Nazareth.  Love each other. -Mared Jurphy Special thanks to Tyler Jordan and Curtis Krommenhoek for play-testing LIGHT-BRINGER, and to Chloe Murphy for her invaluable insight throughout the development process. Made using FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.

Featuring a mix of gameplay genres and an awesome soundtrack (if you’re into harsh noise), this is a trip that’s also food for thought.” Weird Fucking Games

rows.name: Curse of Woney
rows.short_description: A Turn-Based RPG + Roguelike following a Familiar trying to free himself from a witch. Optimize your build, and sling spells until you're free.
rows.description_html: After being turned  into a cat against his will (again), Woney wakes in a familiar place,  with little memory of his current situation.  All he knows is there's only one way out; Death. Whether it be his, or anyone who stands in his way. A turn based RPG/roguelike hybrid with an emphasis on story. Over 50 Spells to Pick and Choose from Each Run! Explore the ever changing and winding halls of a Witch's Manor. Follow a quirky, yet haunting story about a Witch's Familiar trying to set himself free. Optimize until you're a force to be reckoned with in this Turn based Rogue Like!

rows.name: Maru Expedition: We can fly
rows.short_description: Catch falling allies and dominate the battlefield! Control your flying platform to catch characters and auto-attack enemies. Build your team, link skills, and shape your own strategy in this evolving arcade action game.
rows.description_html: Thrilling Control Action that Starts with a Catch Combat begins with a single catch. Control your flight device to precisely catch characters falling from the sky—only then does the battle begin. With enemies and projectiles coming from all directions, predict the falling path and move swiftly. One precise control can change the flow of the entire battlefield. Distinct Characters, Strategic Team Combinations Each character has a unique attack style and skill. Some gather enemies to eliminate them at once, some control the battlefield with powerful knockbacks, and others strengthen the team with support abilities. Your combat experience changes dramatically depending on your choice of characters. Design your own combinations and create a unique playstyle by linking skills together. Skills That Evolve Through Build Progression Depending on your upgrades, attack patterns can change, skill effects evolve, and your entire playstyle can shift. This is more than just number scaling—it’s about evolving your combat experience. Discover the joy of growth where skills transform and strategies expand.

rows.name: Band Together
rows.short_description: Band Together is a retro 2D action platformer game with cute pixel art graphics and challenging gameplay. Search for your fellow bandmates as you traverse a deserted island! Find and utilize the power of magical musical instruments to make your way past rough terrain and dangerous creatures.
rows.description_html: Story Allegro, the conductor of a travelling band, wakes up on a deserted island, all alone after a storm at sea leaves them shipwrecked and stranded. The rest of their band is nowhere to be found! Use magical instruments to traverse the island and discover the fates of their lost band members, but beware, fearsome foes and obstacles lurk around every corner... Gameplay In this  retro-styled 2D action platformer,  collect magical instruments to improve your movement and combat capabilities. Use them to traverse obstacles, defeat foes, and complete multiple uniquely themed levels. These levels will test your skills and tenacity, requiring you to master and combine your instruments’ abilities to survive the island’s dangers! Features Swap between four different instruments, each with unique movement and combat abilities. Many unique enemies and obstacles to overcome, each with different ways of moving and interacting with the player. Retro-inspired difficulty, featuring an easy mode for less experienced players. Three unique environments to explore. Speedrun mode for hardcore gamers aiming to beat their best time. A complete storyline featuring dialogue scenes between the characters in the game. Adaptive soundtrack that changes based on the instruments you collect and use in-game.
