rows.name: FlushFall
rows.short_description: Welcome to FlushFall, a toilet Battle Royale!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Flushfall!  In this game, your goal is to battle the other 99 toilets on the map until you're the last toilet standing! Why Toilets? Why are you fighting? How did you get here? These are the questions that go unanswered the entire game. Fighting Mechanics 'How do all these toilets fight each other?' I hear you asking. Well, they use the only thing toilets are truly afraid of... Plungers. As the player, you click once to kill anything in front of you! That's right, everyone is one tap! You're never  safe! In a world of 100 toilets, where they're all fighting to be the last standing, you're never truly safe. Unless, of course, you become the winner. When you win, let's just say something magical happens. Customization? 'Customization?' I hear you ask? This game has plenty. You can customise your toilet using points you earn from playing the game! Don't you worry though, you can't buy these points using real Money, there's no in-app purchases! It's time to have fun and battle toilets in FlushFall!

rows.name: TakaichiMornSeed
rows.short_description: A desktop pet simulator for the overworked. Drag your pet across the screen—it snaps to edges. Set work hours for break reminders. Its killer feature? Scolding your boss when you work late. This is your cute, cathartic companion against burnout.Takaichi acompany with you!Hope Takaichi make you happy
rows.description_html: Meet your new desktop buddy! This cute, yet sassy, little creature turns your desktop into its playground. Simply drag it around your screen and watch it intelligently snap to the edges , keeping you company throughout your workday. Set your clock-off time , and it will thoughtfully remind you to take regular breaks and stretch. But when you're forced to work late, it won't hesitate to stand up for you, using humorous and cathartic phrases to 'greet' your boss. This isn't just a tool; it's an attitude—a healing companion designed for every office worker trapped by their workload. A Lively Desktop Companion Takaichi 'lives' on your desktop. Interact with it, drag it around, and observe its cute antics as it bounces off and settles against the screen edges. Smart Work Cycle Management Rest Reminders : Customize break intervals. It will promptly remind you to step away from the screen, protecting your health and productivity. Clock-Off Time Guardian : Set your standard finishing time. When the workday is officially over, it will celebrate your freedom. Overtime Venting System This is the soul of the game! When you work overtime, Takaichi shares your frustration. It becomes agitated and voices what you're thinking—using a series of humorous, sharp, and constantly updated lines to roast unreasonable overtime demands, acting as a safe pressure release valve for your stress. Personalization & Companionship Enjoy its unique personality and animations. It's not just a program; it's a digital friend who understands the struggles of your workday and stands with you, effectively reducing the loneliness of the job.

rows.name: Uncommon App
rows.short_description: Uncommon App is a narrative-driven simulation game where you play as an admissions officer balancing academic merit, magical ability, and finances. Review diverse student profiles, conduct interactive interviews, and make impactful decisions that shape the school’s future.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Uncommon Academy! In times such as these - full of post-conflict strife and upcoming uncertainty - being an admissions officer at Unmeiia's very own Uncommon Academy is a highly sought-after position. You should be proud.  But keeping such a position won't be easy - an excellent officer is expected to balance the academic strength of the academy with its financial situation. Only the best students are admitted to Uncommon Academy, and only the best admissions officers don't lose their jobs. Good luck! Key Features: Dynamic Application Review : Make tough choices as you evaluate diverse student profiles, balancing academic merit, magical ability, and financial viability. Branching Consequences : Every decision affects your school's stats and storylines — who you admit today could reshape the campus tomorrow. Mini Goals & Metrics : Follow shifting objectives and track real-time changes in your school’s Theory , Practice , and Finances . Legendary Students : Unlock hidden applicants with powerful buffs (and surprising drawbacks) that influence future admissions rounds. Interactive Interviews : Dive deeper into student personalities, personal histories, and magical vibes to make more informed — or emotional — decisions. After-Hours Exploration : Meet students and staff across campus, uncover their secrets, and gather clues from a mysterious shop hidden nearby.

rows.name: Old Thiess: The Werewolf’s Trial
rows.short_description: Inspired by a historical event, relive the trial of Old Thiess, a 17th-century Livonian peasant accused of being a werewolf. Through his testimony, fight demons and witches in Hell to protect the villagers of Jürgensburg from a diabolical cult.
rows.description_html: Based on a true story, Old Thiess: The Werewolf’s Trial combines exploration, combat, and the intensity of a 2D platformer with the interactivity of a narrative game, where the player's actions shape the outcome of the story. Depending on how well you perform, the villagers will either side with you or turn against you during the trial. The game tells the story of the trial of Old Thiess, a 17th-century Livonian peasant accused of being a werewolf by the Church and authorities. Through his testimony during the trial, relive his exploits in Hell. Explore three circles of Hell inspired by Dante’s Divine Comedy , each filled with unique landscapes, challenges, and encounters.

rows.name: AEXXOS
rows.short_description: Command 25 ship variants with 20+ upgrades in a living, multiplayer galaxy. Explore, trade, mine, and fight epic real-time battles. Forge alliances or betray rivals—your choices shape the universe. Dive into stunning space combat now!
rows.description_html: SPARTAN GAMES - Fair Play Guarantee AEXXOS is 100% no pay-to-win. Any real-money purchases are purely cosmetic—account- locked ship skins and vanity items—so every spaceship, ammunition and upgrade must be earned through gameplay. Your skill and strategy, not your wallet, decide your fate in the Galaxy. What is AEXXOS? Strap into the captain’s chair and command your destiny in AEXXOS. From your starship’s bridge, you’ll chart hyperspace routes, accept daring missions, and engage in heart-pounding PvP battles. Dock at bustling space stations to barter resources, coordinate fleet maneuvers with fellow captains, or execute stealth raids on rival convoys. With over 25 ship variants and 25+ upgrade choices , you’ll fine-tune engines, shields, weapons, and specialized modules to match your tactics—whether you’re a lightning-fast scout or a siege-ready dreadnought. Every loadout decision and alliance you forge shapes a living galaxy where your reputation is the ultimate currency. Living Galaxy AEXXOS’s universe runs on a living, player-driven economy—every resource you use comes from looting, trading, or conquering. Planets vary in what they offer: some lower-tier worlds yield raw ore, ammunition, and basic salvage, while more perilous systems reward daring captains with rare, high-grade materials. Pillage derelict ships for spare parts, conquer rival outposts to claim their stockpiles, or establish trade routes between star systems. As supply and demand shift, savvy captains buy low and sell high, turning battlefield loot into galactic influence. Conquer the Galaxy Forge your own path to supremacy: operate as a lone wolf carving out a reputation through daring raids and solo bounties, or ally with fellow captains in player-led corporations to seize control of star sectors rich in resources. Coordinate blockades against rival factions, plan synchronized assaults on orbital defenses, and defend your trade routes with fleet-wide tactics. Whether you’re staking a claim on a distant mining colony planet or rallying an armada to besiege an enemy stronghold, teamwork and strategic planning will determine who rules the galaxy—and whose legend endures among the stars. Indie Passion Project Born from the vision of a solo, dedicated indie developer, AEXXOS is our love letter to the classic MMOs of yesteryear and the communities that brought them to life. We’ve kept each feature intuitive for quick jump-in-and-play fun, while rewarding those who dive deeper with meaningful progression and discovery. And we’re only just getting started—this release lays the foundation for a universe we plan to expand and refine for years to come. Proudly self-funded and self-published, AEXXOS launches free of corporate influence and without any crowdfunding campaign—just pure passion driving every update. As a true passion project, we pledge to keep the universe growing—expect regular free updates, seasonal events, and fresh content drops as we build AEXXOS together with our players.

rows.name: Phantom Feline
rows.short_description: Play with light and shadow in this Game Boy–inspired puzzle game!
rows.description_html: In Phantom Feline, take control of the titular ghost cat with the power to become a sneaky shadow on walls bathed in light. You can't jump, but by turning into a shadow, you are able to scale walls and move in all directions. You'll use your powers and the many contraptions around you to solve perplexing puzzles and proceed to the next room. Featuring... The ever so cute and crafty phantom feline! 8 puzzling rooms to solve! Vicious vacuums to avoid! Authentic retro feel! 4-color palette, original sound chip, and authentic aspect ratio to the original Game Boy! As Featured At... rows.name: The CodFather
rows.short_description: A crazy 3D hack and slash game where you fight as a king! A survival snake-like game that combines snake-like action and card skill selection!
rows.description_html: 'That wasn't fish. It was a real 3D hack and slash from a madman with a Cod!' Welcome to the world of cod. This game is a 3D wave action game where you fight using Cod as a weapon. In Classic Mode, you can acquire card skills by eating the gems that drop when you kill enemies, and in Challenge Mode, you can automatically acquire card skills every 40 seconds. Level up your skills and survive longer! Good luck! [ ▣ Game Concept ▣ ] The game started with a very simple idea. The term 'ecological' originated from the fact that it was called by various names depending on the condition or drying method of the Cod. I found it interesting how Cod changes depending on its environment, and the idea came to me that it would be fun to give it different attributes and make it into a skill. In this way, a battle system that humorously interprets the characteristics of pollack was born, and the 3D action wave method was chosen as the genre that could best express it. [ ▣ Card System ▣ ] In the game, players can have up to five skills, and the skills vary depending on the turn they appear. Only active skills appear in the first 1-2 turns, and only passive skills appear in turns 3-5. From the 6th turn onwards, active, passive, and basic skills will appear mixed together. If you select a skill that you already have from the skills that appear this way, the level of that skill will increase. If you have all 5 skills, no new skills will appear and you will only be able to select to level up existing skills. Skills have different maximum levels depending on their type, and have different limits depending on the game mode. In Classic Mode, the maximum level of all skills is limited to 3. In Challenge Mode, the maximum level of active and passive skills, excluding basic skills, is expanded to 5. Basic skills are skills that are closely related to a character's basic stats. As the game progresses, various combinations and strategies become possible, and strategic choices depending on the turn become an important factor. [ ▣ Customizing ▣ ] You can customize your character with various costume items obtained through battle, allowing you to enjoy the battlefield in your own style. ★ Only Korean and English are supported in the game. ★

rows.name: Don't Let Me Fade
rows.short_description: Don't Let Me Fade is an interactive adventure about memory, identity, and loss. Piece together fragments of a life - even if a simple teddy bear is the last symbol of connection to oneself in a world without time.
rows.description_html: Don't Let Me Fade: adventure, interractive narrative [created in 48 hours as part of  GG-jam 2025 ] A narrative exploration game about memory, identity, and the slow unraveling of time. Created during a 48-hour game jam, Don’t Let Me Fade invites players into a poetic and emotional journey through the mind of a man losing himself to Alzheimer’s. A World Without Time The jam's theme, 'A World Without Time,' is interpreted here as a metaphor for Alzheimer’s - a fading world where memories slip away, and the boundary between past and present becomes unclear. Time has no meaning when memory itself is dissolving. The Story You play as an elderly man wandering through surreal, dreamlike environments stitched together from fragments of his memories… or is it his present reality? As you explore, you’ll piece together the outline of a life once filled with love, family, joy - and inevitable loss. The man is searching for a teddy bear, convinced it’s his last remaining link to who he truly is. rows.about_html: Don't Let Me Fade: adventure, interractive narrative [created in 48 hours as part of  GG-jam 2025 ] A narrative exploration game about memory, identity, and the slow unraveling of time. Created during a 48-hour game jam, Don’t Let Me Fade invites players into a poetic and emotional journey through the mind of a man losing himself to Alzheimer’s. A World Without Time The jam's theme, 'A World Without Time,' is interpreted here as a metaphor for Alzheimer’s - a fading world where memories slip away, and the boundary between past and present becomes unclear. Time has no meaning when memory itself is dissolving. rows.name: Poppy Sanctum Prologue: Aquance Isle
rows.short_description: Join Mimi as you solve a puzzle on an island controlled by powerful mages. You'll befriend red pandas and other creatures to conduct magic in order to escape in this 2.5D Isometric, puzzle platformer.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Aquance Isle, a holding place for Poppy before they enter the Sanctum. The island is full of friends who are nervous and weary about their potential new home. You will play as Mimi, a young red panda that is stuck on the island. Its Inhabited by mages trying to keep the poppy in control and some other mythical creatures. In order to escape this place, you'll have to recruit some friends to solve a puzzle which involves a cranky mage who can control water. You'll need to avoid the mage-keepers who don't want the poppy to get too rowdy, otherwise they just might cause a disaster. The other red pandas have insight into how the puzzle might be solved, so you'll have to see what they all have to say. But not before they rouse you into a game of tag. Features Hand drawn pixel-art and low-poly style. Whimsical and interactive environment. Physics-driven gameplay mechanics. Cuteness overload. A short, mysterious puzzle to solve. Original music full of mysterious ambiance. Around 10-30 minutes of gameplay. Red pandas!

rows.name: Hekaba
rows.short_description: After a long journey through the scorching sands of the desert, you come across an ancient abandoned temple. To get out alive, there is only one option: unravel the mysteries it holds.
rows.description_html: Hekaba is a puzzle/platformer game. Puzzle: Puzzles are at the heart of the game, based on an original pressure plate mechanic that is used to solve them all. Platformer: Exploration plays an essential role in solving the puzzles. To do so, you can move freely using elements of the environment that give you special abilities, such as double jumps or long leaps. Immersive environment: In the heart of the desert, an abandoned temple opens its doors to you. Its strange and captivating environments await your curiosity. Translated with (free version) Game features: - Run and jump. - Move from platform to platform. - Solve puzzles to advance in the game.

rows.name: Crystal of Atlan
rows.short_description: Crystal of Atlan is a Magicpunk MMO Action RPG where you can immerse yourself in a Magicpunk world. Build your skills, fight and uncover the secrets of this world with your allies! Time to embark on a wondrous journey of Magic and Machinery!
rows.description_html: Crystal of Atlan is a magicpunk MMO action RPG that supports cross-platform play between PC and mobile. The game centers on high-speed combos and three-dimensional combat, delivering a combat experience that combines both tactile satisfaction and strategic depth. DYNAMIC AIR COMBO COMBAT! Master fast-paced 3D combat even in the air. Break free from traditional ground-based combat! Chain combos from ground to air, combined with perfected airborne dodging, knockback collisions, and environmental interactions. Experience smooth combat like never before as you fill up the screen with dazzling visual effects and ignite your warrior within with hard-hitting skills! THRILLING FAIR PVP SHOWDOWNS! Dominate in PVP battles based on skill and mastery! Multiplayer PvP gameplay that emphasizes technical mastery and fair duels. In 1v1 Ranked Matches or 3v3 Team Battles, all players compete on equal footing with identical stats. Victory depends on execution, combo timing, and team coordination—true champions speak through skill alone. DISTINCTIVE CLASSES AND SKILLS! Customize skills with 10+ classes available! Choose freely from 5 base classes and 11 class branch options! Each class possesses over 20 skills that can be mixed and matched to build different combo rotations and playstyles for different combat roles. Find your very own build and playstyle! CHALLENGING TEAM BATTLES! Experience dungeons with strategic teamwork. An adventure is never done alone. Form teams and challenge co-op dungeons at any time! Fight bosses with unique mechanics and triumph over them with teamwork and coordination between classes! Fight together and share the glory and loot with your team! Team work makes the dream work! UNIQUE MAGICPUNK WORLD! Immerse yourself in a magicpunk adventure. Immerse yourself in the floating islands of Atlan, where magic and technology intertwine. As a member of the Adventurer's Guild, you'll delve into ruins, battle Decayed monsters, forge alliances, and uncover the truth of forgone civilizations, leading the world back to order.

rows.name: You And I
rows.short_description: 'You And I” is an interactive film where you guide Mark, lost deep in the woods with his friend, Ace. However the more time the two spend together, the stranger the two become.
rows.description_html: You and I is a comedic, abstract FMV that offers a choose your own adventure style narrative following Mark as he gets lost in the woods with his friend Ace. However, the more time the two spend together, the stranger the two become. Make decisions based on the fractured relationship between Mark and Ace to understand what is really happening. Navigating through the woods takes between 15 minutes and 1 hour , depending on how deeply you engage with the story and choices. The gameplay is designed for meaningful exploration, and is built around three core systems: Two-Choice Decision System: Allowing for simple branching narratives, and easy ways of back-tracking. Skippable Replays: Already seen a scene? You can skip them to keep the pace flowing without losing context. Plentiful 'Endings':   While there are multiple unique paths and route endings to discover, the game ultimately concludes with a single, pivotal decision that determines the final outcome and reflects the full journey you’ve taken. As the forest path unfolds and reality begins to lose meaning, where will you find yourself? How will you view Ace? How will you view Mark? Who are they together? If The Truth is Yours, Then The Truth is That Everything is ... Directed by Juan Ablan and Written by Juan Ablan and Kai Hugessen Acting performances by Ved Ballary (Mark) and Kai Hugessen (Ace) Edited by Juan Ablan and Ciara Murray … You And I

rows.name: Microwave Yourself
rows.short_description: Microwave Yourself is a casual VR puzzle game. Interact with items and combine them in a microwave (along with your head!) to unlock unique visual effects, music, and a message to advance your progress. Find all combinations to escape your torment...
rows.description_html: Stick your head in a microwave to receive messages from god. Microwave Yourself is a casual VR puzzle game. Find the correct combinations of items to put in the microwave (along with your head!) to unlock unique visual effects, music, and a message to advance your progress. You must find all three combinations in order to 'escape' What to expect: Silly jokes Trial and error Relatively short (30-120 minutes) Small, interactable environment Free yourself from torment. (Originally an academic project, this short VR experience is designed to take no longer than a couple of hours to complete. All music, art, and visual effects were made by a small team with love.) (We also advise that you do NOT actually stick your head in a microwave!)

rows.name: Casey Noir and Carved Pumpkin's Latte
rows.short_description: What's this? A Point and Click, 'Who Done It?', Murder Mystery Visual Novel, set in a Gothic Hotel on top of a lonely hill, during the Night of Halloween?
rows.description_html: You've read the description. It's pretty self-explanatory. If you're in a mood for a short, about 2 hour long, visually-heavy mystery game that's just right for the autumn season, then why not give this a try? However, if the free Halloween candy doesn't convince you, then read onwards. Step into the shoes of Casey Noir, an immortal, shadowy detective, who was invited to a Halloween party at a gothic hotel by a familiar face. Unfortunately, the reunion is cut short when one of the guests is murdered, with the murderer being one of the guests still present.  Investigate the hotel and its surroundings, chat with suspects, collect evidence, and dig to the bottom of what's exactly going on this Halloween. The masks of the party-goers conceal, detract, and lie.

rows.name: Simulators, strategies and pigeons
rows.short_description: A free collection of six independent games that explore the “simulator” genre from the most unexpected angles. From a medieval carrier pigeon to an alternative Slavic realm, from flower breeding to stick collecting — this games offers six unique gameplay experiences created by indie teams
rows.description_html: Simulators, Strategies & Pigeons A free collection of six independent games that explore the “simulator” genre from the most unexpected angles. From a medieval carrier pigeon to an alternative Slavic realm, from flower breeding to stick collecting — Simulators, Strategies & Pigeons offers six unique gameplay experiences created by indie teams. Each game stands on its own and dives into a different aspect of simulation: humor, emotion, exploration, or strategy. 💌 Carrier Pigeon Simulator Experience like a brave bird in the Middle Ages! Deliver letters between warring villages, evade obstacles, collect golden eggs! Establish peace and prosperity on the island! Genre: Simulator / Action-Adventure Setting: Medieval era Mechanics: Time management, quests, flight navigation 📰 Unbelievable Times You're a tabloid editor who's made a career faking stories about the paranormal — until it turns out they’re all true. Reptiloids are real. And now… you work for them. Genre: Simulator / Strategy Setting: 1960s America, sci-fi Features: Satirical narrative, political absurdity, aliens 🍂 Stay Strong! A meditative game about routine and the inner experience of someone going through a difficult time. No preaching — just repeated days filled with small acts of effort and emotion. Genre: Atmospheric Simulator Setting: Real life Features: Metaphorical mini-games, emotional progression, growing cycles 🌸 BloomWake A cozy fantasy simulator about magical flower breeding. Manage your own shop, bring life back to an industrial gray city, and rediscover beauty through creativity and kindness. Genre: Flower breeding & shop management simulator Setting: Miyazaki-style fantasy world Features: Relaxing gameplay, collection, emotional storytelling 🌲 This is my stick You find the perfect stick. Name it. Post it on a fake Reddit feed. Get upvotes. Explore forests, collect sticks, and earn the respect of your fellow stick fans. Genre: Cozy exploration / Collection Setting: Procedurally generated natural biomes Features: Humor, attention to detail, relaxing pace 🏰 Kings and... A simulator of leadership without absolute power. You are a regional ruler in an alternative version of early medieval Rus. Your party is your only true tool — use it wisely. Genre: Strategy / Simulation Setting: Alternative early-medieval Rus Features: Limited resources, recon and raids, semi-autonomous world Additional info 🎮 Platform: Windows ⏱️ Playtime: 15+ minutes per game 🧩 Genres: Simulators, Strategy, Adventure, Exploration, Meditative 🆓 Price: Free 👥 Developed by: Independent teams GD GUILD with the support of SUITD 'RESP' community

rows.name: Twilight Syndicate
rows.short_description: Uncover global crimes as an Interpol rookie in this thrilling detective adventure. Chase clues, and expose the Twilight Syndicate!
rows.description_html: Twilight Syndicate is an adventure game where players take on the role of a rookie Interpol detective tracking criminals across the globe. Armed with only a initial clue, players must investigate locations, follow trails, and piece together evidence to capture their targets. Along the way, they uncover the secrets of the Twilight Syndicate, a shadowy organization tied to legendary heists. Twilight Syndicate offers a campaign mode where players solve cases and uncover the truth about the Twilight Syndicate. The game begins with the player receiving a clue that leads them to a specific location. Players travel, talk to NPCs, and investigate for more leads. Each location presents challenges like finding hidden clues or solving puzzles. The game focuses on exploration, deduction, and decision-making. Every choice matters, keeping players engaged as they uncover the Twilight Syndicate's secrets and get closer to capturing the main antagonist initially know as 'The Gentleman'.

rows.description_html: 'Roll her, squeeze her, feed her buns.' t. incorrectlyrics Slap the network center button, enter a unique letter combination and convince your friends to roll this beauty up a tower. What is going on?  Nobody knows!! Let’s find out in this multiplayer jank fest! Features Roll-a-ball physics based multiplayer (or solo) gameplay. Uncomplicated online networking. Funny sounds. A ferocious fiend has with forensic foresight fearlessly found our mistresses fatal flaw, every nightfall she falls fast asleep. She awakens confunded! For where am I?  Frighteningly fresh this fanciful facility, with fragile falls in unforgiving forks.  Oh look! This guy is talking, I should pay attention. You roll a ball of water up a few levels, that's the game. Thank you.

Now you must solve a case for a disgruntled customer... or die trying. features: Top-down hand drawn world. Brain teasing puzzles Engaging spell system brimming with personality. Soulful, character-rich story with an emphasis on humor. Created by one person. I thought I found a 7th dog, but it was actually just the 3rd dog. rows.name: Valiants: Arena
rows.short_description: Each card is a possibility. Each move, a step toward victory. Collect, combine and unleash the elemental power of your Valiants in intense turn-based battles. Can you conquer the arena and become the ultimate Tamer?
rows.description_html: Discover Valiants: Arena! Welcome to the Arena, Tamer! Face off against other players with your team of 4 Valiants in strategic 2v2 battles. Swap your Valiants mid-battle and adapt your strategy in every match. Tactical and Dynamic Combat Switch your Valiants in battle and adjust your strategy as you go. But it might not be that easy with our Stage system. Winning? The arena might decide to make things harder for you. Losing? Maybe it’ll throw you a lifeline. Every turn is a plot twist. Every match tells a different story. Master the Elements Each Valiant has a role ( Tank, Attack, or Support ) and one or two elemental affinities ( Fire, Water, Earth, Ice, Wind, and Grass ). Choose the Best Skills Your choice of Skill Cards is just as important as your Valiants. Pick the right abilities, combine them with elemental affinities, and unleash powerful effects to outplay your opponent. Every Valiant is Unique Select from multiple Valiants and customize their arsenal with different Skill Cards and Accessories to match your playstyle. You are the Tamer Behind every great team, there’s a great leader. The Tamer is a key element in battle—choose between different skins and equip abilities that optimize your strategy and secure your victory. Prove You’re the Best Easy to pick up, hard to master. Valiants: Arena offers an accessible experience with enough depth to challenge even the most skilled players. Climb the ranks through the division system, compete in regular tournaments, and prove you have what it takes to reach the top.

rows.name: Stomach
rows.short_description: STOMACH is a first-person survival horror cooking game located in a cruise ship with PS1 inspired graphics to capture that retro horror feeling. Your task is to read a food order, search for food ingredients, and make it back safely to the kitchen to cook your ingredients before time runs out.
rows.description_html: Stomach is a first-person cooking horror experience set on an abandoned cruise liner. Your only contact is a crackling phone that spits out increasingly disturbing orders. Obey them before the timer hits zero. Core Loop 1. Answer the call. A mysterious boss dictates a single, elaborate dish. 2. Prep under pressure. Complete a variety of rapid-fire cooking minigames: cutting, toasting, microwaving, boiling, and a few others that stay unspoken. 3. Race the timer. Deliver the plate somewhere in the ship’s shadowed corridors. Miss the deadline and learn why no one else keeps this job. 4. Advance deeper. Each of the three levels unlocks new areas, ups the difficulty, and quietly bends reality around you. Key Features - Three complete levels, each with its own signature dish - 30-45 minutes of focused, replayable tension - 5+ interactive cooking minigames where precision matters and panic multiplies mistakes - Escalating jumpscares and subliminal shifts that keep your senses off-balance - Horror through routine: every order feels familiar until it doesn’t No combat, no scavenger hunts. Just you, a ticking clock, and a kitchen that never feels safe. The only thing on your mind, no matter what you might see or hear... YOU. MUST. COOK.

rows.short_description: Survive an onslaught of alien robots in this fast and intense action roguelike. Rapidly evolve your build by leveraging a huge pool of abilities, augments, and upgrades. There are millions of possibilities. Are you and your friends up to the challenge?
rows.description_html: A fast and intense CO-OP focused battle arena featuring rapid progression and randomized waves of increasingly more difficult enemies.  WHAT’S IN THE GAME? An array of battle arenas, each presenting varied and evolving layouts, hazards, and challenges. 90 unique abilities and augments derived from 9 elements: Fire, Light, Ice, Decay, Terra, Wind, Lightning, Void, and Chaos. 99 upgrades for abilities and augments. 18 upgradeable device powers which enhance player progression across playthrough attempts. 42 unique enemy types, including  7 multi-stage boss encounters. 3 multi-tier endgame challenge modes. An endless mode allowing you to push yourself and the game to the absolute limit. Single player or cooperative multiplayer up to 4 players. IT'S 100% FREE. NO MONETIZATION. Arena Survivors is a totally free to play survivors-like game mode from The Black Pool. Entirely developed by two friends, Arena Survivors is available to everyone. No DLC. No micro transactions. No loot boxes. Just have fun with your friends!

rows.name: Kip 2 : Beyond Boundaries
rows.short_description: Kip 2 : Beyond Boundaries - A very difficult precision platformer game about the chicken; Kip.
rows.description_html: Kip 2 : Beyond Boundaries Welcome to Kip 2, a very hard precision platformer, inspired by really hard games, mostly kaizo Super Mario World hacks, such as the ' Grand Poo World ' or ' Dram World ' series. Kip is a relentless game with countless levels, over 600 Story Mode levels that make sure Kip is tested to its limits. And if you have enough of the newer levels you can try the ones before 'Story Mode' was a thing too! Be aware that as of writing this (2-12-2025) some levels can be broken , but you can skip levels thankfully, don't be scared to skip a level here and there. Whether you are a casual or a sweat, this game provides plenty of challenge, if you have finished plenty of levels that hard variants will unlock, which are only for the most determined, thus the difficulty being really high! Almost every level has something new, from gravity changes, to all kinds of orbs that can do different things. The game can be a bit unforgiving at times, because of the tight controls, but patience and effort will always prevail! This game is mostly for people that like old school hard games or just the hardest of the hardest platformers that are out there. The game has a steep learning curve so it's also for anyone to flex their skills, and afterwards let them try to kip it ;) If the game has some weird hitboxes sometimes, It can happen, I'm aware of this problem, it's a little getting used to but I can't really change it because the game has been written fully with 'Scratch' which isn't 'made' for games of this magnitude but I prefer working in the engine over other game engines.

rows.name: Pantheon Poker
rows.short_description: Pantheon Poker reinvents Texas Hold ’em as a mythology-themed digital card game. Play each hand with four random suits, each with unique mechanics that shift strategy and tactics every time. Use a powerful AI-powered luck mechanic to bend odds in your favor and outwit your opponents.
rows.description_html: Pantheon Poker reinvents Texas Hold ’em as a mythology-themed digital card game . Play each hand with 4 random suits, each with unique mechanics that shift strategy and tactics every time. Use a powerful AI-powered luck mechanic to bend odds in your favor and outwit your opponents. Pantheon Poker blends the competitive depth of Texas Hold ’em with the creativity of deck-building games like Dominion . While the core poker rules remain—betting on who can make the best hand—the suits are where things change. Instead of the traditional four, each game draws from a pool of special suits, each inspired by a different mythological tradition. From Norse to Greek to Egyptian gods, every suit introduces new rules and card powers, creating a fresh tactical puzzle in every hand. At the heart of Pantheon Poker is a novel luck system powered by a custom AI model . Your cards and suit powers contribute to a luck stat , which subtly skews the probabilities in your favor. That means more favorable draws, stronger abilities, and clever ways to shift outcomes. Mastering this luck system is key to gaining the upper hand—and becoming a gambling god. Whether you're a seasoned grinder or just looking for a fun twist on poker night, Pantheon Poker is built for all skill levels . Play casually or compete at high-stakes tables with deep strategic depth. Sophisticated AI opponents offer a welcoming space for new players to learn—and a formidable challenge for veterans looking to train and refine their edge.

rows.name: Yes, No, Goodbye
rows.short_description: Yes, No, Goodbye is a haunting word game where you play as an exorcist attempting to send off a spirit clinging to their old apartment. Unscramble the truth and seek out solace for the dead.
rows.description_html: About this game Yes, No, Goodbye was lovingly crafted by a small team as part of Threeclipse's Junior Program — an initiative created for recent graduates and individuals wanting to pivot into the gaming industry. It's the first project & portfolio piece for most of this cohort's developers! Features Over 50 challenging word scrambles Unique art  Beautiful music An impactful story Grace in your goodbyes So you started the seance, but it looks like the entities aren't ready to move on. Pain. Well, nothing worthwhile ever seems to come easily. Guide them to the afterlife by relieving them of their worries. Have a chat, get to know them. And, uh… please don't freak out. It seems like they're in a bad mood. Solve Puzzles Hm… It looks like the experimental tools your boss provided are malfunctioning. Not a problem. You only need to unscramble the responses to figure out what the spirits are trying to tell you. Pay attention The ghosts seem to be strong enough to interact with the mortal realm. How curious… Wait… Is that blood?

rows.name: Nirvana, Origin of Fate
rows.short_description: 3rd person procedural survival 3D Game. The game allows you to simulate the character's survival needs and find meaning in adventure, and create a bond with the other characters in the game, to develop their ability to control the elements of the island.
rows.description_html: 3D third-person game that will take you on an adventure to an island in strange times. Discover your character's ability to survive and develop a long-term metapsychic story. The game allows you to simulate the character's survival needs and find meaning in adventure, and create a bond with the other characters in the game, to develop their ability to control the elements of the island. The story begins in a camp, where the player will find refuge from the very beginning. In a visually stunning environment, learn to communicate using animistic verbs and interact with non-player characters. You can hunt, fish, and gather. You'll be able to explore the island, learn to control the elements of nature, craft your tools, customize your appearance, and more. Explore the area and mark your path through the brush and rocks, and look for other camps. Events quickly give the adventure a plot twist. The player will face the seasons and the elements for an adventure that is as fun as it is educational. The player navigates an island generated by a keyword chosen by the player at the beginning of the game, which provides a number of possible islands. A first person mode is available for immersion. A game for nature lovers trapped in their social housing with a flashlight under the covers!

rows.name: Frontier Combat: Beginnings
rows.short_description: A fantasy JRPG where you build combo chains in turn-based combat, and defend against your enemy’s chains in real time!
rows.description_html: Battle, make allies, build your team, and rise to the top. The Grand Tournament awaits! Choose your favorite character and dive into a mysterious island full of powerful enemies, thrilling quests, and hidden secrets. Features An unique battle system: Build combo chains from mini attacks turn-based, defend your opponent combos in real-time! Solo adventure mode: Become the island’s strongest fighter in a solid 1 hour story-rich single-player experience! LAN multiplayer mode: Challenge your friends over a local network! Look for the multiplayer room receptionist inside Poa Town Market. Build your strategic party: Use your favorite allies and your learned attacks and defenses to create the strongest party and defeat everyone! Ally any enemy you face and recruit them to your party! Befriend your foes throughout your journey and expand your available roster of fighters. Fight and grind: Level up by battling wild enemies across the island. Wide-screen support! Supports up to 4k screen resolution! Original hand-made art! Original soundtrack: Enjoy a catchy, handcrafted OST throughout your journey. Developed entirely by one person.

rows.name: Supermarket Billionaire
rows.short_description: Who doesn't love supermarkets? Build your own empire! Improve your business, hire employees, optimize your facilities... and, most importantly, sell to become a billionaire!
rows.description_html: Have you always dreamed of owning your own supermarket? Start with a humble store and expand it into an unstoppable franchise.Manage products, upgrade your facilities, hire staff, and keep the money flowing. All with one clear goal: reach the top and become a billionaire. Upgrade and unlock an incredible range of products! Unlock and upgrade your supermarket products to generate amazing passive income nonstop! The better your products, the more you earn... Improve your supermarket facilities! Each upgrade gives you bonuses so powerful, even your products will want to work overtime. Make your store the envy of the neighborhood and watch your bank account grow without breaking a sweat! Hire employees! Hire all kinds of employees who do the work for you …  while you just sit back and watch the money roll in! But most of all... become a billionaire! Sell products, earn money to upgrade your supermarket, and unlock new opportunities. Every sale brings you one step closer to your ultimate goal: becoming an unstoppable billionaire!

rows.name: InfernaLLC
rows.short_description: Hell's most profitable Sinstribution™ firm is under attack by IRS operatives hell bent on tanking the company. Play as Inferna LLC's diabolical CEO or as tax-collecting Agents in this asymmetrical multiplayer RTS action dungeon crawl.
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO HELL!! No one escapes the IRS… not even Satan. Welcome to the 4th Circle, home of Hell’s own megacorp, Inferna LLC! In this asymmetrical multiplayer, play with three of your friends and uncover the secrets of Hell’s deepest, dankest cubicles, whether you seek its destruction or its salvation. Asymmetrical Fight with your friends against the ultimate evil: tax fraud. Wield the power of the IRS to destroy company assets, fight off underpaid Sinterns, and reclaim revenue. IRS Agents operate from a third person perspective, reacting to the environment around them in real time. Not an agent of justice? No problem! Play against your friends as the Chief Evil Overseer (CEO), strategically laying traps for the vexatious IRS agents, repairing damages, and hiring employees. View your capitalist realm from the top down perspective of your CCTV. Variety Inferna LLC offers a number of gruesome locations to explore, from a drab office to a labyrinthian warehouse. Each location bears new twists, turns, and challenges. Strategy As CEO of Inferna LLC., you have a wealth of assets at your disposal, including gruesome traps and an army of loyal employees willing to die for the grind. Be warned! You may be filthy rich but your funds will eventually run out. You must be selective with your spending, as the agents possess the power to damage accumulated revenue. When playing as the IRS, teamwork is important. Decide which weapons you and your comrades will wield in their quest for fiscal justice. These choices may just cost you your mission…

rows.name: Journey to Shambhala
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic quest in 'Journey to Shambhala,' a 3D Action-Adventure Hindi game that takes you deep beneath ancient temples in search of the mystical city of Shambhala. You must navigate through 5 challenging stages, each filled with obstacles to unveil the hidden pathway to the legendary city.
rows.description_html: Explore The Pathway To Shambhala - Hindi Adventure 3D Game: 1. Thrilling Adventure: Dive into a captivating narrative as you assume the role of a courageous hero on a mission to uncover the secrets of Shambhala. Explore the depths of ancient temples, solving puzzles, overcoming obstacles, and battling foes in your pursuit of the mythical city. 2. Five Competitive Stages: Conquer five uniquely designed and competitive stages, each presenting its own set of challenges and mysteries to unravel. From the intricate chambers of forgotten crypts to the perilous underground caverns, your journey will test your skills, wit, and courage at every turn. 3. Unravel the Mystery: Delve into the lore of Shambhala as you uncover hidden clues, decipher ancient symbols, and solve intricate puzzles. Piece together the history of this mystical city to unlock the secrets that have eluded adventurers for centuries. 4. Dynamic Combat System: Engage in adrenaline-pumping battles with formidable adversaries. Master a dynamic combat system that combines strategic thinking with swift reflexes, allowing you to unleash powerful combos and special moves against your foes. 5. Stunning Visuals and Environments: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world filled with rich details, atmospheric lighting, and diverse environments. From the haunting depths of subterranean tombs to the awe-inspiring landscapes, every step of your journey is a visual feast. 6. Hidden Pathways and Secrets: Navigate through intricate level designs, uncovering hidden pathways and secret chambers that hold valuable rewards and ancient artifacts. Discovering these secrets is key to unlocking the true potential of your hero. Embark on a quest that transcends time and space in 'Journey to Shambhala.' Are you ready to face the challenges, unravel the mysteries, and become the hero destined to uncover the secrets of this legendary and mystical city? The journey awaits!

rows.short_description: Compete with players around the world in a fast-paced 3D platforming shooter. Race through a variety of hand crafted maps, shooting at targets with an arsenal of weapons, all to achieve the fastest time on the global leaderboard!
rows.description_html: SPEEDRUNNING // Master your aim, strafing, and routing to complete maps as quickly as possible! LEADERBOARDS // Compete against yourself and against players all across the world in our global leaderboards! WEAPONS // Use a diverse arsenal of your favourite weapons, with a responsive system built for skilled players. MOVEMENT // Players of the Source Engine games will be familiar with your strafe-heavy movement system, designed for a high skill ceiling, further enhancing difficulty and complexity.

rows.name: CODE::LUX
rows.short_description: 泥沼化した世界大戦によって主要な電力インフラが失われ、文明が崩壊した未来。 遺物を求めて廃墟を渡るスカベンジャーのカイは、旧国家システムを掌握する謎の少女ミツハと出会う。 彼女の願いは、ただひとつ――かつて世界を支えた核融合炉を再び動かすこと。
rows.description_html: CODE::LUXは、マルチエンディング型ポストアプカリプス・短編アドベンチャーです。 ビジュアルノベルと、ローグライト風な行動選択型アドベンチャーを通して、無頼漢な男と無垢な少女二人の旅の結末を見届けましょう。 STORY 商業用核融合炉が実現した未来。 だが、世界大戦によってそのすべてが破壊・停止し、文明は崩壊した。 電力を失った社会は想像以上に脆く、今や人類は、各地に点在する小規模な再生可能エネルギー発電所と、生産不能なロストテクノロジー〈遺物〉を頼りに、かろうじて命をつないでいる。 そして誰ひとりとして、停止した核融合炉を再稼働させることができない。 なぜなら、融合反応を始動させるには、燃料を1億度以上に加熱・プラズマ化し、超高圧で封じ込める必要がある。その過程では、まさに“発電所を動かすための発電所”が必要なほどの莫大な初期エネルギーが求められる。 今の人類には、それを生み出す手段が存在しない。 ――ただひとり、「ミツハ」という少女を除いては。 CHARACTER ミツハ 文明の光を、この世界に取り戻そうとする謎多き少女。 見た目は幼いが、その頭脳は博士級。とくに工学分野においては、現代の専門家すら凌ぐ知識を持つ。 彼女は、旧国家に存在したすべての官営システムに対する管理者権限を有しており、秘密裏に存在していた、国際条約で禁じられた“最後の原子炉”を再起動させることで、失われた文明を再び動かそうとしている。 カイ 廃墟を巡り、遺物を集めて生きるスカベンジャー。 ある都市でミツハと出会い、彼女の力に価値を見出す。 その高尚な目的にはさほど興味を示さないものの、「遺物を得る手段」として彼女に協力することを選ぶ。 過去を語らず、現実的で冷徹――だが、どこか人間らしさも垣間見える男。 どうやら、本人には忘れたい過去があるようだが……？

Through the fragile fabric of space-time, its story begins to unfold - a tale where past, present, and future collide.

rows.name: REDSHIFT
rows.short_description: A short solo developed psychological narrative horror game where you close your eyes to reveal a hidden layer of reality, the REDSHIFT. Uncover the secrets of the facility, Tower 7, and survive what hunts you within the REDSHIFT.
rows.description_html: About This Game Redshift is a short solo developed psychological narrative horror game where you close your eyes to reveal a hidden layer of reality, the REDSHIFT. You play as Samuel Chase , a field technician sent by Northline Communications to restore power to a long‑abandoned military relay tower deep in the hills. The job feels routine, but is quickly revealed to be something much more. By activating the tower and starting the REDSHIFT, you reveal things that were never meant to be seen. Key Features Dual‑Reality Exploration Open your eyes to see the familiar world, or close them to uncover see into the REDSHIFT: hidden objects, shifting images, strange messages, and something else that's following you. A Focused Single‑Sitting Experience Designed to be completed in 10 to 20 minutes , REDSHIFT delivers a tight, atmospheric story that can be explored in one play session. Immersive Storytelling Uncover the past through environmental details, radio transmissions, and tense dialogue with your dispatcher as the tower grows stranger. A Living Soundscape Dynamic audio, subtle interference, and noise create tension and signal danger long before you see it. Multiple Endings Make your choices. REDSHIFT has two distinct endings, and it will be up to you what decision you make. Will you run, or will you face Tower 7?

rows.name: Spread The Love
rows.short_description: A silly dating sim where your flavor decides your fate. Customize your profile, flirt with six lovably unique characters, and try to survive your first date!
rows.description_html: Ever felt like your romantic destiny hinged on jam? No? Well, now it does. Welcome to Spread the Love , the world’s stickiest (💀) dating simulator where your love life is determined by a deeply scientific (not really) jam-based personality quiz. Are you a mysterious blueberry? A comforting peach? Maybe even… a flirty mango? Whatever your flavor, you’re getting matched. Get ready to Spread The Love ... or something. 🖥️ Customize your character and dating profile! 📱 Take a personality quiz and get assigned one of 12 jam types! ⚙️ Explore the 7 apps on your desktop computer! 🕹️ Play minigames to survive your first date! ✨ Collect all the jam types! Meet The Characters: She runs the boba shop. She runs you . She’s the one with a clipboard, a plan, and a backup clipboard in case the first one breaks. Warm, nurturing, and ever so slightly manipulative. Will absolutely gaslight you, but only to make you hydrate and succeed. Allen was supposed to be coding the future. Now he stocks overpriced beans. Blames the economy, but secretly kinda likes it. Quiet, sharp, and devastatingly observant, especially in movies. Has a Masters in computer science and sarcasm. Cher doesn’t talk much. They don’t need to. Currently working through unresolved parental issues via designing furniture and brooding. Emotionally resides in a foggy European arthouse film. You won’t understand them, but you’ll want to. Overly enthusiastic engineer who thinks every problem can (and should) be fixed by smacking it with a wrench. Aggressively affectionate mechanic who literally climbs walls for fun. She’s touchy, loud, and way too excited to meet you. Good luck! A walking rave flyer who peaked during quarantine but refuses to admit it. He’s charismatic, sexy, and probably just lost a Lingon Legends match. Jet treats love like an Instajam story. He’ll flirt, overshare, and then disappear. Has never opened a textbook.  Everyone’s favorite cozy kitch.tv streamer who accidentally makes you feel at home. Lives between three monitors and an avalanche of Blooblet plushies. She’ll trip over cables, and then apologize to them.

rows.name: Mazzy
rows.short_description: Mazzy is a pixel-style casual puzzle game built around the core concept of rotating the level. Rotate the level, collect the items, and reshape the maze to reach the goal. Simple and fun.
rows.description_html: Mazzy is a pixel-style casual puzzle game built around a simple but interesting idea: rotate and reshape the world. In this game, you play as a stickman navigating strange mazes. Your goal is quite simple—reach the goal. However, in this world, the path is not always straightforward. You will be blocked when you try to find the correct path. By switching to Edit Mode, you can rotate the entire sections, shifting platforms, unlocking new perspectives, and revealing the new paths that weren’t noticed before! Doors may block your way — or become part of the solution. You'll need to rotate with purpose, think spatially, and find clever ways to move forward. Mazzy offers a relaxing and engaging experience. Rotate the level. Collect the items. Reach the goal. It’s that simple — and that fun.

rows.name: Sunflower Stronghold
rows.short_description: Grow Crops, Process Resources and Construct Towers and Defend!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Sunflower Stronghold! Your farm is being over run with pests and it is your duty to defend your farm, your lively-hood, with all your can muster! They never said it would be easy, but here you are! Use budgeting and strategy to come out on top! Grow Crops, Process Resources and Construct Towers and Survive! I made this game as a prototype last year and will continue to develop the Sunflower Stronghold series in Unity. Please include any feedback you have, criticism is encouraged! Let me know if you were able to make it past Day 100 & have FUN!  Enjoy!

rows.name: Case Blind: Stolen Route
rows.short_description: A horror game about escaping from a mysterious place after a chilling encounter in the woods. Explore, stay quiet, and make tough choices as you search for a way out.
rows.description_html: A ride home turns into a nightmare you never asked for. It was just another night. Just another road through the forest. Case Blind: Stolen Route is a first-person psychological horror game where a quiet bike ride spirals into a terrifying journey of survival, fear, and fractured hope. You wake up trapped in a strange place, no idea where you are or how you got there. What follows is a desperate escape, eerie encounters, and choices that can save lives… or leave them behind. Explore. Hide. Think fast. And trust no one too easily. Key Features Atmospheric Storytelling : A slow burning, emotional horror experience built for immersion. Explore & Interact : Investigate your surroundings, solve subtle puzzles, and piece together the truth. Tense Audio Design – Every step and whisper keeps you alert headphones highly recommended. Stealth Survival : Stay low, stay quiet, and avoid those watching from the dark. Choices That Matter : Help others… or focus on escaping. Every decision counts.

rows.name: Fawn The Florist
rows.short_description: Fawn the Florist is a cozy idle game that sits at the bottom of your screen, acting as a peaceful, garden companion for you as you work, study, or relax.
rows.description_html: Fawn the Florist is a cozy, idle game that sits at the bottom of your screen acting as your peaceful garden space you can tend to while you work, study or relax. Players are tasked with helping our dear friend, Fawn, to uncover wondrous new flowers whilst creating their own flourishing garden with the assistance of some friendly critters to create the garden of their dreams. Unlock New Flowers From the scorching fire of the Volcanic Zinnias to the calming droplets of the Hydrogenas, discover all the beautiful flowers along the way! Enlist the Help of your Critter Companions By building homes and providing care, you can befriend a cast of critter companions. In return for your love, they'll help you maintain your garden while you're busy or relaxing! Complete Quests for Fawn Take on simple tasks for Fawn and breathe new life into her gardens! Position the Game to your Needs Adjust the resolution position of your game to fit your purpose and needs to comfortably grow your garden from your desktop!

rows.short_description: Step into the crypto blockchain: smash clicks, farm parody coins, and mess with a full command-driven console that teaches you terms, indicators, chart types like Heikin Ashi, and hidden mini-games all wrapped in a satire-rich clicker.
rows.description_html: Welcome to C4 Clicker: First Mint , a clicker game where fake coins are serious business (not really). This isn’t your average idle game. It’s a crypto parody packed with ridiculous token farming, market chaos, and just enough trading knowledge to confuse your inner bag-holder. 💸 FEATURES: • Click to mint worthless coins faster than a scam DAO • Unlock Steam Inventory Items as in-game drops • Earn all Steam Achievements in one wild ride • Use the in-game console to explore real-world trading concepts → Indicators, charting, trend analysis, FOMO — all gamified • Parody crypto culture, rug pulls, and late-night trading YouTubers 🎮 No blockchain. No NFTs. Just satire, Steam items, and fake financial clout. You won't get rich. But you will click. ⏳ Drops occur every 5 ..10 minutes ( Subject to change with halving cycles. Total halving cycles 1 ) Once the game is released from EA expect rate between mints will be between 60-80minutes.  Current Rarity Distribution Normal — 60.8% Common — 21.7% Uncommon-ish — 13.0% Uncommon — 4.2% Rare — 0.17% Very Rare — 0.087% Each drop produces a real Steam inventory item that can be traded or sold on the Community Market. No real-world cryptocurrency. Just parody tokens, market chaos, and the thrill of the mint.

No NFTs. Just satire, Steam items, and fake financial clout. You won't get rich. But you will click. ⏳ Drops occur every 5 ..10 minutes ( Subject to change with halving cycles. Total halving cycles 1 ) Once the game is released from EA expect rate between mints will be between 60-80minutes.  Current Rarity Distribution Normal — 60.8% Common — 21.7% Uncommon-ish — 13.0% Uncommon — 4.2% Rare — 0.17% Very Rare — 0.087% Each drop produces a real Steam inventory item that can be traded or sold on the Community Market. No real-world cryptocurrency. Just parody tokens, market chaos, and the thrill of the mint.

rows.name: Neo - The Rainbow Sorcerer
rows.short_description: A 2D bullet hell plane shooter game with a creative twist in gameplay—instead of shooting down enemies, pick a matching color and swipe them.
rows.description_html: # Game Overview Title Neo - The Rainbow Sorcerer Game Theme/Story Neo is the last hope of Manatopia. Entropy has enslaved the minds of every elemental and sorcerer in manatopia except Neo. Neo fights against the elementals and Entropy himself to protect Manatopia. Perspective Top-down 2D, stylized grid-based layout Player Actions 1. Use WASD keys to move 2. Click on the screen to emit a mana cloud that destroyes enemies if their color are the same. 3. Change color with their mouse wheel. 4. Collect Elixir (buff) and Primordial Mana (treasure) and avoid enemies and their projectiles Enemy Behavior + Moves toward the bottom of the screen and depletes Neo's health if successfully reaching the bottom of the map + Shoots projectiles towards Neo to kill him. Gameplay Loop + Enemies spawn and move toward the bottom of the screen and shoots projectiles to kill Neo. + Neo's movement and attack via particle cloud + Random Elixir and Primordial Mana spawns which fills Neo's ultimate gauge or increases the score by 1000 respectively + Continue until death Level Progression Level ends: This game has only one level, like flappy bird. The player plays until losing 3 lives. Game Structure + This game invites users to experience a unique plane-shooter genre gameplay where the goal is not to shoot down the enemies but to damage them by selecting a color that matches their appearance. + While there is currently one level, the structure of the game leaves more levels to be easily added. Future Goals + Make infinite level generation using generative AI and implement bosses + Implement tutorial # Buff and Treasure System + Elixir (buff): Buffs increase Neo's ultimate gauge by 1 upon collision. When Neo eats 7 Elixirs, he can activate Rainbow God (ultimate) which gives him invincibility and the ability to damage enemies regardless of the current chosen color for 7 seconds. The mana cloud emitted during Rainbow God is also rainbow, instead of being one color. + Primordial Mana (treasure): Treasures increase the gameplay score by 1000 upon collision with Neo. # Game Assets Inventory Type Name Description Collision/Movement Player Neo A handsome white haired sorcerer who has infinite mana and use all types of mana. The following qualities are implemented as no cooldown for attacks and the player's ability to select a color using their mouse scroll. Enemy0 Cinder Imp A red mischievous fire sprite that occasionally fires a circle of slow flame bullets. Enemy1 Crystal Automaton A cyan floating arcane construct, fires ice laser at Neo occasionally Enemy2 Storm Whispling A yellow fast-moving wisp of lightning that erratically dashes and releases forked bolt barrages. Enemy3 Entropic Wraith A purple wraith that is a fragment of Entropy. Spawns black holes near Neo's radius that sucks him in and depletes one life upon collision. Treasure Primordial Mana Increases score by 1000 points. Auto-collected on collision. Extra Features + Color Picker Invisible hue bar that allows players to choose a color with their mouse scroll. + Made normally very laggy javafx animation very smooth by using an input poller. Please ignore the issue: 'Notice: This product is not compatible with macOS 10.15 Catalina or above. Click here for more information.' + The game works perfectly fine on macOS 10.15+ machines

rows.name: Wish Upon a Cat
rows.short_description: Embark on a delightful little romp through the worlds of various Odencat games to track down a dimension-diving cat in this short, heartwarming adventure.
rows.description_html: 'If I knew things were going to end up like this, I would've just apologized in the first place…' It's your best friend's birthday—but after a recent fight with her, you're not exactly on speaking terms. Before you even have a chance to wallow in regret, though, a burst of light erupts from your computer screen and sucks you into an alternate dimension—where a rather snarky mouse gives you the rundown. A rogue cat with a bad attitude has been leaping between realities and causing all sorts of dimensional mayhem—and if something isn't done to stop it, it might very well cause another big bang. And you DEFINITELY don't want that. With no other options available, you set off in pursuit of the feisty feline—not just to restore balance to the dimensions, but because it's the only way you'll ever make it back home. In this short-but-sweet adventure, you'll journey through the many worlds of Odencat games like Bear's Restaurant and Meg's Monster, meeting dozens of familiar friends along the way on your search for the runaway cat. Why did it throw the dimensions out of whack? What is it this little kitty-cat truly desires? And when all is said and done—what will YOU wish for?

rows.name: Ball Tag
rows.short_description: Ball Tag is tag.... with a ball. This first-person multiplayer game challenges you to avoid being IT for a total of 45 seconds. Pick up the ball, throw it at another player to make them IT, and keep your timer from hitting the time limit.
rows.description_html: Ball Tag is a fast-paced first-person multiplayer game you can play with friends. Ever want to throw a ball at your friend’s head? Now you can! One player is randomly chosen to start as IT , and their timer begins. If you're IT for 45 seconds total , you lose. Pick up the ball, aim, and throw it at another player. If you hit somebody else, they become IT  and your timer freezes. The match ends as soon as any player reaches 45 seconds of being IT.

rows.name: Mate in Eleven
rows.short_description: Auto-chess. Position your units, and the engine plays for you. Last player standing wins.
rows.description_html: Mate in Eleven (#M11)  is Yet Another entry in the auto-battler format. M11 offers a unique twist of engine-based ' Perfect Combat ' to the auto-battler, which takes combat RNG out of the equation. Your positioning and your read on your opponent and their strategy is all that matters. With reduced shop RNG as well, this game captures the 'perfect knowledge' aspect of chess in the auto-battler format, while also allowing for players to think tactically. This allows for the perfect competitive auto-battler, where your micro-adjustments, positioning, and economical decisions decide exactly where you will place every game. Features Ranked matchmaking Custom lobbies (up to 8 players) Bots for custom lobbies Combat with engine lines for every position Custom ELO system to measure yourself against other tacticians

rows.name: Figure Shop Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: In this free version of the game, manage your own figure shop! Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer the best shopping experience to your customers. Manage your warehouse, complete collections, follow trends, and grow your business!
rows.description_html: [Figure Shop Simulator: Prologue is a free version prepared for you to experience the Figure Shop Simulator in advance. This version contains limited content and allows you to try out the general mechanics of the game.] Figure Shop Simulator is a fun and detailed business simulation game where you manage your own figure store. Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer your customers the best shopping experience. To grow your business, manage your warehouse efficiently, expand your store, and personalize its design. Create rare figures for collectors, follow trends, and increase your profit by stocking the most in-demand figures. But be careful! Inventory management, customer satisfaction, and pricing are critical to your success. Can you make the right strategic decisions to bring your store to the top of the industry? Main Features: 3D figure production and customization Shelf management, pricing, and customer satisfaction Create collection sets and discover rare figures Follow market trends and identify best-selling products Build your store from scratch and become the biggest name in the figure collection world!

rows.name: TunTunWorld
rows.short_description: TunTunWorld is a 3D action game with a third-person perspective. Players control a character to explore the map, using three main actions: poke, grab, and jump. By investigating various areas, they can uncover and solve mysteries. The ultimate goal is to solve every puzzle and clear the game.
rows.description_html: Welcome to TunTunWorld! This is a 3D action game like nothing you've ever seen before. You'll control a mysterious creature called TunTun as you progress through the game. At its core, it’s a simple third-person 3D action game. TunTun’s main ability is to poke things. He goes around poking objects around him! By poking, various reactions are triggered in the environment. Using these reactions, you’ll find your way forward. Other actions include jumping and grabbing objects. With 'Jump,' TunTun climbs to reach new areas and explore the world. With 'Grab,' you can carry key items and activate unique mechanisms. By using these abilities, you’ll gradually explore the map and solve its mysteries. If you solve all the puzzles, you’ll clear the game. So get poking and move forward into the unknown!

rows.name: iRobot Factory
rows.short_description: Solve logic puzzles and obstacle courses in this robot simulation game! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of robotics and programming! Create your own robot, connect logic blocks and teach it to solve challenging tasks!
rows.description_html: Can your robot solve every level? Immerse yourself in the exciting world of robotics and programming in the iRobot Factory! You can create your own robot and teach it to solve tasks - simply by connecting logic blocks together. Your robot will be completely on its own as it tackles the levels. In order for it to succeed, you have to prepare it! Build your own robot! Choose from a variety of building blocks and assemble your robot! Customise it to do what it needs to do in the level! Wheels allow it to move. Sensors allow it to perceive its surroundings. Gripper arms allow it to pick up objects and carry them with it.   Programme its abilities! Link logic blocks to teach your robot what to do! Programme how it reacts to the world around it so that it reaches the level's goal! Send a signal to the wheels to make them turn. Read the signal from a sensor to extend a gripper arm at the right moment. Link several signals so that your robot can swerve out of the way when it rolls towards a wall. You can programme this and much more for your robot!   There are lots of levels to solve Solve tricky tasks in increasingly challenging levels - from small obstacles to big puzzles where you have to combine all your knowledge! Start by building a robot with working wheels and finish by creating complex machines that master several different tasks.

rows.name: Watertight
rows.short_description: A short first-person horror game. An accident cripples your submarine while trying to find the wreck of the Titanic. In the darkness, you must restore life-support systems through tense puzzles, only to discover that you are not alone.
rows.description_html: Watertight is a short psychological-horror experience set aboard a 1950s deep-sea submarine. FEATURES Solve clever puzzles to restore your submarine’s critical systems Explore the submarine’s cramped, flooded corridors Horror ambience that amplifies claustrophobia A concise, intense experience designed to be finished in 30 minutes THE GAMEPLAY You’re trapped in a failing submarine with systems on the brink of collapse. Complete a series of critical repair tasks to restore power, life-support, and navigation and hope you survive long enough to realize you’re not alone in the darkness. THE STORY Morgan Spedden was just seven years old when he survived the Titanic’s sinking. Both of his parents were lost to the icy depths. Consumed by survivor’s guilt and a lifelong obsession to uncover the wreck, he poured decades into research and planning. In 1952, he abandons everything he holds dear to captain a one-man submarine into the abyss. What he discovers deep beneath the ocean may finally answer his questions… or destroy what’s left of his sanity.

rows.name: Dancing with Shadows: Prologue
rows.short_description: Dancing with Shadows: Prologue is a 2D dark fantasy visual novel with CYOA-influenced branching storylines. Guide three protagonists through an interlocked and inexorably connected storyline. There are no wrong answers, but your decisions have consequences.
rows.description_html: Dancing with Shadows: Prologue is the first installment of an episodic dark fantasy visual novel with CYOA-influenced branching storylines, romantic routes, and many different endings. Guide three protagonists through a storyline left for you to untangle. Your choices don't just shape the outcome of the story, they shape the personas of the protagonists you control.  This first installation in a four-part story offers a complete narrative arc and serves as the foundation for a larger story. This game is designed to be played multiple times. Romantic routes dynamically evolve across paths, with three (or perhaps four) potential love interests to discover. Feedback and collaboration are welcome. Join us on Discord! There are no wrong answers, but every answer carries weight. Features Dancing with Shadows: Prologue features 3 different protagonists and 3 primary love interests. These stories play out in sequence, and the choices you make one one path affect the next in sequence. Decisions made in  Dancing with Shadows: Prologue  effect the identity of the protagonist you control within the story. The story contains many branching paths, which are determined by the choices you make as the protagonist you control. These choices results in many different possible endings, some of which are carefully hidden. The dialogue of Dancing with Shadows: Prologue  contains 1,474 lines and 14,403 words. Love Interests Other Notable Characters

Captured by Victoriano Huerta's army after the Ten Tragic Days during the Mexican Revolution, Juan will confront his life, death, family, relationships and existence.

rows.name: DayDream Mosaics Juliette's Collection
rows.short_description: A beautiful collection of six-color nonogram puzzles from the Daydream Mosaics series. Play in classic picross style or the enhanced Mosaic mode with power-ups and mistake tracking. Packed with vibrant logic challenges—perfect for puzzle fans of all kinds.
rows.description_html: Daydream Mosaics: Juliette’s Collection brings together a vibrant selection of six-color nonogram puzzles curated from previous entries in the beloved franchise. Choose your game mode and play style—enjoy classic picross gameplay or dive into the enhanced Mosaic mode with power-ups and a mistake counter. With dozens of colorful puzzles and more on the way, this collection offers something for every logic puzzle fan.

rows.name: Ødeborg
rows.short_description: Alone in a dark castle, you must find a way to escape. You will have to explore the castle grounds, find keys, solve puzzles, and if push comes to shove, you will have to use your gun. Be careful however. Your gun only fires one bullet at a time.
rows.description_html: It has been three days since a word has been heard from the king. On your way to investigate, you and your soldiers were attacked by... something. You were the only survivor. Your only choice is to go to the castle yourself in attempt to find the king. Armed only with your pistol, you must go inside and figure out what happened. Features: Explore the King's castle, a dark and seemingly abandoned building with many locked doors and items to find. Your map will come in handy. Conserving your resources is vital. Things such as bullets and healing items are in limited supply, so you'll have to explore every corner of the castle, unless you want to meet a dark fate. You might not be alone in the castle, so your gun will be useful. It only shoots one bullet at a time though, and takes a while to reload. So you will have to use your bullets sparingly. Your camera is in a locked 3rd person perspective. The castle's secrets are not for everyone to see. You must find different keys to open the many locked doors that are strewn around the castle grounds. Figure out what happened.

rows.name: A Hundred Years of Love and Death
rows.short_description: RPG with intergenerational respawn mechanic: If you die you continue to play as one of your children. The gameplay is focused on dating and stealth.
rows.description_html: A 2D RPG with an intergenerational respawn mechanic, where whenever you die you continue to play as one of your children or siblings. Explore a world containing a city with 5 different families, a forest, and a dungeon. Seduce women by dodging undertale-like bullet patterns. Make sure to not confuse the women with the traps. Stealthily sneak past her parents at night in her house to get to her room and create a child. Level up the genetic stats of your characters over multiple generations. Women with higher stats are usually harder to date, because other admirers get in the way. Let your characters heroically die in battle, fighting goblins in the forest, to rescue women with particularly high stats. If you are superstitious, you can sacrifice your first-born son to Baal, although it's unclear whether that does anything. Find and seduce the mermaid to unlock a dungeon filled with dangerous monsters. Conquer the dungeon to beat the game.
rows.about_html: A 2D RPG with an intergenerational respawn mechanic, where whenever you die you continue to play as one of your children or siblings. Explore a world containing a city with 5 different families, a forest, and a dungeon. Seduce women by dodging undertale-like bullet patterns. Make sure to not confuse the women with the traps. Stealthily sneak past her parents at night in her house to get to her room and create a child. Level up the genetic stats of your characters over multiple generations. rows.name: Pokerchinko
rows.short_description: Pokerchinko is an old-school pachinko game. Your goal is to use your skills of precision to snag the card that makes the best poker hand. The better the hand, the better the rewards. Feel the tension as the balls bounce wildly around the playfield and the exhilaration of landing a fantastic hand.
rows.description_html: Pokerchinko is a pachinko game with the added mechanics of trying to make the best poker hand. Launch your ball into the playfield, strategically using enough power to claim a card you need.  There are five tulips.  Land in a tulip and the card on that tulip will be added to your hand. At the top is a spinner that may add some random force to your ball.

rows.name: Galduen of the Void
rows.short_description: A fantasy space agency management game! Manage your team, design your space ship and research new technology! Reach moons, planets and the void beyond. Can you reach the void? Can you bring Galduen to the void?
rows.description_html: Can you reach the void? Can you bring Galduen to the void? The three races of Galduen have finally stopped their fratricidal wars, united by the promise of reaching the stars! You now need to manage your space agency, design your spaceship, and research new technology! Explore the strange worlds of the Galduen system! The Galduen star system is full of enigmatic worlds, caused by the violent solar storms of the Helio star. Understanding them will be a hard task. Develop new technology to reach the stars! Guide your agency to the height of scientific discovery, from better engines to solar sail probes. Build spaceships! Design your spaceship for the task ahead, from solar sail probes to crewed spaceships. Send them to the stars! Bring your astronauts to walk upon the moons and even different planets. Build outposts! Upon the many celestial bodies of the system, outposts can be built to speed your expansion. Discover the secrets of Galduen! Galduen possesses a distinct culture and religion influenced by the stars. Discover how space exploration reshapes their society.

rows.name: Deep Inside: Amore sola mi fa remirare

rows.description_html: Nobody talks about the fire incident at Estmour mansion. As the new servant, you're bound to keep silence. Things take a strange turn when you find a message from your pyromaniac predecessor... deep inside, there's a truth to uncover. • An old fashioned RPG horror game • Three different endings depending on your choices • Many investigation puzzles in the mansion • Full Walkthrough available • Tearoom function to chat with the characters • Unlockable bonus room This is a remaster of Deep Inside, originally released in August 2020. • All the game CGs have been replaced with new artwork • New music tracks were added • Some of the puzzles were changed according to players' feedback
