rows.name: Word maker
rows.short_description: Relaxing game where you can test how much english words you know. Spend your points on automation and let the computer do the work for you.
rows.description_html: Let’s imagine that one day you wake up in the middle of space. Nothingness surrounds you, and the first thing you think is… Where's my bed? Where's my home? Where's… Right, probably yes — but for this description, the correct answer is: scream . Well, let’s forget that there’s no air in space and you probably wouldn’t be able to say anything anyway, for several reasons. All you have left is that oddly-placed text input. Of course, being stuck there for approximately 2–3 minutes, you’ve got nothing else to do but put your mind to work and start typing something into it. After entering a few words, you notice something strange — you're getting points. Typing a new word gives you 2 points, and reusing a previously entered word gives you just 1. Obviously, you want more and more of these points. But why? Well, if you’ve ever looked under the text bar, you’ve probably noticed some odd buttons. Some of them look like inventory icons, but one stands out — it lets you spend your hard-earned words on something called an “automator.” Having nothing to lose, you buy one of these bad boys and realize it wants some items from you. Luckily, another button comes to the rescue — missions ? Yep, of course you take them on, and get all these fantastic machines and weird letter collections. I could take more of your time to describe this strangeness, but instead, I’ll leave you with a short (for now) list of what’s in the game: An amazing, GPU-boiling space atmosphere A beautiful button that hides the text input so you can admire your abominations (I mean creations… or automators) Hand-crafted collectibles from the amazing developer (that’s me!) — the grey letters are just the beginning Automator-building with your collected items and machines Flying letters and words in the automator, just because Drop boxes you don’t buy — you earn them with manual labor and your automators Missions that reward you with rare items or just help boost your points Alpha/early-access bugs, waiting to be squashed In return for all this awesomeness, I only ask one thing: Report any bugs that might be lurking around. We all want a space free of bugs, don’t we? Also, feel free to send in any ideas you’d like to see in the game. Anything will be considered, as long as it fits the main theme. Good luck wording!

rows.name: The Trench
rows.short_description: This is a post ww1 horror game about a soldier coming back to the trench he was stationed at and the events that happened there. You will find out the truth and uncover what happened there as you also find a way to move one from the past.
rows.description_html: Events happen some of which are unforgettable, but the question is can I overcome them? This a post world war 1 horror game about a soldier who comes back to the trench he was stationed at and the events of what happened. As you traverse the trench finding out what happens looking for a way to move past this trench. You will be able to move boxes, read notes and explore what lies in the trench.

rows.name: Dear my『 』
rows.short_description: 'Writing a letter. To face her.' Read the letter delivered to the protagonist and write a reply. Spend time with her through your letters. Where will her letters lead the protagonist? Find out in the game.
rows.description_html: Dear my 『』 is the debut title from the three-person development team, Touch to Start . It’s a visual novel game where you exchange letters and build memories with her . Just another ordinary day—until a letter arrives. The sender? A girl who had always been by your side since childhood. She had once left… but now, she’s standing before you again. Send her your replies, travel to various places, and relive precious memories together. Dear my 『』 delivers quiet comfort and gentle excitement through its emotional story, beautiful backgrounds, and heartfelt letters.

rows.name: Shrouded Depths
rows.short_description: Stranded in the fog of the murky waters on an isolated ferry with nothing but your harpoon gun, you feel the overwhelming presence of something within the misty mangrove. Your vessel is stopped dead and it is up to you with the assistance of the Captain to get the boat back up and running again.
rows.description_html: The Devil’s Strait is no place for the faint of heart, but there’s something inside that’s worth everything. You are Thomas Sencher, a simple man with a simple goal: to find your wife, Ruth, who has been missing for 10 years.  You ventured into the Devil’s Strait armed with nothing but your devotion to Ruth, an old boat, and a harpoon gun. With the captain guiding you, your search begins. Experience this 15-20 minute reality-bending journey with each turn around a corner revealing a new unknown horror. A Strange Circumstance Explore below the deck of your ship as mysterious happenings change the environment around you. As you delve further into the bowels of the boat, the more dangerous the search becomes. Others have walked the same path as you; none have survived. The Devil’s Straight senses a disturbance; that disturbance is you. A Desperate Search Investigate the truth behind your wife’s sudden disappearance and discover what happened. Your wife, Ruth Sencher, traveled to The Devil’s Straight with Agent Vernon of the Bureau of Prohibition to use her knowledge of the area to help find an illegal moonshining operation. She went missing almost 10 years ago. Find the notes that were left behind to piece together where your wife is; only then can you find her. Strategic Combat Defend yourself against the creature trying to thwart your search using your bulky but trusty harpoon gun. You are not alone within these rusted metal depths. Creatures lurk in the depths, not out of malice, but of instinct. You are not where you belong; they are merely a defence mechanism of something greater than your understanding. That does not mean that they are immune to a good ol’ hefty harpoon, but it does mean you will be limited in what you can do. Conserve your health, fight with care, and don’t waste your ammo.

rows.name: What Happened Here?
rows.short_description: What Happened Here is a short adventure horror game: around 30-45 minutes, exploring the classic horror trope of being locked inside a house and exploring it in order to go out.
rows.description_html: Sypnosis: What Happened Here is a short adventure horror game: around 30-45 minutes , exploring the classic horror trope of being locked inside a house and exploring it in order to go out. You play as Elly, a 20 years old girl coming back from work one day to find her home completely changed and her roommates nowhere in sight! Will you assist her to go out, and will you find the truth? Features: Beautiful graphics made with limited 2bit palette, inspired by classic Nintendo games. Original soundtrack that adds to the mysterious atmosphere 4 compelling characters, including our main character Elly A large mystery to solve involving the characters and the mansion itself. 3 main puzzles which put your brain in the challenge 3 main endings and 3 bad endings Some secrets to find if you look deep enough. Secret room in classic RPG maker games fashion. 'Thank you for giving me a chance for happiness, and thank you for playing.'

rows.name: Forgotten Beginnings: A New Afterlife
rows.short_description: An RPG Maker MZ game done in the style of a 1980s NES RPG, with a NES-styled (but not NES authentic) soundtrack.
rows.description_html: This game is free to download, with the option to support me by purchasing the OST and/or the strategy guide.  You are welcome to download it for free and come back later to buy an extra if you decide to.  No ads, no data collection, just free with the option of buying something, if you decide you liked it enough to support me! I wanted to have my own music in a game, so decided to make my own game.  This is the full version of a prologue/demo I released in early 2025. It was made in RPG Maker MZ. Essentially, this is a 1980s NES styled RPG, with some modern quality of life to make it more accessible. It does still have some 1980s NES RPG RNG that will cause game overs at times, as part of the design. It has turn-based combat, challenging boss encounters (where you can get RNG screwed just like the old days!), and it has been designed to have a minimal amount of grinding (maybe 20 minutes total intentional grinding on the 2nd fastest game speed). You control a party of four with different skillsets, enemies have weaknesses you can exploit for max damage, some enemies will even reflect your spells back at you! The soundtrack uses the free NES VST plugin for instruments, so it is authentic to NES in that sense. However, it uses a seperate plugin for vibrato to give it a unique sound - this plugin is not  NES authentic. Also, while the visual art pack I bought was NES authentic, I occasionally made changes that were not NES authentic because I didn't like the limitations it sometimes imposed (ie. map sprite coloring being a mismatch with combat sprite coloring). The drums were made using Tweakbench Toad, which is NES authentic. While I did want the game to be like NES, ultimately I wanted to try doing something a little different to set it apart. As far as story goes, it is hard to say much without spoiling the game, as most information isn't revealed until late in the game... but essentially, the game starts off with your party hearing a strange voice, and coming to life in a strange new world that is full of conflict. My playthrough was ~4.5 hours long on the 'faster' game speed setting, with animations turned on.  This time also does not count time spent in battles that result in defeat and require a reload, so depending on your game speed + how many reloads you need, it may be shorter or it may be longer. As far as replability goes, it would just be if you want to play it again, there is currently no new game +, or any other game modes. It was intended to be a bite-sized NES RPG experience. I hope that's what it's perceived as! If you enjoy the game and want to support me, consider buying the OST! There is also a strategy guide, there is a sample included in the game install directory as 'strategy guide SAMPLE.txt' so you have an idea of how it's laid out.

rows.name: 試される大地 Challenging Land
rows.short_description: A Idle-based simulation game. Place objects in unique rooms to collect and process them! Make full use of the functions to meet the demands of the land and move on!
rows.description_html: 【The land is merciless】 The land is testing you! Summoned by a mysterious force, you proceed to meet the harsh demands of the land! 【Base system】 It has a JRPG atmosphere, with gathering and simple combat. It is a simulation in genre, although it has various elements. You can get placements in the field, set them up in unique rooms, collect them, etc. Most of the collection can be Idle, and each parameter, such as the number of items acquired and the speed of collection, is affected. You can also grow your parameters along the way, so train and get over it! 【Objects gradually increasing】 The number of objects to be placed will gradually increase. Of course, there are objects for collecting, but there are also objects for processing and creating by combining materials. Many of them are even unique with their own functions! 【Convenient warp function】 There is a convenient feature that allows you to memorize a favorite location on the land and fly to it at any time. 【Profit from playing time】 The use of meals allows for a special time to elapse. When the special time reaches its maximum value, the special time is reset and benefits. There are items that increase this profit itself. 【Localization】 Developers used their own localization methods to prioritize the pace of development.

rows.name: Glaucon Inc.
rows.short_description: Your job is your life. Work for Glaucon Inc. processing debtors and making as much money as you can, while you slowly recall your past, and the truth.
rows.description_html: You are a regular middle class American worker, a nobody. Glaucon Inc. is a short first person narrative story game, in which you try your best to uncover the truth of your past. By day, Glaucon Inc. is a text based tale of work at an American super corporation. Make your way to work every day and process as many debtors as you can. Your worth is your work, so do your best for the company! A hard working employee is a happy employee. Forget your past. After a long day of work, you may experience strange dreams, in which your world expands into a three dimensional environment, where you can look for clues to your past. An unfathomable experience after the one dimensional text based world of your real life. These dreams are a violation of company policy, and will be dealt with accordingly. No questions. Disobedience will not be tolerated. Keep your head down, and do your job. Failure to comply will result in disciplinary action.

rows.name: MachineGunner2 : Bullet Transcending
rows.short_description: MachineGunner 2 is a 2d top-down shooter game that Player controls four characters to clear stages and complete them as fast as possible. One hit will take you to the start line of the stage. So push it at your own pace.
rows.description_html: In MachineGunner 2, you will control four players. You can use WASD to move them, and Arrow keys to fire. Use Q,E,R,F to Mark or Unmark player 0,1,2,3. Marked player is able to move but Unmarked player's position is locked.  Also, you can place your players to Cover Block. When player collides with it, Soon the player's color will be turned into grey. In that state, the player is invincible. But it can't fire. When you exit the Cover Block, the player turns back to original state. You should fire to the enemy that has same color with your player. Exceptionally, white enemy takes damage from all players' bullets. One hit will take you the start of the stage, so try not to get hit. If you don't want to be game over in some stages, press f12 to activate playerkeepGoing mode. If you see texts on the left down side from screen, it is activated. you can press f12 once again to deactivate it or when going next stage, it will be deactivated automatically.

rows.name: Set Adrift
rows.short_description: Set Adrift is a single-player fantasy exploration game where you sail between strange islands, talk to odd creatures, uncover lost secrets, and cast your line in search of the unknown.
rows.description_html: Set Adrift is a single-player exploration game set in a mysterious archipelago shrouded by mist. You begin shipwrecked on the edge of an unknown world. With only a small raft and a handful of supplies, you’ll fish for survival, sail between strange islands, and piece together fragments of a lost history. The game focuses on discovery, eerie atmosphere, and environmental storytelling. Every island has been handcrafted, filled with hidden notes, odd characters, and strange landmarks. Some locations are abandoned, others inhabited by creatures with unclear intentions. Dialogue is nonlinear, quests are optional, and the world rewards curiosity over urgency. Set Adrift invites you to drift, explore, and make sense of a fractured place where time feels off and the sky never quite looks right.

rows.name: HowlKraul
rows.short_description: A fast-paced pixel dungeon crawler focused on score chasing. Break furniture, slay enemies, and grab as many coins as you can in rooms that constantly change colors and foes. Play alone or with a friend and settle the score with end-of-run stats.
rows.description_html: Step into a fast-paced pixel-art dungeon crawler built around score chasing. Each run takes place in a single room that constantly feels fresh as its colors and enemies change. Defeat waves of foes, smash furniture for coins, and push your high score as far as you can. Play solo or team up with a friend, then compare end-of-run stats to see who really came out on top. Arcade-style dungeon crawler in pixel art Dynamic room with changing colors and enemies Local solo or 2-player co-op End-of-run stats to compete with your partner Collect coins by smashing furniture or slay the dungeon inhabitants Carry your team in co-op and let the end of run stats show it wasn’t your fault you lost Climb into the top three on your local leaderboard

rows.name: Excommunication
rows.short_description: The renegade Angloids and wayward souls forge plans within the artificial realms, let them burn in the surreal 'hack and slash'. Excommunication is an artistic experience in which the heretics dream of uprising. But let steel be your answer. No heretic shall remain.
rows.description_html: A solo study project developed within 10 months. Dynamic Hack & Slash Action Experience fast-paced, brutal combat in a dynamic hack-and-slash world. Charge through linear levels filled with relentless enemies, visceral melee encounters, and explosive abilities. Purge the Heretics Your mission is clear: cleanse each level of all heretical presence. Face waves of corrupted foes, complete sacred objectives, and restore divine order to the artificial realms. Task-Based Advancement Each level offers unique objectives and escalating difficulty. Completing these tasks not only drives the story forward, but unlocks deeper layers of the uprising and your own strength. Customize Your Talents Throughout the game, you’ll discover powerful pickups. These allow you to unlock and choose from a range of talents that enhance your combat style be it aggressive, tactical, or relentless. Every choice tailors your crusade to your preferred way of purging. Crush the Revolution The heretics are rising. Their false gospel spreads through steel and circuits. But you are the blade of judgment. End their revolution with fire, steel, and righteous fury. ~ Ashes to ashes. Dust to dust. We are but dust, and to dust we shall return. Amen.

rows.name: MISHA
rows.short_description: Misha is a cute anime girl who’s always by your side to brighten your day. She loves dancing, making funny faces, and trying on new outfits. Help her build a collection of stylish clothes!
rows.description_html: Collect cute outfits, build Misha’s wardrobe, trade what you don’t need! Misha is your cheerful anime companion who loves dancing and showing off new looks — your job is to unlock, mix, and complete her collection. No tricks: it’s all about outfit gacha, dressing up, growing your closet and a little bit of clicking ❤️ Click, type, play — earn points Click the mouse, press keys on your keyboard or controller — the counter grows with every action. Exchange points for outfits When the timer expires, a box appears. Click it and trade your accumulated points — receive a random outfit for your collection. To see how much time is left until the exchange, click the pedestal. The timer also appears in place of the points counter after a few seconds of inactivity. Dress Misha Open the interface, choose an item, and click — Misha instantly tries on the new look. Trade duplicates or sell Trade duplicates for rarer items or sell them on the Steam Community Market (in the release version). Go to the exchange tab. Click the auto-fill button or choose yourself which items to trade. Confirm the trade and receive an item one rarity tier higher!

rows.name: The Witch's fabulous Cracker Show
rows.short_description: Play as Cracker, the witch's errand boy. Collect ingredients for the ingenious cake plan and avoid the hungry children. Solve amusing puzzles, unlock new abilities, and explore the witty world of the Cracker Show.
rows.description_html: Story The bad witch is hungry for children again. So she makes an ingenious plan to lure the kids with a magnificent cake. But unfortunately, she doesn't have any ingredients at home. Since Lara Croft is busy with the new remake, the Master Chief is on a Hawaii vacation in, and Link has to rescue Zelda again, only you remain. So, with a sparrow on your head, you set out to collect the eight sacred ingredients from the children's realm. Not easy when you're made of sugar and cookies... Welcome to ' The Witch's fabulous Cracker Show '. Slip into the role of Cracker and travel with a mysterious elevator to various places in search of the ingredients. On your journey, you'll meet strange members of the Dead Animal Club, an annoying radish man, treacherous baked goods, and capricious witches. Solve little puzzles and fight against the six hungry child generals who will try to eat you. But hey, you'll make it, because the friendly Weapons Guru always provides you with the right tools. The game is musically accompanied by classical music and modern swing beats. Visit places like the Pretzel Festival, Irina's Vegetable Garden, and Distel's Dollhouse. What are you waiting for? Dive into an imaginative adventure full of explosive vegetables, dancing fishbones, and plenty of humor. If we can make you smile, we've achieved our goal. Enjoy 'The Witch's fabulous Cracker Show'! This awaits you:  A short game with 2 hours of playtime Three learnable skills from the Weapons Guru (Cinnamon Star, Christmas Cracker, Caramel Cannon) A Candy Shop for equipment and items Classical music by Tchaikovsky, Bach, Bizet, and many more Various children as final bosses A character collection with all the crazy characters Numerous Easter eggs related to series, games, and movies Two animated videos More than 10 puzzles and lots of hidden bonus content

rows.name: The Man in the Park
rows.short_description: You see a man in the park on your walk home. Will you help him?
rows.description_html: The viral horror classic from itch.io now on Steam! The Man in the Park is a multiple ending 5-minute horror game where you try to make it out of your neighborhood park . . . alive. Please note : this is a free, very short intro to the series. Game #2 is coming soon, and #3 is in development, both of which expand the story significantly. FEATURES Three possible endings Classic big-screen jump scares Micro horror game that can be 100% completed in a single sitting (get all endings in 5 minutes)

rows.name: Glassy Stare
rows.short_description: A story-driven psychological experience where memory fades, silence deepens, and something waits in the dark.
rows.description_html: 'Wilbur has a meeting today—one he’s been waiting for with a quiet, particular kind of anticipation. His fiancée is expected to arrive in the lush garden by his estate. In the evening, when the air fills with the scent of damp earth and faded blossoms, they will sit together on the bench near the dry fountain and, as before, speak softly, almost in whispers, unaware of how time slips by. Very soon, he’ll say something tender—perhaps the same words he spoke to her last May, or the winter before that. Very soon… the illness will pass.' 'Glassy stare' is the first story in a collection of visual novels, united by a dark, mysterious world, intense emotions, and vivid imagery. - A visual novel with a deep, psychological narrative - Unique visual style blending abstraction and symbolism - Dark, atmospheric presentation with horror elements - Poetic writing and meditative storytelling - No complex mechanics: focus on mood, choices, and interpretation

rows.name: MONSTER WAR: Clicker & RPG
rows.short_description: MONSTER WAR is a hybrid of clicker and RPG, where complex solutions are hidden behind the clicker shell. Progress depends on calculation, the choice of development paths, and ability to see the connections between systems. This game will open up to those who love experimentation and infinite growth.
rows.description_html: MONSTER WAR is a clicker game about a religious world in which each of your clicks writes an endless story of struggle. Fight hordes of monsters, collect powerful equipment, brew potions from monster organs (not a joke) and improve yourself everywhere and anywhere. Trade, communicate, exchange promo codes and bonuses, trade freely with others — this online world lives and breathes with you. Every monster you kill, every choice you make, is your opportunity to become stronger. There are no boundaries in this game: only you, your strength and the endless fight against monsters — for greatness, fame and wealth! Take action and the game world will react. ENDLESS STRUGGLE Fight against monsters that have no end: sorcerers, bandits, beasts, skeletons, centaurs, dragons, piranhas and otherworldly entities — you can't count them all! The damage caused by your click is not just a number on the screen. This is an indicator of your superiority and becoming in the endlessly tormented world of the game MONSTER WAR . FREEDOM FOR YOUR POWER Do you want to squeeze resources, getting the most out of every click? Towering over your enemies at the speed of light? Deal septillions of damage with a single click? Would you like to make a fortune with builds with a bonus to the Gold you receive? Yes, there is that too. And yes, you are free to combine all these assignments as you wish, thereby creating unique sets of equipment. GAMEPLAY-RELATED MECHANICS Every mechanic, every system presented in MONSTER WAR is closely related to all other mechanics. Every use of game elements made here changes the course of the game. A NEW MILESTONE IN THE GENRE MONSTER WAR is a game created to say a new word in the clicker games genre. This game gives you new mechanics, systems, ideas and images that never seen before in any clicker game.

Overcome the obstacles, kill the slimes and robots, get all the energys balls you find to get score, kill enemies to get hearts and get lifes and finish with the slime boss Controls: Space: Jump A: Left D: Right Click: shot You can choose one of the four elements (water, fire, air, and earth). rows.name: Game of Dice
rows.short_description: Roll the dice, rule your fate! Thrilling real-time board battles!
rows.description_html: Conquer the cities, dominate the board! A real-time board battle against players from all over the world. Roll the dice, seize cities, and survive to bankrupt your opponents in thrilling matches! With a variety of skill cards and charming characters, dive into an endless battle of strategy and wits. ▣ Real-Time PvP Matches With Duelists Around the World! Duelists around the world, gather round! Compete with friends around the world through seasonal rankings and tournaments. ▣ Colorful Animation Dice! Robot Dice, Panda Dice, Devil Dice... Choose what you want and craft it! Enjoy the great animations of over a hundred Dice. ▣ Customize Your Deck With Skills! Select from over 200 Skills to create your own strategy for victory. Use various Skills like ‘Push’, ‘Drag’, and ‘Summon’! ▣ Over 100 Unique Characters! Watch the ‘Game of Dice’ animation filled with unique Characters. Meet new friends around the world through guild contents! ▣ Various Contents That Never End Enjoy seasonal ranking, league tournaments, and guild match! Also, enjoy the exciting faction clash, limit tournaments, and odd number events every week.

rows.name: Coffie Simulator - Prologue
rows.short_description: In Coffie Simulator Prologue , run your own café, serve unique cusstomers, and master the art of coffee-making! Customize, upgrade, and manage your shop while handling orders with precision. Every choice matters. Can you succeed?
rows.description_html: In Coffie Simulator Prologue , step into the world of coffee and experience the thrill (and chaos) of running your own café! Your dream? To own the best coffee shop in town. But it won’t be easy—you’ll need to master the art of coffee-making, keep your customers happy, and manage your shop like a pro. Design & Customize – Create the coffee shop of your dreams! Stock Up & Manage – Keep an eye on your supplies or risk running out when you need them most. Handle Your Finances – Every bean counts! Spend wisely and invest in upgrades. Expand & Upgrade – Improve your shop to attract more customers and build your coffee empire. Unique Customers – Each with their own personalities and preferences! Your Choices Matter – Treat customers well… or badly! Your reputation will shape how they react. Stay on Your Toes – Follow every order carefully; slow service or mistakes could drive customers away forever! From Simple to Complex – Learn and master recipes, from a basic espresso to the most intricate latte art. Realistic Brewing Mechanics – Use professional barista tools to craft the perfect cup. Master the Espresso Game – Precision is key! Extract, steam, and serve like a real barista. Every Save is Unique – No two playthroughs are the same! rows.name: Factory Planner: First Sparks
rows.short_description: Factory Planner: First Sparks is a card-based simulation and strategy game. In this Prologue version, build your own factory using strategic card combinations and enjoy a unique sandbox experience.
rows.description_html: Roadmap About the Game Factory Planner is a strategy and simulation card-based game. Players combine various cards to build their factories from the ground up, efficiently manage resources, and optimize production processes. Each card plays a different role in factory management: collecting resources, producing goods, managing electricity, or speeding up processes. With careful planning and strategic card combinations, you can overcome challenges with your engineers and build an industrial empire! The game isn't limited to production; it also offers a vast sandbox structure that allows players to progress in unique ways. Whether you focus on building an efficient automation system or experiment with different production chains, you will discover new paths in the game world. Every choice you make shapes the future of your factory and creates new strategic opportunities. In a system powered by Facility, Organization, Engineer, and Resource cards, you connect cards to create functional production lines. Each card has different functions and connection points, allowing for strategic decision-making. Managing the connections between solid and liquid materials, as well as electricity, plays a critical role in maintaining the correct flow. Incorrect connections can halt your entire production line. Connections are drawn at 90-degree angles, can be broken, rearranged, and dynamically integrated into your system. Assigning Engineer cards to production and storage units can increase efficiency, unlock new recipes, or reduce energy consumption. Each assignment directly impacts your factory's operations, and undoing an assignment will change the system as well. Energy is at the heart of your factory. Electricity generated from thermal generators is distributed to machines. If production units lack enough power, production stops, and the system goes into a red alert. Use Splitter and Merger cards to manage and direct the flow of energy more efficiently. Warehouses have a specific capacity. If material transfer isn't managed properly, the system may lock up. Correct transfer speeds are crucial for efficient production. Develop and upgrade your existing cards to create more complex and powerful systems. Through the Craft system, you can produce new cards at every level to grow your factory's capabilities. Get real-time information on the status of your factory: active cards, engineers, production speed, and energy levels. Also, issues like warehouse capacity, material shortages, or electrical failures are quickly reported and guide you toward solutions. You start with basic resources like wood and iron. Over time, you’ll work with more advanced materials like sulfur and uranium, eventually building more complex factories in the nuclear era. Factory Planner is a game that challenges you to think strategically, plan carefully, and manage your systems effectively. Combine cards strategically to build your factories, manage resources efficiently, and transform a small workshop into a massive industrial complex. Let production flow, and let the system run smoothly! Key Features Card-Based Building System Facility, Organization, Engineer and Resource Cards Solid and Liquid Material Flow with Power Management Engineer Assignments to Boost Efficiency Energy Management and Distribution Storage Capacity and Material Flow Control Card Upgrades and Crafting System Real-Time Factory Status Monitoring Resource Variety: From Wood and Iron to Uranium No Enemies – Purely Production-Focused Experience

rows.name: RAVENOUS
rows.short_description: Ravenous is a psychological horror game in which you play as Louis, a child trapped in a monster's basement. Explore the mysterious abode, solve puzzles to save your little sister and survive the psychological nightmare prepared for you.
rows.description_html: RAVENOUS is a first-person narrative psychological horror game, where you play as Louis, a child trapped in the depths of a basement designed by a monster who seems to know everything about you. You are alone. Trapped. And your little sister is waiting for you somewhere in the darkness. Discover the cursed history of the White family through oppressive environments and solve puzzles to survive. GAME FEATURES  Explore a gloomy Victorian basement with unique rooms and atmospheres. A mysterious storyline filled with clues that take you to the heart of a family drama.  Gameplay based on exploration and reflection: each room is a psychological puzzle to solve.   Available in French, English, and Korean, compatible with keyboard and XBOX controller.   ESCAPE THE NIGHTMARE You are harmless. All you have is your intelligence, your courage, and the hope of seeing the light of day again. Find your sister, or lose yourself forever in this labyrinth shaped by grief and hunger.

rows.name: Wires And Whiskers
rows.short_description: Wires and Whiskers is a local co-op action-puzzle game where two players control a lab-engineered gerbil and its magnetic exosuit. Work together to fight mutated enemies, solve magnetic puzzles, and survive in a ruined, post-apocalyptic trench world.
rows.description_html: Wires and Whiskers is a fast-paced, two-player local co-op game where you control a cybernetic lab gerbil and its armed exosuit through tactical combat and magnetic puzzles. Each player takes on a unique role: one handles agile movement and melee dashes (the gerbil), while the other manages long-range attacks and magnetic interaction systems (the exosuit). You must rely on precise coordination to survive an irradiated world overrun by mutated enemies and unstable tech. Explore Together! Fight together! Use Projection! This game is a 20-30 minute experience developed by students at ISART DIGITAL as part of their final year project! If you have any feedback or bug reports, please let us know on discord!

rows.name: Keyboard Quest
rows.short_description: Use your keyboard to assist Princess Tilda in her quest to retrieve the ancient Runekeys. Discover various keyboard-themed foes, cast spells and vibe along to some incredibly catchy tunes in this short but sweet project from Resonance Games!
rows.description_html: Join Princess Tilda on her Keyboard Quest! In this cute bite-sized game, players will use their keyboard keys to protect the Princess throughout her journey - playing the role of the kingdom's mighty Scroll-Lock. Cast two powerful spells using your keyboard to help defend the Princess Go up against menacing keyboard-themed enemies: the Octothorpe, Ampersand and Hyphiend, each with their own behaviours and abilities Protect Princess Tilda as she traverses the world and collects ancient Runekeys Win or Lose - each game is quick and provides unique challenges each playthrough Supports UI in English, French, Italian, Farsi, Russian, Mandarin, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, and SA Spanish Keyboard Controller Cast spells to defend Princess Tilda, and help her recover three ancient runekeys before making it back to the safety of her castle. You will use your physical keyboard to defend the Princess - pressing keys to shock foes with lightning or bounce them around with bubble magic! Cute and Quirky Keyboard Characters You'll face up against some particularly nasty monsters as Tilda travels, including the common Octothorpe, the quick-flying Ampersand and the terrible Hyphiend. Each enemy behaves a bit differently, and so learning those differences may be the key to winning or losing! Micro Gaming This is a Resonance Games micro-game. Once you get the hang of it, it should only take you about five minutes to play. So take a seat, enjoy the music and visuals and see if you can get the Princess to safety! The Keyboard Kingdom depends on it~

rows.name: Pigeon Coo-lette
rows.short_description: Pigeon Coo-lette is a part-puzzle-part-rhythm game developed by Northeastern University students. It focuses on the simple mechanic of following a pattern of bullets and blanks as they are loaded into a gun and then repeating them, with a 'serious' yet 'silly' story.
rows.description_html: Snatched off of city streets, you wake up to a strange figure making you play a game. Now, you must survive for as long as you can in this audio-based minigame to find out who captured you, and why? Pigeon Coo-lette is a part-puzzle-part-rhythm game developed by Northeastern University students. It focuses on the simple mechanic of following a pattern of bullets and blanks as they are loaded into a gun and then repeating them, while also demonstrating a bright art style and an intriguing, yet silly story. Playtime With mounting difficulty as the game goes on, the playtime can vary greatly from player to player. However, the estimated playtime is approximately 20 mins. The pigeon has some patience, but do you?   Art Pigeon Coo-lette was given one limitation with art: we could almost entirely use only one color. We were allowed limited use of its complementary color, which we highlighted the bullets and the pigeon’s eyes with. Aside from that, we were tasked with creating a monotone game, with the only variation being the value of the color we chose.   Controls Space skips dialogue A/Left Click  shoots the gun D/Right Click spins the gun’s cylinder (skipping a bullet) Esc pauses   Your objective is to shoot every blank and skip every actual bullet in the revolver’s cylinder, six in total for each round. Shooting an actual bullet would obviously lead to your death, but skipping a blank will lead to the pigeon shooting you himself. As such, getting the order correct is crucial to your survival.   Accessibility The volume of the background noise and the SFX are adjustable from the pause menu.

rows.name: Nakuma
rows.short_description: Nakuma is a singleplayer RPG with focus on grinding for gear and experience points. Obtain a variety of magical spells, upgrade your gear and invest stat-points as you progress!
rows.description_html: Nakuma is a singleplayer RPG game with a focus on grinding for gear and experience points by defeating monsters on a variety of different maps. The game uses a simple action combat system and allows for multiple magical spells to be obtained and used. Oldschool MMORPG-like grinding for gear and experience points. No boring quest or story elements! Multiple different environments and themed monsters that inhibit them. No stagnating level curves! You will level up fast and steady throughout the entire gameplay. Upgrade your gear and get stronger! Choose your fate by spending stat points that you receive while leveling up! Gear drops with different grades of rarity. The same piece of gear could drop with better attributes if you are lucky! Find and use a range of abilities to defeat monsters more quickly and tactically.

Soar through deadly obstacles in two intense modes: complete hand-crafted levels or go for the highest score in endless mode. Unlock tons of unique characters and customize them with fun accessories. Want more? Ready to fly... or die?

rows.description_html: Step into a living, digital gallery featuring the vibrant works of Riley Magras. Wander through a stylized, immersive space where paintings come to life around you. Discover hidden paintbrushes tucked throughout the exhibit, explore interactive visuals, and engage with art in a way that blurs the line between gallery and game. Vending machines offer structures that can be placed to defend your location but turns off the generator when overpowered. Unlock achievements for experience rewards or level up by shooting signs. They may not look like much but they sneak up on you.

rows.name: Sawmania
rows.short_description: Protect your base against an onslaught of monsters using your mighty saw!
rows.description_html: Defend Your Base   You are the last bastion.  Stand strong against monsters and ghouls as they carry out a full-out attack to destroy your base. Survive long enough to acquire candies, obtain powerups, and protect your base from destruction.   Two Ways To Play   Campaign Mode: Fight your way through 9 unique campaign levels, each with their own twists and challenges to conquer.  Do you have what it takes to break the curse once and for all. Survival Mode: Fight endlessly against monsters and ghouls while obtaining new powerups and curses every few rounds. How long will you hold out for before the monsters overtake your base? Wield the power of the elements Give yourself an edge in battle by harnessing the power of the elements to your advantage. Magic-imbued crystals can be unlocked to powerup your saw during combat, letting you slice through the incoming monsters with ease. If you see a crystal appear, destroy it with your saw and watch the magic unfold. Try stacking multiple elements on top of each other to create devastating combinations!    Earn Rewards & Customize   As you earn achievements in Sawmania, you will be rewarded with a bonus currency that you may redeem in the Trades & Offers store in exchange for miscellaneous cosmetic items. These allow you to customize your gameplay experience by equipping any combination of launchers, saw skins, and particle trails. The choice is yours!

rows.name: Spencer's Spaghetti Quest
rows.short_description: Run, jump and punch your way through a bright hand-drawn world collecting upgrades and currency to become even stronger! Progress through different themed levels and defeat unique bosses to gather the legendary spaghetti ingredients!
rows.description_html: Spencer's Spaghetti Quest is a fast-paced 3D platforming puzzle-solving shooter, made up entirely of hand drawn sprites. There are various little things around the map you can collect that will make you a bit stronger, and a bunch of fun movement mechanics to mess around with. Shoot magic bolts from your fingers, stretch out your arm and punch enemies far away, or use it to launch yourself and reach hard to get areas. There will be a variety of puzzles, NPC's to interact with, plenty of enemies, and tons of random wacky antics! Many of the character's you'll see were made and submitted by community members! You can get different costumes by playing the game, some which will be exclusive to early access players and discord members! Featured Content Creators BunBuns :

rows.name: The Calamity Trials
rows.short_description: Complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles while IT chases you. These weapons will increase speed, or become another obstacle you must overcome.
rows.description_html: THE SCREEN The screen will have everything you need to begin the trials. You will enter your mind in a world we create. You will feel and experience everything as if you're truly there. We won't be checking in too often since there are plenty of other subjects, but I can assure you that trying to leave the chair by force won't work. Little tip: don't stare at the screen too long since you'll be here awhile, for your sanity. THE TRIALS It's too late to turn back; you signed the papers, remember? The trials are what you chose over the death sentence. You'll be tasked to complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles. Reach the end goal before IT catches up to you. These weapons will either help you increase speed and further the gap from IT , or become another obstacle you must overcome. Being caught by IT or falling into the void will result in FAILURE . The only way to win is by reaching the LIGHT at the very end of the stage. I can't provide too much information on what we're preparing for until you complete the trials, but I will say you are not ready for what's to come. THE KHRON Khrons is a currency that allows you to unlock stages when you have the required amount. You receive 1000 khrons every stage completed. If you FAIL a stage, you will lose 100 khrons. This provides you 10 opportunities to complete a stage. THE DOOR Stages are still a work in progress, but we have plenty of time. Until we feel you are ready or have the required amount of khrons, the door remains CLOSED!

rows.description_html: In this puzzle game, you take control of various characters. Figuring out your path to the goal tile. God's ray helps you stay alive, but when an obstruction breaks the sight, you die and become a ghost. As long as you are in god's sight, you can possess any body. Find your path to the goal. It's our first game, just made for fun and given away for free. Enjoy!

God's ray helps you stay alive, but when an obstruction breaks the sight, you die and become a ghost. As long as you are in god's sight, you can possess any body. Find your path to the goal. It's our first game, just made for fun and given away for free. Enjoy!

rows.name: Wordcaster
rows.short_description: Wordcaster is a voice-driven RPG adventure where you become a wizard, casting spells by speaking words aloud. Real-time speech recognition turns your voice into magical attacks against enemies. Unlock spellbooks, battle bosses, collect coins, and level up in a unique voice-powered RPG experience.
rows.description_html: Overview Your voice is your weapon. Wordcaster is a voice-driven RPG adventure where you step into the robes of a wizard, casting spells by speaking words aloud. Real-time speech recognition listens to your voice and unleashes magic against enemies. Gameplay In Wordcaster, every spell comes from your voice. Choose from a variety of spellbooks, each with its own set of words and power multipliers. Face waves of enemies across multiple worlds, take down challenging bosses, and collect coins to upgrade your wizard. Progression is built around classic RPG elements: Spellbooks with unique vocabularies and damage multipliers Levels & XP to grow stronger and unlock new abilities Coins & Shops to purchase upgrades and customize your wizard Whether you’re mastering basic words or commanding advanced spellbooks, every victory comes from how clearly and quickly you can cast your spells.

rows.name: T.B.M ~The Blueppers Mayhem~
rows.short_description: The best f2p play there is! Play against a friend or in a public match in fast paced 1v1 battles. Win matches to get resorces for progresion and unlock as many clishers as you can so you can promote as many of them for great rewards. The more support this product gets the more updates it will get!!!
rows.description_html: *So you want a 1v1 experience? A combination of a platformer and a fighting game? Well you are in the right place! Welcome to The Blueppers Mayhem where we don't take things to seriosly... after all, you are in the Void City the place where all the clishes and the mistakes live in, under the tree of the Multi-Multiverse, where all the Brands you know live in separate universes... *Now about gameplay. So as you have read it is a 1v1 fighting game and the maps are bigger for more freedom in movement. The goal of the gamemode 'Game Robbery' is to get a kill. After that a game will spawn around the map and you will need to colect it. As soon as you are carring the game try to get to your basket and stand near it for 4 seconds to score a point. First player which gets 3 games wins. *The progresion is split in two parts: *Juicy zaps - reward only available by end of the match or by promotions which result from playing matches. These are used for upgrading your characters to unlock slots, to buy clisher packs, to buy Rare Prints and to buy Overcharges. *Dimes - reward from promotions as said before, but also through real money. With these you can do everything said up with two diffrences. You can not upgrade your chracters with juicy zaps so you have no slots for Upgrades and also you can buy with dimes only, Tags which are a cosmetic to express your emotions. *So, in the end, in order to level up your chracters you need juciy zaps even if you spend money but they are unbuyable through real money. So here is the first ever implemetension of a P2W WALL which is nor Pay to win it is actually Play to Win! In exchange dimes have really good values if you want to get some through your beloved cradit card... *There is not a really complex story yet, though I have a question for you. How did Blueppers break his display? And how did Scarrlet get her scar? Well... nobody knows, yet... *There are some goals in this game: 1. Promote all your characters! -by winning games from matches with each clisher; 2.Get all Tags! -each has a unique way of unlocking them get in the game and you will see! 3.Upgrade your clishers and get all the Upgrades (Rare Prints and Overcharges). The jurney will be hard and you will rage but after a while you will become the master of.... T.B.M. ~THE BLUEPPERS MAYHEM!~

rows.name: OverField
rows.short_description: Tiny Miniature World Cozy Light Social Grand Open Adventure Hello! Let's explore the OverField together!
rows.description_html: Worldview Rota Tech is recruiting new members! You'll become the new Leader of the exploration team through tests! In this world lies a hidden realm known as the “OverField”—a mysterious frontier at the very heart of Rota’s research. You'll encounter various events with explorers, face challenges from mysterious forces, and uncover the truth behind the “OverField”.   ▼Game Features ◆Fantastical 'Field' Within 'Reality'◆ Step into a meticulously crafted miniature-style 3D world—both whimsical and lifelike. With stunning visuals that feel like a living animated film, every step brings the world vividly to life.   ◆Exploration Filled With Fun and Danger◆ Enjoy adventure-filled box garden exploration with surprises at every turn. Experience lighthearted and charming combat while leading your team through thick and thin.   ◆Meet Charismatic Exploration Members◆ Form your own exploration squad, travel between 'Reality' and 'Field', and build trust with your teammates through adventures.   ◆Create Dream Homes and Customize Styles◆ Personalize explorers' outfits with multi-part dyeing and fashion combinations. Build your plaza home with creative ideas using multiple furniture themes.   ◆Enjoy Daily Life Beyond Adventures◆ Seaside tranquility, forest swings... Perfect spots for solitude to heal life's fatigue. For socializing, join barbecue parties, dynamic soccer games, and COSPLAY contests! Meet the life and friends you've been longing for at Rota Plaza - always a place to enjoy the world's beauty!

rows.name: Eldritch Archives
rows.short_description: Nightmares of awful creatures and twisted worlds have haunted you since you received a letter from a prospective client. Delving into the mystery behind this cursed page may be the only chance you have of ever sleeping again. Nobody ever said being a paranormal investigator was easy...
rows.description_html: Working as a paranormal investigator means you have never had a shortage of strange clientele. But this letter and the page accompanying it have begun to erode your sanity and you have been possessed with a desperate need to investigate its origin. Eldritch Archives is a short horror game where you take the role of an investigator that has answered the call of a concerned client. You arrive at their home and must attempt to ward against the forces that inhabit it. Use your environment You can interact with, pick up and throw a variety of items and use them to help you ward against the evil forces. Detect supernatural energy You have a trusty detector that will help you find and deal with objects that emit dark energies. Collect information and solve the mystery There are mystical pages in hidden places that will unravel the true nature of the events that unfold. Collecting them all may lead you to discover something of real supernatural significance. Your actions will determine your journey During your investigations there are a number of stories to tell... some have more grisly fates than others. Good luck.

rows.name: Katana
rows.short_description: Katana is a clicker game where you click... a katana! Click the katana to earn more katanas — simple, addictive, and ever-growing. Every 3 hours, you’ll receive a random katana drop to add to your collection.
rows.description_html: Katana — The Ultimate Clicker Game for Sword Enthusiasts Click. Collect. Repeat. In Katana , every click brings you closer to building the greatest katana collection ever. Get a random katana every 3 hours and watch your collection grow with unique blades forged through community creativity. 3-Hour Drop Rates* : Common – 80% Uncommon – 16% Rare – 3% Epic – 0.99% Legendary – 0.01% * Drop rates are subject to change Key Features : A katana. Obviously. Items to boost and expand your collection Unlockable achievements A community fully powered by katana passion Submit your own designs via Discord! Every katana in the game is inspired or created by players like you. Join the fun, leave your mark, and shape the future of Katana !

rows.name: Island Market Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Island Market Simulator – In this strategy and economy simulation game set in an island town, build your trade empire by starting with a small market. Produce your goods through farming, livestock, and supply chain management, and expand your business with seasonal dynamics and festivals!
rows.description_html: Roadmap About the Game ◆ Increase your reputation by decorating your home with 100 different items . Express your style with paintings, furniture, and decorative accessories. Market and home decorations directly affect your in-game prestige system! ◆ Diversify your income by offering 73 different products for sale. Showcase various product categories to expand your customer base. Reach maximum profit potential through strategic product placement! ◆ Discover the dynamics of the game with countless weather events brought by 4 different seasons . Effects like snow, rain, and scorching heat can impact everything from farming to trade. Each season brings new challenges and opportunities, adding life to the game! ◆ Diversify your farming by growing 47 different crops . Optimize the processes of sowing, watering, and harvesting to achieve maximum yield. Sell your produce at markets or use it in various recipes! ◆ Make your game even more colorful with events that appear on specific dates. These seasonal or special-day events offer rare rewards and surprise opportunities. Stay active to never miss out and benefit from every advantage! ◆ Raise 3 different types of animals to obtain various products like milk, wool, eggs, and meat. Take care of their health and happiness to increase productivity. Sell the products you collect or use them in your own production processes! ◆ Shape your in-game relationships by completing quests from the kingdom, pirates, and townsfolk . Each quest has its own story and reward. Through these missions, you can discover new areas and witness different storylines! ◆ Grab your hammer and head to the workshop! Use 10 different machines to craft 40 unique products! From cheese to fabric, jam to alcohol everything depends on your craftsmanship. You choose what to produce and shape the economy your way!

rows.name: Slash
rows.short_description: A skill based game with lots of customizability, where you slash bullets with a sword before they hit the ground, to earn money and get new cosmetics.
rows.description_html: A skill based game with lots of customizability, where you slash bullets with a sword before they hit the ground, to earn money and get new cosmetics. When the play button is pressed bullets will fall down from the top of the screen, you must hit them with your sword before they hit the ground or you will die and have to start over. There are three different spots the bullets can spawn at, each one corresponds with a certain attack. If the bullet spawns on the left you must hit it with a left slash. If it spawns on the right you must hit it with a right slash. If it spawns in the middle you must hit it with a stab. Each bullet you strike you will get a point and cash. You can buy cosmetics with cash. The more points you have the more often bullets will spawn, and they will have a higher max speed. Try to get the highest score you can.

rows.name: Food Facility
rows.short_description: Food Facility is a 2D factory automation game where you design and build complex production lines to create delicious food, sell your goods, and grow your business empire!
rows.description_html: Food Facility is a game where you build a complex factory to produce food as efficiently as possible—all within the tight space you're given. Droppers Droppers release ingredients that can be combined, compressed, mixed, and more. Discover multiple ways to transform these items into food products. Combine things! Take ingredients from your droppers and feed them into machines like the Mixer—combine flour and sugar into dry mix, or experiment with more advanced machines as your factory grows. Tiers Unlock tiers to progress your factory! Discover hidden recipes and occasionally new machinery as you advance. Shop Ingredients don’t appear out of nowhere! Buy what you need to keep your factory running. Contracts Take on contracts to boost your factory’s profits and earn even more!

rows.name: Rocrasher
rows.short_description: PUSH and SMASH!!! Savor the ultimate thrill of crushing everything in your way! Crushing the little figures along the road will increase the boulder's size and weight, granting it greater acceleration and diving force!
rows.description_html: Rocrasher（大石头杀人事件） PUSH and SMASH!!! Savor the ultimate thrill of crushing everything in your way! Crushing the little figures along the road will increase the boulder's size and weight, granting it greater acceleration and diving force! Multiple Levels to Choose From Each stage offers a unique style — from the surface to the underground, roll your way through and crush everything in your path. Satisfying Physics and Collision Feedback Experience dynamic physics-based destruction. The way objects shatter depends on what you hit and how fast you crash into it, giving each impact a different level of feedback. Various Interactive Mechanics Want to clear the road for your giant boulder? Try out different abilities at your disposal: 1 Tap the boulder to push it in any direction. 2 Tap obstacles to smash them apart. 3 Crush as many little critters as you can. Charming Cartoon Art Style & Immersive Audio-Visuals A cute and quirky giant boulder, swaying grass and flowers, bouncing roaches — all enhanced by post-processing filters, outlines, sound effects, and screen shake. Together they create an engaging and stress-relieving audiovisual experience.

rows.name: Grind Hero: MMORPG
rows.short_description: 2D MMORPG with PvP, guilds, bosses, sigils, and a vast world to explore!
rows.description_html: GRIND HERO – 2D CROSS-PLATFORM MMORPG WITH PVP, GUILDS AND EPIC ADVENTURES! Get ready to dive into a nostalgic and challenging world in GRIND HERO – a 2D MMORPG made for players who love leveling up characters, exploring vast maps, and testing their skills in intense PvP battles! PLAY ANYWHERE Grind Hero is fully cross-platform, allowing you to play with the same account on both PC and mobile. Take your adventure with you wherever you go! CLASSES AND EVOLUTION Choose from 4 unique classes and unlock a powerful upgrade upon reaching level 20. Each class has its own playstyle, abilities, and battlefield role! PARTIES AND GUILDS Form parties with your friends or team up with other adventurers! Join a guild to take part in exclusive events, conquer territories, and grow as a team. PVP WITH SKULL SYSTEM Engage in PvP combat in dedicated areas! The skull system marks player killers, adding more risk and strategy to every encounter. AUTOMATED BOSS EVENTS Prepare for epic battles against bosses that spawn automatically across the world! Team up and fight for rare loot and glory. SIGIL SYSTEM Unlock and equip Sigils – unique passive abilities that enhance your strength, defense, speed, regeneration, and more. Customize your build to match your playstyle. SKILL TRAINING SYSTEM Leveling up is only part of the journey. Train your skills over time to become stronger and more efficient in combat. A VAST WORLD FULL OF SECRETS Explore a huge open world with diverse regions, immersive quests, hidden chests, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. There’s always something new to discover! MAIN FEATURES: • Lightweight and addictive 2D MMORPG • Full cross-platform support (PC and Mobile) • Party and guild systems • PvP with skull system • 4 classes with evolution at level 20 • Passive Sigils for deep customization • Automated world boss events • Real-time skill training • Open map with quests, chests, and hidden content Love grinding, exploring, fighting bosses and becoming a legend in a nostalgic 2D world? Grind Hero is for you! Download now and begin your journey!

rows.name: Resonance Solstice
rows.short_description: Resonance is a unique real-time trading RPG that combines real-time card battles with train simulation. As a COLUMBA conductor, you’ll travel the continent, rebuild and reconnect a fractured world.
rows.description_html: Dear Conductor, finally we meet! Resonance Solstice is a unique real-time trading RPG that combines real-time card battles with train simulation gameplay. As a conductor for COLUMBA, you’ll drive your train across the continent, reconnecting cities and regions to save a world on the brink of collapse. In this world full of unknowns, you'll meet companions from different factions, each with unique personalities, and together you'll face the adventures and challenges that come your way during your journey. ===Drive the Eternal at full speed=== Drive the Eternal across ' Morphic Field Pollution' zones and travel through the beautiful post-catastrophe landscapes. Start the engine and reconnect the world rendered in shambles. ===Design and Manage Your Dream Train Home=== Customize the Eternal however you like and turn it into your personal movable home on rails. With diverse styles, enjoy the adventure in your own unique way! ===Real-Time Trading, Wealth Incoming=== Ports, cities, and the wilds — dynamic markets where you buy low and sell high! Trade across cities in real time and become the world’s top merchant! ===Real-Time Card Battles with Endless Combinations=== Engage in thrilling card battles in real time. With flexible team-building and countless card synergies, craft your exclusive squad and dominate the battlefield your way! ===Top-Tier Voice Actors for Anime-Style Immersion=== Every character features Live2D interaction and premium Japanese voice acting! Encounter unforgettable allies and dive into an anime-quality, story-rich journey! Voice Actor Cast: Kitō Akari, Mizuki Nana, Kugimiya Rie, Tomatsu Haruka, Sugita Tomokazu, Ishida Akira, Morikawa Toshiyuki, Matsuoka Yoshitsugu, Uchiyama Kōki, Ōnishi Saori, Murase Ayumu, Enoki Junya, Toyoguchi Megumi, Honda Mariko, Kanemoto Hisako, Tamura Yukari, Maeda Kaori, Uchida Aya, Ise Mariya, Kuroki Honoka, Numakura Manami, Nakahara Mai, Senbongi Sayaka, Yumiri Hanamori, Taketatsu Ayana, Kohara Konomi, Yukana, Maria Naganawa, Sonozaki Mie, Asumi Kana, M・A・O, Machico, Tachibana Mirai, Itō Shizuka, Tadokoro Azusa, Itō Miku, Mamiya Tomoaki ===World Settings=== When the unknown object 'Morphic Moon' appeared in the sky, everything we once knew changed. The world was thrown into disarray, with conflicting factions and chaos spreading through every corner of the cities. In Resonance, humanity succumbed to slumber, transmuting into dream-drunk entities beyond mortal recognition. In this remade reality,‌ as a Conductor of COLUMBA,‌ where shall you steer your Train —‌ the lifeline threading between Bonfire Cities' final hopes? All aboard! Take the controls of your own Eternal and ride across a world slipping into chaos!

Voice Actor Cast: Kitō Akari, Mizuki Nana, Kugimiya Rie, Tomatsu Haruka, Sugita Tomokazu, Ishida Akira, Morikawa Toshiyuki, Matsuoka Yoshitsugu, Uchiyama Kōki, Ōnishi Saori, Murase Ayumu, Enoki Junya, Toyoguchi Megumi, Honda Mariko, Kanemoto Hisako, Tamura Yukari, Maeda Kaori, Uchida Aya, Ise Mariya, Kuroki Honoka, Numakura Manami, Nakahara Mai, Senbongi Sayaka, Yumiri Hanamori, Taketatsu Ayana, Kohara Konomi, Yukana, Maria Naganawa, Sonozaki Mie, Asumi Kana, M・A・O, Machico, Tachibana Mirai, Itō Shizuka, Tadokoro Azusa, Itō Miku, Mamiya Tomoaki ===World Settings=== When the unknown object 'Morphic Moon' appeared in the sky, everything we once knew changed. The world was thrown into disarray, with conflicting factions and chaos spreading through every corner of the cities. In Resonance, humanity succumbed to slumber, transmuting into dream-drunk entities beyond mortal recognition. rows.name: PANOPTYCA : Idle RPG Manager
rows.short_description: Discover a new style of RPG management gameplay. Experience the fun of an idle RPG that blends an innovative four-view battle system with a deep hero-growth mechanic.
rows.description_html: Game Overview Step into the role of a commander in a vast fantasy world. Manage, train, and lead your heroes to forge the strongest Alliance squad. Key Features 1. Innovative Multi-Character Management System Unlike traditional RPGs that focus on a single hero, Panoptica allows you to nurture up to eight heroes simultaneously. Each hero explores a different region independently, embarking on their own unique adventure. 2. Real-Time Four-View Battle Observation Mode Through the four-panel Command Mode, you can monitor multiple ongoing battles in real time. Step in instantly during emergencies to adjust your strategy, or focus on upgrading your heroes' equipment and skills when the situation is stable. 3. Party Dungeons While individual heroes hunt autonomously across the field, you can form two-hero parties to challenge high-difficulty dungeons. Experiment with combinations such as tank and DPS, or mage and healer, to defeat powerful bosses that would be impossible to face alone—earning both exciting rewards and the satisfaction of cooperative play. 4. The Essence of Strategic RPG Management Go beyond simple leveling and become a true commander of heroes. Assign characters to optimal battlefields based on their classes and traits, distribute equipment efficiently, and manage skill trees to maximize synergy. With precise auto-battle customization, you can design and control the battlefield exactly as you envision it. The satisfaction of growing up to eight heroes simultaneously delivers a new sense of accomplishment never before felt in traditional RPGs. 5. Aesthetic of Medieval Fantasy and TRPG Charm Featuring parchment-style visuals reminiscent of classic tabletop RPGs, Panoptica digitally recreates the nostalgic feeling of rolling dice with friends around a table. Each region offers its own monsters and treasures, and as your exploration deepens, a richer world and lore unfold before you.

rows.name: Scaredy Cat
rows.short_description: A scaredy cat steps into the forest alone to find a rare flower for her friends — but some journeys are more than they seem.
rows.description_html: Scaredy Cat is a short, emotional narrative adventure where you play as a young kitty trying to prove she’s brave enough to cross the darkest part of the forest to find a rare flower alone. A journey that starts as a simple dare quickly becomes something deeper, as kitty meets the inhabitants of the forest and has to face the truth about herself.  Key Features A short but heartfelt experience (~10–20 minutes); Explore stylized locations of the game world; Funny dialogue and interesting story twists; Simple controls, accessible to all players. The game was made as a part of a Summer Studies course at Kajaani University of Applied Sciences in just a few months. This is out first Steam release! :)

rows.name: THUGGING
rows.short_description: THUGGING is a 3rd Person Shoot 'em up set in a dystopian city fueled by drugs and gambling. Inspired by classic 3D retro games it tries to capture this unique oldschool ambient in a semi open world setting. Steal money, kill thugs and get away in your car!
rows.description_html: THUGGING is a third-person shoot ’em up set in a lawless city where crime, drugs, and gambling control everything. The streets are stained with blood, and only the most ruthless make it out alive. Revenge, Retribution and maybe ... a second chance? You’re fresh out of prison with one thing on your mind — revenge. The city that turned its back on you hasn’t changed, and it’s still crawling with thugs, gangs, and dirty criminals standing in your way. With weapons in hand and nothing to lose, you’ll fight your way through the streets, leaving chaos behind as you climb back to the top. The only question is, how far will you go for revenge and how much drug money can you steal?! Features:  Shoot, Steal, Survive – Engage in relentless 3rd Person shootouts, kill armed thugs, and keep stacking dirty cash in your hideout Muscle Car Rides – Cruise the city in style, traveling from one place to another while catching your breath between fights and discovering your old town Revenge-Driven Story – Fresh out of jail, with nothing left to lose, your future is written in bullets and blood This isn't just survival; it's about taking back what's yours. Your story is one of blood, bullets and drug money. The city offers no mercy and neither will you!

rows.name: License to Grill
rows.short_description: Pick your favorite meat character and cook up to 8 friends using the environment, wacky weapons, or your trusty frying pan in this online 3rd Person Combat PVP game!
rows.description_html: License to Grill is a multiplayer 3rd Person Combat game with up to 8 players . Your goal is to cook your friends in Free For All matches. Take advantage of wacky ragdoll physics to knock your friends into an an oven or tenderize them with a big hammer! Use a variety of wacky and powerful weapons to cook your friends in creative ways. Each weapon has something special about it. Each weapon will heat up your opponents, eventually cooking them! Frying Pan Your trusty default weapon that always comes back to you even after being thrown. Meat Hammer A devastating Meat Tenderizer that can slam the ground with incredible power that can knock players around. Pepper Shotgun A powerful shotgun with strong knockback that can easily cook other players with a regular shot or a charged shot that uses more ammo. Fridge Door A riot shield style weapon that you can use to cool yourself faster and defend from frontal attacks as well as thrust forward with incredible speed. Propane Launcher A grenade launcher style weapon that fires 2 highly explosive propane tanks at once that leave fire at the point of impact. Navigate interesting level layouts that provide plenty of opportunities for riveting interactions. Pizza Party A tight pizza kitchen inspired environment with a conveyor belt covered in weapons leading to a giant pizza oven that will cook you if fall in. Market Showdown A food market street inspired environment with a hot charcoal grill spilled in the middle of the map. Market Showdown has lots of vertical space and cover to take advantage of.  Cook the most players in a match to score the most and win !

rows.name: The Most Epicest Snowball Fight Ever!
rows.short_description: The snowball fight of your dreams! Take up arms against imaginary snow monsters in this charming turn-based tactics game where a child's imagination is their greatest weapon. Can you defeat the forces of the evil Baron von Slushie?
rows.description_html: It's a beautiful, snowy day in the neighborhood. School's cancelled, so it's time for a snowball fight! Play as a group of friends taking up the mantle of defending their homes from imaginary monsters with nothing but snowballs, cocoa, and their wild imaginations. Immerse yourself in a rich and rewarding tactical experience! Take cover behind the environment to protect yourself, focus fire to stop monsters from regenerating, and more! As you fight, your imagination will begin to run wild. With this power, you can bring imagination to life! Soar through the air, create the ultimate unbreakable anti-everything shield, and more! After each level, choose three new powers to add to your team! There's no wrong answers, so let your imagination run wild as you prepare to face the endless hordes of snow monsters!

rows.name: FOR GOD'S SAKE, HELP HIM!
rows.short_description: FOR GOD'S SAKE, HELP HIM! is a tiny, surreal first-person art 'game' about what it's like. your goal is singular and simple: try to help him, however you can... if you can. that's a tall order considering you're both in a blank void and he's being crushed over and over.
rows.description_html: FOR GOD'S SAKE, HELP HIM! is a tiny, surreal first-person art 'game' about what it's like. your goal is singular and simple: try to help him, however you can. if you can. in this blank, reverberant void, the only things around are you, him, and giant objects periodically falling out of the sky and crushing him. simply put, he needs help. for a few minutes, you can step in and help him. no, seriously -- it will probably only be a few minutes of playtime. walk around and explore the void if you'd like. interact with whatever you can. maybe you'll find something out there that can help, but wander too far and you'll wrap back around to where you started. surely, somewhere in this space, you can find a quick and easy solution to get him out of this predicament for good, and we'll all live happily ever after? only one level, only one objective, only one ending. the game exclusively revolves around helping him. there is nothing else. there's a reason the game's free. --- (a little experiment i made in my very limited free time over the last month or so)

rows.name: HEGGO
rows.short_description: A strategy roguelike shooting game. Play as Egg Kid, helping the demon Egg Overlord defeat monsters. Allocate monsters each round, with stronger monsters offering better rewards. Defeat them in time, then use the leftover time to craft equipment and upgrade your stats to reach the goal.
rows.description_html: This project is a free game created by the developer out of personal interest and as a portfolio piece. The game took three months to complete, with all music, art, programming, and writing created independently by the developer. In the game, the protagonist plays as an egg kid who was executed by the king and sent to hell. Seeking revenge, they make a deal with a demon to assist in their plans. Inspiration was drawn from games like Lone Star Hunter, The Binding of Isaac, Bratato, and Slay the Spire. The game adds a time-based resource mechanic to the traditional roguelike genre, allowing players to dynamically allocate the number of monsters each round. The initial difficulty is high, requiring multiple attempts to gradually unlock the monster and item bestiary, gaining off-round growth and enhancing base stats. Once all equipment bestiary are unlocked, players can customize their starting gear, which changes the gameplay by focusing less on survival and more on gear-building. The game also pays homage to some well-known games' items or characters, offering surprises for players. The main game takes about one to two hours to complete, while the full achievement run takes approximately five to ten hours. We hope players find joy in the experience. Note: This game displays language based on your in‑game settings menu, not via Steam’s language selector. To switch languages, please change it inside the game menu.

rows.short_description: Gnomeball is a fast-paced soccer game for 1-4 players, set in a charming miniature garden. Become a goal-scoring machine, pass like a maestro, and channel your inner Messi as you gracefully dribble past defenders!

There are many ways to bend the game to your will: kick the ball low or high, head it while it's up in the air, or take a more technical approach by timing your dribbles just right to outplay defenders. rows.name: Defend the Castle
rows.short_description: Defend the Castle is a day-by-day tower defense roguelike where you face 5 enemy waves per day, upgrade between battles, and struggle to survive as enemies grow stronger. Make the right choices or fall. Some days bring... something else.
rows.description_html: 🏰 Defend the Castle How long can you survive - when each day only makes the enemy stronger? Defend the Castle is an intense day-by-day tower defense game where you fight off waves of attackers in a world that never gives you a moment to breathe. Each day brings 5 waves of enemy assaults , and you have only 60 seconds to survive. But this isn't just a game about defense. It's a game about choices . What do you upgrade? What do you sacrifice? What will it cost to see one more dawn? 🔥 Features • Roguelike structure: Death is inevitable - and necessary. Fail to meet your daily kill quota , and it's game over. • Strategic upgrades: Between days, spend your hard-earned resources to improve your base , repair the damage , and prepare for what’s next . • Hidden threats: Some days feel... different. Something larger stirs in the distance. What awaits at the edge of dawn? • Dynamic enemy waves: Each wave features unique combinations of enemy types - no defense holds forever. • Atmospheric world: A living battlefield with storm clouds that strike lightning , flocks of birds in the sky , and visual details that breathe life into every deadly sunrise. ⚔️ Fate is Calling Defend the Castle is as much a battle against time as it is against the enemy. A strategic survival experience where every choice matters - and every day could be your last.
