rows.name: Panic Sell
rows.short_description: Would you like to feel like a trader? Try to earn crazy capital in this game or lose everything! Buy cheaper and sell more expensive. That's all you need on your way to wealth. Good luck!
rows.description_html: Panic Sell is a free trading simulator where markets are crazy, coins are jumping, and your choice decides the fate of your virtual wallet. Your motto in this game is: buy low and sell high. Try not to lose all your money, but on the contrary, become very successful. In this game, you are waiting for 10 coins that change in value randomly. However, Panic Sell has some secrets that will help you increase your chances of successful transactions. Every 20 price marks there is a line that blocks the price from moving into another range with a probability of 70%. And every 60 marks there is a line that blocks 90% of attempts to cross the line. Use these support and resistance lines to win. You can buy or sell any number of coins if you have enough budget for it. Time is running out and prices are changing every few seconds. Therefore, sometimes it is worth acting quickly, and sometimes it is worth waiting for a more opportune moment. The main objective of the game is to achieve the largest possible total capital. Learn to catch prices near support and resistance lines in time. Be patient. Observe. Act accurately and quickly. Go ahead!

rows.name: Girls' Frontline
rows.short_description: As a Commander for Griffin & Kryuger PMC. Navigate faction power struggles, deploy forces strategically, and work to restore order in a war-torn world.
rows.description_html: In 2030, the Beilan Island Incident erupted, triggering environmental deterioration that threatened humanity's survival and intensified global conflicts, ultimately leading to a worldwide war. Now, after years of relentless warfare, you take on the role of a Commander under the employment of Griffin & Kryuger Private Military Contractor. With a squad of Tactical Dolls, you will navigate the power struggles between factions, strategically deploy your forces, and restore order and stability to a war-torn world. Girls' Frontline is a turn-based strategy RPG that offers: Hundreds of Unique Tactical Dolls Recruit and command Tactical Dolls, each representing different firearms. With stunning artwork, full professional voice-overs, and distinct personalities, these girls will stand by your side in battle! An Expansive Storyline & Immersive Worldbuilding Set in the latter half of the 21st century, the game takes place in a war-ravaged world where 'Autonomous Doll' technology has risen to prominence in both military and civilian sectors. As various factions vie for survival, conflicts driven by technological rivalry, ideological clashes, and political strife unfold. As a Commander, you will lead Tactical Doll combat squads through intense battles, unravel deep conspiracies, and reshape the post-war world while seeking a path toward humanity's future. Intricate and Strategic Combat Mechanics Experience a fusion of real-time tactical deployment and pre-battle strategic planning, where quick decision-making and careful positioning determine the tide of battle. Different firearm classes—Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns, Shotguns, and more—each come with unique combat roles and abilities, offering a rich tactical experience. Every Tactical Doll possesses distinct skills and combat styles, allowing for endless strategic combinations. Adapt to your enemies and adjust your squad formation to master diverse battle scenarios! A Heartwarming & Romantic OATH System Strengthen your bonds with your favorite Tactical Dolls and unlock exclusive voice lines and special stories through the OATH System! Forming an Oath also grants combat bonuses, making your squad even stronger. Find your perfect partner and forge an unbreakable bond!

rows.name: Castle Siege
rows.short_description: An army of knights clashes to reclaim their stolen kingdom, fearing their enemy has made a terrible discovery. Immerse yourself into thrilling, action-packed medieval warfare, set in a breathtakingly epic world!
rows.description_html: Castle Siege is a third-person medeival-style combtat game set in an epic, immersive world. Fight through waves of determined enemies as you lead your army in taking back your castle and claiming victory over your kingdom! Castle Siege features a singleplayer experience blending adventure with fast-paced action, and is praised for its incredible visuals, advanced AI, and cinematic gameplay.

rows.name: Telenet Shooting Collection Launcher
rows.short_description: Welcome to Shooter Heaven! The classic Telenet Japan & Wolf Team shooters are back! Note: The “Telenet Shooting Collection Launcher” is a free game launcher that lets you play titles from Telenet Japan and Wolf Team. The games themselves are not included with the launcher.
rows.description_html: Note: The “Telenet Shooting Collection Launcher” is a free game launcher that lets you play titles from Telenet Japan and Wolf Team. The launcher does not include the games themselves; it is a program for running game ROMs you have purchased. Game ROMs must be purchased separately as DLC. Classic shooters from Telenet Japan & Wolf Team arrive on Steam! Tanks, helicopters, spacefighters, enjoy a wide variety of battles! Granada : an all-direction scrolling shooter where you pilot a tank-type mobile weapon. Avenger: a near-future, mission-based strategic shooter in which you fly a combat helicopter. Gaiares : a distinctive shooter that lets you absorb enemy weapons and turn them into your own. Psychic Storm : a thrilling shoot-’em-up with two-player simultaneous play. This collection features four uniquely memorable shooters from the legendary developer  Telenet Japan. Convenience with added features:  While faithfully preserving the original atmosphere, we’ve added options such as key configuration and a rewind function. Notes: To play Granada, Avenger, Gaiares, and Psychic Storm, you must purchase each of the following DLCs separately: DLC “Granada,” DLC “Avenger,” DLC “Gaiares,” and DLC “Psychic Storm.” This product respects each work’s originality and includes content as it appeared at the time of its original console version. Please understand that, with regard to displayed in-game designs, company names, etc., we do not assume responsibility in the present day.

rows.name: Pingorile
rows.short_description: A retro-style 2D platformer where you play as a penguin collecting yellow budgies to fulfill his dream of flying. Explore diverse levels, jump past obstacles, and enjoy a colorful, music-filled adventure.
rows.description_html: PINGORILE is a charming retro-style jump’n’run where you play as a small, round penguin with a big dream – to fly. Inspired by a quirky TV show, the penguin sets out on a journey to find 12 golden budgies scattered across colorful and varied levels. A mysterious ostrich from the show has promised that anyone who collects them all will achieve the ability to fly. Jump, dodge, and explore vibrant pixel worlds full of surprises, secrets, and captivating music. Each level brings new challenges – from tricky platforming sections to relaxing moments – all wrapped in nostalgic 2D style. Features Classic jump’n’run gameplay with smooth controls Many creative and varied levels Numerous budgies to collect Retro visuals and an original, diverse soundtrack Are you ready to help him achieve his impossible dream?

rows.name: Bandits vs Lords: Epic Clash
rows.short_description: Prepare for a thrilling adventure where every decision counts. Construct your base, gather resources, and train unique troops to outsmart your opponents in tactical combat. Raid enemy villages for loot, forge alliances with other players, and expand your territory in a quest for ultimate dominance.
rows.description_html: Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash is  an addictive free-to-play MMO strategy game, you'll build a mighty kingdom, command a fearsome army, and clash with rivals in epic PVP battles. Prepare for a thrilling adventure where every decision counts. Construct your base, gather resources, and train unique troops to outsmart your opponents in tactical combat. Raid enemy villages for loot, forge alliances with other players, and expand your territory in a quest for ultimate dominance. Features: - Build an Unstoppable Force: Construct your base, upgrade buildings, and craft deadly traps. - Command a Powerful Army: Train and level up your troops and unleash devastating special abilities. Grow your base: Raid rivals, construct in strategic locations, and expand your kingdom. - Forge Alliances: Join forces with other players to create unstoppable clans. - Master Tactical Combat: Deploy your army wisely in real-time battles that demand cunning. - Instant Action: No long wait times - engage in combat whenever you're ready and have food! - Play PVE Bandits Campaign: Progress over the bandit campaign and gain resources. - Climb the Ranks: Prove you might and rise to become the ultimate Lord! A World of Conflict Awaits: In a realm where kingdoms clash and bandit hordes run rampant, only the strong will survive. Will you rise to the challenge, build a formidable empire, and conquer your enemies? Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash delivers: - Thrilling strategic gameplay - Intense PVP and PVE battles - Base-building excitement - Epic loot - Clans & strategic resource sharing. Download Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash for FREE and claim your destiny today! In-app purchases are available. A network connection is required.

rows.description_html: DELIVERY defines YOU CLIENTS demand ENTERTAINMENT AN ACTION-PACKED SHOOTER, where delivery services meet ARCADE FUN. Providence Delivery Service issues Couriers— delivery boys with guns—as cleanup for their corporate blunder of rogue delivery drones, but with a delivery entertainment twist! rows.name: Neural Tanks
rows.short_description: Neural Tanks is a third-person tank combat game that takes AI to the next level by leveraging Neural Networking. Neural Networking allows enemy tanks to learn and adapt over time, making them smarter, faster, and more efficient as they navigate the battlefield.
rows.description_html: Neural Tanks is a third-person tank combat game that takes AI to the next level by leveraging Neural Networking. Neural Networking allows enemy tanks to learn and adapt over time, making them smarter, faster, and more efficient as they navigate the battlefield. The enemy tanks, however, aren’t just self-improving by chance, they’re under the control of the sinister Sassy Sam, a mad scientist who unleashed a rogue AI into the world without a second thought for the chaos it would cause. Your mission is to take down the increasingly dangerous enemy tanks before they wreak anymore havoc. Along the way, you’ll discover powerful upgrades to give you an edge in combat, including camouflage, enhanced tank components for improved performance, and even quirky vanity items like tank boobs and tank nuts to give your vehicle some personality. Gear up, outsmart the AI, and stop Sassy Sam before it’s too late!

rows.name: Fate of Gun
rows.short_description: Click 「PLAY」 to start. The PLAY button turns into FIRE.​ After clicking FIRE, the button is grayed out. You fire first. If it's a live round, you fail the game and this round ends. If it's a blank round, the pirate will continue to fire.
rows.description_html: You are a space traveler who meets space pirates on your journey. At this moment, you engage in a game of life, winning to obtain pirate treasure and losing to pay the price Click on 'PALY' to start, press a bullet into the magazine, rotate the magazine, and place the gun on the table. PALY button changes to FIRE After clicking FIRE, the button will be grayed out; You shoot first. If it's live ammunition, your game will fail and this game will end; If it's an empty shell, the pirates will continue to shoot If the pirate fires with live ammunition, the game ends and you win, settling the reward If the pirate fires an empty shell, the game continues and the FIRE button lights up, allowing you to continue clicking At the same time, the Cashout button lights up, displaying the amount that can be redeemed at this time Continue clicking the Fire button until live ammunition is fired, ending this round of the game

rows.name: Path of the Sphere
rows.short_description: Take some time off your day to enjoy a relaxing cozy spin through theses labyrinths.  The base game offers you the full classic mode completely free! And there's more.. if you reach the last level of classic all you need to do is request new levels! Classic mode is a love letter to the community
rows.description_html: Welcome to Path of the Sphere (PotS) Take a break from the intensity of life and roll into the maze 😮‍💨. Path of the Sphere is a a relaxing labyrinth game where you guide a colorful sphere through 35 levels of mazes. No pressure, no deadlines, no conflicts. Just soothing gameplay in your own way and at your own pace. 😌 FEATURES OF THE GAME 🍃 35 levels of labyrinth at start 📟 Endless levels on request ⚙️ Customise your experience with: 🎶 Music (Calm for a more relaxing play or Intense to spark your challenging side) 🔉 Sound effects (hear the ball roll or turn it to enjoy just the music) 🕘 Timer (Display it digitally or in a classic analog style) 🗺️ Minimap (Switch it on for smoother play, or off for extra challenge) 🌟 Level Select panel to replay your favourites ⌨️ Keyboard friendly controls (WASD and arrow keys) 📋 In-game updates panel so you're always informed 🌸 Tap Illaza, our chibi mascot, in the main menu to visit our socials WHO SHOULD PLAY? There is something for everyone in PotS 🤓 Educational benefits: logical thinking, spatial awareness, emotional regulation, independent learning and improved memory 😌 Classic Mode offers a sensory friendly alternative to high intensity games 😮‍💨 Helps unwind and release tension after a long day 🫂 Enjoy it with friends or family. A game that people of all ages can enjoy.

rows.name: Dice Saga
rows.short_description: Dice Saga is a RPG/multiplayer party game where four players compete against each other. Build up your character and tear other players down in this colorful and chaotic digital board game!
rows.description_html: Dice Saga is a RPG/multiplayer party game where four players compete against each other. Build up your character and tear other players down in this colorful and chaotic digital board game! Four players will have to adventure into dangerous lands and battle ugly monsters to power up their characters. Build up the strongest warrior, or use the tricks at your disposal to ruin the game for other players! It's all in good fun! Each board has a powerful Boss monster; a risky fight that can grant you great rewards. But beware: other players can turn the fight against your favor or snatch the reward from under your nose, so be quick about it! There are two ways to play the game: in Blitz, you must build up your character fast, because the game ends with a battle royale, where the champion is declared winner. In Adventure, the last player living, wins, but after every turn and every disgraceful defeat, your age will tick down and, when your life drops to zero, you will roam the board as a ghost.  Features Up to four players complete in a roguelite against eachother, or against Ai Kill monsters and earn rewards that will help you on your quest, or hinder other players Features a simple, fast combat system that uses dice in an unique way Players are pinned against eachother in regular tournes to see who's build is the strongest Multiple scenarios and game modes!

rows.name: CatFatherJump

rows.description_html: This is a frame-by-frame platformer that requires no precise controls—you don't even need a keyboard. rows.short_description: A 2D psychological point-and-click horror game where you explore disturbing environments and uncover hidden truths through narrative-driven gameplay.

You’ll explore eerie environments, uncover dark secrets, and confront horror both external and within. As we always say: Pay Attention.

rows.name: How Your Package Gets Delivered
rows.short_description: Perfect For Fans Of: Endless runners Reflex-based games Arcade-style challenges Indie action-platformers
rows.description_html: Take control of your speeding delivery package in this fast-paced 3D obstacle runner where precision and quick reflexes are your only lifeline. Your goal? Survive the highway, avoid obstacles, and reach your final delivery destination at 25,000 meters. Speed-Based Challenge: The further you go, the faster it gets. Keep your focus sharp. Dynamic Obstacles: Dodge walls and hazards that spawn in random patterns every run. Power Pads: Boost and Slow Pads create moments of intensity and strategy. Ramp Launches: Fly off ramps with cinematic flair—if you land it right. One-Mistake Death System: Crash once, and it's game over. No mercy. High Score Tracking: Compete with yourself and reach new milestones with every attempt. Stylized 3D Aesthetic: Minimalist, modern visuals for a clean and vibrant atmosphere. Pause, Settings, and Mute Options: Built-in quality-of-life features to let you play on your terms. This is my first Unity Game. I learned a lot and had fun working on this project.  Special thanks to... Brackeys for making this possible. Music: JUANJO_SOUND SFX: Dustyroom, VoiceBosch, SoundBits, Olivier Giardot UI: MadFireOn, Mr_Command_Coder Feedback and support from... Bryan, Danny, Daniel, Dab Look out for my next project! Follow MindPlayPark

rows.name: Ameshidama
rows.short_description: This is a horror adventure game where you guide a lonely girl into the outside world. The girl is stuck in a small room, alone and unable to go outside. She dreams of the outside. What is outside? Why can't she go outside? Even after learning the reason, will you still take her outside?
rows.description_html: A girl who loves fashion and cute things. She spends all her time alone in a small room, unable to go outside. She dreams of going outside. Feeling sorry for her, you decide to take her outside. Along the way, she encounters creepy picture books, strange paintings on the walls, and a multi-legged monster... The mystery only grows as she progresses. However, as we get closer to the outside world, a certain reality becomes apparent. Does her happiness lie outside? Why can't she go outside? After knowing all this, will you still take her outside? This is a short horror adventure game. The player's goal is to lead the lonely girl to the outside world. There are obstacles along the way that will hinder her. At times, she may even be chased by unidentified monsters. Solve these obstacles and bring her out into the world. ・Play time About 30 minutes to 1 hour ・Endings There are two endings. The endings branch out depending on the player's choices and actions. ・How to play Confirm: Z Move/Select: ↑←↓→ Open menu screen/Cancel: X button Dash: Shift <Video submissions and live streaming> You are welcome. rows.name: Farlands: Tiny Harvest
rows.short_description: Tiny Harvest is a relaxing desktop game that runs while you work, study, or browse the internet. Grow space plants, upgrade your crops, ship, home, and tools, and enjoy a cozy, minimalist experience designed to keep you company throughout your day.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Tiny Harvest , a small and relaxing desktop game that lives quietly on your screen while you work, study, or browse the internet. HOW DOES IT WORK? In the corner of your desktop, a tiny space farmer responds to every click and keystroke you make throughout the day. You don’t need to pay attention, he takes care of planting and harvesting on his own. As you harvest space plants, you'll earns credits you can then use, along with your inputs, to upgrade his tools, crops, home, and spaceship. PERSONALIZATION Want to personalize your farmer? Unlock a variety of charming hats as you go and choose between two different characters. They won’t boost performance, but they’ll definitely boost style. LIGHTWIGHT AND COZY Tiny Harvest is an idle game with no intrusive menus, no pop-ups, and no stress. Lightweight, cozy, always present—like a virtual houseplant that thrives quietly while you go about your day.

rows.name: Guardian of Altai
rows.short_description: Feel like a true Altai shaman in this simple 3D shooter with magic elements and a fully diegetic interface! Unleash the powers of fire, water, air, and stone. Battle Erlik's golems, free ancient spirits, and restore balance in a mystical world inspired by Altai mythology.
rows.description_html: Guardian of Altai is an atmospheric adventure inspired by the myths and spirits of ancient Altai. Become a shaman — the last guardian of balance between worlds. Channel the power of the elements, beat your ritual drum, and fight back the darkness that has covered the land. Your journey will take you deep into the underworld to save what remains. Step into a world where every sound and symbol pulses with ancient magic. Free the trapped spirits, defeat the spawn of Erlik, and restore harmony before it’s too late. Battles with mythical creatures and shamanic magic in action A diegetic interface — nothing on screen but the ritual A cozy yurt… and a purring cat Ethno-fantasy visual style and atmospheric soundtracks Reconnect with the spirits. Become a shaman. Become the Guardian of Altai .

rows.name: Funny Bones
rows.short_description: A fast-paced Halloween themed typing game where you can test your speed and spelling skills in a crazy summoning madness.
rows.description_html: Funny Bones: Test Your Typing Speed and Spelling Skills in this Summoning Madness! 🎃👻 Get ready for the spooky challenge of  Funny Bones ! In this fast-paced Halloween themed game, your mission is to spell out the body parts of each skeleton before it fades into the underworld. Complete one skeleton, and another appears—but beware! The pace picks up with each new skeleton, challenging even the quickest fingers! 🖤💀 Modes: 📖 Story Mode: where you find the mysteries of the necromancer's school. ♾️ Infinite Mode: here you can put yourself to the challenge and compete against others to become a Summon Master. Key Features : ⚡  Fast Reflexes Needed : Each round speeds up—do you have what it takes to keep up with the skeleton swarm? 📚  Educational & Addictive : Test your anatomical knowledge and spelling skills in this brainy, fast-paced game. 🧛  Perfect for Halloween : With eerie visuals and thrilling music,  Funny Bones  plunges you into the spirit of the season. Prove who’s the ultimate speller among the undead! 🕸️👀 How to Play:  - Type the words that fall using the keyboard to summon the missing parts of the skeleton 🦴✨ Credits: Trailer Music : Hall of the Mountain King Kevin MacLeod Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 License - Remix: Red Monkey Studio. Keyboard UI :

rows.description_html: Tiny Terrors is a casual 2D action game with a top-down perspective where you control a small ghost and collect candy while avoiding the Terrors that appear in the field. rows.name: Depths Unseen
rows.short_description: Fall into the ruins of the long abandoned Mariana Corp Lab that now sits vacant just below the surface. Can you survive this unforgiving world?
rows.description_html: Deep within the depths lies The Lab, a crumbling subterranean superstructure barely held together by the rusting metal and crumbling concrete. Navigate this chapter based 2D platformer, where only the best can survive. Your goal is to make it out of this place by whatever means necessary. Solve a mix of puzzles in the world, make harrowing jumps, find hidden lore, and escape monsters beyond your comprehension. Navigating this world won't be easy, so keep your wits about, and stay alive. Can you uncover the secrets of this strangely familiar world? Within the dark depths you will encounter the long forgotten experiments that were created in The Lab, they'll hunt you, chase you, and make sure you never feel alone. Its up to you whether you try to hide, try to run, or try to fight.

rows.name: Dobro Goranku
rows.short_description: A TCG like you’ve never played before. Dobro Goranku combines fast-paced action, deep strategy, and the art of bluffing, letting you build unique decks and defeat rivals in breathtaking duels.
rows.description_html: Master a deck-building card game where strategy, power, and destiny collide. In a world where all conflict is settled by the divine game of Dobro Goranku, every card you play shapes the future. Build your deck, challenge rivals, and seize control of fate itself. A World Forged by a Card Game. When endless wars threatened to tear the world of Turiya apart, a God intervened with a single, unbreakable rule: all disputes, from the fate of empires to bitter personal rivalries, would be decided by a sacred card game—Dobro Goranku. In this new era, strategy is your weapon, and the deck is your army. Those who control the cards, control destiny itself. Your path to victory starts with strategic deck-building. You must master the six core elements— Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, and Darkness —to outwit your opponents. Each round is governed by a random element. If your card matches the active element, you secure a guaranteed victory for the turn. But if both players match—or neither do—the true test of power begins. In this scenario, victory goes to the player whose card has the higher stat linked to the round’s governing element. Evolve Your Power, Claim Your Legacy Dobro Goranku is more than just a simple battle. Your cards are a living arsenal designed to evolve. They will level up, gain new stats, and grow immensely more powerful with every duel you win. Matches are swift and decisive, concluding in just five rounds. The player who accumulates the most points doesn’t just win—they claim rewards that transcend simple victory, fueling their ongoing progression. Test your skills against an advanced AI designed to challenge you at every turn. Battle players from around the world and climb the global leaderboard to prove your strategic mastery. Evolve your cards, unlock powerful improvements, and constantly customise your deck to perfect your playstyle. Master the distinct mechanics and synergies of Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, and Darkness. Jump into quick, engaging battles that are easy to learn but offer deep strategic challenges. Dobro Goranku is the ultimate experience for: Fans of competitive TCGs and turn-based strategy games. Players who love the deep satisfaction of deck-building, climbing leaderboards, and perfecting their personal strategies. Anyone seeking a competitive game with simple, fun, and highly engaging mechanics. Dobro Goranku will be available in multiple languages, including English, Portuguese, and Spanish.

rows.name: Toy Town Mayhem
rows.short_description: In Toy Town, a toy has one goal, to be the last one standing, because the last toy is always the best toy. Play online with up to 9 other players and secure your victory!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Toy Town! In Toy Town, a toy has one goal, to be the last one standing in the shop, because the last toy standing, is always the best toy. Need to practice first? Play the Free For All mode, all the toys in Toy Town are covered by top notch insurance, so that when a toy is damaged, they'll get fixed right up and will be ready for their next battle. Done practicing and ready to be the best? Hop into the battle royale mode, where you will fight 9 other real players, to be the last toy standing! What kinds of weapons and items will help you to win in Toy Town? Toy Town has many things that will suit everybody's needs! The Rapid Rifle - Quick and Reliable Option ' Rapid Rifle, the name doesn't do it enough justice!' - Larry Supreme Shotgun - A Solid Shooter 'BLAM!! Well that's it! Finishes the job just like that!' - Also Larry The Bomb - Classic slapstick weapon 'Can't go wrong wit it!' - Cowboy Jim Fabulous Frankfurter 'Great meal after a long day.' - Skull Gang Greg More weapons are to come as Toy Town gains more residents! How about maps? Where can we fight? Good questions! Toy Town currently has 3 locations where you can compete to be the best, with more on the way! The MEGA MAP 'Totally huge!' Cheese Room 'Everything is made of CHEESE!' Floating Plains 'The first battle royale map! Islands fall overtime, don't fall with them!' More maps will come as Toy Town has more time to renovate. So what are you waiting for? Book a trip to Toy Town and enjoy the Mayhem!

rows.name: Roman Rumble
rows.short_description: WRESTLING MEETS ANCIENT GLORY! Unleash chaos in the Roman Colosseum as the crowd roars with every WHAM and SLAM!
rows.description_html: Roman Rumble is a single player, over-the-shoulder beat 'em up where you get to beat the coins out of your opponents and climb the ranks in the gladiator arena. To become a legendary roman wrestler, home-run your opponents with nothing but your fists as you’re outnumbered, but never out armed. Flex at your fans and hear them revel in your glory! Glorious Display Fill your glory meter, by damaging and taunting your enemies, to receive gifts from the crowd. These gifts will help you become an even greater warrior, giving you unique powers in the heat of battle. From Underdog to Legend The player must defeat 5 waves of enemies in a gladiator arena with inspiration from wrestling. By completing a run of the gauntlet (the 5 waves), the player will become the champion of the arena. Theatrical Combat Finesse the hit combos to launch enemies into the air! And make the crowd go wild! Our team name is E-Motion Studios. Our goal is to create a third-person action game that blends the spectacle of wrestling with the brutal drama of Roman gladiator combat.  The Team: Designers - Sebastian Poutanen, Tom Fasham, Lachlan Sharman Programmers - Hailey Graham, Peter Erbeni, Jack May Artists - Parker Laansma, Yuxuan Zhou Composer - Belita Welsh

By completing a run of the gauntlet (the 5 waves), the player will become the champion of the arena. Theatrical Combat Finesse the hit combos to launch enemies into the air! And make the crowd go wild! Our team name is E-Motion Studios. Our goal is to create a third-person action game that blends the spectacle of wrestling with the brutal drama of Roman gladiator combat.  The Team: Designers - Sebastian Poutanen, Tom Fasham, Lachlan Sharman Programmers - Hailey Graham, Peter Erbeni, Jack May Artists - Parker Laansma, Yuxuan Zhou Composer - Belita Welsh

rows.name: The Tale of Oath
rows.short_description: Uncover ancient magic in The Tale of Oath, a student-built action-adventure where you wield elemental spells, solve puzzles, and battle dark druids in a mystical, atmospheric world.
rows.description_html: The Tale of Oath is a third-person action-adventure game set in a world where ancient magic teeters on the edge of chaos. Originally developed as a student project at Carnegie Mellon University’s Entertainment Technology Center, this prototype showcases a rich narrative and magic-based gameplay wrapped in an atmospheric experience. Use this key if needed: R – Back to the last savepoint T+P + (0-3) – Jump to major game scenes Game Overview In the mystical land of Rifts England, a Citadel outsider stumbles into an unraveling world where elemental forces have gone awry and the sacred Tree of Life is destabilizing. Wielding newfound powers, the player must purify corrupted Druid altars, solve elemental puzzles, and battle the Blood Druids threatening to consume the land in darkness. As the journey unfolds, players will fight through ancient temples, rescue imprisoned Druids, and confront the Blood Druid in a climactic showdown. Every spell is designed with dual purpose—use magic not just to fight, but to unlock paths, trigger platforming mechanics, and interact meaningfully with the world. Features Single-player action-adventure gameplay with controller support Puzzle-solving through multi-use magic mechanics A branching world of temples, elemental environments, and narrative-driven quests Atmospheric soundtrack, handcrafted VFX, and immersive level design Developed in Unity 6 with the Penguin Action Toolkit About the Team The Tale of Oath was developed by Ashling Tu and Team Quessant, a passionate group of graduate students at Carnegie Mellon University for the Level Design Production project. The project was guided by instructors Ruth Comley and Ricardo Washington, with expert insight from SME Ketul Majmudar and consultant Michael Christel. Join us on this journey—experience a world of myth, magic, and discovery. Quessant Team Members: Ashling Tu, Lisa Zhang, Yuhuai Huang, Albert Guo, Xixi Huang, Tianyi Lin, Wuji Cao

rows.name: Song of Nanzhao
rows.short_description: Song of Nanzhao is a music-driven puzzle adventure set in ancient China. As a voiceless court musician, use pentatonic melodies drawn from nature to solve puzzles, uncover hidden stories, and connect with villagers, seeking peace through the power of sound.
rows.description_html: Song of Nanzhao is a music-driven puzzle game inspired by traditional Chinese folk music, particularly the Nanzhao Fengsheng music. This vertical slice presents the first chapter of the game. In the year 798 AD, war swept across the land. The Tang Dynasty launched massive conscription campaigns, leaving border kingdoms in turmoil. For years, the Nanzhao Kingdom clashed with the Tang in endless conflict. Born into this chaos, you are a court musician—silent by birth, but never voiceless. With music as your only bridge to the world, you must carry the hope of a nation longing for peace. Wander through an ancient Chinese village during a time of war. Meet villagers shaped by hardship, uncover their personal stories, and build trust through empathy and kindness. Use music to interact with people and the world around you. Every object has its own sound. Listen closely, and you’ll hear melodies hidden in the world. Learn and record these melodies using a pentatonic system based on the five elements. Each note is a tool—helping you speak, unlock secrets, and gather key items. Use your music to solve puzzles, unlock forgotten memories, and progress through the story. Whether you're delivering the right tune to a villager or playing a melody to open sealed paths, every note you play brings you one step closer to understanding the past—and shaping what’s to come. As the musician of Nanzhao, your melodies carry more than sound—they carry meaning, memory, and hope. In a world scarred by war, can music offer a path to peace?

rows.name: The Crawling Dead
rows.short_description: Design, deploy, and manage the release of parasitic wasps to save a national park from invasive insect pests. Harness the power of nature’s most efficient killers to strike back at the invaders and turn them into The Crawling Dead!
rows.description_html: The Crawling Dead is a strategy simulation game where you take on the role of a lead scientist tasked with saving Stormveil National Park from ecological collapse. Swarms of invasive insects are devastating the park’s delicate ecosystems, and traditional methods of pest control have failed. Your solution? Genetically engineered parasitoid wasps. Harmless to humans, these beneficial wasps are killers of pest insects and utilize a variety of creepy strategies to manipulate and kill their hosts - turning them into The Crawling Dead! Design and deploy a variety of specialized wasps to target different invasive species, adapting to changing seasons, terrain types, and resistance patterns. From alpine meadows to desert canyons, each biome presents unique challenges and different pest insects that require careful planning and scientific precision. Create the most efficient and effective parasitoid wasps to save the national park and restore ecological harmony. Balance science, speed, and strategy as you guide the park’s recovery from spring through the first snowfall of winter. Every wasp release counts. Every adaptation matters. And if your wasps fail, the invasive wave of pest insects will damage the ecosystem for good. Will your engineered wasps be enough to turn the tide? FEATURES A fun, interactive main game mode Design Lab with a trait tree and customizable wasps Six unique minigames Three difficulty levels Eighteen achievements Weather hazards Adaptive news feed Many possible strategies In-depth statistic tracking Original art and soundtrack Educational elements for learning about parasitic wasps

rows.name: Monster Girl Manor
rows.short_description: Welcome to the MONSTER GIRL MANOR! Tour around to find your way to meet the characters created by Dream Audio VA, Lacey Audayo, Method Switch, Startlit Audios and Xena Alexander. Find out which girls are your vibe and find out more of their lore!
rows.description_html: Welcome to THE MONSTER GIRL MANOR!!! Take a step into the Monster Girl Manor, a visual novel where you have the chance to meet the monster girls created by a creative team of VAs: Method Switch Dream Audio VA Startlit Audio Xena Alexander Lacey Audayo (coming soon!) This game currently features an introduction to one of four unique characters, each one created and voiced by one of our VA team members and featuring VTube models that you may or may not have seen live streaming! Currently, each character has a brief but fully voiced introduction scene lasting about 10 minutes. These scenes are linear and very narrow in scope. However, as the game develops, it will be expanded to include date nights and relationship progressions that are often seen in visual novels and dating sims. Please note that this game will be 100% FREE! It is not intended to make profit but instead to navigate several different popular characters from the catalog of our VA cast.

rows.name: Apoclone
rows.short_description: Apoclone is a post-apocalyptic idle strategy RPG where you command a squad of clone warriors and unleash powerful mechs in turn-based combat. Strategize your formation, conquer enemies in PvE and PvP, and thrive in a ruined world—even while offline.
rows.description_html: Apoclone is a post-apocalyptic idle strategy RPG that combines hero collection, tactical mech combat, and a deep formation system. As a Commander in a ruined world dominated by rogue science, you’ll lead a clone army against mutant forces and twisted warlords. Recruit and upgrade clone heroes from rival factions, each with unique skills and elemental powers. Unleash mighty Titans to shift the tide of battle in strategic, turn-based combat. From PvE dungeons and tower challenges to global PvP arenas, every fight tests your strategy and team synergy. Apoclone also features an idle system that lets you collect rewards while offline, making progression smooth and satisfying for all types of players. Customize your lineup, optimize your gear, and dive into the lore of a world ravaged by cloning experiments gone wrong. Whether you're a tactical mastermind or a casual player, Apoclone offers intense strategy, striking visuals, and endless battles to explore—all from the comfort of your browser.

rows.name: War of Dots
rows.short_description: Easy to learn, hard to master. A simple & free RTS game.
rows.description_html: Overview War of Dots is a minimalist real-time strategy game. Command your armies in real-time battles across a variety of maps. Capture cities, manage resources, and defeat your rivals. Game Details The key idea in War of Dots is simplicity. Unlike most other strategy games, it doesn’t rely on complex mechanics. There are only two types of units: light – perfect for fighting in numbers, effective in most terrains, and cheaper to produce; and heavy – slower and less maneuverable, effective only in clear terrain, but with high damage and health, making them ideal for breakthroughs and impenetrable defenses. The economy is just as simple. Cities produce new units and supply existing ones. Each city supports up to five units; if there are more, the excess units will starve. By capturing cities, you gain an economic advantage over your opponent. That’s all you need to know! Download the game and prove your place in history alongside legends like Napoleon and Alexander the Great. Key Features Real-Time Tactical Combat: Command your armies, manage resources, and strike at the perfect moment. Fast-Paced Multiplayer: Jump into solo or team-based matches with other players online. Minimalist Interface: Clean visuals focus on clarity, showing only what you need to make strategic decisions. Multiple Game Modes: Includes ranked PvP, casual matches, and custom map creation. Instant Replay: Review matches with full replays showing both your moves and your opponent’s. Simple to Learn, Hard to Master: Easy for new players to pick up, with deep tactical mechanics that reward skill and planning. Why You’ll Love It War of Dots captures the thrill of classic RTS gameplay in a fresh, abstract package. With short match durations, smart mechanics, and competitive depth, it’s both accessible and endlessly engaging—perfect for players who crave strategic challenge in quick, action-packed sessions. Check out for more info:

rows.name: Haunting Invitation
rows.short_description: You have been invited, but not by your own will, rescue your best friend before HE finds you... Delve into this first-person single-player puzzle game and experience horror segments mixed with challenging gameplay!
rows.description_html: You have been invited, but not by your own will, rescue your best friend before HE finds you... Your surroundings are deceptive, and mysterious forces have transformed your physical being to that of a doll!     Be wary of The Host, for he is unwilling to allow you to escape his domain so easily. Overcome him and all difficulties that await your path as find your way out of this treacherous mansion. Be wary, as underestimating him will quickly put an end to your journey.    Haunting Invitation is a 3D first-person single-player puzzle video game that features minor platforming sections as well as a combination of horror elements and challenging gameplay situations. Be prepared for a dark, tense atmospheres as well as a semi-realistic graphical style.  Can you solve this nightmare and escape with you and your friend’s lives?  Key Features   Stealth can be expected within certain areas; you must carefully consider your approach in various rooms and use the environment to your advantage.   Exploring the manor will be a difficult task; use what’s available in your surroundings to overcome various puzzles and challenges, exploration and memory of essential information is critical.    Tools such as the flashlight will be crucial in navigating what may lay ahead. Aim to use items you may encounter wisely so that you don’t find yourself in danger too often.  Mature Content Description   The developers describe the game like this:  Content is generally suitable for ages 13 and up. May be appropriate for viewing at work; game does not feature extreme violence or gore.

rows.name: Fishing Relax
rows.short_description: 🏝️ A tropical fantasy fishing RPG. 🐠 Reel in rare fish and story-rich treasures from different universes. 🐉 Help a dragon whelp to transform into a fully grown dragon. 🏆 And compare your collection with your friends!
rows.description_html: 🏖️ Escape to a paradisiacal island Imagine casting your line into crystal-clear waters, enjoying the sun as you relax fishing. But this isn't just any fishing trip – it's an unforgettable adventure! After being separated from your soulmate by some mysterious purple light, you become friends with Fongfan, a dragon whelp. Explore the world, complete quests and unlock achievements! Help Fongfan to transform into an adult dragon and unravel the mystery of the purple lights. Reel in rare fish and story-rich treasures, and compare your collection with your friends! Play without an account, or sign in to save your progress across all your devices. Just the game to relax and live a memorable adventure. 🕹️ Easy to play Click on a fish to begin fishing. Hold the reel to fish faster. 🏆 Fish them all! Collect more than 90 treasures that have been teleported to your planet by the mysterious purple lights. 🎒 Visit your friend's inventory Compare your collection with your friends! 🐉 Help a dragon Help a dragon whelp transform into a fully grown dragon by completing quests. 🐟 Fish activity surge Fish more and faster during the first five minutes of every hour. ✨ Collector effect The more treasures you collect, the more frequently rarer ones will show up. 🎮 Early access I am working on new game content. Visuals have been created with the use of AI. I would love to work with an artist, but I don't have the budget yet.

rows.name: Typing Fireworks
rows.short_description: Typing Fireworks is a casual game where your fingers run across the keyboard to set off fireworks! You can only move to adjacent keys, escape the danger zone before the fuse burns out, and look up to enjoy the dazzling display when the fireworks bloom!
rows.description_html: Typing Fireworks（指尖烟花） MOVE! CROUCH! BOOM! Only move to adjacent keys. Moving over keys will make you trip and fall! Press and hold your current key to crouch and light the fuse. Crucial! After igniting the fuse, make sure to escape the danger zone before it explodes! Watch the Fireworks! When fireworks light up the sky, press and hold the SPACE to look up and enjoy the show. Pro Tip: You'll earn bonus points for watching! Watch your step! Random tiles will break! Stepping on them will make you trip, fall, and lose points! Plan your path! The aim is higher scores!

rows.name: 空王座 Empty Throne
rows.short_description: Empty Throne is a dark fairytale puzzle game. Compose the Snow Queen’s tale in music. Truth twists through alley whispers and forest echoes. The throne lies empty. The mirror speaks. Who writes the ending—you, or the lie?
rows.description_html: Contact Discord:  About the Game Story I was once merely a composer, commissioned by the royal court to score the 'tale' of the Snow Queen. Yet this manuscript appears to exist in multiple iterations. Some versions echo through city streets, while others lie buried beneath forest loam. She claims it to be her autobiography. The magic mirror, however, insists these are merely the chapters she wishes you to remember. I compose melodies. I unravel mysteries. Key Features Distinctive Visual Aesthetic - A unique art style blending pixel art with fantasy elements, crafting an atmospheric dark fairy tale world Ensemble Narrative Design - Multiple interconnected storylines woven together through diverse, compelling characters with distinct personalities Immersive Musical Gameplay - Dynamic music game sequences that heighten narrative tension and deliver emotional crescendos Original Soundtrack - Meticulously composed music tailored specifically for the game experience Interactive Fiction Elements Scene-based interactive puzzles Use the mirror to uncover the truth Rhythm Game Integration Development Team huxx - Game Design & Programming 'Dual-discipline developer specializing in design and technical implementation' 沐风沐 - Game Design 'Wielding the mystical ability to challenge programmers and stress artists to their creative limits' 骷髅男 - Game Design & Art 'Visual artist pushing creative boundaries' 楚狈良 - Game Design & Art 'Design-focused artist bridging creative vision and visual execution' S.W.Diversity Studio (Music Team) Developer's Note Thank you for your interest in Empty Throne . Empty Throne Studio represents an independent development collective comprised of university students who have dedicated their passion and spare time to game creation. Through perseverance and shared vision, we have brought our inaugural project to fruition. Empty Throne marks our debut formal release. While we acknowledge areas for improvement, this project embodies our complete creative dedication and technical commitment. We take pride in presenting our first fully-realized interactive experience. This journey represents both an ambitious creative undertaking and a collaborative adventure shared between developers and players. We invite you to explore this world we've crafted and hope Empty Throne delivers a memorable, atmospheric, and emotionally resonant gaming experience. Thank you for joining us on this narrative adventure.

Use your wits and bravery to strengthen the shelters and save more humans. Recruit powerful heroes to help you explore the post-apocalyptic world and find strong survivors to form a defense alliance. In the game you can experience simulation construction, map exploration, material collection, army recruitment, destroy zombie lords and other gameplay. Strengthen your shelter, build an invincible army and become a hero of the end of the world to shelter humanity.

rows.name: SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN
rows.short_description: Wacky rhythm action meets roguelike randomness! Every clash shuffles in new buffs and trolls, causing crazy rhythm chaos! Face off in 2-player local PvP and groove to a funky soundtrack with 10 original tracks designed to get you jamming and slamming (your controller!)
rows.description_html: Get ready to rumble on the dancefloor! SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN  catapults you into frantic, head-to-head rhythm battles - no holds barred flamboyant theatrics. Hit each beat on time to boost your popularity and charge your special meter, but miss a step and you'll stumble and lose your mojo. Rig the odds with crazy accessories! After every showdown, choose from a random selection of nearly 50 unique accessories. Will you choose to supercharge your moves or unleash clever tricks to troll your rival? Each run shuffles the stakes, with different tracks and builds to play - turning each and every match into a brand-new dance spectacle. It's a roguelite remix of rhythm that keeps you on your toes! Two rival dancers, endless competition! Face off locally against a friend as rival dancers hungry for stardom. Shuffle Showdown is designed to be played as couch PvP, so whether you're nailing combos or sabotaging your opponent you can be sure to expect taunts, reversals and one-upmanship as you out-dance, out-play and out-shuffle your opponent! Groove to an original funky soundtrack! The 100% original score pumps adrenaline through every face-off. Each track is engineered to sync with the rhythm and your moves, so feel the beat and let the music fuel your next show-stealing combo. Infinite remix-ability! With randomised accessories and tracks, every showdown hits differently. Master the meta and discover new synergies to keep the dancefloor unpredictable - then jump straight back in and shake  shuffle things up all over again! About the team SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN  is developed by Team Roland, and was born out of a university project gone much, much too far. We wanted to take our passion for creating games that make players feel excited (and occasionally crash out on their friends) and share it for free with anyone who might find it on Steam. Please forgive us if there are any bugs; as this is our first time shipping a game, SHUFFLE SHOWDOWN may have some technical issues we are unaware of. Many times the fix is as simple as restarting the game - sorry for the inconvenience. Thank you so much for playing and we hope you have fun!

rows.name: PolyLumina
rows.short_description: A colorful rhythm simulation game where you compose polyrhythmic chord progressions and watch them come alive through glowing, reactive visuals.
rows.description_html: Polylumina is a musical simulation and visual sequencer: craft polyrhythmic chord progressions, watch each note pulse and bloom in vibrant patterns, and shape your own luminous symphony. Create custom chord progressions effortlessly-any progression, any key! Tweak visualizers in real time with intuitive controls. Rotate, move and freely explore every pattern.

rows.name: Beat of Rebellion
rows.short_description: Be the voice out of the choir! Beat of Rebellion is an isometric rhythm-based Hack & Slash. Follow the Beat, create your own Melodies and unleash devastating combos to fight against a totalitarian regime in a cyberpunk city.
rows.description_html: Let the Rhythm guide you In Beat of Rebellion , you'll take the role of the Pulsedrifter , a young rebel who struggles to survive in a bleak future. Inside the cyberpunk metropolis of New Nexus , all forms of art are banned, artists are persecuted, and progress has suffocated the soul of humanity. Music is your ally, and the Beat is your weapon. Fight to bring back voice, color, and rhythm to a city cast into silence. Beat your enemies with Melodies Beat of Rebellion blends a rhythmic game with the intensity of an isometric Hack & Slash . Each battle unfolds in arenas where music dictates timing: the closer you time your actions to the Beat , the stronger you become! At the core of the combat system are Melodies : customizable combos where you assign the inputs, creating your own unique and rhythmicfighting style. Discover the Cyberpunk city of New Nexus Journey through the Underbelly of New Nexus : three levels , each with its own environment and increasing BPM . Explore the Underbelly of New Nexus , overcome traps, hack gates, and dash over gaps while following the Beat . Follow the rhythm and dive into the city to meet its inhabitants and uncover its secrets.

rows.name: Letherfall
rows.short_description: Letherfall is a first-person horror video game with Lovecraftian elements: the player must make their way through monstrous entities and intricate puzzles while exploring the abandoned village of Letherfall. Some nightmares don’t fade. They’re just waiting for you to open the wrong door.
rows.description_html: Letherfall, June 27, 1998. A child is found on the shores of a lake. His eyes wide with terror, his body frozen with fear and cold. Not far from him, dozens of lifeless bodies: Dylan is the only survivor. The police investigate, secret services intervene, but it’s all in vain — the truth lies buried with the corpses and within the twisted corners of young Dylan’s mind. Manhattan, 2018 Dylan still remembers nothing of that tragic night, but terrible nightmares begin to consume his mind. Relentless. Violent. A voice haunts him in his sleep. Just one sentence, repeated over and over: 'Come back to Letherfall.' It sounds like his sister Janie — whose body was the only one never found. Driven by a dark impulse and the guidance of his therapist, Dylan returns to the now-abandoned village. Letherfall is rotten, decayed, silent… but it is not empty. Something is there. Something watching. Something that remembers. Explore a disturbing and decaying environment, through distorted memories, inhuman presences, and unspeakable horrors. Survive, uncover the truth — or lose your mind trying. Letherfall is waiting for you. And this time… no one gets out.

rows.name: FoE Remains
rows.short_description: Remains is a hardcore mix of platformer, 2D-shooter and roguelike with RPG elements. Travel around a post-apocalyptic world and explore its various corners, communicate with locals and help them, level up and fight enemies using a vast arsenal of weapons and magic.
rows.description_html: REMAINS is a mix of genres with its core as a platformer: side view, familiar game mechanics (jumping, climbing stairs). A rich arsenal of weapons plus fights being a crucial part of the game give you vibes of 2D-shooter. Finally, you can take it as a roguelike game with exploring procedurally generated locations, picking locks, gathering loot, leveling up and learning new skills/perks, crafting, trading, etc. The amount of content right now is huge: several large locations with numerous kinds of rooms, almost a hundred types of enemies, about two hundred types of weapons and explosives, dozens of spells, more than sixty perks and plenty of other things. The development is complete, but new versions may appear in the future. Extra content Reforged - A mod that changes many aspects of the game and fixes bugs, made by Kostr184. Extra bunker Rooms - a mod that adds new rooms in military base locations, made by convetangent.

rows.name: Yuki「清醒梦」
rows.short_description: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.
rows.description_html: Yuki is a narrative horror adventure set in a remote, abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. A story shaped by memory, regret, and choice Words matter. Every conversation and discovery changes how the story unfolds. Three possible endings — each one reflecting your values and decisions. Face the past in fast-paced combat Confront lingering spirits in bullet hell encounters. Fast breakbeats and frenetic rhythms set the pace for intense battles. Unravel the mystery Explore the remains of a closed campus. Piece together the truth through an online chatroom, strange sightings, and whispered regrets. The only demons here are the memories we carry — and the ones we leave behind. An online chatroom filled with rumors. Mysterious sightings no one can explain. A campus abandoned, its classrooms frozen in time. And at the heart of it all — your best friend, missing without a trace. What happened that night before the school closed down? What secrets are still buried in its halls? Move freely through a fully 3D-modeled environment. Interact with characters, examine objects, and solve puzzles to gather clues — each step bringing you closer to the truth. The only demons here are not monsters of flesh and blood, but the echoes of regret left behind. They linger in empty classrooms, drift through silent hallways, and whisper from forgotten corners of the school long after its doors were shut. Each spirit you encounter is bound by unfinished stories, memories that refuse to fade, and choices that can no longer be undone. To move forward, you’ll have to face not just their regrets — but your own.  Words matter. But words alone won’t save you. Confront the lingering spirits, face their relentless attacks in fast-paced bullet hell encounters, and adapt to each situation under pressure. The knowledge you’ve gathered from exploring the campus isn’t just for solving puzzles — it’s your weapon. Piece together what you’ve learned, choose your words wisely, and turn memory itself into your advantage.

rows.name: Gravitrix
rows.short_description: Gravitrix is an extreme-pogo-sticking 3D sports-platformer dressed in a comic-book art style meant for misfits and rebels looking to unleash their inner pogo spirit in a chaotic, high-flying world full of stunts.
rows.description_html: You play as Bucky, styling your way through the alleys and spaces of a very small Pogotown exploring different tricks on your pogostick. Break the boundaries of movement and experience the freedom against the pull of gravity. Collect different costumes and items from the environment. Show you moves in the performance arena. You decide the moves. You make the path. Go Pogo! Gravitrix follows a futuristic comic-book shaded art style to capture the vibrance of the beautiful colors in the game world showcasing the rich, obstacle-filled world of extreme pogosticking. The neon signs, popping visual effects and the bucket-head character are aimed to invoke the spirit of rebelliousness and creativity in your gameplay. Collect coins, props and costumes from the environment. How many tricks can you combine? Can you flip off an edge into a grind? Can you recreate some real pogo tricks? Hop on to the pogo performance arena to show off your style. But remember to rush your bucket-home before it is too late!! Enjoy an intuitive and responsive control system that gives you complete freedom over every movement. It is easy to learn, but challenging to truly master. Gravtrix includes the following gameplay features: Pogo stick jumping mechanic Boost feature that the player can control (based on timing) to jump higher 8 Classic Pogo tricks(inspired from real pogo tricks) 4 advanced tricks (inspired from real pogo tricks but infused with break dance moves) A grind mechanic which lets players grind in a skateboard like fashion using their pogostick on edges and wires Wall bounce mechanic A rocket jump which adds a thrust to the pogo taking it to a ridiculous height A tutorial level, a story-mode level with scripted events and a free-roam mode Gravitrix was created as a semester project by master’s students at the Entertainment Technology Center at Carnegie Mellon University. The game was developed in collaboration with and under the guidance of Xpogo - a company of highly talented individuals who perform real life pogo stunts professionally! The game is a semi-finished version which will possibly get more features and updates in the future.

rows.name: Taina's Cursed Legacy
rows.short_description: A text-based RPG with a nonlinear story set in a free Slavic fantasy world. Shape the heroine's character through your choices and unlock multiple endings. Mystery, folklore, and relationships — your fate depends only on you.
rows.description_html: Fate casts its dice—and I see. I see that you'll take on the role of a girl. Hair like fire, born in a black hut near the graveyard. It's no easy role, and your choices are many: will you be kind and gentle, or wild and willful? Will you serve others, or seek only your own gain? Or maybe you’ll walk a third path… Time will tell. Your fate is yours alone. It depends on you—and your strength. ---- A text-based RPG set in a free-form Slavic fantasy world Unlimited freedom of choice – Every decision shapes the story, creating a unique experience Multiple endings – Unlock different outcomes based on your actions An intriguing story – A tale that changes and deepens with each choice

rows.short_description: POLYARD is a fast-paced co-op shooter where you and your friends battle dangerous infected, tactically clearing the area. After the mission, you must quickly evacuate by transport to survive.
rows.description_html: Polyard is a dynamic low poly shooter where survival turns into a profitable business. Fend off hordes of zombies, collect resources, exchange them for money and open new arenas to earn even more. The further you go, the more dangerous your opponents become... and the higher the reward.

rows.name: Astral : Steam Edition
rows.short_description: A sandbox about freedom and creativity. Leave your body through astral projection, drive cars, and explore unique maps across different game modes like Sandbox, Free Drive, and Free Build.
rows.description_html: Astral: Steam Edition is a sandbox about exploration and freedom. Its central mechanic is astral projection: leaving your body to explore the world from a new perspective and interact with what’s around you. The game includes three ways to play: Sandbox – Open-world freeplay with money and shops. Free Build – Unlimited items and full creative freedom. Drive – Focused on vehicles, with cars spawning at the Boot and Rusty Nail shop. Vehicles can be bought with in-game currency or spawned freely in Free Build. Shops exist as part of the pause menu, with more systems to come in future updates. Three maps are currently available: Islands, Crazy Road, and Flatland. This game was created by a single developer named Daniel, with the help of tools like Universal Vehicle Controller by Perfect Games. Astral will keep expanding as I continue to learn and improve. Your support means a lot.

rows.short_description: Overcome dangerous specters that now risk corrupting your device upon instillation. Specter Inspector is a training simulator that operates as pop up windows on YOUR desktop.
rows.description_html: Specter Inspector is a training simulator that operates as pop up windows on YOUR desktop. Specter Inspector teaches YOU how to overcome dangerous specters that now risk corrupting your device upon instillation. Three modules of training teach you to control the paranormal inspector known as Bobert, utilize your EMF device to detect and evade specters, use your battery powered EMP device to stun and surpass specters, all while navigating an increasingly dangerous graveyard. Can you conquer each module? Or will your device succumb to corruption? Three modules of content to discover: utilize different inspector tools and specter evasion techniques to overcome the graveyard! Definitely no ethereal spirits or wayward specters that take possession of your device upon instillation. rows.name: Furry College
rows.short_description: A playful, cheeky visual novel about ambition, fame, and feline charm. Flirt your way through college life and social media drama — every post, every choice, every scandal counts!
rows.description_html: 🐾 About This Game Furry College is a sparkling, satirical adult visual novel that follows the chaotic rise of a young cat girl chasing the dream of fame and glamour. Her goal? Become the next big thing on Instacat , the hottest social network in the feline world! Between embarrassing misunderstandings, spicy rumors, and unforgettable encounters, our ambitious (and occasionally clumsy) heroine will navigate the ups and downs of college life — one selfie at a time. Will she become a viral sensation… or just another meme? ✨ Features Make your choices, shape her destiny. Every decision affects the protagonist’s popularity, reputation, and relationships — from harmless flirtations to full-blown scandals. Meet a colorful cast of characters. From overly confident cheerleaders to eccentric professors and jealous rivals — each encounter hides opportunities (and potential disasters). Explore the campus like never before. Discover classrooms, dorms, and secret corners of Pinecreek College as you unlock alternative scenes and exclusive storylines. Comedy, charm, and chaos. A brilliant mix of humor, adventure, and cheeky moments that poke fun at influencer culture and college clichés — with a feline twist. Multiple routes and endings. Build your own version of the story — from innocent to wildly provocative — depending on how daring you want to be. 😸 Why You’ll Love It If you enjoy lighthearted adult stories with witty dialogue, sassy characters, and a dash of social satire, Furry College will make you purr with laughter. It’s Legally Blonde meets Animal House — with fur, flair, and fabulous filters. 🐱 Meet the Cast At Pinecreek College, no day is ever ordinary — and no cat keeps their fur clean for long! Here are some of the unforgettable personalities that will cross your path: 🐾 Mittens – The Dreamer (You can customize her name) Our ambitious but hopelessly clumsy protagonist. Armed with charm, curiosity, and questionable judgment, she’s determined to become an Instacat star — even if that means surviving embarrassing auditions, viral fails, and chaotic roommates. 🎀 Debbie – The Best Friend... or Frenemy? Sweet, loyal, and a little too curious about Mittens’s “career choices.” Debbie tries to help, but her advice often leads to the exact opposite of what she intends — with hilarious and sometimes revealing consequences. 💅 Alison & Lara – The Influencer Queens The reigning divas of Instacat, always posing, posting, and plotting. They’re glamorous, sarcastic, and terrifyingly good at destroying reputations with a single story. Getting on their good side might be the biggest challenge on campus. 🦊 Juno – The Schemer Smart, sharp-tongued, and impossible to read. She knows everyone’s secrets — including Mittens’s — and loves to push others out of their comfort zone. Whether she’s a rival or a twisted ally depends entirely on you. 👩‍🍳 Roxie – The Wildcard A chaotic coworker from the campus café with an unpredictable temper and a strange fascination for Mittens’s misfortunes. Half troublemaker, half romantic interest — all entertainment. 🐯 Agatha & 🐶 Harrison – The Landlords from Another Era Agatha runs the household with an iron paw and an obsession for discipline, while her meek husband Harrison just tries to stay out of the way. Living with them is part sitcom, part social experiment. Together, they form a gallery of absurd, funny, and surprisingly relatable characters — each capable of making Mittens’s life a little more complicated... or unforgettable.

rows.name: FALL
rows.short_description: 'FALL' is a small-scale visual novel game. Players will take on the role of 'Lane', a girl in Celeste. After encountering members of a mysterious organization , she will go to investigate a series of mysterious events. Depending on the player's choice, the game will lead to two different endings.
rows.description_html: Game Introduction Lane, a carefree girl living in the Mangrove City of Celeste, went on a trip with her friends as usual during the summer vacation. However, she met a black-clad man who claimed to be looking for the Omega seal and a woman called 'Cardinal'. In the pursuit of the truth, what kind of sparks will be ignited between them, and what will Lane do? Everything is up to you to decide. . . Story background The story of 'FALL' takes place in a fictional world called 'Vision Land'. The world of 'Vision Land' was once very similar to our real world until the discovery of Ether energy led to the outbreak of war. After the war, a political pattern that lasted for a hundred years emerged. It seems that there is a mysterious hand keeping the world unchanged, forcibly stopping time. Character Introduction Lane The girl living in Mangrove, a port city in Celeste, has led a carefree life since childhood. Perhaps because her past life was carefree, stable and peaceful, she developed a calm personality, without desires or attachments. However, fate will push her down a perilous path. Zemots Lane's classmate, a young man who once developed feelings for her. Born with a melancholic personality, they often appear listless. Amber Lane's classmate, a hot-tempered and energetic girl, is lively but a bit hard to get along with. Kresodore Lane's classmate is a very influential figure in the school. Coming from a wealthy family, he has a domineering personality and attaches great importance to the concept of hierarchy. He likes to divide people into different classes and strives to become the 'upper class' in his mind. Such a personality makes him pursue what doesn't belong to him. Lambda Senior officials of the mysterious organization seem to use Lambda as their code name. This time I came to Mangrove City to recruit candidates for the 'Omega of Cardinals'. Alpha The leader of the mysterious organization. Gameplay The total text volume is 50,000 words, divided into the prologue, Chapter One, Chapter Two and Chapter Three. There are two different endings. Players will make a choice at a key node and it will affect the direction of the ending. In addition to the main storyline, there will also be very detailed explanations of various Settings in the visual field. It does not include a favorability system. Except for the protagonist Lane, the plots of the others are fixed. rows.name: Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero
rows.short_description: To save the people of his village, He enters the Hammashan castle from which no one returns alive. But he sparks a war for the power of a civilization which the world believed has been annihilated.
rows.description_html: Content Creation & Streaming Policy We grant permission for individuals to record, stream, and monetize gameplay footage of 'Last Hammashan' on platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Facebook Gaming, and similar services. Last Hammashan is being developed by a solo programmer and on Zero budget. To save the people of his village, He enters the Hammashan castle from which no one returns alive. But he sparks a war for the power of a civilization which the world believed has been annihilated. To force Gideon into entering the Hammashan castle to retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Astrolabe, Greystone takes the people of his village hostages. The Astrolabe was left behind in the castle by the Hammashan civilization. It is the key to their ancient knowledge. When Gideon touches the Astrolabe, it activates and shows him a place unfamiliar to him. He hears a voice calling out: 'Come home Adam!' Gideon discovers that his real name is Adam and that he is the last Hammashan. An entity at the site awakens his Hammashan blood which alerts the tyrant Sevarog who calls upon his generals and orders killing Adam. What is different? Whenever Adam (Gideon) defeats any of Sevarog’s 12 generals, he reclaims the Hammashan powers from them and then he wields it, as well as the fighting style, as his own. Every win means new abilities and a new fighting style. Adam doesn't die, the lesser health he has, the more vulnerable he is. example: when his health is low, even small hits make him kneel for a long time. Example from the gameplay video: In the boss fight video, Adam has already defeated Twinblast and so he reclaimed the Hammashan powers from him and he can wield it as his own. When transformed, Adam moves and fights exactly like Twinblast. That is, he doesn’t just reclaim weapons and powers, he reclaims the fighting style. Adam can also instantly switch between his original powers and transformed powers. At the end of the video, Greystone tries to use his ultimate attack at the same moment Adam reclaims the Hammashan power from him which leaves Greystone frozen as a statue. Adam reclaims the Hammashan sword fighting style and wields it as his own. He uses it to finish Greystone saying to him: grey stone, what a befitting end.

rows.name: Echoes of Seasons
rows.short_description: In order to restore the fertility of your town's land, play the role of a reckless young man who, with Demeter's blessing, can change the seasons. Put your observation and logic skills to good use in this single-player 3D puzzle game!
rows.description_html: In order to restore the fertility of your town's land, play the role of Nikolos, a reckless young man who, with the blessing of the goddess Demeter , can change the seasons . Put your observation and logic skills to good use in this single-player 3D puzzle game ! Gather offerings from the various scenery so that Demeter can help you find your way, collect scrolls that hold mysterious secrets and find a way out of complex situations ! A variety of challenges await you, from pressure plates to pendulum swings, you'll need to solve multiple mechanisms to progress! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This game is the result of a final year project , now available on Steam! We hope you will enjoy it — have fun, and don't hesitate to share your feedback with us!

rows.name: Arctic Digger TCG Collection Prologue
rows.short_description: This limited version offers a taste of the full game. A cozy simulation sneak peek where you start digging through the arctic to discover ores and trading card packs. Try out early item production, basic upgrades, and meet your first penguin helpers. More features will come in the full version!
rows.description_html: Dig Deep Start digging through thick layers of snow in the arctic wilderness. The deeper you go, the more valuable ores and hidden trading card packs you’ll uncover. Upgrade your gear and keep digging, who knows what treasures are buried below? Produce New Products & Sell Turn the resources you find underground into useful items. Merge them in your crafting machine to create better, more valuable products. Sell what you make and keep expanding your snowy workshop. Complete Trading Card Collection or Sell them to earn money As you dig deeper, you’ll uncover hidden trading card packs buried in the snow. Open them to find unique cards and grow your collection. Each pack holds surprises, common cards, rare ones, and even shiny collectibles. Complete full sets to show off your collection. Some special feature cards also give powerful boosts to help you dig faster, craft better, or earn more. Sell Products & Expand Your Area Sell the items you craft to passing penguin customers arriving by boat. Use your profits to upgrade machines, unlock new zones, and expand your snowy base. The bigger your operation, the more fun and chaos you’ll manage!

rows.name: Catch Sunlight Museum
rows.short_description: High-class virtual museum where every piece of art is given the space and respect it deserves.
rows.description_html: Our mission is to elevate digital art by providing a beautifully curated, high-class virtual museum where every piece is given the space and respect it deserves. We showcase art from around the world in immersive, thoughtfully designed environments—free to explore and free to submit. In a digital world where artwork is often lost in endless feeds, we offer a dedicated space where each artist’s voice can stand out and be truly seen. We plan to add new curated exhibits regularly.  If you’re a digital artist—whether you create images, 3D objects, music, VFX , or other digital formats—we invite you to be part of this immersive, high-class platform designed to make art stand out, not get lost in a feed. Please Submit your art on our Catch Sunlight Museum Website.  We welcome creativity in many forms—but please note that we reserve the right to curate and display submissions as we see best for the overall experience.
