rows.name: FIGHT LIKE HELL
rows.short_description: FIGHT LIKE HELL is a fast-paced FPS where relentless gunplay, fast weapon switching, and good strategy turn every fight into pure (un)controlled chaos. You are the Destroyer, a human soldier now wielding Hell’s abandoned technology after the Devil's defeat in Hell.
rows.description_html: Introduction Hell has been destroyed, but a new Hell awaits, and what's left behind is far worse than any Slayer or evil of biblical proportions. Enter arenas with aggressive and unforgiving combat which encourage constant motion and pressure. Set up deadly weapon switching combos for maximum damage per second, use your lighthook to quickly move around the map, or deploy stealth to escape a brush with death. Note: FIGHT LIKE HELL contains only comical violence and contains no blood, gore or offensive graphical depictions of any kind. Current Features Public Matchmaking Random matchmaking against new or unknown players. Private Matchmaking Private matchmaking against your friends and their friends with a simple Lobby Code. Dedicated Backend FIGHT LIKE HELL has a dedicated back-end where players queue for games. Players log in to Steam but all matches are played on dedicated servers (for both public and private matches).  At the moment all FIGHT HELL HELL matches are hosted in the Europe region. As development continues more servers and regions will be made available. 1 vs 1 Multiplayer Mode Engage in glorious one on one combat against the community or your friends. 2 x Weapons Crush your enemies with simple but deadly accuracy -- or -- set up fast weapon switching combo's for maximum damage per second. 2 x Player Equipment Use your Lighthook to grapple around the map quickly or use your Stealth to gain a tactical advantage over an aggressive enemy. Community Join the FIGHT LIKE HELL Discord Server to stay on top of the latest development progress, get early previews of future content, interact with the developer, report bugs and join the ranks of those who fight like hell! From The Developer Thank you for your early support of the game! The current state of the game leaves a lot to be desired and improvements are being made every week. I invite you to learn more about the game, contribute ideas, provide feedback or even contribute to the game through the FIGHT LIKE HELL Discord Server. Special Thanks A special thank you to the following bands, teams and developers who helped FIGHT LIKE HELL become a reality: LEGION OF THE DAMNED TransIP (Team Blue) Archanor Octamodius Team Suriyun Team Firesplash Entertainment Team Kronnect Team Michsky ChocDino

rows.short_description: I want to play that puzzle—where you look at the numbers on the left and top and fill in the intersecting squares—forever! In a rainy café, you can quietly and endlessly immerse yourself in solving puzzles.
rows.description_html: I want to play that puzzle —where you look at the numbers on the left and top and fill in the intersecting squares—forever! rows.name: Idle Pixel Fantasy
rows.short_description: Recruit hard-working helpers and magical creatures that automatically collect gold and crystals. Unlock new levels, invest in stronger units, and work your way up to the powerful dragon boss at the top. A relaxing pixel-style idle clicker!
rows.description_html: 🪙 Get Rich, One Layer at a Time! Idle Pixel Fantasy is a relaxing and addictive idle clicker in pixel style. Recruit hardworking helpers, brave fighters, and magical creatures that automatically collect gold and crystals for you. Invest in stronger units, unlock new layers – and fight your way to the top, where the mighty dragon boss awaits! 🎮 Gameplay Features 💰 Buy units that automatically generate resources: humans, animals, and fantasy creatures 🧱 Unlockable layers – each brings new visual themes and unique units 🔁 Synergy system : Peasants spawn chests Knights attack chests automatically Goblins collect crystals Necromancers boost skeletons 🗺️ The World of Idle Pixel Fantasy Explore and expand your base across multiple themed layers: 🏡 Layer 0 : Village life – Peasants, Cooks, Dogs 🪨 Layer 1 : Rocky world – Miners, Griffins, Spiders ⚰️ Layer 2 : Dungeon – Skeletons, Bats, Necromancers ❄️ Layer 3 : Ice – Fairies, Angels, Spirits 🌋 Layer 4 : Volcano – Demons, Flame creatures 🐉 Final Layer ✨ What Makes It Special? ✅ Everything is saved and loaded automatically – your progress is always safe ✅ Charming pixel art with lovingly animated units ✅ Relaxing gameplay : Play, sit back, and let your resources grow ✅ Synergy instead of standard idle – many units interact cleverly ✅ Steam achievements for extra motivation 👑 Defeat the Dragon! Your ultimate goal: Reach the top layer and defeat the dragon. But to lower its HP, you'll need lots of powerful units. Build, optimize, observe – and conquer the ultimate monster in the final showdown !

Recruit hardworking helpers, brave fighters, and magical creatures that automatically collect gold and crystals for you. Invest in stronger units, unlock new layers – and fight your way to the top, where the mighty dragon boss awaits! 🎮 Gameplay Features 💰 Buy units that automatically generate resources: humans, animals, and fantasy creatures 🧱 Unlockable layers – each brings new visual themes and unique units 🔁 Synergy system : Peasants spawn chests Knights attack chests automatically Goblins collect crystals Necromancers boost skeletons 🗺️ The World of Idle Pixel Fantasy Explore and expand your base across multiple themed layers: 🏡 Layer 0 : Village life – Peasants, Cooks, Dogs 🪨 Layer 1 : Rocky world – Miners, Griffins, Spiders ⚰️ Layer 2 : Dungeon – Skeletons, Bats, Necromancers ❄️ Layer 3 : Ice – Fairies, Angels, Spirits 🌋 Layer 4 : Volcano – Demons, Flame creatures 🐉 Final Layer ✨ What Makes It Special? ✅ Everything is saved and loaded automatically – your progress is always safe ✅ Charming pixel art with lovingly animated units ✅ Relaxing gameplay : Play, sit back, and let your resources grow ✅ Synergy instead of standard idle – many units interact cleverly ✅ Steam achievements for extra motivation 👑 Defeat the Dragon! Your ultimate goal: Reach the top layer and defeat the dragon. But to lower its HP, you'll need lots of powerful units. Build, optimize, observe – and conquer the ultimate monster in the final showdown !

rows.name: CRACKED
rows.short_description: Physics-based wizard brawling! In CRACKED, glass-headed mages duel in chaotic 1v1 to 4v4 battles. Draft absurd upgrades, unleash wild spells, and shatter the competition in this 3D roguelike PvP arena.
rows.description_html: CRACKED is a fast-paced, 3D PvP roguelike where glass-headed mages go head-to-head (or head-to-shards) in chaotic arena duels. Inspired by Rounds and powered by physics-based combat, every fight is unpredictable, explosive, and wildly replayable. Play solo or team up in 1v1 all the way to 4v4 showdowns. After every round, choose from a pool of powerful, quirky upgrades that stack into outrageous builds — from homing fireballs and jet packs to rapid-fire chaos or poison clouds. No two fights are the same. No glass head survives forever. Core Features: 🔮 Team-based Brawling: Battle it out in 1v1 all the way to 4v4 matches. 🧠 Make your build:  with over 40 upgrades of various rarities, make your build your own! 🧪 Concoct your fun: Stack upgrades each round and create broken, over-the-top combos. ⚡ Fast & Fluid Rounds: Jump into short, explosive matches with zero downtime. 🎮 Controller & Online Ready: Built for online competitive fun.

rows.name: MAID MOVING BOXES
rows.short_description: An anime android maid and her work drone are meeting a quota at the warehouse! A simple yet engaging game about the monotonous, relaxing process of working as a mover. Short but challenging levels, multiplayer, and lots and lots of boxes await you!
rows.description_html: Quit your job, now an android maid will work in the warehouse instead of you! Maid Moving Boxes is a simple and short game where you have to work... as a box mover. But as a cute anime girl! An engaging physics-based game where you need to meet quotas set by unknown management to load boxes onto cargo ships. Boxes! Boxes, boxes! Boxes have character... they have a price. And they also store many different things - food, chemicals, or even gold. Management expects you to load a certain type of box to complete the given tasks. Or something like that. Your drone assistant cleverly grabs and lifts cargo, if it has enough strength, but you need to be careful and cautious: boxes can break or damage other cargo! In addition to durability, weight, and price, they have... quirks... that can complicate your life. More fun together! We have... a multiplayer mode for you and your friends so you can work in the warehouse together with your colleagues. In multiplayer mode, tasks are generated randomly, which means your shift will last forever! you and your friends can play as much as you want! Upgrades Can't lift the cargo? Weakling. But we have a solution! With honestly earned money, you can buy upgrades that will increase your stats to complete our tasks. Some upgrades will simplify your workflow, while others will diversify it, for example, by unlocking a new way to grab cargo.

rows.name: Real-time Shogi
rows.short_description: Welcome to a world of Shogi freed from the limits of turns. From an infinite number of possibilities, find the shortest path to victory. Your tactical reading and sharp judgment will dominate the board. This is a new challenge for even the most seasoned Shogi fans.
rows.description_html: Shogi, the classic Japanese game of strategy, has been reborn. Welcome to Real-Time Shogi, where the ancient board game collides with the blistering speed of modern action games. Forget waiting for your turn. In this game, you and your opponent move your pieces simultaneously in a constant flow of attack and defense. Victory demands more than just deep strategy; it requires quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and the ability to make split-second decisions under pressure. Master the traditional pieces, anticipate your opponent's moves, and unleash your strategy in a dynamic, ever-shifting battlefield. This is a true test of mind and wit, where hesitation means defeat. Are you fast enough to claim checkmate?

rows.name: Click Me Harder
rows.short_description: Click anime girls, get money, spend it to get more anime girls.
rows.description_html: Click Me Harder is the ultimate anime girl clicker experience you didn’t know you needed — and probably shouldn’t admit to playing. Start with one lonely anime girl and a dream: to click her. Hard. For money. Every click earns cash. Upgrade your clicks, automate your earnings with idle anime assistants, and snowball your empire into a full-blown waifu industrial complex. Features: Click anime girls. Repeatedly. For profit. Watch numbers get bigger than your love for anime. Build a waifu workforce — Upgrade girls to get more money and points. Idle income so you can “go outside” and still earn money (you won’t). Questionable moral decisions wrapped in cute packaging. Steam Items to collect and trade! Prestige your way to a victory by optionally sacrificing score to the anime overlords for small gain increases! You’re not just clicking. You’re ascending. Wishlist now and prepare to say: “I can stop anytime I want.” Spoiler: you won’t. FAQ :  1. Q: Can I contribute?  A: Yes, just join the discord!  2. Q: Is the point to farm score, money, or steam items? A: Yes. 3. Q: Is this a naughty game?  A: NO, Get your head out of the gutter! 4. Q: Is this a NFT game? A: NO, absolutely not, its a 'Steam Inventory Item' farming game. Steam inventory items pre-date NFTs (came before), although 'NFT's' may have copied a bit from steam items, they are not the same or similar. This game does not use any crypto/blockchain technology and only uses tools provided by Steam. This game doesn't harm your hardware, unlike crypto mining. Steam does not allow crypto/blockchain/NFT games. 5. Q: Why did you use AI for this? A: For programming, it should be obvious that AI is at a point where its nearly impossible to write code that is better AND do it at a rate faster than AI, we are only humans and AI is a good tool for programming. For artwork, this may have been a oversight, but finding artist that expect reasonable rates is harder than you might think. So I'm asking for any community member to join the discord, and comment in the community forums to help us make this game better! 6. Q: I left the game open for 5-10mins still no drops, did you scam me?! A: NO, I took nothing from you first of all. Second of all, the steam drop system is partly developer controlled and partly steam controlled, so sometimes the drop trigger drops nothing, no one has an explanation for why.  This game has a drop trigger every time you open it and every 15min after (unless you decrease it by buying buffs, which can lower it to a 5min loop), expecting items with only 10mins of game time may not work...... Have you thought of possibly opening the game again...? There might be something already waiting for you.... ;) NOTE: Game time is part of my small algorithm, so if you don't get a drop right away, come back, try again, be more patient!

rows.name: Overtime Syndrome - A Late Night Shift Story
rows.short_description: Experience “just another late night shift at the office” in this ultra-short horror game. Somehow this night, the whole office is filled with an eerie, unsettling atmosphere. Missing coworkers, dim lights, and a mysterious presence known only as “it”... Will you make it to the end of your shift?
rows.description_html: Experience 'a night of overtime you’ve grown accustomed to' in this ultra-short horror game. But unlike the usual grind, the entire office tonight feels…off, ominous and Strange. Your coworkers are nowhere to be found. The lights are dim. And something — or someone — unknown is lurking. Can you make it until the end of your shift? Overtime Syndrome – A Night Shift Story is a free, ultra-short horror game. In this game, you take on the role of Max , an overworked corporate drone stuck on yet another late-night shift — only this time, something’s not quite right. Strange and unsettling events begin to unfold. As Max, you’ll try to finish your work and make it through the night… hopefully alive. First-Person Horror Experience the night shift from Max’s own eyes. Control Max as you complete tasks, collect items, and follow mysterious leads in the hope of leaving work early — or at least leaving alive. Uncover the Company’s Secrets This decades-old company has a story of its own. In this game, piece together the background of the company, uncover the hidden truth behind its decaying office, and discover the cause of the strange events you’re experiencing. Your Phone is Your Lifeline Who carries a old flashlight everywhere? It’s 2025 — everybody has a smartphone! And when it comes to lighting your way, your phone’s flashlight will be your best friend.

rows.name: I'm Tripping
rows.short_description: You woke up high in space with a smoke shop to run. Buy second-hand items from weird intergalactic beings, grow mysterious plants, craft drugs, and flip it all to aliens. From Pre-Rolls to edibles —keep them high, keep the cash flowing. And rule number one: get high on your own supply.
rows.description_html: You got high and woke up in the middle of space with a smoke shop to run. No idea how you got here, but aliens are lining up for blunts, bongs, and bizarre substances. Scavenge secondhand marketplaces, find good deals on used items, and flip them to cosmic customers. Grow strange intergalactic plants, manufacture your own drugs, and craft everything from Pre-Rolls to wax pens and edibles. Keep the aliens high, keep the cash flowing. Just don’t forget to trip —every substance is a gamble, every hallucination a game. Some trips will break you. Others will make you rich. Buy a wide range of used items—some can be flipped directly to aliens for quick profit, others serve as key ingredients in drug manufacturing. Learn what’s worth reselling and what’s better cooked into something stronger . Sell. Flip secondhand finds for quick profit or move your own handcrafted stash of intergalactic drugs. Aliens love that stuff—and they pay good money for a good trip. Manufacture. Create everything from Pre-Rolls to potent alien edibles using resources purchased or discovered in unexpected places. Plant.  Grow bizarre intergalactic flora like LSD plants, bong plants, and Pre-Roll plants. You’ll need to get the seeds first—maybe you’ll win them in a high-stakes alien poker game, or score them from shady darknet marketplaces. Trip. The heart of the hustle. Every trip is a high-stakes game—alien poker, spin the bong, mushroom roulette. Bet big, and the aliens will match it. Win rare items to expand your empire… or lose it all in a cosmic flash. What’s it gonna be, hooman?

rows.name: SailFront
rows.short_description: A new type of sailing simulator that brings a fresh interpretation of competitive sailing mechanics, with realistic wind physics! Build your own race courses, play with friends, or explore the large-scale maps!
rows.description_html: Take charge of your own dinghy-inspired sailboat in a multiplayer PvP environment! Select from three engaging game modes to sail in: Race, King of the Hill, and Duels. Or, build your own race courses with the custom level editor! SailFront is the first sailing simulator to gamify real sailing mechanics and rules into multiple fun game modes! Here are the current modes available in the beta, with more on the way! Racing Sail in traditional races, going from mark to mark to reach the finish line. Select from pre-existing race courses, or make your own using the race course level designer! During races, real racing rules of sailing are enforced. Just like real races, those that break rules are required to complete penalty turns! King of the Hill Test your rule knowledge and negotiating skills, with the King of the Hill game mode! Fight other players to claim ring zones and be awarded points. Be careful not to break any sailing rules, or you will be expelled outside the ring! Duels Box fight 1v1 until a collision occurs! At that point, the boat with rights wins the duel! Powering all these game modes is SailFront's unique rule system. This system allows players to see, in real time, which boats have sailing rights, and most importantly, why. Because of this info, players who are unfamiliar with the racing rules of sailing can learn them easily! SailFront follows the virtual racing rules of sailing, which contain the most basic sailing rules. Enforcement is achieved through forced penality turns, adding a touch of realism.  In addition to the game modes mentioned above, SailFront includes a course level editor, which allows you to create your own race courses in a matter of minutes! The course editor includes many features that enable you to tailor courses to your preferences. In addition, marks will automatically set themselves to the correct rounding (port or starboard), based on their position in the course. At the heart of SailFront is multiplayer connectivity. Unlike many existing sailing simulators, SailFront offers a lobby-style multiplayer service, where players can create their own public or private servers, and choose which servers they connect to through the join menu. This means you don’t have to wait for mysterious matchmaking to put you into a game, and you can connect with friends in an instant. Feel free to join our Discord server for further updates!

rows.name: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy: Free Appetiser
rows.short_description: Open a diner on a desert planet, grow exotic ingredients, create a menu for intergalactic palates and deal with powerful factions. Free Appetiser is the prologue to Diner at the End of the Galaxy, where you cook and manage your way to intergalactic riches and glory.
rows.description_html: Free Appetiser is a prologue for Diner at the End of the Galaxy, a management game where you run the only diner in a post-apocalyptic galaxy. Learn the basics of running an intergalactic diner, and see just how profitable (or non-profitable!) it can get! Build grand dining halls, busy kitchens, and outdoor gardens where exotic crops thrive. Design a menu that caters to the diverse preferences of your alien clientele. Hire literally anyone who walks through your doors in order to staff your diner with the best cooks, gardeners, servers, and crafters in the Nusa star system. Optimize your interior design to navigate rush hours and hungry guests. Decorate your Diner and sit back and watch your bustling creation come to life as customers pass through. Making customers of different factions happy rewards you with Faction Points that can not only be used to request a visit from their traders, buy special objects and build special rooms - it also allows you to request a faction to invade a region of the galaxy. Earn monthly rewards for each successful invasion you fund! So get started on your galactic diner today! You’ll have tons of tools at your disposal to make your own unique restaurant with your own uniquely weird menu.

rows.name: Consumption Line
rows.short_description: 'Consumption Line' is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.
rows.description_html: Welcome to your first day at the KindBroth® soup factory! Consumption Line is a short, 100% free, experimental indie game about food systems, industrial production, deceptive advertising, and the erosion of meaning in a world obsessed with efficiency. You play as a factory worker operating two machines: one for broth, one for noodles. Your job is simple: meet your daily quota, follow the recipe, don't ask questions. At first, it feels almost cozy. But as days pass, ingredients change. Machines get faster. Expectations rise. And something about the soup... feels slightly off. Features Short and focused. Playable in one sitting (approx. 30 minutes). Assembly-line gameplay that evolves each day. No game over states, no collectibles, no grind. Just play and think. Unlimited soup! What is this game exactly? This is not a traditional game. There are no skill trees, boss fights, or deep systems. It's a tightly scoped, 30-minute experience meant to invite reflection. Over the course of five in-game days, your routine remains the same: leave your flat, take the subway, arrive at the production line, hit your quota, go home... Yet there are some changes, some funny and some bleak, that reveal issues in the world around you. Fully free! Consumption Line is 100% free and also ad-free. It was created as a personal, 'artsy' project to explore our relationship with ultra-processed foods, misleading marketing, and the ruthlessness of capitalism.

rows.name: Realms of Reverie
rows.short_description: Realm of Reverie is a short VR exploration adventure game where you navigate the ruins of a sacred village and restore its lost energy after a disaster, inspired by artifacts from Mexico’s National Museum of Anthropology.
rows.description_html: Have you ever wanted to step into a quiet world shaped by myth and memory? Realm of Reverie is a short VR adventure game developed in Unreal Engine 5. Explore and interact with simple puzzles in this short student game. After a disaster leaves a sacred village in ruins, you awaken as the spirit of its last priest. Explore the remnants, gather lost energy, and restore the shattered Sun Stone. Inspired by artifacts from Mexico’s National Museum of Anthropology, this 10-minute journey offers gentle exploration and a moment of quiet reflection. Realm of Reverie is the product of two person team Maggie Lin and Yichen Xiong for Senior Thesis 2025.

Collect scrap to customize the robot’s parts, listen to radio songs while you explore the diverse environments, meet other robots, defeat enemies, bosses, and two extra minigames to enjoy!

rows.name: Cuber
rows.short_description: Cuber is a low-poly endless runner game in which you have to keep an ice cube alive. There are many obstacles, as well as items that influence the effect of the obstacles. So you have to make smart decisions: do you avoid obstacles, or do you try to destroy them with the help of the items?
rows.description_html: Cuber is a low-poly endless runner game in which you have to keep an ice cube alive. There are many obstacles, as well as items that influence the effect of the obstacles. So you have to make smart decisions: do you avoid obstacles, or do you try to get rid of them with the help of the items? Your goal is to stay alive as long as possible and score as many points and cover as much distance as you can. Endless Running - Play as long as you can keep it up Stay Cool - You are constantly melting, collect ice to keep cool Destroy Obstacles - Get more points for destroying obstacles like barricades, fire, UFO and many more Simple controls – The controls are very simple and consist only of the Left , Right and Jump . Both Keyboard and Controller are supported.

rows.name: Beyond Your Wall
rows.short_description: Tap. Break. Breathe. Become. Tap to break walls and open the door to self-discovery.
rows.description_html: Beyond Your Wall is a meditative wall-breaking experience where you tap through emotional blocks and reveal short quotes of insight, clarity, and strength. With each tap, you crack the surface of the wall and a little more of yourself. Whether you’re feeling happy, gloomy, angry, or just curious, the game responds to your mood with a personalized moment of reflection. Watch the wall crumble and let powerful words shine through. Capture your favorite breakthrough messages with the in-game camera feature and return to them anytime. No scores, no stress—just a few mindful minutes to breathe, reset, and feel a little more whole. Key Features Choose your mood and break your wall with purpose. Tap to release tension and feel the wall give way. Get inspired by encouraging and original quotes. Save your favorites with one tap. Designed to soothe with clean visuals and calming sound. Break the wall. Feel lighter. Break the wall. Discover what’s behind it. This is your space to pause, reflect, and become. Sometimes a small crack is all you need to move forward.

rows.name: Youmu's Cube Adventure
rows.short_description: Youmu Konpaku has been turned into a cube! Help her escape by navigating her through 100 levels in this challenging physics-precision game inspired by the Ball Revamped flash game series! Also includes a lower-difficulty option for a less strict experience.
rows.description_html: Starring Youmu Konpaku from Touhou Project! In this challenging physics-based game, you will have to precisely lift the cube against gravity and carefully navigate to the exit of each level without touching the walls or enemies. But this is easier said than done, due to the cube's high speed as well as enemies that will try to mess with you! Mechanics like Focus mode and the Charged slash will prove useful, but expect to fail a lot. Fortunately, a lower-difficulty option is also available. Can you beat all 100 levels, with all sorts of different enemies & mechanics scattered across the journey? 100 levels, plus something extra at the end 6 worlds, each bringing their own challenges Fight or escape from 17 different foes, each with their own behavior Use the power of Animal Spirits to alter Youmu's abilities to complete levels

rows.name: FISH³: FIRST CATCH
rows.short_description: FISH³: FIRST CATCH is a high-octane, surreal speed-fishing adventure where your boat is powered by fish! Engage in time-attack stages, dual-rod fishing, and underwater spear-fishing in a dreamlike world teeming with bizarre aquatic creatures.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME NOW! About the Game FISH³: FIRST CATCH is the stand-alone prequel to the insane fishing adventure FISH³: FISHTASTIC FISHING FISHSCAPES. In FIRST CATCH experience the following as you learn the origin story of FISH³: FISHTASTIC FISHING FISHSCAPES: Tackle 3 unique levels Catch over 15 exotic deep sea creatures Uncover the mystery of this strange ocean and meet it's weird inhabitants Cast your rod to catch a powerful fish that will pull your boat, becoming a fish-engine , control the direction by pulling the fishing rod into desired direction and hope that the fish won't outpower you! These waters are filled with a bunch of weird creatures that behave like fish. Why are they like this? What purpose do they serve? All that bothers you is that they act like fish and react to bait like fish, so that means you MUST catch them all! Two hands means two fishing rods - while controlling the boat with one rod, you can cast with a second one to catch fish that tags alongside and increase your total haul.

rows.name: Hydropawnics
rows.short_description: Take this shoot to the moon! Help this space cat on their mission to the stars by fixing generators, dodging lasers, and keeping the last plant alive in Hydropawnics!
rows.description_html: This adorable space cat has been tasked with taking the last surviving plant to the moon in hopes of inhabiting it. But the ship is breaking down the more it flies on! The power generators keep breaking, all the defense turrets have mistakenly marked YOU as their target, and the plant can't sustain itself. Will you join them in their quest and succeed? Or will you falter? Gameplay Overview Hydropawnics is a 3D isometric puzzle platformer all about managing your time and resources effectively. Generators will break and need to be fixed, the sole plant slowly deteriorates with water, and the turrets will fire at you from many angles. As you progress, the map and challenges needed to progress get harder, so you will need to think more carefully about how to do your job well. Your quick thinking, platforming, and management skills will all be necessary to come out on top! Hydropawnics was initially created as part of a student game jam by 5 developers. Hope you have fun with it!

rows.name: Dorothy's Job
rows.short_description: A frenetic and hilarious isometric twin-stick shooter where you play as Dorothy, a muscular maid who is in charge of cleaning levels full of enemies and filth with deadly mops, vacuums, and outrageous cleaning tools.
rows.description_html: Meet Dorothy , the overly muscular maid of an evil mastermind, in a hilarious isometric twin-stick shooter where cleaning is just as deadly as combat. Every day, Dorothy must face a brand-new, randomly generated level overflowing with enemies and filth. Your goal: clean everything —sweep away villains and mop up messes using an arsenal of outrageous cleaning tools turned into powerful weapons. Fight with your trusty mop, unleash the destructive power of a vacuum cleaner, and discover other cleaning gadgets reimagined as instruments of mayhem. What to expect of Dorothy's Job? Procedurally Generated Chaos – Each day brings new layouts, enemies, and challenges. Cleaning Tools of Destruction – Wield mops, vacuums, and more as deadly weapons. Be a One Woman Army – Play as Dorothy, a maid who’s as strong as she is unstoppable. Action Meets Comedy – Over-the-top twin-stick action with a tongue-in-cheek sense of humor. Whether you’re scrubbing floors or blasting foes, Dorothy’s Job proves that cleaning can be messy, chaotic, and ridiculously fun. Developed in colaboration with:

rows.name: FlipSum - A Puzzle By Claris Richter
rows.short_description: FlipSum is a bold new twist on classic number puzzles! Inspired by sudoku, this brain-teasing series challenges you to flip, cancel, and balance numbers on a grid to match the target totals. It’s a thrilling game of logic, deduction, and number.
rows.description_html: FlipSum is a bold new twist on classic number puzzles! Inspired by sudoku, this brain-teasing series challenges you to flip, cancel, and balance numbers on a grid to match the target totals. It’s a thrilling game of logic, deduction, and number play—perfect for puzzle lovers who crave something fresh and clever. Get ready to see numbers in a whole new light! How To Play: Mark numbers as positive, negative, or cancel them out. Only one number may be cancelled per row / column. Can you balance the entire grid so that each column / row adds up to the correct number? Features: 4 Difficulty Levels Infinite Puzzles Level Counter Per Difficulty Track Your Total Points To Show Off To Your Friends!

rows.name: Land Run
rows.short_description: An original single-play card game set in the 'LandRun' of the Western Pioneering Era. A fierce psychological battle using cards and luck, the game is turned upside down with just one card.
rows.description_html: LandRun is a one-man strategy card game with a motif of the land scramble 'landrun' from the western frontier era. Players, as black slaves, participate in 'Land Run Tournament' because of their owners' greed, and if they win, they will get the freedom they promised and the land they want. This piece is a personalized title developed for PCs, using Unity. Unlike the typical Trump game, except for five special cards, it is designed so that the impact of number size does not appear significantly. When a player hands one card, his or her horse advances one space in the opponent's direction, and when the horse crosses the opponent's boundary, the attack succeeds. Successful three times in this attack will result in victory in that round. The key strategy is to plan in which order to use the card and move the horse, with items that reverse the opponent's advance, move several spaces at once, or adjust the timing of crossing the boundary line. In addition, if the boundary breakthrough does not occur three times until the deck is exhausted, the score is calculated by adding the sum of the number of cards left in the hand and the sum of the unused physical strength cards, and the sum is used to determine victory or defeat. As a result, there are two winning plans: a direct attack victory that breaks through the opponent's boundaries three times and finishes quickly, and a score victory that is aimed at managing hand and physical strength while looking at the deck run out. It is up to the player to decide which plan to choose, and it is important to strategically adjust the timing of using the item, the consumption of the physical card, and how much handwriting you will leave. Another feature of the game is that there is still room for a turnaround even in unfavorable situations due to various items. Matches are played in a tournament format. Players will face several contestants in a row under the direction of their owners, each with a different disposition: 'the type who pushes aggressively from the beginning' and 'the type who saves items and special cards and then flips them all at once in the second half.' The rules are the same, but they are designed to vary depending on who you face, whether you are aiming for an attack victory or a point victory. A round can take approximately 10 to 15 minutes, and the game is designed to allow you to find your own winning pattern by re-attempting several times in a short period of time. It uses a simple mouse-only interface. The game is played by simply selecting a card, but the weight of the judgment varies depending on how you read the horse's location, the number of cards left, and the remaining physical strength of the card. We aim to design it as intuitive as possible so that even players who are not confident in numerical calculation can strategize with the image of 'move forward, step back, push away.' In terms of visuals and world views, in order to give an epic reason to the rule of 'why fight each other to move forward first,' we tried to superimpose Landrun in real history with the situation of 'who runs first and takes the land.' The board and UI are motifs of desolate land maps, old gambling tables, and bulletin boards in bars, and we tried to direct the main character to feel like he is getting closer to freedom and the ground whenever the horse advances one by one. It is a game created by black slaves who are forced to fight for their owners, conscious of twisting the contradictions and madness of the Western Pioneering Era and Landrun through the structure that they try to win their freedom in the end within the same rules and tournament.

rows.name: Alpha Point
rows.short_description: Alpha Point: Solo-indie multiplayer FPS featuring ray-traced, realistic visuals and slick gunplay. Risk it all in a unique Rank & Loadout system; win matches to earn tags and progress, lose and watch it slip away. Fight in FFA, TDM, CTF, and TSG across 5 maps with your custom loadout. Available now!
rows.description_html: Alpha Point is a next-generation, solo-indie masterpiece: a realistic, competitive multiplayer FPS packed with action, grit, and community... Whew, that's a lot of adjectives. Stunning Ray-Traced Graphics: Experience cutting-edge visuals with highly optimized ray tracing, delivering lifelike lighting and reflections on a solo-indie budget. Fluid Movement & Gunplay:  Master intuitive mechanics with responsive shooting, nostalgic movement, and tactical sprinting for never-ending, heart-pounding action. Innovative Rank & Loadout System: Climb ranks through your wins, earn Tags to unlock weapons and characters, or risk it all to prestige for the rank boost you deserve. Go bankrupt and you'll be back at square one. Diverse Gameplay Modes: Free-For-All: Eliminate every rival in sight. Bloodiest hands win. Team Deathmatch: Team up to outgun the enemy. Coordination is your edge. Capture the Flag: Steal the enemy flag while defending your own. Strategy is key. The Survival Games [ New! ] : Collect gear and compete to be the last man standing. With more on the way... Five Unique Maps: Battle across meticulously crafted arenas designed for intense firefights. Eleven Distinct Weapons: From assault rifles to snipers to shotguns, customize the loadout that suits you best. Local Voice Chat: Strategize with teammates and taunt foes in real-time. Robust Anti-Cheat: Non-intrusive protection built into the code itself. Bartholomew... The times of war are upon us, and the Alpha Squad needs you. Feel the thrill of the high-stakes, innovative Rank & Loadout system, where every match is a gamble on your future. Victory will progress your rank and earn you Tags, your currency for unlocking powerful weapons and unique characters. Defeat , on the other hand, will cost you Tags and set you back in the ranks. Play it safe to build your arsenal, or push aggressively for glory . The choice is yours. Purchase enough weapons, and you'll gain the ability to Prestige , giving you the rank promotion you deserve, but at the cost of resetting your Loadout for a challenge anew. Run out of Tags entirely? You'll face Bankruptcy , wiping your Loadout clean and setting you back in the ranks. Alpha Point's Rank & Loadout system rewards skill, strategy, and nerve, making every kill meaningful in your non-stop fight for survival. Built by a passionate solo developer, Alpha Point is a living project shaped by community feedback, with additional planned content already coming your way. Join the fight, wishlist now, and head to the Alpha Point -- your squad is calling.

rows.name: PKWAR
rows.short_description: Enter the arena in PKWAR, a hardcore PvP MUD where text-based combat meets competitive glory. Choose from 5 unique classes, battle players simultaneously, and rise through military ranks from Private to Captain. No graphics, no distractions - just pure skill-based combat. Death or glory.
rows.description_html: PKWAR: Text-Based Battle Royale MUD Every war. Everyone starts equal. Only knowledge wins. Welcome to PKWAR - a PvP MUD where 15-minute matches deliver intense, skill-based combat. No grinding. No gear advantages. Just you, your wits, and other players fighting for supremacy. WHAT MAKES PKWAR DIFFERENT: ⚔️ True Competitive Equality - Every match starts fresh. No player has equipment advantages. Veterans win through map knowledge and tactics alone. ⏱️ 15-Minute Matches - Quick, intense battles that fit your schedule. No 8-hour grinding sessions required. 🎮 Battle Royale Meets MUD - Spawn with nothing, scavenge equipment, hunt other players. Last warrior standing wins. 🗺️ 2100+ Room Battleground - Master the massive map to find the best loot spawns, ambush points, and puzzles. Knowledge is power. 🎯 Multiple Game Modes: Free-for-all bloodbaths Strategic team warfare 'Best vs Rest' enforcer hunts PROGRESSION & FEATURES: 📈 Skill-Based Ranking - Rise from Private to Captain through victories alone 🏆 46 Steam Achievements - Including hidden challenges 💰 Match Rewards - Earn credits through performance 🧙 Become an Implementor - Top players at level 10 can shape the game world 🎲 Dynamic Elements - Random weapon spawns and shifting maze exits keep every match fresh PERFECT FOR: Competitive gamers seeking pure skill-based PvP MUD veterans wanting fast-paced action Battle royale fans ready for a text-based challenge Anyone tired of pay-to-win and grinding No graphics. No distractions. Just pure, tactical combat where your mind is your greatest weapon. Join now via Steam client or connect directly: pkwar . org port 2222

rows.name: Lumi & The Lost Tablets
rows.short_description: Lumi and the Lost Tablets is a family friendly 3D platformer. Jump, glide, and explore your way through multiple colorful areas and restore peace to the ocean!
rows.description_html: Lumi & The Lost Tablets is a colorful 3D platformer for all ages. Jump, glide and puzzle your way across the ocean floor to find the lost stone tablets to take on corrupted foes and restore peace to the sea! Jump. glide and explore! Jump and glide your way across two colorful areas - the Reef and the Ruins.  Collect!   Explore the levels to find pearls and stone tablets. rows.name: Come out, cat
rows.short_description: The hidden cat is waiting for your words.
rows.description_html: Come Out, Cat is a short and simple adventure game where you call out to a cat who's hiding away, hoping to coax them back into the world. 🐈️ How to Play Choose two word cards — one action, one subject. Combine them to call out to the cat. Pay attention to how the cat reacts. Use those reactions to figure out the right words. When you find the right phrase, the cat will come out. That’s all. 🖥️ Streaming / Videos / Fan Works Feel free to stream, record, or create fan content — as long as it’s within the bounds of common sense!

rows.name: Paradise Island 2: Hotel Game
rows.short_description: Turn a sun-kissed island into the ultimate tropical getaway. Build luxury hotels, design beautiful beaches, and create attractions to delight your guests. Manage resources, expand your resort, and watch tourists flock to your paradise in this relaxing citybuilding game.
rows.description_html: The legendary hotel tycoon game is back! The tropical island looks as beautiful as ever, ready to house your ultimate hotel empire and receive crowds of family tourists, adventure seekers, and even virtual villagers. Develop the lost island into the most luxurious family resort in Paradise Island 2 — one of the sunniest and cutest hotel games out there. Start off with just a bunch of straw huts that provide a village life vibe on the island and build your way towards a full hotel empire with elite 5-star family accommodation fit for a world-class hotel tycoon. Make your island resort the most hyped vacation destination with all sorts of attractions, shops, and restaurants. Engage family tourists and their kids with hotel games and activities. Turn the whole island into an amusement park filled with rides, cafes, and virtual villagers, giving your guests a taste of village life. Become the ultimate hotel tycoon by expanding your influence on a lost island and tailor your hotel empire to fit the needs of even the most demanding tourists: be they young and noisy fun-seekers or reserved family people looking for safe family fun. Becoming a hotel tycoon is a serious mission, but no one says you can’t have fun on your island while you’re at it! Key features: ✔ Build over 300 buildings drawn in a unique style and make the best hotel empire ✔ Improve and develop your family island, invite and entertain guests, and earn huge profits to become the ultimate hotel tycoon ✔ Help and feed animals in danger, build your resort in tune with nature in one of the most beautiful hotel games ever ✔ Take part in competitions against friends and other city managers ✔ Play with your hotel tycoon friends: visit friends’ islands to find hidden objects and receive gifts! ✔ Unique events with special game mechanics and lots of amazing quests

rows.short_description: A unique psychological horror game featuring strange characters, many different types of gameplay, lots of monsters, and a full narrative (No chapters) that is sure to be the greatest game you have ever played ever
rows.description_html: As a Divine Intervention special operative it is your job to investigate the game Dreamcatcher 2003  and find a way to contain it before it can claim anymore victims. Explore unique locations reminiscent of RPG Maker classics like Yume Nikki and Ib meeting lots of strange characters and fighting off plenty of monsters under the guidance of the mysterious Kiki. This game features 1-2 hours of unique horror, comedy, and action that will be able to keep you on your toes for the entire runtime of the game.

The more neutrons the more money made! Different materials have vastly different effects when hit:  Fissile materials will make more neutrons! Multiply neutrons and redirect them! Increase profits of neutrons! Obtain perks with powerful synergies that gives you a unique experience every time you play. Challenges, starting materials, and persistent unlocks will make sure the experience always feels fresh and give a harder challenge for those who seek it.

rows.name: Step Away
rows.short_description: Step Away makes your time off-screen feel more rewarding. While you’re away, going for a walk, cleaning up or grocery shopping, the little wanderer gathers steps. When you return, you might find he’s earned a new hat for his journey.
rows.description_html: Hey there! Ever find yourself stuck in front of your PC with zero motivation to do the things life actually expects from you? Then this little app we made might be just what you need. Type in what you're about to do, place your cursor in the square, and watch the little wanderer set off. While you’re away doing something useful, like going for a walk, cleaning up, or grocery shopping, he’ll quietly gather steps in the background. And when you come back, he might even have earned a new hat for his efforts. Spending Time Off-Screen We know it’s not always easy to get away from screen and deal with life stuff. This app gives you a gentle push in the right direction and a small reward for being off-screen. Minimalist Design This is a super minimal experience. No pressure, no complexity, no real gameplay. Just peaceful vibes and a little guy walking while you’re AFK. Rewarding Hats Rack up steps to unlock a handful of charming hats. Equip whatever suits your style. If you enjoy this, please consider picking up the Supporter Pack DLC . It helps us keep making creative content like this. And if you’ve got any feedback, we’d love to hear from you on our Discord :) Julian & Basti

rows.name: Rock and Stone
rows.short_description: Rock and Stone is an idle background mining game where you play as a dwarf, mining rocks for valuable loot. You can sell your loot on the community market for profit or use it to get new gear and gold. Equip different gear—from common to legendary—to boost your stats and mine even more effectively.
rows.description_html: In Rock and Stone , you are a dwarf on a mission to get rich! While you'll be mining rocks and collecting valuable loot, your true fortune is made in the player-driven market . You'll need to decide whether to sell the items you find to other players or use them to speed up your own mining. With no pay-to-win in-game purchases, your success depends entirely on your gear, luck, and determination. Gameplay Rock and Stone is a game that works for you, even when you're not playing. You will mine rocks in the background , automatically gathering Steam items . You can either sell these items on the market for a profit or open them for new gear and gold. You can occasionally click to use a limited stamina reserve to speed up mining manually. You can also purchase in-game buffs with gold you find, giving you temporary boosts. The stronger your gear, the faster you can mine and the better your chances of finding rare treasures. Looting & Gear Items come in five rarities: Common , Uncommon , Rare , Epic , and Legendary . Each rarity provides stronger stats and bigger bonuses. There are 11 stats that affect your mining, including: Magic find Damage, crit chance and crit damage multiplier Experience Buff and gold chance Buff duration and gold amount Stamina regeneration Auto-mining speed You can equip various types of gear, such as rocks , pickaxes , and pickaxe mods , to improve these stats and become an even more effective miner. Buffs & Gold While mining, you have a chance to find gold and  temporary buffs . You can also buy longer-lasting buffs with gold at any time. There are four types of buffs that can give you a boost, including: Increased damage More experience Faster auto-mining Faster stamina regeneration Reforge Reforge functionality allows you to combine 12 items of the same rarity into one new item of the next higher rarity Look out for secret recipes that don't require all 12 items! A gold cost , which varies based on the item rarity, is associated with each reforge. You can enable Reforge mode using the button in your in-game inventory. Type of the output item is affected by the distribution of the input items types. Artifacts Artifacts are collectible items that grant stat bonuses to your character as long as they remain in your Steam inventory . They’re passive, and persistent. Each artifact provides fixed bonuses. Bonuses are automatically applied when the artifact is in your Steam inventory—no need to convert them to game items, equip or activate. Artifacts come in multiple rarities , just like other in-game items. The higher the rarity, the stronger and more numerous the bonuses . Community Join the community! Connect with other miners, influence upcoming content and features, and be the first to know about events and promo codes .

rows.name: Ghost Code: Escape
rows.short_description: Collect pets and explore 18 handcrafted levels as you uncover a small part of the world of Ghost Code.
rows.description_html: 'Ghost Code: Escape' is the humble beginnings of a new saga. Simple Gameplay It's a relatively simple 2D platformer. A Breezy Experience Most of the 18 stages can be completed in under 30 seconds, but mastering them can be a challenge. Unique Art The game doesn't use tiled environments. Every stage is handcrafted as a singular art piece. A Peek into a New World The story isn't front and center, but it is an origin of sorts for a big player in the world of Ghost Code. It's 100% free, so give it a try.

rows.name: Duelmasters
rows.short_description: Battle your friends in fast-paced 1v1 arena brawler style duels. Choose from axe, sword, or spear, each with its own strengths, and fight through intense rounds. Outplay your opponent, become champion of the arena, and earn the title of Duelmaster!
rows.description_html: Gameplay Each player will start the game by equipping 1 weapon and 1 ability from inside the preparation room, once both players ready up they are transported into the arena where they will duel. Players can use the arena to their advantage by interacting with scattered powerups, knocking down environmental hazards or pushing their opponent in lava. The first player to reach 3/5/7 points will be crowned the winner of the duel. Weapons Axe - Leap aggressively into fights burning the ground wherever you land, the axe is the most aggressive of the weapons designed to maintain a heavy offence. Spear - Set traps for your opponent and hurl spears of lightning at your enemy, best at keeping distance the spear is for those who prefer to play more defensively. Sword - Use your superior skill to outplay any opponent with using high mobility dashes and jumps, the sword is intended as the most flexible weapon, for both attack and defence. Abilities Dash - Weave in a dash between any ability in the game, the most skilled users create new combos by themselves. Hook- Grapple your self quickly anywhere in the arena, safely repositioning in a tight spot, alternatively pull any opponent in that is trying to escape. Repulsor Shield - Create a shield around yourself that can deflect any attack in the game with the right timing.

rows.name: Go Bananas!
rows.short_description: Race through shifting magical terrain in this first-person adventure. Fight off chasing enemies with your stick, then unlock fireballs. Find the right path as routes change each run, grab enchanted bananas for shields, and reach the portal before time runs out.
rows.description_html: In this fast-paced first-person adventure, you take on the role of a lone explorer racing to reach a mysterious portal at the edge of an ever-changing magical terrain. But the path is never the same twice—some routes are blocked, forcing you to think quickly and adapt on the run. Armed with only a sturdy stick at first, you’ll fend off relentless enemies that spawn and chase you through the landscape. Master close-range combat before unlocking the ability to hurl devastating fireballs at your pursuers. Scattered throughout the map are enchanted bananas—rare magical fruit that grant you a brief but powerful shield when collected. Will you navigate the dangers and escape, or fall to the forces guarding the realm?

rows.name: NAVYFIELD : CROSSFIRE
rows.short_description: Engage in thrilling online naval battles with historical warships in PvP(12vs12) action game! Take command of legendary warships and compete against players worldwide in epic naval battles!
rows.description_html: Real-time Online PvP(12 vs 12) and PvE Battles: Experience heart-pounding action in real-time battles against players from around the world. Engage in intense PvP and PvE battles in different game modes, bringing historical realism to Navy Field, the ultimate online action game. Command Legendary Warships: Take control of over 500 warships from the USA, UK, Japan, Germany, Soviet Union, France, and Italy. Choose your favorite among cool destroyers, cruisers, battleships, aircraft carriers, and submarines. rows.name: Shidunzi Parkour
rows.short_description: Ever looked at a humble street bollard and thought, 'I want to be that'? Now you can! Dodge and crash your way through endless streets as a sentient stone bollard in this quirky, stress-relieving arcade game.
rows.description_html: ▶︎ INTRODUCTION They were once the silent guardians of the sidewalk. Now, they are the unstoppable champions of the street! Welcome to Shidunzi Parkour ! This is a wonderfully absurd casual game where you play as... well, a stone bollard, on a wild rampage through the city. Forget superheroes and chosen ones; here, you'll experience the peak of existence as the most common, everyday roadblock. The core gameplay is a classic, intuitive three-lane runner, but we've packed it with two distinct ways to have fun: 【PARKOUR MODE: THE ART OF THE DODGE】 In this mode, you are a nimble parkour master. The streets are swarming with your stationary brethren. Rely on your sharp reflexes and precise timing to weave through the chaos, pushing your limits to set the ultimate high score. It’s not just about survival; it’s a graceful ballet of concrete and asphalt. 【MUSIC MODE: A CARNIVAL OF RHYTHMIC DESTRUCTION】 Switch to Music Mode, and let the mayhem begin! You become a rock-and-roll renegade, and your one and only goal is to SMASH EVERYTHING. Collide with other bollards in perfect sync with the electrifying beat. Every successful impact is a satisfying note in a symphony of destruction, creating the ultimate stress-relief experience. ▶︎ FEATURES Two Core Modes, Double the Fun : Master the thrilling challenge of high-speed dodging in Parkour Mode, or unleash your destructive side and smash to the beat in Music Mode. Become a Rhythm God: Full support for custom beatmaps! Craft your very own 'Bollard Symphony' and share it with players worldwide via local files or the upcoming Steam Workshop integration. Challenge the world with your unique rhythms! Online & LAN Multiplayer Mayhem : Compete with friends online or on a local network! In Parkour Mode, you'll see other players' ghost silhouettes as you race against their best runs. In Music Mode, watch a live leaderboard and battle for the top score in real-time! Host Your Own Game with Ease : No dedicated server required! The game client itself can act as a server. Simply share your IP address, and you can instantly start a LAN party with your friends. The Ultimate Stress-Relief Tool : Become a bollard. Run wild. Forget the rules. This might just be the most absurdly satisfying and relaxing game you'll ever play. Are you ready? Pick your mode, hit the streets, and show the world what a stone bollard can really do!

rows.name: Fly Over! 100KM! Mountains!
rows.short_description: This is an easy-to-learn yet incredibly challenging endless flight game. Control your little plane through the ever-changing sky, nimbly avoiding obstacles and desperately trying to escape the ever-approaching tornado behind you. Every advance is a test of skill and perseverance.
rows.description_html: Take to the boundless skies with your little plane! Fly through clouds and obstacles, feeling the wind whipping through your wings—but remember, your true enemy isn't just the obstacles ahead; it's the roaring tornado behind you. It's closing in on you, and all you can do is accelerate, dodge, and persevere...    Your goal is one: fly over 100 kilometers and claim that untouchable medal of honor. This is not only a test of skill, but also a test of will.    Simple rules, pure challenge: every move determines how far you can fly.    —Are you ready for this marathon in the sky?   ⌨️ Keyboard Controls: ↑ ↓ ← → / WSAD Boost: Spacebar Pause: ESC key   🎮 Gamepad Controls: Left Stick Boost: B Pause: Y

rows.name: 1 in a Million | A game of odds
rows.short_description: Can you get the 1 in a million achievement on Steam?
rows.description_html: Want to have the bragging rights to say 'I have a 1 in a million achievement on Steam'? Well today is your lucky day because that is what this entire game is based on. Objective: Get a score of 1,000,000 all you have to do is click a button and hope it hits the 1,000,000 and you will now have that achievement, you can purchase upgrades that allow for an auto clicker and reduce the time between clicks There are also side achievements that can be acquired such as 1% which is a score of 1, Full stop, which is a score of 999,999 and upgraded, which is acquired by purchasing all upgrades, if you get those 4 plus the 1 million, then you will have the King of Achievements achievement which is by far the rarest of rare when it comes to achievements, this game can take years to 100% or it could take a single day, it's all based on odds, you might get very lucky your first couple clicks

rows.name: Chess With Idiots
rows.short_description: Shape the turn order in a speed-based tactical roguelike. Adapt to shifting battlefields, overcome unique bosses, and unlock powerful new abilities as you guide a band of idiots through four perilous and distinct regions!
rows.description_html: Outthink. Outlast. Outplay. Step into a tactical roguelike where every battle is a puzzle, every move matters, and defeat is just the start of the story! Assemble your team of unique idiots and fight through 4 dangerous regions — each with its own enemies, gimmicks, and secrets... From goblin ambushes in dense forests to mind-bending traps in a forgotten library, every encounter forces you to adapt your strategy. Chess with Idiots is a turn based strategy roguelike. You control a self made team of 'Idiots' with the goal of completing as many runs as possible. A run starts at the forest and ends at the final boss on top of the volcano. Finishing a run allows you to either continue, or completely end your run. If you decide to continue, you restart at the forest but will notice that all the enemies have become a lot stronger... Key Features Custom turn order - Determine the order of actions yourself and create the optimal strategy.        Four Distinct Regions – Forest, Cave, Library, and Volcano — each with unique visuals, challenges, and bosses. Roguelike Progression – Unlock new characters, abilities, and strategies with each run. Dynamic Encounters – No two battles play out the same thanks to randomized enemy setups. Environmental Hazards – Lava flows, collapsing tiles, magical anomalies, and more keep the battlefield alive. Handcrafted 2D Art & Effects – Colorful environments and smooth animations bring each region to life. Will you conquer the dragon at the heart of the volcano… or become just another hero swallowed by the flames? DISCLAIMER ! This game is not a variant of chess, it is it's own concept but influenced by the game of chess.

Every mouse click and keypress is a chance to spawn an egg: crack the egg to reveal hats and cosmetics ranging from common to legendary. Collect items, equip them, or trade them on the Steam Marketplace!
rows.description_html: Chicken Fren struts on your desktop, turning every click and keypress into a chance to find legendary cosmetics. Keep them to flex, or trade them on the Steam Community Market. There are over 40 unique hats to collect, so start grinding today! Every Keypress and Mouse Click is a Dice-Roll The more you press, the better your chances. But odds are stacked against you, so keep the rolls coming. Common: 1 out of 50k Uncommon: 1 out of 100k Rare: 1 out of 250k Epic: 1 out of 500k Legendary: 1 out of 1 million Secure, Fair, Server-Verified Drops Every roll is performed on a cloud server using secure HMAC keys for fairness and anti-bot protection. No cheating. No offline spoofing. Just real odds. No in-game purchases. Every item is earned by players and only bought or sold on Steam’s marketplace. Good luck and happy clicking, frens.

rows.name: Luminaria
rows.short_description: 'Travel through the darkness, collect stars, and awaken the world's only beacon.'
rows.description_html: The light has faded, and the world has sunk into silence and darkness. Only one beacon rises above the endless expanse, and only you can ignite its light. To awaken the beacon, you must journey through gloomy locations and collect the stars scattered across the world. Each one is a fragment of the lost light, and only by gathering them all will you be able to dispel the darkness. Luminaria is a meditative journey where the focus is not on speed but on atmosphere. The world responds to your presence, and your path is filled with soft radiance that step by step brings back hope. The sole grand goal — collect all the stars to activate the main beacon. Atmospheric world — a blend of darkness and light in a minimalist visual style. Meditative gameplay — no battles or timers, just you and a peaceful adventure. Smooth animation and light effects — creating the feeling of a living world. Musical accompaniment — a gentle soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere of the journey.

rows.name: Duet Night Abyss
rows.short_description: A Thrilling Hybrid Action RPG, featuring a Dual Narrative
rows.description_html: In the long and repetitive dream, Quicksand constantly pours down. The compass of destiny starts to tick. The two wake up and embark on their separate journeys. On this shore, you emerged from a perilous situation but were exiled to the harsh North Border, struggling to survive. On the other shore, you found yourself in a maelstrom of power, striving to escape from a cage woven with conspiracies. No need to bid farewell. As time perpetually flows forward, As the two shores will eventually meet, You will meet each other one day. Duet Night Abyss is a fantasy adventure RPG with a high degree of freedom developed by Hero Games' Pan Studio. The game features 'Multiple Weapon Loadouts x 3D Combat' at its core, and tells the story of 'Demons' from dual perspectives. [Craft your own lineup] Freely farm character fragments and forging materials to unlock your favorite characters and weapons at your own pace. No forced progression, no rigid templates—just the joy of free cultivation and strategic experimentation. Focus on strengthening your core squad or exploring endless tactical possibilities. [Destinies intertwine — Meet demons of a hundred faces in the DNA] You will step into a land where magic and machinery coexist, playing as two protagonists with vastly different backgrounds. Encounter a variety of demonic beings with their own perspectives as you engage in constant battles and exploration to uncover the truth behind a thorny fate, ultimately bringing an end to the spiral of suffering. [Swap between melee & ranged weapons — Freely create multi‑dimensional weapon combos] In battles, you can freely switch between melee and ranged weapons, allowing characters to break free from the limitations of a single weapon class. Choose from a variety of cool melee weapons such as whipblades, crossbows, and even heavy firepower like sniper rifles, grenade launchers, and high-tech hover guns to create your unique weapon loadouts. [Exhilarating hack‑and‑slash battles — Master agile moves and mow down hordes] Engage in fast-paced combat against waves of relentless enemies with the freedom to utilize both close and long-range attacks, as well as aerial assaults and ground takedowns. Bask in unexpected and thrilling battle experiences through diverse combat gameplay including tracking, reconnaissance, and rescue missions. [Customize your look with dyes — Mix & match—colour weapons & outfits freely] Dye and switch at will—take full control of your weapon and character aesthetics. Swap color schemes on the fly to match your combat style with your personal flair. Combine a wealth of accessories—from elegant headpieces to lively waist ornaments—whether for refined beauty or playful fun, the choice is yours.

rows.name: Samuel Prince Attorney at Law Chapter 1
rows.short_description: The first of seven chapters of a courtroom battle style visual novel, in which the story follows brand new lawyer Samuel Prince as he solves a strange variety of different crimes. Investigate the crime scene for evidence, then use it in court to find the real truth behind the case.
rows.description_html: The first of seven chapters of a courtroom battle style visual novel, in which the story follows brand new lawyer Samuel Prince as he solves a strange variety of different crimes. Acquire evidence by investigating the crime scene, then use it in court when cross examining witnesses to cleave through all the lies and find your way to the truth. In this chapter, Samuel Prince makes his grand debut in the courtroom, defending a young college girl accused of killing her best friend.

rows.name: Sport Animals
rows.short_description: Sport Animals is a physics-based game about a group of animals playing a sport! Customize your animal, practice your game, and get onto the field start scoring goals in 1v1s, 2v2s, or 3v3s. Compete against your friends or join public lobbies to play against other animals!
rows.description_html: Sport Animals is all about getting out onto the field and scoring goals! Pick out your animal's style from a myriad of options and start playing, either with friends or in public lobbies with other online players. Games only take 5 minutes and support all team sizes between 1v1 and 3v3. You can also spectate games for a more cinematic experience! Game Features Character Customization:  Thousands of combinations of animals, colors, and accessories No Scripted Mechanics:  Physics-based ball and character movement Play with Anyone:  Public and friend-based lobby options Custom Lobbies:  Customize all game settings from the lobby, including gravity, shot speed, and more Always Free All cosmetics are immediately available for your use. Sport Animals is all about making the animal you want and having fun in game, so we'll never add microtransactions or paywalled items to the game. The game and its content will always be 100% free!

rows.name: Myrkwood: Offshoot
rows.short_description: Myrkwood: Offshoot is a top-down survival defense game that you can play with friends! Defend the Gem as you fight through waves of enemies!
rows.description_html: Myrkwood: Offshoot is a top-down survival defense game that you can play with your friends! Spawn with 5 other people and defend the objective, the Gem, as Bombrats and hordes of monsters attempt to try to crack it. Dodge, slash, & fight as you attempt to try to get the highest waves survived. Features Online/local multiplayer - You and 5 other players can join the same lobby and defend the Gem together! Upgrade your character! Buy upgrades & items to help you defend the Gem! Chat with friends! Chat with your friends to help coordinate and communicate better! Nice pixel art graphics! Well, at least we think so.  Endless waves! Fight through endless waves with increasing difficulty.  Dungeon crawler! Run through endless rooms & fight through hordes of monsters as you try to get the highest completed room counts.  Enemy variants! Enemies become more difficult by becoming stronger and having multiple powers to try to kill you! :)

rows.name: Champions of The Cosmos
rows.short_description: Champions of the Cosmos is a retro sci-fi RTS inspired by 80's action figures, comics and movies. Play heroes with the power to reshape the landscape around them and other unique abilities to take over the cosmos and choose whichever side you sympathize with most - light or darkness.
rows.description_html: Champions of the Cosmos is a retro sci-fi RTS inspired by 80's action figures, comics and movies. Play heroes with the power to reshape the landscape around them and other unique abilities to take over the cosmos and choose whichever side you sympathize with most - light or darkness.  Developed as a vertical slice in just four months, this student project presents a playable demo that offers a first glimpse of our vision. Terraforming Harness the power of the rare ore Terranium to reshape the battlefield in the heat of combat. Raise hills and mountains to your advantage or tear open the ground and hurl your enemies into the planet’s core. Even greater powers await those who master the Terranium Laboratory , where new abilities can be researched and unleashed. Light and Darkness   Choose which side you will conquer the galaxy with, light or darkness. Each faction offers unique heroes and slightly different mechanics. All units on both sides are fully and authentically voice-acted. Game Modes In Champions of the Cosmos , you can choose between three modes. Learn the basics of both factions, combat, and general gameplay flow in the Tutorial. Embark on a narrative-driven journey in the Campaign, or challenge yourself against the AI in Skirmish-Mode, on three distinct maps to test your skills and mastery of the game.

rows.name: Alien Brothers 2
rows.short_description: 《Alien Brothers 2》is a top-down ARPG. Loot dark fantasy gear with random stats, runes, and upgrades. Skills auto-fire. Control everything with just a mouse or an Xbox controller. Rise from nothing, defeat the Demon King's legion, and save the galaxy!
rows.description_html: ◆  Please note: Multiple AMD users have reported game stuttering. Workaround: Disable AMD's anti-lag feature ◆Defeat enemies to obtain equipment and runes of different color qualities. The entries and values of the equipment change randomly. rows.name: The Day of the Jellyfish
rows.short_description: A point-and-click comedy adventure game featuring original pixel-art and music, quirky puzzles, and fully voice acted dialogue. Play as Hank and Duck, who only showed up in town to put on a rockin' concert, but ended up smack dab in the middle of a mutating cola-based pollution catastrophe.
rows.description_html: Your friendly neighborhood soft drink corporation has been polluting the ocean and mutating the local sea life, just as the 80s' newest upcoming band BLUEBERRY FINN is entering town for a show. Hank and Duck need to split up if they're going to stop the evil that is afoot, and save all the beach-goers from being jellied! Escape from the Jellyfish is a point-and-click comedy adventure game featuring original pixel-art and music, quirky puzzles, and fully voice acted dialogue. The story revolves around two protagonists, Hank and Duck, who only showed up in town to put on a rockin' concert, but ended up smack dab in the middle of a mutating fizzy-based pollution catastrophe.   FEATURES: - Play as TWO different characters, classic adventure game style. - AQUA based puzzles that will get stuck in your brain for hours! - Learn about the environment and what to do to protect it!  - Feel like you are in '80 again! (Or for the first time. I'm looking at you, Generation Z). - Defeat the Evil Jellyfish! - Beautiful OST

rows.name: Do NOT say 21!
rows.short_description: A free AI slop counting game, where the objective is simply to avoid the number 21. Do you have enough brain cells to win?
rows.description_html: Layla is bored and wants to play a game with you. According to her, you must take turns counting upwards in groups of up to 3. But you must count in a way that you don’t end up being the one to say the number 21.  Actually requires your brain While her game’s premise is staggeringly simple, it will require the use of some of your finest brain cells to figure out how to beat her. And if you do, you’ll get an achievement.  Gameplay: The 'How to play' trailer is for entertainment purposes only. When you actual play the 21 game, Layla will not tolerate any funny business. You can only play by the rules - there are no dialog options for illegal game moves. The goal is simply to beat her 3x in a row for the achievement. Controls: Press spacebar to count when it’s your turn. Included with your purchase: A simple but perplexing arithmetic challenge Single button gameplay Achievements Spoken dialog with subtitles The numbers 1 through 21 An annoying girl (ft Layla)  DLC and extras: If you've enjoyed counting with Layla, there are some optional donation DLCs available which allow you to take Layla to new locations.

rows.name: BIRDHOUSE
rows.short_description: A short narrative-driven horror game made in RPGmaker featuring hand-drawn graphics and animated cutscenes. Players navigate the house and its backyard, interacting with the environment and collecting key items to progress the story.
rows.description_html: BIRDHOUSE is a short interactive horror experience created by HELLLST4R featuring hand drawn graphics, animated cutscenes, and an original soundtrack. Wick, a young human-like creature, lives in a secluded forest home with a loving deity. As he completes chores around the house and discovers a mysterious abandoned egg in the backyard, he must grapple with visions and strange occurrences that begin to plague his once tranquil home. All is not as it seems in this quiet house... FEATURES Narrative-driven eldritch horror game Digitally painted graphics and animated cutscenes An original ambient soundtrack  Walking simulator that uses key items and interactables to progress the story Collectible pages that provide world-building exposition Short playtime, meant to be completed in one sitting  IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS: Please contact me at helllst4r@gmail.com with details about the issue you encountered so I can quickly fix it.

rows.name: PANTSU: Atty's Collection
rows.short_description: A casual anime game with mini-games to collect panties, which are used to rank up, unlock levels, and buy items to customize your own character. Lighthearted with funny descriptions.
rows.description_html: PANTSU: Atty’s Collection is a casual online single-player collecting game, where you help Atty, Mizu, Sasa, and Rikki collect a constantly growing list of panties in the world. Fill up your collection, earn panty points, and use those panty points to unlock higher levels and more outfits to customize your own member! Brief Story: Atty is the founder of Atty’s Secret Base, which is a secret organization designed to find and collect (steal) panties. PANTSU is a specialized team that stands for the “Panty Acquisition Network, Team Star Unit,” which specializes in stealing panties directly from people to add to the collection. Atty, Mizu, Rikki, and Sasa (with the panda bears) are the main members of PANTSU, and need your help to collect them all! Game Style: Each of the characters has their own unique style of collecting panties. Atty has a reaction time method of collecting panties, where you will need to press the screen when the yellow bar is within the pink circle. Mizu is very calculated in her approach to collecting panties. Solve “simple” math problems to find a way to collect panties with her method. Sasa's style is based on her ability to manage the little pandas she takes care of. She helps control the chaos that the pandas make when collecting panties. Tap on the circles in order from lowest to highest to collect panties. Rikki’s style simulates the complex maneuvers she makes with her tail to collect panties. Drag the coin through the maze, collect the keys to open the door, and drop the coin into the treasure chest. Collection: Fill up your panty collection in each stage. Each character has their own Legendary panty that reflects a portion of their personality. Mizu, Sasa, and Rikki each have their own variety of legendary panties they can find, so mastering all the styles of play is needed to complete the collection! Progression: Each panty, based on rarity, will earn you panty points. These panty points can be redeemed to increase your level, which will unlock more stages and more outfits for your member to buy. Check the leaderboard to determine your rank in Atty's Secret Base! Character Customization: You can build your own member in Atty’s Secret Base, and you can currently use your member to stop thieves from stealing your properly stolen panties! More features will be coming soon.

rows.name: MU: Dark Epoch
rows.short_description: MU: Dark Epoch is a fantasy MMORPG mobile game that combines high quality, fast-paced gameplay, and innovative features. As the best MU instalment in the series by far, it offers impressive dynamic costumes and stunning graphic performance. Log in now and win the Archangel Set!
rows.description_html: MU: Dark Epoch is a fantasy MMORPG mobile game that combines high quality, fast-paced gameplay, and innovative features. As the best MU instalment in the series by far, it offers impressive dynamic costumes and stunning graphic performance. Log in now and win the Archangel Set! [Iconic Classes] Classic remastered classes with countless branches available for class change. [Epic Battles] Team up with friends to conquer dungeons, establish the strongest guild, gather companions, and engage in thrilling PvP battles in Roland City. Who will secure dominance in the server?
