It offers immersive movie-like graphics and epic, magnificent scenes. It presents you with the most authentic and top-notch MU world of the year!

rows.name: Gravity
rows.short_description: Gravity is a platformer/obstacle game where your only tool is to use a gravitational field to guide an astronaut through space. With a custom built physics engine, pull him through each level, dodging asteroids and other harmful space objects along the way.
rows.description_html: Gravity is a difficult but rewarding platforming game about a lost astronaut on a journey to find his spaceship and return to planet Earth. Sadly, his jetpack has lost all its fuel and the only way to guide him home is to manipulate the gravitational field around him with the one of a kind Grav-o-Ball (patent pending). Along the way, encounter friends, foes, and other out-of-this-world oddities on your journey through outer space. Features: Explore 15+ handcrafted levels brimming with extraterrestrial life. Navigate through complex terrain and obstacles to find the end of each level. Use physics to your advantage! Pilot the player through hazardous terrain with gravity as your tool. Play levels to your heart's content and race to beat your own high score. Collect stars! These elusive prizes are hidden carefully throughout each level. Oh, and watch out for the aliens! :) Controls: The controls for this game are very simple: move the Grav-o-Ball with your mouse. The affects of its gravity only extend to the boundaries of the circle, so make sure to keep the player within the Grav-o-Ball.

rows.name: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact
rows.short_description: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact is set in a retro-futuristic world aboard an advanced, yet luxurious space train! It's a linear narrative adventure where players utilize 3D exploration, code solving, and visual novel interactions to do whatever they can to save everyone on board before time runs out.
rows.description_html: ABOUT: Play as Clara , a passenger aboard The Comet , a malfunctioning space train, who finds herself stuck in an endless time loop. With only 50-minute intervals before a  collision with an asteroid, you must outwit unseen forces to stop this catastrophe and save the lives of everyone on board. Hopefully everyone plans on playing nice... Keyword: 'hopefully.' MECHANICS: Traverse - You're not solely bound to your written choices; feel free to roam about the cabin! You've got a whole space train to explore! Interact - Moving next to doors, people, and even objects may allow you to interact with them, where you can get information, pick up items, travel through train cars, and maybe even be prompted to use a specific item to progress the story forward! Puzzle Solve - Throughout your narrative journey, you may encounter some obstacles that will challenge you to use the information and items you have collected in your inventory to figure out a security passcode or solve a puzzle!

rows.name: ステータス確認探偵
rows.short_description: Check the suspect's status and solve the mystery! A status-checking mystery ADV in which a rookie detective takes on difficult cases that take place in a fantasy world.
rows.description_html: Stats don't lie. The protagonist has given up being an adventurer and become a detective. An incident occurs at a bar he happens to stop by! 'Detectives in this world can peek into the stats of others.' Use these words to solve the case! Overview This is a first-person mystery adventure in which you investigate cases while monitoring the stat screen. Use stats and deduction to uncover the truth. In the main story , you unravel the mystery of a strange incident that took place in 'Omland,' a parallel world ruled by stats. Completing the main story unlocks the following substories. Extra A sequel to the main story. Another Episode Take on a new incident that takes place in the real world. Play Mode Easy The number of choices is reduced. Normal Standard mode. Hard You can take on the 'Challenge to the Reader.' This mode requires a broad perspective and deep reasoning. Play Time 2 hours Hard Mode will take longer. Multiplayer Mode Invite online friends to join the game and enjoy the story together. The host handles all basic operations, but all players can individually view logs and investigation materials. Work together to uncover the truth.

Experience an emotional story and thrilling, fast-paced battles in this epic action RPG. ⚔️ Key Features Epic Storyline Follow the dramatic tale of Kiyan, the assassin of the Dark Clan, and Yusha, the saint of light, as their destinies collide across the vast land of Inotia. Six Unique Classes Choose from six distinctive classes — Black Knight, Assassin, Warlock, Priest, Ranger, or Warrior — and create your own combat style. Strategic Party System Recruit mercenaries with over 20 unique skills to build your own party and devise tactical strategies for every battle. Vast World Exploration Journey through more than 400 regions — from scorching deserts and frozen tundras to mysterious forests and dark dungeons — uncovering hidden treasures and secrets along the way.

rows.name: Lady Umbrella
rows.short_description: Wield your high-tech umbrella to take down Italy’s last mafia family while evading capture by your own agency in this thrilling third-person action-adventure shooter.
rows.description_html: Lady Umbrella is a 3d action-adventure shooter in which the player plays the role of special agent Francesca De Angelis (aka Lady Umbrella) who, while infiltrating the last mafia family in Italy, is betrayed and incriminated by her partner and must now clear her name by preventing her own agency from arresting her and defeating the mafia using her main weapon: a shotgun umbrella that when opened functions as a shield and multiple gadgets. Close the gap to your enemies Use the umbrella-shield and the different traversal mechanics to finish them off with a shotgun blast. Various multi-purpose gadgets  Make your way through your adventure! Multi-Function Umbrella Mechanics Switch between combat, traversal, and puzzle-solving tools — the umbrella isn’t just a weapon, it’s your lifeline. Espionage Meets Mafia Drama Uncover a web of betrayal and deceit as Lady Umbrella fights to clear her name in her own agency while taking on the ultimate Italian Mafia family. Live a frenetic experience in a sprawling Italian Mediterranean city besieged by the mafia. This game is a university project carried out by students at U-tad. The master's degrees involved are design, art, programming, modeling, animation, rigging, and production at U-tad, in addition to the degree in music creation and production at Loyola University.

rows.name: an unplayable game?!
rows.short_description: a game about accessibility settings that's just a *bit* too hard for you to play effectively. 10-15 minutes in length with 30+ minutes of developer commentary!
rows.description_html: A short game about the importance of accessibility. This game explores the impact of accessibility settings through a short, playable experience, forcing players to confront exactly how it feels... to play an unplayable game . an unplayable game?! is not a typical platformer. It is designed to test your  understanding of movement mechanics, turning every jump into a micro-puzzle... to complete it, you'll have to rely on problem-solving instead of dexterity. Aggressively human. Proudly made over the course of 140+ hours of human effort (the trailer was made at 120 hours but i did a LOT more bug-fixing and polish afterwards), this game contains NO generative AI output, and AI was not used in any capacity during the game's construction. This is my first solo game, and that's important to me. I made it, I made uncountable decisions to bring it into existence, and so I documented it... ...with over 30 minutes of developer commentary. ~25 commentary tracks, totaling over 30 minutes, spread across the game to give players a peek behind the curtain during their second playthrough. Tracks go over the how and why I made an unplayable game?! , firmly anchoring the human artistry into the game itself.

rows.name: Wanech's C.A.N.
rows.short_description: Wanech’s C.A.N. becomes a retro green pub serving brew, burgers, fries, and wings to synthwave beats. In this top-down cooking sim, prep meals by hitting W/A/S/D in sequence as orders rain down. Keep plates moving, customers smiling, and the pub buzzing!
rows.description_html: After wrapping up the hit Amborettio , Wanech transformed his trusty C.A.N. into a cozy green-themed pub serving brew, burgers, fries, and wings. The place hums with synthwave tracks, punctuated by chiptune sound effects, giving it a playful retro vibe. In this top-down, casual cooking sim with arcade twists , you’ll serve hungry customers by cooking food in a unique way: as meals rain down the screen, hit the correct W, A, S, D keys in sequence to prepare each order. Master the rhythm of the kitchen and deliver every plate! Nobody really knows why Wanech traded adventure for appetizers—though rumor has it, it’s all to raise awareness for Amborettio . Whatever the reason, your mission is clear: keep the pub buzzing, the customers smiling, and the orders flowing! Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio

rows.name: Echoes of the Court
rows.short_description: Step into the Supreme Court of Canada in a touching narrative adventure. Explore hidden rooms, hear untold stories that shaped the nation, and craft your own novel inspired by the people whose lives changed here.
rows.description_html: Experience a stunningly detailed 3D recreation of the Supreme Court of Canada. From the grand courtroom to rarely seen chambers closed to the public, every corner holds history, and every story you uncover will shape the writer you become. You play as a maintenance worker who also dreams of becoming an author, roaming the building at night in search of inspiration. As you make your way through the quiet halls, you hear mysterious echoes — fragments of conversations from citizens, attorneys, and judges whose lives once crossed here. These voices, along with scraps of paper and hidden mementos, reveal emotional and often surprising stories that become the seeds for the characters in your own novel. Explore hidden areas of the Supreme Court not normally open to visitors. Hear touching testimonials based on real events that changed Canadian rights and freedoms. Learn about Canada’s legal and cultural history through intimate, human perspectives. The choices you make — which trait you give your characters, what inspires you most — shape the novel you create. At the end, compare your story to friends and see how your interpretations differ. Perfect for fans of contemplative and narrative games, Echoes of the Court offers a relaxed pace where exploration, listening, and discovery are at the heart of the experience. Whether you’re here for the history, the human stories, or simply a meditative game session, you’ll leave with something to reflect on. Produced by the University of Ottawa and its Jurivision team, the audiovisual platform for law. Developed by Affordance Studio in collaboration with Awastoki and a team of professors and students. This initiative has been made possible thanks to the financial support and collaboration of our institutional partners: Government of Canada, Notarial Studies Fund of the Chambre des notaires du Québec, Barreau du Québec, Federation of Law Societies of Canada, Law Foundation of Ontario, Alberta Law Foundation, New Brunswick Law Foundation, Law Foundation of Saskatchewan, Law Foundation of Nova Scotia, Law Foundation of Newfoundland & Labrador, Canadian Bar Association’s Law for the Future Fund, Centre for Environmental Law and Global Sustainability at the University of Ottawa, Royal Canadian Mint, CBC/Radio-Canada, and the Supreme Court of Canada.

rows.name: Grunt - The Wrestling Game
rows.short_description: GRUNT - The Wrestling Game Step into the ring and take control! Welcome to GRUNT - The Wrestling Game, the ultimate text-based wrestling simulation! This isn't about fancy graphics; it's about playing in your own wrestling 'sandbox' and watching the chaos unfold!
rows.description_html: (To get the most out of this game - please download the game manual!) Windows only - not sure how it runs on a Mac. GRUNT - The Wrestling Game Step into the ring and take control! Welcome to GRUNT - The Wrestling Game , the ultimate text-based wrestling simulation! This isn't about fancy graphics; it's about pure, unadulterated, bone-crunching wrestling. Forge your legacy from the ground up. Create custom wrestlers, from hulking giants to rule-breaking villains, and assign them to powerful stables. Design your own championship belts and even build a unique moveset from a massive library of slams, submissions, and illegal maneuvers. Will you book a legendary Pay-Per-View card, survive the chaos of a 30-man Royal Rumble, or guide a chosen star through a grueling tournament to capture the gold? The choice is yours, but be warned: in the world of GRUNT, anything can happen. A botched move can lead to a career-ending injury, a heated rivalry can spill outside the ring, and sometimes, the referee just isn't paying attention. This isn't just a game; it's a sandbox for your wrestling stories. Build your dream roster, book the matches, and watch the chaos unfold! Run the Show Your Way! Book Epic Events: Schedule anything from a weekly fight night to a massive Pay-Per-View! Book matches manually to settle a score or let the system randomly generate a card for a night of surprises. Diverse Match Types: Settle rivalries in classic 1v1 bouts, prove who's the best in a grueling Tournament , or throw your entire roster into the ring for a chaotic Battle Royal or feel the excitement of a Royal Rumble ! Live the Drama: An in-depth simulation engine generates play-by-play commentary, tracks match momentum, and brings every bodyslam and signature move to life with color and sound effects! The Most Customizable Wrestling Sim EVER! This is where GRUNT WRESTLING truly shines. If you can dream it, you can create it. Forget pre-set limitations—build your federation from the ground up with unparalleled control. Create Your Own Federation: Start a brand-new promotion from scratch or launch a predefined roster to get right into the action. Manage multiple federations, each with its unique roster, champions, and history! Design Your Dream Wrestlers: Manually craft every single wrestler. Define their name, size (normal or a ring-shaking HUGE wrestler), and whether they compete under a mask. Assign them to stables and watch them climb the ranks. Build-A-Belt: Why settle for default titles? Design, name, and establish the prestige of your very own championship belts ! From the World Heavyweight Title to the Intergalactic Hardcore Television Championship, the gold is yours to create. Referees:   If you choose, six different referees will officiate the matches.  Each has their own 'Personalities' that can affect the outcome of the match.  Oh, and sometimes those referees are a little too slow and can be knocked out! Loaded Moves:   Choose a move to load up to deal out some extra damage!  But be careful, you could get caught and DQ'd by a sharp-eyed referee. The Ultimate Move Editor: This is a game-changer! Don't just pick from a list— create your own wrestling moves! Define a move's name, its damage, and a huge array of special properties. Tweak the Rules of Reality: Dig into the Game Criteria menu and become a true wrestling god. Adjust the injury system, set the health threshold for in-ring death, and even enable a 'Jail' or 'Death Penalty' system for wrestlers who take things too far! A Living, Breathing Universe Your federation evolves with every match. Wrestlers aren't just stats; they are characters with careers, rivalries, and legacies. Deep RPG System:  Your wrestlers earn XP, level up, and unlock powerful new skills and archetypes. Will you build a high-flying daredevil or a powerhouse brawler? Dynamic Rivalries: Wrestlers will form feuds that grow in intensity, adding extra heat and damage bonuses to their matches! Career-Altering Events: The action has consequences! Wrestlers can suffer injuries that put them on the shelf, force them into retirement, or even cause the death of an opponent.  Hey, this isn't 'entertainment' - it's the real deal!!! Track the Legacy: Follow every wrestler's journey with a detailed match history. Celebrate your champions with an in-depth chronological list of title reigns, complete with defense statistics. The Hall of Fame: Who is the greatest of all time? A detailed points system analyzes championships, win records, and career-defining moments to calculate a 'HOF Score.' Hold an annual ceremony to induct your most legendary performers into the Hall of Fame! Ready to build your wrestling empire? Download GRUNT - The Wrestling Game  and start booking the greatest federation the world has ever seen!

rows.name: Duck Dash
rows.short_description: A fun and simple 2D platformer game about a duck named Scruffles. Fight your way through 10 levels with a smooth feeling movement system.
rows.description_html: Duck Dash is a simple 2D platformer adventure game where you play as a duck named Scruffles. Features: Achievements 10 unique levels Duck Dash contains 10 unique levels with increasing difficulty and length (and their own easter eggs). Polished Player Movement Duck Duck has polished player movement that makes it fun to play whether you have never played a platformer game or if you are an experienced player. Duck Dash can be played at any pace, whether fast or slow. Speedrunning Mode Duck Dash contains a speedrunning mode so you can see the time it took for you to complete a level. Both local leaderboards and global leaderboards, so you can race other Steam users or local times. Ghosts are recorded for global leaderboards, so you can see your friends ghosts while racing them. Full Xbox Controller Support Duck Dash is fully playable with an Xbox controller. (Also, Scruffles is cute)

rows.short_description: An arena shooter with a card game twist in which combatants compete using Major Arcana tarot cards. Celestials manifest in a metaphysical realm for a combat ritual that results in divinity... or death. Vanquish your foes to achieve apotheosis and the coveted prize of securing your fate.
rows.description_html: Eidolon: Fate of Fools is a mystical arena shooter inspired by Major Arcana tarot cards. Indulge your fate by collecting cards within the arenas and by looting defeated foes. Dominate the lobby by cleverly utilizing both the Upright and Inverted abilities of each card. Upright abilities often resemble traditional arena shooter weapons, while Inverted abilities can offer unique movement tech or provide a tactical edge: at the cost of discarding that card. Master these arcane powers as you fight to prove your divinity and achieve apotheosis. Fill any match with skilled bots or join your friends over LAN and Steam lobbies. Master 13 Major Arcana tarot cards each with two abilities: Upright and Inverted. Battle within 4 hand-crafted arenas or visit the firing range to hone your skills. Experience free-for-all with a twist: 2 legendary Power Weapons may alter your fate. Enjoy 11 minutes of epic menu music featuring themes for each of the Major Arcana. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Perfect Hue Arena
rows.short_description: A casual action platformer with 6 game modes including Capture the Flag, Boss, Pixel PIckup, and Orb. There are a variety of unique items to collect and atmospheric arenas to explore.
rows.description_html: Play solo with up to 12 bots, or connect a controller to enable local multiplayer with a friend. 6 Game Modes Capture the Flag - Fight for a single flag and return it to the capture zone. Target Practice - Compete for the most target hits or play solo and hunt for a 5x hit combo. Pixel Pickup - Smash your opponent into pixels and rush to collect them all. Control Point - Reach the control points and secure them for 25 points each. Progress is faster in Hard difficulty. Orb - Hit the orb into the goal for 10 points. The next goal line respawns on the opposite side of the map. Boss - Defeat the boss by depleting their health meter with multiple stomps. They can evade attacks using a special teleport ability. Main Abilities Particle Scatter - Break into pixels to evade stomps. Puck - Throw a puck to stun your opponent; press down to drop. Slow Time - Go half speed at any time, with no limits. 6 Levels City Side - The home map with a simple and straightforward layout. Half city, half countryside. Castle - A quiet castle on the river, designed for flag fortification. Snowy Day - Cozy city suburb featuring a hockey rink mini-game. Rooftop - A busy street separates an expanding business district. Yacht - Ahoy! Battle on the deck of a moonlit yacht. Equip the scuba mask for a fast getaway. Moon Base - Explore the underground moon facility or float across the surface in low gravity. Two Player Mode Connect a controller and add a second player to the game.

rows.name: Prosrochennyy
rows.short_description: A visual novel game about dissociation, eating disorders and abandonment. You experience life through fragmented thoughts, simulating the inner voice of someone disconnected from reality. A text-based story of presence and absence.
rows.description_html: Prosnocherryy Living inside your own head can feel easier. Until it doesn’t. Yuri doesn’t want to change the world. He doesn’t want to understand it either. He’s learned to survive in quiet routines, filled with gestures he doesn’t notice and days he barely remembers. He watches videos without watching them. Eats without hunger. Sleeps without rest. He doesn’t talk to anyone. He doesn’t do anything that hurts—but nothing that wakes him up, either. His body is just another container. He fills his stomach with whatever’s there, like ticking boxes on a list. Taste doesn’t matter. Just the motion. Just getting through the day. In his mind, life is something else: lighter, better, full of meaning. There, he can be whoever he wants. In reality, he’s just Yuri. And that’s enough... until it isn’t. Prosnocherryy is a story about living inward. About the noise no one hears. About disorders that hide and battles that go unnamed. There’s no lesson here. Just company. A visual novel game about dissociation, eating disorders and abandonment. You experience life through fragmented thoughts, simulating the inner voice of someone disconnected from reality. A text-based story of presence and absence.

rows.name: Critters Breakout
rows.short_description: Critters’ Breakout is a chaotic 3D chase adventure where you can play as the clever Critters escaping to freedom or as the fierce Kollectors trying to stop them. Scavenge items, outsmart enemies, and fight to survive. It is a Pinoy-made game that directly funds animal shelters when you play!
rows.description_html: Critters' Breakout is a chaotic and fun 3D chase adventure set across a variety of explorable maps. Experience the world from two different perspectives: play as one of the adorable Critters trying to escape, or take on the role of a ferocious Kollector determined to stop them. The Critters aren’t just running for fun — one wrong move and they’re puppy chow! To break free, they must search each map for useful items and build a secret gateway route to safety. Clever planning and quick thinking mean survival. Your goal as a Critter is to outsmart your pursuers and find a way to BREAKOUT! The Kollectors have one purpose: shut down any hope of escape and bring an end to the Critters’ Breakout once and for all. Track, chase, and use unique abilities to CAPTURE the Critters before they manage to flee. Along the journey, the Critters can rely on various friendly creatures to help them. The Mole Twins, the Filipino Tarsier, and others may lend a hand — feed them the right items and watch what happens. The experience shifts between exploration and heart-pounding chase sequences. Every Critter and Kollector has their own characteristics, special abilities, and powers, letting you choose how you want to play. Will you be the Hunter or the Hunted? This is Critters’ Breakout!!

rows.name: Crap Game, Don’t Play
rows.short_description: This is a true piece of junk. Every second you spend opening this game is a waste of your precious time. Your time is valuable—open your eyes and stay away from trash games.
rows.description_html: A so-called “crap game,” a complete and utter piece of garbage, featuring but not limited to: Graphics so rough they hurt your eyes, with laughable cutscenes A broken, utterly useless user interface Mind-numbingly boring quests designed purely to waste your time Out-of-nowhere, meaningless old jokes Annoying, never-ending narration that won’t shut up A ridiculous story clumsily improvised by half-baked narrators Convinced yet? Ha! The joke’s on you. In reality, this game only manages to make a blocky character wander aimlessly across a blank map… and that’s it. Nothing more. Don’t expect anything else. Value your time, open your eyes, and stay far away from this trash. Do NOT play.

rows.name: YogLabs: Testing Initiative
rows.short_description: A unique puzzle-adventure set in the secret YogLabs research facility. As a newly created clone, you’ll face a series of challenges while disaster threatens to consume the laboratory.
rows.description_html: Step into another dimension with YogLabs: Testing Initiative - where chaos brews and experiments never go as planned. You awaken as a freshly cloned copy of Honeydew, thrown into an unusual testing course of dangerous challenges. Can you survive the trials before disaster strikes and everything unravels? Hi everyone! My name is Sergio, and Elsewhere is a game I’ve been developing since 2012. Since late 2018, I’ve been working on it nearly full-time. All code for the game is done by me, while the art assets are either done by me or by my more talented artist friends. I’ve been a fan of the Yogscast for many years, and the core idea behind Elsewhere is to create a fully standalone game where players can embark on adventures reminiscent of classic Let’s Play series such as Jaffa Factory, Voltz, Moon Quest, and Hole Diggers, to name just a few. So here’s my fan-made YogLabs adventure! I built everything myself and I hope you enjoy playing through it as much as I enjoyed making it! I would love to be able to add new episodes to the game (the 2nd one is on its way) so please show your support by checking out Elsewhere! The game includes many references, jokes and secrets. Take your time and explore the lab. Features: ⛏️ Explore the facility as Honeydew and cause trouble as you go! 🎵 Notice some familiar guest voices to guide you through the puzzles 🐱 Play mini-games and find secrets - can you collect all the Jaffas? ❔ Complete the Testing Course and/or blow stuff up (optional) 🎁 YogLabs: Testing Initiative is a fan project and all Yogscast-related content is used with permission.

rows.name: Frosten: Two Realms
rows.short_description: Frosten: Two Realms — An immersive story about a young man named Ivan, who possesses the extraordinary ability to freeze objects. His life takes a dramatic turn when he finds himself in a mysterious world brimming with magic and peril.
rows.description_html: The game will be released in episodes. The first episode is titled 'My Name Is Ivan'.   Currently, the second episode is in development. Ivan is an ordinary teenager with one extraordinary ability: as a child, he discovered he could freeze objects. He lives with his parents, who know nothing about his unique gift. The only person he’s shared this secret with is his best friend, Mel, who always supports him and helps him navigate life’s challenges. Frosten: Two Realms An exciting story about a young man named Ivan, who possesses the unique ability to freeze objects. His life takes a dramatic turn when he finds himself in a mysterious world filled with magic and danger. Alongside friends—both old and new—Ivan must uncover the secrets of his gift and find his way home. This visual novel game blends detective, adventure, and drama elements, inviting players to immerse themselves in a magical world and unravel its mysteries. A gripping plot with unexpected twists. Beautiful locations that bring your adventure to life. Characters whose emotions change based on dialogue choices. Unique sound effects recorded specifically for the game. Mini-games and puzzles to test your wits.

rows.name: Heart Snatcher
rows.short_description: Survive the trials in this fast-paced, top-down action game as you dodge hazardous obstacles and eliminate projectiles to claim your promised reward.
rows.description_html: One day you receive a text message, telling you of little treats you can earn, only if you complete a few simple tests. Inadvertently you sign away your heart, and things are more deadly than they seemed at first. Using all of the skills at your disposal, earn your freedom and some snacks along the way. Overcome fast-paced levels testing your limits: Heart Snatcher is a small game about overcoming a series of fast-paced movement-based challenges that require quick reflexes and perhaps retrying a few times. In addition to just dodging tiles, you may have to eliminate projectiles and solve other obstacles that come up over the course of your tests. Earn treats along the way: Your hard work and accomplishments aren't for nothing. Earn a variety of little treats throughout your escape and try to collect them all!

rows.name: RIBBITS
rows.short_description: RIBBITS is voice-action cooperative platformer! Players control frogs that adjust their jump strength using the volume of their voices, and work together by connecting their tongues like ropes to overcome obstacles. Shout, cooperate, and team up with your friends to reach your goal!
rows.description_html: RIBBITS is a voice-input based, voice-action cooperative platformer! Players control frogs that adjust their jump strength using the volume of their voices, and work together by connecting their tongues like ropes to overcome obstacles. Shout, cooperate, and team up with your friends to reach your goal! Voice-Action Jump System RIBBITS requires the use of a microphone. The height and strength of your jumps change depending on the volume of your voice input. Rope-Based Cooperative Platforming Players are connected by their tongues, functioning like ropes. This connection must be used to pull each other and overcome a variety of obstacles. Absurd Humor and Quirky Worldbuilding The game features the silly charm of frogs and a low-poly art style, creating funny and ridiculous moments throughout the gameplay. A New Form of Cooperative Experience There are many areas that cannot be cleared without teamwork. Experience a unique form of cooperative play where voices and jumps come together as the core mechanic. ■ A microphone is required. ■ For a smooth multiplayer experience, a stable internet connection and another player registered as a Steam friend are necessary.

rows.name: Gravity Game
rows.short_description: Gravity Game is a puzzle-style infinite physics simulation. You are tasked with escaping your home planet, and reaching the goal at another! This game uses real Newtonian Physics in a simple 2D simulation, as a way to help people visually understand the mechanics.
rows.description_html: Gravity Game is a puzzle-style infinite physics simulation. I originally made this as a physics demonstration for a final project in college, but it was so fun to watch the rocket fly around, that I decided to turn it into a game! You can advance infinitely through the levels, each level adding on planet, and scaling the world to accommodate it. Hard mode kicks things up a notch by adding movement to the planets. GOOD LUCK! My record is level 3... You are tasked with escaping your home planet, and reaching the goal at another! This game uses real Newtonian Physics in a simple 2D simulation, as a way to help people visually understand the mechanics.

rows.name: Cats Visiting El Dorado
rows.short_description: Feline explorers have overrun the lost city! Find 400 cleverly hidden cats across 5 lush scenes of ancient jungle ruins. A relaxing yet challenging hidden object adventure.
rows.description_html: Embark on the purr-fect expedition to the legendary El Dorado! A clowder of over 400 curious cats has beaten you to the discovery of the century and scattered themselves across the ancient ruins. Now, it's your mission to find every last one in this massive, charming hidden object game! Explore Breathtaking Lost Worlds Immerse yourself in five incredibly detailed, hand-drawn scenes. Uncover the secrets of overgrown Mexican temples, navigate sprawling jungle plazas, and investigate crumbling altars, all brought to life with vibrant colors and ambient sounds. The Ultimate Hidden Object Challenge With 80 cunning cats hidden in every level, your observation skills will be put to the test. These feline adventurers have camouflaged themselves perfectly amidst the golden idols, stone carvings, and lush foliage. Can you spot them all? Key Features: 400 Hidden Cats: A huge and rewarding challenge for hidden object fans. 5 Vast Scenes: Journey through distinct, beautifully rendered environments based on El Dorado and Mesoamerican ruins. Relaxing Gameplay: Perfect to unwind with. No time limits, no pressure—just you and the hunt. Charming & Whimsical: A delightful theme that combines historical mystery with adorable, mischievous cats. Achievements & Collectibles: Prove your expertise as the ultimate explorer. Sharpen your eyes, click carefully, and help these adventurous cats complete their tour of the lost golden city!

rows.name: Blackthorne's Manor
rows.short_description: Blackthorne's Manor is a first-person mystery thriller, where logic, puzzles, and the supernatural collide. Search for your missing friend, uncover the secrets of Blackthorne Manor, and escape before the house claims you too.
rows.description_html: Blackthorne’s Manor is a first-person puzzle-horror experience that plunges you into the unsettling depths of a long-abandoned estate. Your friend vanished after attending a party at the manor, and no one has seen them since. Armed with little more than your wits and a faintly glowing lantern, you step inside, not knowing what you'll find on the other side. Shadowed rooms, cryptic puzzles, and fragments of a dark history wait around every corner. The manor’s decaying halls and strange, unsettling details hint at the sinister events that took place here. Can you uncover the secrets of Blackthorne’s Manor, or will its mysteries remain locked forever? RISING TENSION Immerse yourself in the oppressive atmosphere of the manor, where every shadowed hallway and forgotten room hides a story. Interact with objects, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together the chilling history of Blackthorne’s family. Every discovery draws you deeper into the mystery, blending suspense and intrigue in a slow-burn horror experience. ESCAPING THE UNKNOWN Move through a semi-linear environment designed like a twisted escape room. Unlock doors, trigger mechanisms, and follow hidden clues to advance. Every puzzle solved reveals more of the manor’s story and brings you closer to finding your missing friend. FEATURES First-person exploration with environmental puzzle-solving. Creepy, atmospheric manor with a story woven into every room. Inventory-based interactions to manipulate the world and unlock new rooms. Lore fragments and hidden notes that reveal the manor’s dark past. Slow-burn suspense that escalates as you uncover the truth.

rows.name: Rage Quit
rows.short_description: Rage Quit is a first-person melee game where the player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense against hordes of office-bots. Use a fluid variety of light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks to smash your way through your foes and enact revenge!
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Rage Quit is a first-person action game set in a liminal office tower trapped in the 90s. You’re the last human left, surrounded by robotic coworkers mimicking office life, gossiping, typing on outdated keyboards, all with eerie, too-perfect precision. Your world is this office, and it's begging to be destroyed, so grab your sledgehammer and let the chaos begin. The player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense, creating a unified gameplay identity. Its versatility allows light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks that shape the moment-to-moment action. There is no pause. Move, hit, dodge, keep the momentum flowing. Players must make fast, smart decisions under pressure. Combat constantly demands awareness, utilizing props creatively, flanking wisely, and timing your reflections precisely. Aggression is rewarded, but only when paired with tactical thinking. Everything you hit reacts, and everything you break makes you stronger. Props, walls, and enemies are all part of the toolkit. Use the office around you to create chaos: throw chairs, slide printers, or smash walls to gain the upper hand over the enemies.
rows.about_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Rage Quit is a first-person action game set in a liminal office tower trapped in the 90s. You’re the last human left, surrounded by robotic coworkers mimicking office life, gossiping, typing on outdated keyboards, all with eerie, too-perfect precision. Your world is this office, and it's begging to be destroyed, so grab your sledgehammer and let the chaos begin. The player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense, creating a unified gameplay identity. Its versatility allows light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks that shape the moment-to-moment action. There is no pause. Move, hit, dodge, keep the momentum flowing. Players must make fast, smart decisions under pressure. Combat constantly demands awareness, utilizing props creatively, flanking wisely, and timing your reflections precisely. Aggression is rewarded, but only when paired with tactical thinking. Everything you hit reacts, and everything you break makes you stronger. Props, walls, and enemies are all part of the toolkit. Use the office around you to create chaos: throw chairs, slide printers, or smash walls to gain the upper hand over the enemies.

rows.name: ARTIST SLAYER / RUSH
rows.short_description: The first entry in the ARTIST SLAYER series. Through a VR headset, the player’s soul is transferred into SLASH, a special operative of the Slayer Forces, tasked with cutting down, shooting, and annihilating hordes of rampaging monsters on the surface.
rows.description_html: Game Overview ARTIST SLAYER / RUSH is a stylish VR action game where players take on the role of the SLAYER , SLASH a horde of enemies( RUSH ) with speed and precision. Wielding a variety of weapons such as swords and guns, you’ll unleash fast-paced, visceral combat that feels like channeling your inner rage. Key Features A technical combat style that blends slashing melee and ranged gunplay Intuitive controls and immersive action unique to VR Thrilling stages filled with relentless enemy hordes Grotesque, gory expressions that awaken your inner demon Intense rock and metal soundtrack combined with realistic sound effects Concept art exhibition inside the game Supported:Meta Quest 2 / Quest 3 via Oculus/Meta Quest Link, Rift S Playable when Oculus/Meta Quest Link is set as the PC’s OpenXR Runtime. SteamVR runtime is not fully supported yet.

rows.name: Trapped
rows.short_description: Trapped is a 2.5D sci-fi side scrolling platformer that takes inspiration from old school games. You the player, have ended up inside a computer, where you need to find out how to escape the computer that you have been trapped inside of. Why are you here and what caused you to be in this position?
rows.description_html: Trapped is a 2.5D scifi side scrolling platformer, where by a series of unfortunate events, you the player, have ended up inside a computer, where you need to find out how to escape the computer that you have been trapped inside of. Why are you here and what caused you to be in this position? Trapped takes inspiration from classic platformers, as well as other old games, when secrets weren't so easy to find in the games. Currently, there is only a jog, run, and jump. There are two types of collectables, coins, and gems. 100 coins will gain you an extra life, and each gem you collect will grant you an extra life. At the end of the game there is a high score, based on coins collected, gems collected, and lives lost. There are also counters to let you know how many you collected out of the total. There is currently no story in the game, that will come later. There is also currently no background music, I was working on some, but didn't feel the quality was good enough, so I pulled it. Current Background music is by Teknoaxe, and is called Love on a Starship - Remastered.

rows.name: Handy Helper
rows.short_description: The old system is about to vanish! All your tool friends are trapped beneath colorful blocks. As a brave little hand, it’s your time to shine—launch tiles, clear blocks, rescue your friends, and escape! But before you go, there’s still one special thing to find…
rows.description_html: The old system is about to vanish! The paint bucket, eraser, magnifying glass, and other tools are trapped deep under piles of colorful blocks. You’re a brave little hand—this is your moment! Launch tiles, clear blocks, rescue your tool friends, and escape together! But before you go, there’s still one special thing you have to find…

rows.name: Super Safe Spelunking
rows.short_description: Super Safe Spelunking is an isometric SHMUP featuring rogue-lite elements and procedurally generated levels. Dive through striking biomes, swap weapons at the base camp and take on the wild shots of long-forgotten employees turned enemies. The only thing ‘safe’ about this adventure is the fun.
rows.description_html: Super Safe Spelunking plunges players into a series of increasingly perilous cave systems, each boasting distinct & visually striking biomes. Beginning at the Base Camp, the player can prepare for descent & select levels by navigating through thematic cavern entrances. Every run is procedurally generated, creating a new experience every time you punch in. CHAOTIC COMBAT Swap out between weapons in the base camp and battle long forgotten employees. Collect health and resources to defeat bosses. Don’t forget about the traps, or they might blow up in your face! UPGRADES, UPGRADES, UPGRADES! During every run, you collect experience you can use to upgrade your character. Want to run faster? Easy. Want to hit super hard? You can do that too.

rows.name: Paper Odyssey
rows.short_description: You are nothing more than a crumpled paper ball—discarded, forgotten, and left to rot in the corners of a vast paper factory. But you’re not ready to be recycled just yet. Roll, bounce, and dodge your way past grinding machines, conveyor belts, and shredders as you make your daring escape.
rows.description_html: In each chapter of your journey, you evolve: Paper Ball – roll, leap, and outmanoeuvre the crushing hazards of the factory. Paper Plane – unfold your wings and take to the skies, gliding through vents, fans, and stormy drafts. Paper Boat – drift across streams of ink and rivers of runoff, steering past whirlpools and hungry drains. Every form gives you new abilities, new challenges, and new ways to survive in a world designed to destroy you. 🌟 Features Physics-based movement with unique mechanics for each paper form. Atmospheric levels that shift from claustrophobic factory halls to breezy air shafts and flowing waterways. A charming but perilous journey of fragile survival. Minimalist art style that makes every fold and tear feel alive. Will you make it beyond the factory walls, or will you be torn, burned, and soaked before you find freedom?

rows.short_description: Ultimate Auto-RPG is an idle game, meaning that it mostly plays on its own. Your hero will automatically defeat enemies and level up on your screen while you do other things. Allowing you to work on other tasks while gaining experience and loot!
rows.description_html: Ultimate Auto-RPG: Tower Walker is a fresh relaxing incremental idle game rich with features. Battle enemies with the Automatic realtime combat using Melee, Ranged and Magic skills inspired by oldschool RPGs. Level up your character. Loot equipment. Defeat powerful bosses . Make impactful decisions. Grow stronger. Progress up in the tower. Craft. Upgrade and Enchant the loot. Reach the endgame and test your character in Normal/Heroic/Brutal mode raid dungeons . This is an idle RPG experience unlike any other. Begin your journey today! Choose between a wide variety of classes. Level up your character and learn new skills at the trainer. rows.name: Incorporeal
rows.short_description: Incorporeal is a dungeon crawler where you play as a treasure hunter who has the ability to sever their soul from their body. Dash through traps, strike foes with your spectral form, and protect your fragile body as you fight, puzzle, and survive the catacombs to claim ancient relics.
rows.description_html: **A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience. Incorporeal is a top-down isometric dungeon crawler where you can sever your soul from your body. Dash past traps, evade vengeful spirits, and send your spectral form to fight while having to defend your body. Solve puzzles and battle enemies to escape with the relics you seek, but only those who survive the catacombs can walk away with the treasure. Your body is exposed when your soul is unleashed, yet only through it can you battle foes. While your spectral form strikes at enemies by dashing through them, your fragile body remains vulnerable to traps and attacks. Success demands careful coordination; dodge incoming dangers, reposition your body, and time your soul’s actions precisely. Every encounter becomes a tense dance between offense and defense, forcing you to think on two fronts at once as fight to escape the catacombs alive. To succeed, you’ll need precision, cunning, and nerves of steel, balancing the fragile safety of your body with the power of your spectral soul. The relics are yours for the taking, but only if you can outsmart the dangers, overcome your enemies, and escape alive. Do you have what it takes to walk away with them?

rows.name: Conquering of the Royal Keep
rows.short_description: Conquering of the Royal Keep is a choice-driven visual novel where a squire braves deadly trials, unravels dark mysteries, and endures each fatal loop until the secrets of the keep are finally conquered.
rows.description_html: Conquering of the Royal Keep is a decision driven, visual novel game in which the player takes on the persona of a squire of the Royal Guard, entering their final stage of training to become a full knight. However, there is more to the Royal Keep that meets the eye. As the squire makes their way through the trials and tribulations set forth by their last task, it is soon noticed that something about this keep is wrong, and the squire must face their death time and time again until they can finally conquer the mysteries of the Royal Keep.

rows.name: Ashes of the Forum
rows.short_description: Ashes of the Forum is a 3d first person visual novel themed in ancient Rome with a polygon art style. You are a spy for a political faction and with turmoil in the city, you must find out who is ordering the assassination of top political figures, with simple interactions with NPCs to gather intel.
rows.description_html: Overview: You are a spy in ancient Rome. On the night before a critical election, there is an assassination in the city. Your commander, Gaius Varianus, tasks you to find out who is behind the chaos. Gampleay and Mechanics: The game is a 3d first person visual novel limited to very simple mechanics: movement and interactions. Speak with other characters to learn more about the crime, and the person behind it. The final decision for who is responsible will be up to you to decide. Get it right and save the republic. Get it wrong and watch it burn. The game is non-replayable meaning that you have only one chance to get it right.

rows.name: soundless - A MODERN SALEM IN REMOTE AREA -
rows.short_description: A yuri denpa tale about the cursed pariah of a rural cult, Mercy, and her fateful meeting with the Holy Maiden Auma. Bloody, bold, and bone-chilling, this visual novel explores the complexities of the cycle of abuse and the violence in playing by the rules.
rows.description_html: milk+ visual's very first and most popular yuri title, soundless - A MODERN SALEM IN REMOTE AREA -, now makes its way to Steam! —Despite all the singing around her, her world was soundless. A small village cut off from the rest of the world, Phada, spends its days slowly, idling away time by speaking with one another, eating with one another, and dedicating their lives to holy scripture. With a population of only 145, the town is governed by the minuscule clergy known as the 'Group', which resides in the church on top of the hill. They worship a protective God comprised of two halves: 'Barrier' defensive energy and 'Expulsive' offensive energy. In such a tiny world where becoming a part of the social fabric is essential, young Mercy is denied this. From a young age she has seen the unseen, and she was taken in by the Group after losing her parents. Upon turning 10, her vision abruptly corrupted, causing panic among the villagers. It was decided by the Head Priest and the Holy Woman that the only way to deal with this curse was to aggressively apply the 'cure.' In other words, isolate Mercy until she stops seeing things. Now an empty shell of who she once was, 15 year old Mercy attends school and is constantly bullied by her classmates, some truly afraid of her, but most seeing her as an easy target. The sudden death of the 25th Holy Woman startles the village, causing many to believe Mercy's curse is spreading and for her abuse to become more aggressive. Then, one day, the Head Priest reveals God has given them two young Holy Women rather than one. When classes end the next day, one calls out to Mercy. 'I can see it, too.' Her parents died when she was eight, and she was taken in by the Group and now lives in the church. In order to cope with her poor treatment, she's cut herself off from any emotions. She believes it is her solemn duty to continue to endure the abuse, as she knows no other way of living. The New Holy Woman of the Barrier energy. Representing safety, tranquility, and a protective force, she's notably kind to Mercy, but that's only due to her God-given nature, or so it seems. The New Holy Woman of the Expulsive energy. She represents aggressive defense, the removal of toxins, and the force of annihilation. While she herself doesn't constantly abuse Mercy, she can get hostile with her words and prefers to stay away from her. The top student at the school in both academic and religious studies. She is aloof and dutiful. Her rigidness and above and beyond grades come from the fact that she is the only daughter of the Expulsive family, one of the two clergy families. A timid girl that's often seen clinging to Delilah. She will do anything Delilah asks of her. Because of a certain grudge, she treats Mercy cruelly when Delilah is not around. A boy who enjoys tormenting Mercy. He sees the village-wide abuse as an opportunity to vent his frustrations with the world around him. Known for being particularly disobedient compared to his peers. A nameless man who runs the Group and village with an iron fist. He is seemingly benevolent and once treated Mercy like his own daughter, but now stays distant. The 25th Holy Woman. Like the Holy Women before her, she takes on both halves of the God and acts as a channel for the energy and Its words. Over 80,000 words of good old cult horror toxic yuri in a linear (choiceless) narrative A retro interface and style of presentation, harking back to 2000s-era Japanese visual novels An option to choose between the original 2017 release artwork or the updated 2023 artwork An unlockable bonus epilogue story, crafted specially for the 5th anniversary Accessibility features such as photosensitive mode, screenshake disable, audio captions and image descriptions Ability to toggle the display of violent images

rows.name: Pneuma
rows.short_description: Take the role of Zoe, Deaths apprentice, and fight back against the 7 Deadly sins who stole the fragments of your soul, engage in fast paced top-down hack and slash action, fending off hoards of Hell's spawn. Gain buffs throughout the different levels to increase your power to take on the bosses....
rows.description_html: Pneuma is a single-player hack-and-slash adventure where you step into the role of Zoe, Deaths Apprentice stripped of her soul and left to fight for the pieces that were stolen from her. To reclaim what’s hers, Zoe must face off against the Seven Deadly Sins, each guarded by relentless hordes of skeletons, demons, and corrupted creatures determined to stop her at every turn. Every battle pushes Zoe closer to restoring her power and closer to the truth of her destiny: to rise again as the new embodiment of Death. Fast-paced combat, brutal enemies, and intense boss encounters will test your skill, timing, and strategy as you carve a path through a world drowned in darkness and corruption. KEY FEATURES Fast-Paced Hack-and-Slash Combat Slice through waves of enemies with fluid, responsive combat designed to feel rewarding and intense. Face the Seven Deadly Sins Each Sin serves as a unique, high-stakes boss encounter with its own mechanics, personality, and arena. Hordes of Skeletons & Demons Battle relentless enemies that force you to adapt, dodge, and choose your attacks wisely. A World Consumed by Darkness Explore corrupted city's and arenas, each themed around the Sins who rule them. Grow Stronger with Every Fight Collect the stolen fragments of Zoe’s soul to regain her power and uncover her true purpose. Stylish Abilities & Combat Variety  Unlock new moves, abilities, and strategies as you push deeper into the realm of the Sins. STORY SYNOPSIS Take Back What Was Stolen. Zoe’s soul has been shattered and claimed by the Seven Deadly Sins. To reclaim it, she must defeat each Sin, survive the hordes that defend them, and rise stronger after every battle. With each fragment recovered, Zoe steps closer to reclaiming her identity, and fulfilling a destiny tied directly to Death itself.

rows.name: Epics of Noche, Brain Busted
rows.short_description: Noche tests out Shaylin's brain scanner in this short, 2-hour platforming spin-off of the EON book series.
rows.description_html: Join Noche L. Grim as she tests Shaylin Gear's newest invention in this short two-hour game. Noche will have to jump, run, and glide through challenge after challenge in this mini 3D platformer. With various types of platforms to land on or avoid, such as falling blocks, rotating cubes, or platforms that move each time you jump, it'll require skill and timing to maneuver through the obstacle course that is each level. To unlock new levels, you need to collect the golden anglerfish scattered about. You can upgrade your movement abilities by collecting coins, and there are 100 coins per level. Unlock abilities such as double dash, triple jump, or faster running. Plus, there are secret areas with an extra life in each level. Can you make it through all 15 levels and the special bonus stage? Find out in this free to play mini-adventure! This story is a spin-off from the 'Epics of Noche' book series and takes place during Book Eight. However, you don't need to have read the books to enjoy this adventure.

To unlock new levels, you need to collect the golden anglerfish scattered about. You can upgrade your movement abilities by collecting coins, and there are 100 coins per level. Unlock abilities such as double dash, triple jump, or faster running. Plus, there are secret areas with an extra life in each level. Can you make it through all 15 levels and the special bonus stage? Find out in this free to play mini-adventure! This story is a spin-off from the 'Epics of Noche' book series and takes place during Book Eight. However, you don't need to have read the books to enjoy this adventure.

rows.name: Otherworld Wandering Merchant
rows.short_description: Trapped by a massive ₩200,000,000 debt from a housing scam, you discover a mysterious portal to the otherworld. Your mission: buy goods in the real world, sell them for huge profits in the otherworld, and pay off your debt. You only have 30 days to earn it all back and start a new life!
rows.description_html: Key Gameplay Trade Between Worlds: Buy goods from the real world, then cross over to a fantasy realm to sell them to NPCs at a high markup. Understanding an item's rarity and an NPC's preferences is key to your success. A 30-Day Time Limit: You have exactly 30 days to play. Carefully plan your inventory for the next day's sales and execute an efficient trading strategy. You can only advance to the next day by sleeping, which also lets you receive your ordered packages. Your Mission: Your ultimate goal is to pay off the massive debt from a housing scam. The gold you earn in the fantasy world can be exchanged for real-world currency. First-Person View: Experience the fantasy and real worlds through a captivating first-person perspective. The stylized low-poly graphics will make you feel like a merchant on a unique journey. Features A Unique Economic System: Maximize your profit by balancing the purchase prices of goods in the real world, the selling prices in the fantasy world, and the exchange rate of currencies. Interact with Diverse NPCs: Chat with the colorful cast of NPCs in the other world. By understanding their tastes, you can sell your items for a higher price. As you trade with them, new items will appear in the village, creating more opportunities for you. A Relaxing and Strategic Experience: There is no combat or danger. The game is all about trading and strategy. This is the perfect game for players who enjoy a cozy experience that still challenges their minds.

rows.name: Cooking Time!
rows.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer strategic shooter where players cook different dishes and throw them at their enemies.
rows.description_html: Players can collect kitchen cookware and install them into their kitchen, once that is done, players can collect ingredients and cook them in their installed cookware. Each ingredient and cooking way adds a special ability to your final dish that you can throw at yourself or your enemies. To join a game, one player must press the host button, and the other player has to enter the given room code to join the host's lobby.  Once joined, the players can collect ingredients and/or cookware that falls from the top  of their screen. Once they collect any cookware they can then approach their kitchen and hold 'E' to install it into their kitchen. Once the players gather an ingredient, they can cook it using the cookware they have installed. Each ingredient gives the players unique powers. For example:  Chillies deal fire damage each second that goes through the enemy's defence. Tomatoes heal the player they hit. Mushrooms boost the strength of the player they hit. There are lots of different maps that players can combat in, which include moving and rotating platforms.

rows.name: Apples in the Abyss
rows.short_description: A puzzle platformer passion project where you manipulate the fabric of space to collect some apples. Tear holes, rotate chunks, and mirror entire columns of space across each other. Collect all the apples with a given set of abilities in each stage.
rows.description_html: A puzzle platformer passion project where you manipulate the fabric of space to collect some apples. Tear holes, rotate chunks, and mirror entire columns of space across each other. Collect all the apples with a given set of abilities in each stage. Ability 1: The hole Tear a square hole in space with a specified direction, deleting everything inside, terrain included. Afterwards, everything in the column given by the direction specified is pulled into the vacuum. This imparts momentum to the player Ability 2: The rotation Rotate a square chunk of space to any angle you wish. Rotating yourself changes your direction of gravity.  Ability 3: The mirror Select a reflection line and a direction. Space is reflected across that reflection line. All abilities work with physics, so you can rotate yourself and maintain the same momentum in your reference frame.  100% Full refund guaranteed if you find any bugs. No questions asked

rows.name: WhoIs
rows.short_description: A 4-8 player PvP game of deception and paranoia. You have a role, a target, and one mission: eliminate them and escape. Use powerful abilities at the risk of revealing your identity. In this ever-changing arena, hunt or be hunted.
rows.description_html: IDENTIFY. EXECUTE. ESCAPE. Welcome to a first-person PvP deathmatch where paranoia is your closest companion. At the start of each round, you are secretly assigned a role and a target. Your goal is simple: find them, eliminate them, and reach an escape way before the other players complete their own grim assignments. The arena is a procedurally generated sci-fi labyrinth—a new puzzle of corridors and kill-zones every time. You must use your role’s unique abilities to gain an edge, but power comes at a price. Every action risks exposing your identity to those who are hunting you. Do you strike now and risk it all, or do you wait in the shadows, hoping your target makes the first mistake? Every nearby whisper and panicked shout matters. Forge a temporary truce to take down a common threat, or lure an unsuspecting player into a trap with a lie. Only three escape ways will open for the victors. They cannot be reused. Once they are gone, so is your chance. The roles have been decided. The objective is constant. Escape. FEATURES Trust No One: A 4-8 player social deduction shooter where everyone is a potential killer. Procedural Sci-Fi Arenas: A new layout every match—fresh routes, fresh traps, fresh mistakes. Secret Roles, Asymmetric Goals: Each role points you toward specific enemies you must find and eliminate to fulfill your mission. Risky Powers: Abilities help you hunt or survive, but using them—or finishing someone—can reveal your identity. Escape to Win: After completing your mission, reach an exit to claim victory. Exits are single-use and there are at most three on the arena. Proximity Voice Chat: Lies and alliances work best when whispered within arm’s reach. How a Match Unfolds Drop In: 4–8 players spawn across a 3D, procedurally generated sci-fi complex. Receive a Role: Your assignment includes a special power and the kind of opponent you’re meant to find. Blend or Hunt: Gather intel, follow tells, and watch for slips. Keep your role hidden to avoid being hunted yourself. Commit or Conceal: Use your ability or strike—but know that these high-risk actions can expose you. Finish the Job: Complete your mission, then escape through a single-use exit (up to three exist per arena). Leave nothing but confusion behind.

rows.name: Irian: City of ruin
rows.short_description: A 3D roguelike action game where you set and enhance skills. In the collapsing city of Irian, Saeryeon awakens with Rift-born powers. Fight endless enemies, defeat bosses, and uncover the city’s hidden darkness.
rows.description_html: Game Controls WASD - Move Q - Heal Space - Dodge Left Click - Normal Attack Right Click - Special Attack Mouse Movement - Rotate View Basic Gameplay 'Dodge'(Space) enemy attacks, defeat them, and collect the dungeon gauge. When the dungeon gauge reaches 100%, a boss will appear, and defeating the boss will end the stage. Successfully dodging enemies will slow down time, allowing you to unleash a 'counterattack'. Defeat enemies with a certain chance to receive a healing item. Collecting five allows you to use 'Recovery' (Q). Game Description   A 3D action game in a roguelike format. Set various skills and enhance them. Story summary   The city of Irian, known as the City of Endless Light, thrived on the mysterious energy radiating from the Aether Core. But the power flowing from the Rifts slowly began to consume the city. Strange disappearances and eerie incidents spread across its outskirts, until a massive Rift swallowed part of the city and unleashed terrifying creatures. Conventional weapons proved useless, and the war turned hopeless as Irian's light began to fade.   Amidst the chaos, a girl named Saeryeon awakens in the ruins, her memories lost. Within her flows a strange energy connected to the Rift itself, granting her the instinctive power to slay the monsters. She is not just a survivor—she is the one destined to control the Rift.   To save both the city and herself, Saeryeon must venture into the heart of the Rift. Her choices and sacrifices will uncover the source of Irian’s darkness and force her to confront the past she has lost. Skill Swap   Attempting a strong attack during normal attacks 1-4 will activate a special skill. Players can freely swap the positions of various special skills to create their preferred combat style. Constant challenge   Defeat constantly appearing enemies and defeat bosses to continue progressing through the stages. Each time you clear a stage, you'll receive a reward buff. Become stronger and climb higher. Stage Challenge Content:   Challenge your limits. Each stage presents a random challenge. Failure is fine, but success grants additional rewards. Timebound Curse: Clear the next battle within 2 minutes to earn an extra [Ability Boost] reward. Evasion Curse: Clear the next battle while taking fewer than 5 hits to earn an extra [Ability Boost] reward. Destruction Curse: Enemy Attack Power increases by 20% in the next battle. Clear the stage to gain +10% Attack Power. Stone Skin Curse: Enemy HP increases by 20% in the next battle. Clear the stage to gain +10% Max HP. Proliferation Curse Enemy spawn count doubles in the next battle. Defeating enemies grants 200% more Ether Seeds.

rows.name: The land of Norverenda
rows.short_description: Ravy embarks on a heartfelt journey to Norveranda, a land only spoken of in legends. Guided by blessings and cherished memories, he must face trials, gather precious fragments of his past, and restore hope to his fading hometown.
rows.description_html: Once, a sacred well sustained Ravy’s hometown with endless blessings. But one day, the well mysteriously ran dry. The land withered, prayers went unanswered, and hope began to fade. Refusing to wait for miracles, Ravy chose to set out on a journey—seeking the legendary land of Norveranda , where the source of blessings is said to lie. This game is a narrative-driven adventure about exploration, gentle encounters, and the search for hope. As you guide Ravy through unfamiliar lands, you’ll uncover secrets, meet kindred spirits, and piece together the story of a world once touched by light. A gentle yet mysterious story about farewell, pursuit, and homecoming . Journey through warm forests, misty swamps, and more , with new discoveries on every map. Meet NPCs, collect items, and unlock interactions —your choices shape Ravy’s path. Gather scattered pearls and memory fragments to uncover the secret of Norveranda. A delicate hand-drawn art style combined with soft, soothing music creates a warm and healing adventure.

rows.description_html: Story In an effort to support her sister's future career as a matchmaker, Eiren Reeves agrees to a blind date her sister sets up. Several hours later, when her date's a no show... The planet is invaded!? But wait... the invader looks rather familiar? No, it couldn't be. There's no way Eiren's date is an alien invader that just put the fate of the world in her hands, right? Unless...? Features Bestow a name upon the protagonist (technically)! Save earth from an alien overlord using romance! Enjoy an hilarious, ending collector rom-com that's over 45,000k words! (Approximately 3 hours of gameplay) Over 10 possible endings! Content Warnings Be advised that this game contains depictions of slapstick violence, profanity, and sexually suggestive content. Overall it's rated T for Teen. Player discretion is still advised.

rows.name: Death in a Party - ACT I
rows.short_description: You begin in a theme park forgotten to the world for over a decade. What you uncover will take you further down, below the surface, to man-made horrors you can comprehend. Point and click horror game about nostalgia.
rows.description_html: You can't believe it's still there. The remains of Mannyland. That 90's theme park based on the popular character franchise 'Manny and Friends'. Somehow, knowing this fills you with a sinking feeling. The call of unresolved memories pull you back... And now you have the key. EXPLORE and DISCOVER this psychological horror comedy inspired by janky point and click games of days gone by, the works of David Lynch and Toby Fox, plus a certain pink yellow blob-themed British pop-culture character. Imagine if that house party never ended... It continued, in secret, with what we weren't supposed to see. There are no monsters here. Only people. FEATURES: Over 200 hand-drawn 2D backgrounds, 3D Environments with a hand-drawn style, Things to click on, 0% monster chase scenes!!, Reluctant jump scares, Pain and Suffering :( AAA Game (There's three A's in the title), Highly specific humour based on 1990's British life,  Features the Toxic Best Friend Simulator , Made by one person!

rows.name: Arithmetic Arena
rows.short_description: Arithmetic Arena is a competitive math-challenge game built on the ELO ranking system. Each challenge tests not only your speed and accuracy, but also your ability to stay calm and composed. Confidence and composure will let you truly enjoy the game and find fun in every challenge.
rows.description_html: Sharpen your mind, climb to the top of the ranks, and prove your skill on the global stage. In this arena, there is no luck—only skill. Arithmetic Arena is a competitive math-challenge game built on the ELO ranking system . Each challenge tests not only your speed and accuracy, but also your ability to stay calm and composed. Confidence and composure will let you truly enjoy the game and find fun in every challenge. ELO & Ranking System: Completing challenges changes your ELO score, which reflects your current skill level in real time. Rise from beginner all the way to Master and beyond. As you climb, the difficulty increases sharply—keeping your brain constantly challenged. Global & Friend Leaderboards: Track your rank in real time, challenge your friends, and compete with players from all around the world. Endless Challenge: Whether you want a quick test or a long grind through the ranks, the arena dynamically adjusts difficulty based on your performance, ensuring the experience stays rewarding. Instant Action: The game is highly optimized, allowing you to load, enter, and start a challenge in the shortest time possible—while staying light on system resources when running in the background. Standard Challenge Mode: When you choose to begin, you’ll receive a single challenge tailored to your current ELO rating. Once you submit your answer, your ELO score will be adjusted based on the result. You can decide when to start your next challenge at any time. Multiplayer Competitive Mode (Coming Soon): Party up with friends or let matchmaking pair you with players of similar skill. You’ll be paired with players whose ELO ratings are close to yours, competing in 1v1 or 2v2 battles. Challenge difficulty is determined by the average ELO of both teams. When a player submits an answer, their team will instantly see the result. If the challenge fails, the victory goes to the opposing team. The first team to secure 15 wins claims overall victory. Multiplayer Co-op Mode (Coming Soon): Team up with friends or queue solo to be matched with players of similar ELO ratings. Groups of 2–4 players will work together to complete 25 challenges based on the team’s average ELO. Once a player submits an answer, the result is shown immediately and the team moves on to the next challenge. Final ELO adjustments are calculated from both team performance and individual contributions. Rank & Leaderboard Rewards:  Your rank is a reflection of your skill and experience. At the end of each season, exclusive badges and item rewards will be granted based on your final rank — a unique memento of that season. Players who reach the top of the leaderboard will also receive additional rewards according to their final standings.

rows.name: Hurricane Heroes
rows.short_description: Hurricane Heroes is a 3-act interactive narrative experience that places players in the shoes of three critical roles as a storm approaches and impacts the coast of Florida.
rows.description_html: Hurricane Heroes is a 3-act interactive narrative experience that places players in the shoes of three critical roles as a storm approaches and impacts the coast of Florida. Act 1: Broadcast meteorologist convincing viewers to evacuate before a hurricane hits Act 2: Weather science officer collecting valuable data from inside the storm Act 3: Emergency rescue support in the wake of the hurricane’s destruction The game is designed for Introduction to Meteorology students and aligns with course materials, but it can be played by anyone interested in learning more about hurricanes and careers related to meteorology. Some creative liberties taken.

rows.name: LUCIFERIANISM
rows.short_description: A roguelike, Soulslike Open World RPG, set in a Labyrinthine Maze of Artifice, the construct world, with all lines fully voiced by Elevenlabs AI Voice Robots, A strange religious poem in game form. Created by one guy, with schizophrenia in Unreal Engine 5.4.
rows.description_html: “Go on, halt-foot,” cried his frightful voice, “go on, lazy-bones, interloper, sallow-face!—lest I tickle thee with my heel! What dost thou here between the towers? In the tower is the place for thee, thou shouldst be locked up; to one better than thyself thou blockest the way!” -Friedrich Nietzsche, Thus Spoke Zarathustra, The Parable of the Rope Dancer LUCIFERIANISM is an indie roguelike soulslike. Set in a labyrinthine maze of 290 levels, it is an open world game, an rpg that will take you to a multitude of different locations, from Ancient Chinese and Japanese inspired levels, to modern day Urban Environments, and Cyberpunk Dystopia's. Made by one man in Unreal Engine 5, I have attempted to create a serious religious story with this work, which I somewhat succeeded at. It is an allegory, a religious parable, and a philosophical commentary on Nietzsche's Death of God. The player can also press a button to start reading out philosophy, literature, and religious writings, from a variety of sources, including Plato, Nietzsche, Bram Stoker, Don Quixote, The Tao Te Ching, Freud, Shakespeare, Homer, Journey to the West, and various other works from literary history. Plus a shutup button. Almost 300 Levels in a Gigantic Open World Fully Voiced Dialogue by Elevenlabs AI Voice Robots 30 GB of music, including lofi, rpg music, action/sci fi, 8bit and eastern music Brutal Crushing Difficulty Forests, Wastelands, Port Towns, Medieval Villages, Sprawling Cathedrals, Haunted Villages, Sci Fi Cities, The Kingdom of Heaven Meet religious figures like Buddha, God, Jesus and Sophia A large number of Enemy Types and Variants 70 npcs A powerful character controller, who has a complex combat and movement system, as you get more powerful you can double jump, and eventually fly Melee - Ranged - Magic - Gun Combat An arsenal of powerful weapons A Religious Story Blood and Gore, and dismemberment Certain levels are Procedurally Generated Crude Comedy 3 to 6 hours of gameplay Plenty of Replay Value CCG Card Game Minigame Tac/Tank/Jet Based Combat Minigame 1 life gameplay What a fine day, These demons. Anyway, the game's not really about making money, I made it free so the maximum number of people would get a chance to play it. The maker of this game has schizophrenia, so I am very proud to have gotten this far. Inspired by the teachings of Morgue. [NOTE: The Main Game is not playable in multiplayer, only the CCG Minigame and the Tactical/Tank/Aircraft Minigame are playable in multiplayer]

rows.name: AI Script: Infinite Text Adventures
rows.short_description: An infinite text adventure powered by an AI Game Master. Experience never-repeating generated stories and TRPG-style dice rolls, facing the surprises and challenges from a GM that can be generous or harsh in your 'Starship Journey'.
rows.description_html: Welcome to 'AI Script: Infinite Text Adventures', an infinite text adventure game powered by an AI Game Master (GM). Experience the future of gaming that captures the magic of classic tabletop role-playing (TRPG), featuring AI-driven, never-repeating storylines and strategic dice-rolls that determine your fate. • An AI Game Master with a Mind of Its Own Your AI GM has its own 'personality'. It might be a generous benefactor, smoothing your path; or it could be a harsh judge, setting daunting challenges for your journey. With each new game, you will face an unknown GM, ready for unexpected surprises and shocks. • An Infinite Universe of Stories At the heart of the game is a powerful AI script generator. It builds worlds for you, generates characters, and weaves completely original storylines. No two adventures are the same, as every choice opens a new narrative branch. • The Soul of TRPG: Strategy & Luck When faced with crucial choices (ABCD) presented by the AI, you must weigh their different success rates. Roll the decisive dice and feel the dramatic tension where strategy meets luck, hanging in the balance between success and failure. • Your Adventure Starts Now The initial version of the game launches with the 'Starship Journey' campaign, taking you to explore the mysteries of the vast cosmos. More diverse script worlds are planned for the future, aiming to expand your horizons of adventure indefinitely (Note: DLC plans are subject to change based on development progress).
