rows.name: Mariposa
rows.short_description: Mariposa is a 2D puzzle-platformer game that harnesses the butterfly effect, shaping the past to change the future. Every interaction with Mariposa, an automatonsmith from a utopian past, will billow out into time itself—and guiding a ghost from a forgotten era might be enough to change your fate.
rows.description_html: Mariposa is a 2D puzzle-platformer game that splits you between two worlds—a vibrant past where human society has seemingly progressed beyond the bounds of imagination, having harnessed technology to craft a shining utopia, and the other, a distant future where paradise has crumbled into an abandoned ruin, a wasteland haunted by humanity’s hubris. Follow Mariposa, a young automatonsmith who spends her days picking up various gigs after her shift at the antique store, enthralled with the bright, up-and-coming city. Cheerful, empathetic, and friendly, she’s always here to lend a helping hand! Her latest project? An antique radio that holds more than meets the eye.  When her voice echoes into the weave of time, suddenly this relic of a bygone era bridges the gap between impossibilities, threading a single line of communication from blinding elysium into something much bleaker. Let the everyday become catastrophic and the mundane become life-saving—let the simple flutter of butterfly wings change the winds of fate, forevermore.

rows.name: Gogyō
rows.short_description: After so much effort and training, the day of the final test has finally arrived. Under the guidance of Sensei, face off against other disciples to become the sole “Master of the 5 Elements.” To achieve this, be the wisest, the most cunning, or... the fastest!
rows.description_html: A mix of cards and game board for hours of free fun . Clear, uncluttered menus offer a wealth of possibilities: - a tutorial to learn the rules at your own pace. - play solo against 1 or up to 4 opponents. - a fun Xp system to unlock your game, step by step. - 2 expansions to renew the way you play. - a multiplayer mode to play as a family or take on opponents from all over the world. GamePlay : Chakras are scattered around the game board. To move, 3 types of cards are available: - 'Yin' to move backwards. - 'Yang' to move forward. - 'Karma' to interact with your opponents. Each chakra collected on the element circles (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) makes you a Master of that element. The first Master of 5 elements wins the game.

rows.name: Fragments of Dread - False Haven
rows.short_description: Fragments of Dread is an episodic psychological horror series. Each episode tells a self-contained story of dread, fear, and survival.
rows.description_html: Part 1: False Haven In the first episode, you play as Luca — a young boy staying with his grandmother while his parents are away. What begins as a quiet night soon spirals into a surreal and terrifying experience. After a disturbing phone call, Luca starts questioning everything around him. Is his grandmother really who she says she is? Would you make it through the night? Key Features Short, narrative-driven psychological horror Atmospheric sound design and immersive visuals VHS-inspired aesthetic and UI Real-time interaction via objects and puzzles Controls WASD - Move E - Pick up F - Interact R - In the blink of an eye ESC - Settings Menu

rows.name: Dungeon Run
rows.short_description: Race through 100 floors, collect all the keys, and compete for glory!
rows.description_html: Navigate through mazes, find chests, and collect 100 unique keys per floor to unlock the path to the next floor. Only the fastest and most cunning adventurers can reach the top! Key Features: 100 Floors of Procedural Mazes: Every run presents a fresh challenge with randomized chest placement. Competitive Key Collection: Collect keys, buy/sell with other players, and strategize to beat the maze before anyone else. Seasonal Competition: Races reset every season, giving everyone a fresh chance to claim the top spots. Are you fast enough to conquer the dungeon and claim your place among the champions? Every decision counts—every second matters. Step in, explore, and race through Dungeon Run .

rows.name: Wattson the Bulb
rows.short_description: A metroidvania platformer set in a bizarre world. Master unique abilities and combine them in creative ways to overcome challenges over a hundred hand crafted levels. Speed through to find the fastest route or explore at your own pace to unlock everything — a tough but rewarding adventure awaits.
rows.description_html: About This Game Awaken as a tiny bulb in a strange, beautiful, and hostile world. You remember nothing—only a spark of curiosity and the instinct to survive. As you explore, you’ll recover fragments of your past, master a growing arsenal of abilities, and learn to combine them in creative ways to outsmart enemies, outmaneuver hazards, and open paths you didn’t even know existed. Built around tight, responsive platforming and layered exploration, this metroidvania challenges you to chart your own route through over a hundred hand-crafted stages. Whether you’re a speedrunner hunting for the perfect line or an explorer methodically unveiling every secret, a tough—but fair—adventure awaits. Key Features A unique hero with a forgotten past: Guide a sentient bulb on a journey of self-discovery, piecing together who you were—and who you’ll become—through exploration and play. 10+ unlockable abilities: Dash across chasms, grapple to new heights, wall-climb, reshape your size to slip through tight spaces, conjure platforms, and more. Each power is simple to learn and satisfying to master. Ability combos that reward creativity: Chain moves together to invent your own solutions. Convert a near-miss into momentum, link grapples into aerial routes, or combine size-shifts with movement tech to break through seemingly impossible challenges. 100+ hand-crafted levels: Every area is designed to teach, test, and tempt—shortcuts for the bold, secrets for the curious, and clean routes for those chasing gold. 5+ themed biomes: From neon cityscapes and eerie laboratories to alien cliffs, starlit voids, and slime-soaked caverns, each biome introduces fresh twists, hazards, and surprises. Multiple playstyles supported: Explore at your own pace to unlock every upgrade and secret. Or speed through, mastering routes and shaving seconds off your best times. Challenging but fair: Tight checkpoints, readable hazards, and crisp controls make even the hardest sections feel achievable with practice. Secrets and optional trials: Hidden passages, high-risk time trials, and collectible passages reward mastery without blocking your main path. Controller-first feel: Built for gamepads with snappy input and clean readability. Keyboard play is supported as well. The World The world is bizarre yet cohesive: a patchwork of biomes stitched together by long-forgotten machinery and organic growth. City ruins loom over shimmering laboratories; wind-scoured cliffs give way to subterranean slime nests and star-dusted vistas. Every zone layers new mechanics and visual storytelling on top of your growing toolkit, inviting you to revisit past areas with fresh eyes and newfound skills. Progression You Can Feel Learn, don’t just level: Your strength is defined by knowledge—of routes, of timing, and of your abilities. Each upgrade opens both obvious doors and subtle techniques. Meaningful unlocks: Every ability changes how you move and think, encouraging inventive solutions and enabling elegant, high-skill routes. Non-linear paths: Multiple ways forward, optional challenges, and plenty of reasons to return to earlier zones with a stronger kit. Built for Skimming—and Depth Jump in quickly: Early levels teach by doing, with clear signposting and intuitive hazard design. Mastery at the top end: Advanced tech and clever ability chains let experts express skill and creativity in spectacular ways. Visuals and Feel Crisp, readable art: Environments and hazards are designed for clarity at speed. Distinct biomes: Each area is instantly recognizable, with new platforming concepts and ambient storytelling. Satisfying feedback: Snappy movement, responsive air control, and punchy audio cues make every success feel earned. Perfect for Speedrunners and Explorers Speedrunner-friendly routes: Clean lines, advanced skips (if you can pull them off), and time-focused challenges. Completionist bliss: Hidden rooms, ability-gated secrets, and collectible routes that reward thorough exploration. Accessibility and Options Play your way: Tweak difficulty-related options, adjust visuals and audio, and configure controls to suit your preferences. Fair checkpoints: Practice tricky sections without losing long stretches of progress.

rows.name: Aphasie
rows.short_description: Aphasie is an open-world immersive sim of action and stealth that puts you in the role of Mastema, the Angel of Cataclysms. Explore the dynamic environment of the city of Babel, use your powers, stealth, or a wide array of weapons and tools to bring down the tower.
rows.description_html: Human madness rises in the form of a tower… Aphasie is an open-world immersive sim of action and stealth that puts you in the role of Mastema, the angel of cataclysms . Evolve within the dynamic environment of the City of Babel, use your powers, stealth, or a wide array of weapons and tools to carve your way to the Tower of Babel. Freedom of action lies at the heart of Aphasie — there is always more than one way to achieve your objective. Main Features: A living and reactive open world: Citizens and guards roam the city and engage in a wide variety of interactions, whether with the player or with each other. The city is filled with tools, quests, and hidden interactions to uncover. Total freedom of approach: Every obstacle in Aphasie can be solved or bypassed in many different ways. Use blades and rifles to fight guards, attempt a stealth approach by disabling alarms, or rely on your powers and the environment to discover new paths. A spear can serve as both a weapon and a platform once embedded in a wall. A tossed gold coin can turn a civilian into a distraction. Hypnosis can transform them into an ally. Varied powers: Your fall from paradise has scattered several of your abilities across the city, it’s up to you whether to recover them or not. Among these supernatural abilities are the power to possess enemies, to create diversions, and many other occult skills. An original artistic direction: The world of Aphasie blends 2D paper-cut and calligram characters with a 3D city inspired by ancient Greece, set upon a colossal aqueduct. The city and its characters evolve within a minimalist universe that highlights key gameplay elements. Available in English and French. Destroy the tower, and reclaim your place in paradise. Music by Loic Dutronc

rows.name: Project Chromata
rows.short_description: Project Chromata is a deep sci-fi incremental game about restoring the universe by mixing colors. Unlock new technologies, prestige to gain powerful permanent upgrades from a vast star chart, and master automation systems to watch the numbers soar in this satisfying and feature-rich idle experience.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Project Chromata An idle, minimalist sci-fi game with a deep, unfolding mystery. You awaken as the Chroma Engine, a machine built for a single purpose: to create. In a silent, starless void, you must generate fundamental colors, mix them into complex new forms, and reignite the memory of a lost cosmos. Your Directive The universe is empty. Your function is to fill it. By allocating your power and building a vibrant resource engine, you can push back against the perfect nothingness. Each restored star is a new light in the dark and a fragment of a forgotten story, bringing you closer to understanding what was lost. Gameplay Create & Combine: Generate primary colors and unlock complex mixers to build an intricate production chain. Reignite the Stars: Use your creations to generate Light and restore a vast, explorable Star Chart , unlocking powerful, permanent bonuses with each constellation. Automate Everything: Evolve your engine with sophisticated automation to manage production and upgrades, allowing you to focus on cosmic restoration. Discover the Past: Uncover the secrets of the void through fragmented lore entries tied to your progress. From the Developer Thank you for joining the Project Chromata ! The game currently includes the entire first major story arc (Stage 1 & 2), offering a complete and satisfying gameplay experience from start to finish. We are hard at work developing the next massive content update, Stage 3, which will expand the story and introduce entirely new systems. We welcome you to our community and look forward to hearing your feedback as we continue to build upon the universe!

rows.name: Walk this road, again
rows.short_description: A free, story-driven short visual novel with no choices. The narrative weaves between the present (202X) and the past (200X), depicting the suffocating chain of violence within a Korean school setting with stark realism.
rows.description_html: About this game 'In the past, I was not even protected by my homeroom teacher. And now that I am a homeroom teacher, I am also not protected by anyone.' Present (202X) Z High School teacher Ko Hae-won's past traumas resurface when he sees Woo Jin-woo, a student in his class. Who is he? Long ago (200X) X Middle School in the era before the Students’ Human Rights Ordinance, when corporal punishment was widespread. 'I' was writing a novel as a hobby, but my homeroom teacher caught me... Feature Introduction 10 Chapters in total, no choice. Playtime: 1.5~2 Hours There's a depiction of violence and suicide. Please be aware. Solo development by Ren'Py. Photo retouching BG. Silhouette characters and no voices. English, Korean and Japanese are supported.

rows.name: Juvenate
rows.short_description: Juvenate is a 2.5D platformer where players will journey across three distinct levels—each featuring unique environments, enemies, and mechanics.
rows.description_html: Juvenate is a 2.5D platformer developed by a team of eight senior game development students at the Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD). Designed as our capstone project, our goal was to craft a polished and immersive experience that showcases our strengths in traversal design, combat mechanics, and visual storytelling. Players will journey across three distinct levels—each featuring unique environments, enemies, and mechanics. Juvenate blends fluid movement with challenging encounters, all set within richly detailed worlds brought to life through professional-grade 3D art, animation, and gameplay scripting.

rows.name: Forbidden Terror: Board Game
rows.short_description: A psychological horror game where you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old trying out a new board game, The Ouija Board, with his friend Emily. Little did they know, it was far from a simple board game.
rows.description_html: Forbidden Terror is an episodic psychological horror game where each episode unravels a different horror tale. Forbidden Terror: Board Game In the first episode of Forbidden Terror, you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old living with his parents. Jonah and his parents moved into a new house that they acquired for a very low price after a family was brutally murdered there and no one else was willing to live in it. Jonah and his best friend Emily, who is a huge fan of horror films, discover an Ouija Board at their local convenience store and bring it home for fun. They had no idea it was more than a simple board game. Gameplay The game is designed to fully immerse you in the story of the narrator. It is primarily an atmospheric, psychological horror, first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration and conversation mechanics. It features photo-realistic graphics, immersive environmental design and a cinematic aesthetic.

rows.name: Click-Her
rows.short_description: Click-Her is an adult clicker game that mixes the addictive satisfaction of clicker gameplay with fast-paced erotic action. Progress through increasingly challenging environments, unlock new characters and positions, and push your multipliers to insane levels.
rows.description_html: 🔥 Gameplay Overview Interactive Erotic Clicker – Each click triggers smooth, looping animations created in Blender. The faster you click, the faster the action gets, with escalating visual effects and massive score multipliers. Five Unique Levels – From the intimate Bedroom to the fiery depths of the Temple Below , each stage offers new challenges, ambience, and vibes. Timed Challenges – You have limited time per stage to rack up points, earn stars, and climb the leaderboard. Star Rewards – Earn Bronze, Silver, and Gold packs by filling stars during each level. Packs unlock characters and positions, but choosing when to buy is a risky gamble. 👩‍🎤 Collect & Unlock Characters – 5 unique girls, each with multiple variations (Casual, Sexy, Naked, Costumes, Legendary skins, and ultra-rare Shiny versions). Positions & Actions – Unlock 5 erotic actions, from classic Missionary to high-intensity Halfmoon . Rarities boost multipliers (from x1 to x5). Pack System – Spend points on Bronze, Silver, or Gold packs. The longer you wait, the cheaper they get; but after each purchase, prices double. Inventory System - Collect all your animations and replay them whenever you want. ⚡ Multiplier Madness Your score is driven by stacking multipliers: Girl variant bonus Position bonus Click speed bonus Example: S Annie (5x) + Doggy Style (2x) + Fast Clicking (3x) = 30x total multiplier! 🌍 Game Modes & Progression Main Campaign – Conquer 5 levels (Bedroom → Tropical Club → Beach → Temple Below → Mount Olympus). Bonus Level – Unlockable if you perfect all 5 levels: choose any map for one last high-score run. Leaderboards – Grind your way to the top! Inventory System - Collect all your animations and replay them whenever you want. 🛠️ Future Content (DLC Roadmap) New Characters & Variations Customizable “Tools” (different dicks & toys) Fantasy Creature Expansions Additional Levels & Maps Interested in what we do? Check out our website or join our discord server!

rows.name: Shrimad Bhagavad Gita VR
rows.short_description: The Bhagavad Gita holds profound relevance for humankind today, especially in a world marked by rapid change, stress, ethical dilemmas, and a search for meaning. The Gita addresses universal themes like: Duty vs. Desire, Inner Peace, Self-Realization, Equanimity, Detachment, Mindfulness.
rows.description_html: KlipVR brings you Shrimad Bhagavad Gita in VR “Experience timeless wisdom in immersive reality—anytime, anywhere.” In today’s fast-paced world, many feel overwhelmed, disconnected, and spiritually fatigued. Ancient wisdom like the Bhagavad Gita often remains out of reach—too abstract, too time-consuming, and not engaging enough for younger generations. That’s why we created Shrimad Bhagavad Gita in Virtual Reality —a fully immersive, interactive experience that brings the teachings of the Gita to life. Walk through the battlefield of Kurukshetra.  Hear Krishna’s guidance in your home.  Make choices as Arjuna and reflect on dharma.  Meditate with verse-based guidance. This is not just a spiritual experience—it’s a journey of clarity, courage, and connection.  Let Lord Krishna speak to your soul through immersive reality.
